file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: 体数据的基本概念与定义
content: 体数据记录了某个三维或多维空间范围内各个离散的格点上的数值，也被称为格点数据。在计算化学界常用的Gaussian型cube文件就是体数据的一种记录方式。格点间隔区域上的数值可以用离它最近的格点数值来表示，或者使用插值方法通过临近格点数值来生成。
topic: 体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: Basic concept and definition of volume data
content: Volume data records the values at discrete grid points within a certain 3D or multidimensional spatial range, and is also called grid data. The Gaussian-type cube file, commonly used in the computational chemistry community, is one way of recording volume data. Values in the regions between grid points can be represented by the value of the nearest grid point, or generated via interpolation using the values of neighboring grid points.
topic: Concepts, acquisition, and visualization/rendering principles of volume data
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: 间接体渲染与等值面构建
content: 间接体渲染得到的是等值面图，即这个面上各处的数值都等于用户设的isovalue值，需要先构建等值面模型（由一堆三角形构成）再按照标准的图形学渲染方法得到图像。构建等值面的方法非常多，最常用的是Marching cubes方法，其基本原理是先判断各个点上数值是否大于isovalue（大于记作1，小于记作0），扫描每个格子，若6个点不都为1也不都为0，就代表这个格子穿过了等值面。
topic: 体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: Indirect volume rendering and isosurface construction
content: Indirect volume rendering yields an isosurface plot, i.e., a surface on which the value everywhere equals the isovalue set by the user. One must first build the isosurface model (composed of a collection of triangles) and then render the image using standard graphics rendering methods. There are many methods for constructing isosurfaces; the most commonly used is the Marching cubes method. Its basic principle is first to determine, for each point, whether its value is greater than the isovalue (recorded as 1 if greater, 0 if less), then scan each cell; if the 6 points are neither all 1 nor all 0, it means the isosurface passes through that cell.
topic: Concepts, acquisition, and visualization/rendering principles of volume data
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: Marching cubes算法的拓扑简化
content: Marching cubes方法中，若一个格子的6个点不都为1也不都为0，就代表这个格子穿过了等值面。总共有2^6=256种穿越方式，如果考虑对称性的话，可以简化为15种。通过线性插值方法近似得到的与等值面相交的点用黄点表示，每三个这样的点构成一个紫色三角形，所有的穿过等值面的格子产生的紫色三角形连起来就构成了等值面。
topic: 体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: Topological simplification of the Marching cubes algorithm
content: In the Marching cubes method, if the 6 points of a cell are neither all 1 nor all 0, it means the cell is intersected by the isosurface. There are 2^6=256 possible intersection configurations in total, which can be simplified to 15 when symmetry is considered. The points intersecting the isosurface, approximated by linear interpolation, are represented by yellow dots; every three such points form a purple triangle, and the purple triangles generated by all the cells intersected by the isosurface, when connected, constitute the isosurface.
topic: Concepts, acquisition, and visualization/rendering principles of volume data
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: Marching cubes算法的模糊性问题及替代方案
content: Marching cubes的一个最大问题是模糊性问题，这会造成生成的等值面在个别地方出现错误，有很多人提出了不同方法去解决这个问题（可参考综述文章Computers & Graphics, 30, 854）。另一种构建等值面的方法是Marching tetrahedron，这种方法是把每个格子再切成5、6个或多个三角形然后以类似方法构建等值面上的三角形，优势在于没有了模糊性，而且等值面穿越三角形的方式只有2^4=16个，通过对称性可简化为三种。
topic: 体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: Ambiguity issue of the Marching cubes algorithm and alternatives
content: One of the biggest problems of Marching cubes is the ambiguity issue, which can cause errors in parts of the generated isosurface. Many people have proposed different methods to solve this problem (see the review article Computers & Graphics, 30, 854). Another method for constructing isosurfaces is Marching tetrahedron, in which each cell is further split into 5, 6, or more tetrahedra, and then the triangles on the isosurface are constructed in a similar way. Its advantage is the absence of ambiguity, and there are only 2^4=16 ways for the isosurface to intersect a tetrahedron, which can be simplified to three cases by symmetry.
topic: Concepts, acquisition, and visualization/rendering principles of volume data
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: Marching tetrahedron方法的优缺点
content: Marching tetrahedron方法比Marching cubes的优势在于没有了模糊性，而且等值面穿越三角形的方式只有2^4=16个，通过对称性可简化为三种，大大方便了编程。但缺点是会产生比Marching cubes更多的顶点，加重渲染负担，而且三角形的质量更加恶化，总有很多三角形面积非常小（对于等值面模型质量几乎没贡献，故浪费了计算量）。
topic: 体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: Advantages and disadvantages of the Marching tetrahedron method
content: The advantage of the Marching tetrahedron method over Marching cubes is the absence of ambiguity, and there are only 2^4=16 ways for the isosurface to intersect a tetrahedron, which can be simplified to three cases by symmetry, greatly facilitating programming. However, its disadvantages are that it generates more vertices than Marching cubes, increasing the rendering load, and the quality of the triangles is worse, with many triangles having very small areas (contributing almost nothing to the isosurface model quality, thus wasting computational effort).
topic: Concepts, acquisition, and visualization/rendering principles of volume data
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: 直接体渲染与间接体渲染的性能对比
content: 对于数据量很大的情况，第一次构建等值面（IVR）会花一定时间，一旦构建好了，再去旋转缩放视角就非常快了。而DVR方式下每更新一帧都需要重新算一遍，因此旋转缩放视角的过程的计算量会比IVR大很多。好在光线投影算法逐渐被转移到了GPU中实现，这使得计算速度大为加快，旋转缩放等操作可以实时完成。
topic: 体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: Performance comparison of direct volume rendering and indirect volume rendering
content: For very large data volumes, constructing the isosurface for the first time (IVR) takes some time, but once it is constructed, rotating and scaling the view becomes very fast. In DVR mode, however, every frame update requires recomputation, so the computational effort of rotating and scaling the view is much larger than with IVR. Fortunately, ray casting algorithms have gradually been moved to GPU implementations, which greatly increases computational speed, allowing operations such as rotation and scaling to be done in real time.
topic: Concepts, acquisition, and visualization/rendering principles of volume data
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: 体数据可视化的效果比较与二维截面
content: 等值面图（IVR）虽然可以比DVR得到的图更清楚、准确地定量研究体数据，但是图形效果上做不到DVR那么炫。因此，想做出富有艺术气息的体数据图，计算化学工作者们应当学会那些支持DVR模式的通用的、高级的体数据可视化工具。另外，考察体数据也可以用二维截面图，这能更清晰地展现特定平面上的细节，但没法同时考察整个空间的体数据。
topic: 体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: Comparison of volume data visualization effects and 2D cross-sections
content: Although an isosurface plot (IVR) allows clearer and more accurate quantitative study of volume data than a plot obtained from DVR, the graphics cannot be as visually stunning as DVR. Therefore, computational chemistry researchers who want to produce artistically appealing volume data figures should learn those general-purpose, advanced volume data visualization tools that support DVR mode. In addition, volume data can also be examined with 2D cross-section plots, which can show details on a specific plane more clearly, but cannot examine the volume data of the entire space simultaneously.
topic: Concepts, acquisition, and visualization/rendering principles of volume data
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: 体数据的格式与通用类型
content: 体数据没有固定的格式，不同程序有各自的私有体数据格式。唯一一个跨领域通用的格式是raw格式，就是将全部格点数据以二进制方式按顺序写入，没有经过任何额外处理，且连格子设定都没有在其中记录，也没有定义数据类型。如果没有额外的信息记录各个维度的格点数和平移矢量的长度比例，那么这种数据根本没法利用。
topic: 体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: Formats and common types of volume data
content: There is no fixed format for volume data; different programs have their own proprietary volume data formats. The only format that is universal across fields is the raw format, in which all grid data are written sequentially in binary without any additional processing; not even the cell settings are recorded in it, and no data type is defined. Without additional information recording the number of grid points in each dimension and the length ratios of the translation vectors, such data cannot be used at all.
topic: Concepts, acquisition, and visualization/rendering principles of volume data
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: raw格式的数据精度与记录方式
content: raw形式储存的体数据一般都是使用单字节(8bit数据)或双字节(16bit数据)的整数来表示数值大小的，数据范围分别是0~255和0~65535（假设是无符号整数）。很少见到以4字节整数方式记录（数据范围0~4294967296），以单精度或双精度浮点数记录的raw格式也很少见到。
topic: 体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: Data precision and recording of the raw format
content: Volume data stored in raw form are generally represented by single-byte (8-bit) or double-byte (16-bit) integers, with data ranges of 0~255 and 0~65535 respectively (assuming unsigned integers). 4-byte integer recording (data range 0~4294967296) is rarely seen, and raw formats recorded as single- or double-precision floating-point numbers are also rarely seen.
topic: Concepts, acquisition, and visualization/rendering principles of volume data
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: 浮点数体数据转raw格式的处理
content: 在一些计算模拟领域中生成的体数据是浮点数，可能有很大的数值范围，而且数值分布也不均匀（如电子密度是随着远离原子核呈指数型下降的）。如果转存为比如单字节的整数型raw格式就会越界了，因此就需要对数据范围进行移动、拉伸，这样才能让数据范围落在0~255以内，并且分布均匀，使作图方便。
topic: 体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: Processing floating-point volume data for conversion to the raw format
content: Volume data generated in some computational simulation fields are floating-point numbers, may span a very large numerical range, and their distribution may be uneven (e.g., electron density decreases exponentially with distance from the nucleus). If such data are directly saved as, for example, single-byte integer raw format, values would go out of range; therefore the data range needs to be shifted and stretched so that the data range falls within 0~255 and is evenly distributed, making plotting convenient.
topic: Concepts, acquisition, and visualization/rendering principles of volume data
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: 体数据的分文件存储方式
content: 体数据为了避免单个文件太大不好处理，或者受限于格式定义，有时会将某个维度拆成单独的文件存放。比如随时间变化的数据可能每个时间点都有单独的体数据，断层扫描的体数据可能把每一层的数据保存为一个个二维面数据。
topic: 体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: Multi-file storage of volume data
content: To avoid a single file being too large and unwieldy, or due to format definition limitations, volume data are sometimes split into separate files along a certain dimension. For example, time-dependent data may have a separate volume data file for each time point, and tomographic volume data may have the data of each slice saved as individual 2D plane data.
topic: Concepts, acquisition, and visualization/rendering principles of volume data
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: 体数据的应用领域与数值类型
content: 最常见的体数据记录的是三维笛卡尔空间分布的立方格点上的标量数据。在一些领域也使用更高维的空间、纳入时间的维度即形式，或使用曲线坐标、球面坐标以及三斜格子、八面体格子、四面体格子等其它类型的格子。每个点上的数据可以是标量，也可以是向量数据（如电场）或含有多个量的数值（如气温、气压、湿度、空气中各物质的浓度）。
topic: 体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: Application fields and numerical types of volume data
content: The most common volume data record scalar data on cubic grid points distributed in 3D Cartesian space. Some fields also use higher-dimensional spaces, include time as a dimension, or use curvilinear coordinates, spherical coordinates, and other types of cells such as triclinic, octahedral, and tetrahedral cells. The data at each point can be scalar, or vector data (e.g., electric field), or values containing multiple quantities (e.g., temperature, air pressure, humidity, and the concentrations of various substances in air).
topic: Concepts, acquisition, and visualization/rendering principles of volume data
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: 基于格点数据的科学研究方法
content: 除了用于可视化，一些科学研究中的数值方法也要借助于格点数据。比如在计算化学中，有一类盆积分方法就是基于格点数据的（用于AIM、电子定域性分析），定量分子表面分析（可用于研究分子反应位点、预测热力学性质、相互作用强度等）也要借助于格点数据。
topic: 体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: Scientific research methods based on grid data
content: Besides visualization, some numerical methods in scientific research also rely on grid data. For example, in computational chemistry, one class of basin integration methods is based on grid data (used for AIM and electron localization analysis), and quantitative molecular surface analysis (which can be used to study molecular reaction sites, predict thermodynamic properties, interaction strengths, etc.) also relies on grid data.
topic: Concepts, acquisition, and visualization/rendering principles of volume data
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: 获取体数据的测量技术
content: 能获取体数据的测量技术/仪器有很多，它们需要将测量到的信号进行重新处理后才能得到体数据。这类技术包括医学上用的核磁共振、计算机辅助X光断层摄影(CT)、正电子发射断层摄影(PET)、弥散张量成像(DTI)；材料学用的超声波扫描显微镜(C-SAM)；生物学上用的激光扫描共聚焦显微镜(CLSM)、冷冻电子显微镜；以及化学上的X光衍射等。

heading: Measurement techniques for acquiring volume data
content: There are many measurement techniques/instruments capable of acquiring volume data; they require reprocessing of the measured signals before volume data can be obtained. Such techniques include medical nuclear magnetic resonance, computed axial tomography (CT), positron emission tomography (PET), and diffusion tensor imaging (DTI); the ultrasonic scanning microscope (C-SAM) used in materials science; the laser scanning confocal microscope (CLSM) and cryo-electron microscopy used in biology; and X-ray diffraction in chemistry, among others.

content: 计算机模拟可以直接得到很多类型的体数据。比如量子化学上，可以计算轨道波函数、电子密度、电子定域性函数、外磁场下电流密度分布；分子模拟中可以计算不同粒子的密度分布；气象学/海洋学等领域利用流体力学可以模拟温度、速度、密度分布等等。

heading: Computer simulation methods for acquiring volume data

For example, in quantum chemistry, one can compute orbital wavefunctions, electron density, electron localization functions, and current density distributions under an external magnetic field; in molecular simulation, one can compute density distributions of different particles; in meteorology/oceanography and other fields, fluid dynamics can be used to simulate temperature, velocity, density distributions, and so on.

heading: Data classification in volume data visualization
content: Data classification in volume data visualization refers to setting suitable parameters so that regions of interest can be clearly displayed. Specifically, when displaying via an isosurface, it means setting an appropriate isosurface value; when using direct volume rendering, it means setting the color (RGB value) and transparency (alpha value) of points in different spatial or numerical ranges.

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: 直接体渲染与光线投射算法
content: 直接体渲染包括光线投射算法、错切-变形法、频域体绘制法、抛雪球算法、Sabella法、V-buffer法等等，这些方法可以直接得到屏幕上像素点的色彩值，目前最为常用的是光线投射算法。光线投射算法的基本原理是：从屏幕的每个像素径直引出射线，根据射线依次穿过的位置上的色彩值和不透明值（通过与之相邻的点的在数据分类阶段由用户设定的色彩和不透明度进行插值来得到）对色彩和不透明度进行依次累积，直到光线透过了体数据区域或者不透明度为1时停止。
topic: 体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理
fm_title: 谈谈体数据1：介绍体数据

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: Direct volume rendering and the ray casting algorithm
content: Direct volume rendering includes the ray casting algorithm, shear-warp method, frequency-domain volume rendering, splatting, the Sabella method, the V-buffer method, and so on. These methods directly obtain the color values of pixels on the screen; currently the most widely used is the ray casting algorithm. The basic principle of the ray casting algorithm is: a ray is cast from each pixel of the screen, and colors and opacities are accumulated sequentially according to the color and opacity values at the positions the ray passes through (obtained by interpolating the colors and opacities set by the user during the data classification stage at neighboring points), until the ray has passed through the volume data region or the opacity reaches 1.
topic: Volume data concepts, acquisition, and visualization rendering principles

file: 09-可视化与制图/127_体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理_卡片.md
heading: 光线投射法与光线追踪法的区别
content: 光线投射法与光线追踪法的区别在于后者发出的光在碰到物体时会反射、折射，不考虑穿越过程的色彩的累积，而只考虑相交处的情况。而光线投射法发出的光会一直径直前进并累积色彩，也因此不会产生阴影效果。
topic: 体数据概念、获取与可视化渲染原理

heading: Difference between ray casting and ray tracing
content: The difference between ray casting and ray tracing is that rays emitted in the latter are reflected and refracted when hitting objects; the accumulation of colors along the traversal path is not considered, only the situation at the intersection. In ray casting, rays travel straight ahead and accumulate colors, which is why no shadow effects are produced.

heading: Raw文件读写中的整数转换
content:
Fortran标准仅定义含符号整型，而raw格式使用无符号整型，因此读入raw文件的无符号8bit/16bit数据后，必须将负值部分分别加上256或65536以还原正确数值。输出raw文件前，需利用int1或int2函数将数据转换为含符号整型，大于127或32767的数据会自动减去256或65536变为负数。
- 读入后修正：负值 + 256 (8bit) 或 65536 (16bit)

heading: Integer conversion in raw file reading and writing
content:
The Fortran standard only defines signed integer types, while the raw format uses unsigned integers. Therefore, after reading unsigned 8bit/16bit data from a raw file, negative values must be corrected by adding 256 or 65536 respectively to recover the correct values. Before writing a raw file, the data must be converted to signed integers using the int1 or int2 functions; data greater than 127 or 32767 will automatically have 256 or 65536 subtracted, becoming negative.
- Correction after reading: negative value + 256 (8bit) or 65536 (16bit)

content:
多字节数据在二进制文件中的记录顺序分为Little Endian（低字节在前）和Big Endian（高字节在前）。例如整数32444（0x7EBC），Little Endian记录为BC 7E，Big Endian记录为7E BC；Windows和Linux程序通常使用Little Endian。
- 32444的十六进制表示：0x7EBC
- Little Endian示例：BC 7E

heading: Byte record order in binary files
content:
Multi-byte data in binary files is recorded in either Little Endian (low byte first) or Big Endian (high byte first) order. For example, the integer 32444 (0x7EBC) is recorded as BC 7E in Little Endian and as 7E BC in Big Endian; Windows and Linux programs typically use Little Endian.

- Little Endian example: BC 7E

heading: 无符号与含符号整数的数值关系
content:
无符号8bit整数范围为0~255，16bit为0~65535；含符号8bit整数范围为-128~127，16bit为-32768~32767。在0~32767范围内两者记录方式相同；当无符号整数值大于32767时，对应的含符号整数值为负值，两者换算关系为：含符号整数值 + 65536 = 无符号整数值。
- 16bit转换关系：Signed = Unsigned - 65536 (当Unsigned > 32767)

file: 10-化学信息学与脚本/128_体数据格式转换工具vodaconv使用与原理_卡片.md
heading: Numerical relationship between unsigned and signed integers
content:
Unsigned 8-bit integers range from 0 to 255, and 16-bit from 0 to 65535; signed 8-bit integers range from -128 to 127, and 16-bit from -32768 to 32767. Within the range 0~32767 both are recorded in the same way; when an unsigned integer value is greater than 32767, the corresponding signed integer value is negative, and the conversion relation is: signed integer value + 65536 = unsigned integer value.
- 16-bit conversion relation: Signed = Unsigned - 65536 (when Unsigned > 32767)

heading: g_densmap生成平面投影密度图
content: Gromacs的g_densmap工具可以将体系中某个组粒子的出现密度投影到一个平面上。使用-aver参数设定投影轴（默认为z，可选x或y），投影面即垂直于该轴的平面。参数-xmin和-xmax用于设定该轴上的指定坐标范围，仅将该范围内的粒子投影到平面上，最终生成.xpm格式的图。

heading: g_densmap generating planar projected density maps
content: The Gromacs g_densmap tool can project the occurrence density of a particle group in the system onto a plane. Use the -aver option to set the projection axis (default is z; can be x or y); the projection plane is the plane perpendicular to that axis. The -xmin and -xmax options are used to set the specified coordinate range along that axis, so that only particles within that range are projected onto the plane, finally producing a plot in .xpm format.

heading: g_densmap生成轴向-径向密度分布图
content: g_densmap可以制作轴向-径向密度分布图，需用-rmax定义径向最大距离，-amax定义轴向最大范围。操作中需定义三个组，第一组质心指向第二组质心的方向作为轴方向，两者中点为零点；第三组为求密度的组。结果xpm图的横坐标为轴向位置，纵坐标为径向距离，颜色代表密度，即不同高度位置垂直于轴的平面的径向分布函数。

heading: g_densmap generating axial-radial density distribution maps
content: g_densmap can produce axial-radial density distribution maps; use -rmax to define the maximum radial distance and -amax to define the maximum axial range. Three groups must be defined: the direction from the centroid of the first group to the centroid of the second group serves as the axis direction, with the midpoint of the two as the zero point; the third group is the group for which the density is computed. In the resulting xpm plot, the horizontal axis is the axial position, the vertical axis is the radial distance, and color represents density, i.e., the radial distribution function on a plane perpendicular to the axis at different heights.

heading: 计算分子周围二维密度的旋转预处理方法
content: g_densmap仅能沿x、y、z轴投影，不能自定义方向。为了获得平行于苯环平面的密度图（如磷酸化酪氨酸附近钠离子密度），需在轨迹拟合前旋转分子。使用VMD的mouse-move-residue功能，按住shift拖动鼠标旋转分子，使苯环与某两个坐标轴组成的平面（如yz平面）平行，然后保存为新的pdb文件。

heading: Rotation preprocessing method for computing two-dimensional density around molecules
content: g_densmap only projects along x, y, z axes without custom direction. To obtain a density map parallel to benzene ring plane (e.g., sodium ion density near phosphotyrosine), the molecule must be rotated before trajectory fitting. Use the VMD mouse-move-residue function, hold shift and drag the mouse to rotate the molecule so that the benzene ring is parallel to a plane formed by two coordinate axes (e.g., the yz plane), then save it as a new pdb file.

heading: VMD rendering of spatial coordinate axes to assist alignment

heading: 轨迹拟合与坐标范围设定
content: 使用trjconv将轨迹向旋转后的结构进行拟合，以目标分子（如磷酸化酪氨酸）组作为参考组。运行g_densmap前需用VMD估算合适的坐标范围，例如苯环平面上下几埃区域。运行命令示例：g_densmap -f A.xtc -s A.pdb -aver x -xmin 4.2 -xmax 4.8，组分别选择钠离子和磷酸化酪氨酸。

heading: 使用Multiwfn显示龙虾体数据
content:
从Multiwfn 2.3版本开始支持读入cube文件并直接显示等值面。操作前需在settings.ini中将aug3D参数从默认的6改为16，以确保坐标轴足够长。载入lobster.cub后选择功能0，在默认isovalue为0.05时图像不可见，需在文本框输入50并回车才可显示龙虾。由于 lobster.raw 是8bit精度（范围0~255），需要在该范围内反复调整isovalue以消除噪音或空气信号干扰获得最佳效果。Multiwfn显示高格点数等值面的速度远低于Molekel和VMD。
- 原始数据： (lobster.raw.gz, 301x324x56, 比例1:1:1.4)
- vodaconv参数：文件名 lobster.raw，点数 301,324,56，间距 0.1,0.1,0.14，数据类型 1，scale类型 2，输出 lobster.cub

heading: Displaying lobster volume data with Multiwfn
content:
Starting from Multiwfn version 2.3, cube files can be read in and isosurfaces displayed directly. Before the operation, change the aug3D parameter in settings.ini from the default 6 to 16 to ensure the coordinate axes are long enough. After loading lobster.cub, choose function 0; at the default isovalue of 0.05 the image is invisible, and the lobster can only be displayed after entering 50 in the text box and pressing Enter. Since lobster.raw is 8-bit precision (range 0~255), the isovalue must be repeatedly adjusted within this range to eliminate noise or air signal interference for the best result. Multiwfn displays isosurfaces of high number of grid points far more slowly than Molekel and VMD.

- vodaconv options: file name lobster.raw, grid points 301,324,56, spacing 0.1,0.1,0.14, data type 1, scale type 2, output lobster.cub

heading: Extracting data of a specified plane with Multiwfn

heading: vodaconv转换raw文件导致体积增大的原因
content:
cube文件体积远大于raw文件是因为文件存储格式不同。raw文件是二进制文件，8bit数据点仅占用1个字节；而cube文件记录的是字符数据，每个数据点需要13个字符来表达（即13字节），因此转换后的文件大小约为原始文件的13倍（如lobster.raw从5.2MB增至69.5MB）。
- 数据对比：lobster.raw (5.2MB) -> lobster.cub (69.5MB)

heading: Reason why converting raw files with vodaconv increases file size
content:
The cube file is much larger than the raw file because the file storage formats differ. The raw file is a binary file, where an 8-bit data point occupies only 1 byte; the cube file, however, records character data, and each data point requires 13 characters (i.e., 13 bytes) to express. Therefore, the converted file size is about 13 times the original file (e.g., lobster.raw increased from 5.2MB to 69.5MB).

heading: GaussView处理大型体数据的性能限制
content:
GaussView在显示大型体数据等值面时速度较慢，缺乏实际应用价值。处理几百万个点的体数据速度尚可，但对于256^3（约1600万）个点的数据已显得吃力，若体数据精度达到512^3（约1.34亿）个点则无法进行等值面显示。

heading: Performance limits of GaussView when handling large volume data
content:
GaussView is slow in displaying isosurfaces of large volume data and lacks practical value. It handles volume data of a few million points at an acceptable speed, but struggles with data of 256^3 (about 16 million) points; if the volume data precision reaches 512^3 (about 134 million) points, isosurface display becomes impossible.
- Performance thresholds: 256^3 = 16,777,216 points (barely usable); 512^3 = 134,217,728 points (unusable)

heading: AOIM方法计算原子轨道成份
content: AOIM方法通过正交投影在分子体系中还原出原子轨道，将波函数转化为在极小基下表达，然后利用Mulliken方法计算各轨道中每个原子轨道的成份。AOIM方法基组稳定性较好，但程序已年久失修，对Gaussian09的fch文件不兼容，不支持f及以上角动量基函数。

heading: Calculating atomic orbital contributions with the AOIM method
content: The AOIM method restores atomic orbitals in a molecular system via orthogonal projection, transforming the wavefunction into an expression in a minimal basis, and then uses the Mulliken method to calculate the contribution of each atomic orbital in every orbital. The AOIM method has fairly good basis set stability, but the program is no longer maintained; it is incompatible with fch files from Gaussian09 and does not support f or higher angular momentum basis functions.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: 原子及片段成份的计算方法
content: 定量计算原子所占成份的最直接办法是将原子所拥有的全部原子轨道所占成份加和（推荐NAO方法）。基于实空间划分的方法（如Hirshfeld划分）是通过积分轨道在原子空间内的模的平方来计算成份。Hirshfeld划分中A原子的权重函数为ρ_A(r)/ρ_pro(r)，其中ρ_pro(r)为自由原子密度叠加。计算片段的成份即将其包含原子的成份加和。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: Methods for calculating atomic and fragment contributions
content: The most direct way to quantitatively calculate the atomic contribution is to sum the contributions of all atomic orbitals belonging to the atom (the NAO method is recommended). Real-space partitioning methods (such as Hirshfeld partitioning) calculate contributions by integrating the squared modulus of the orbital within the atomic space. In Hirshfeld partitioning, the weight function of atom A is ρ_A(r)/ρ_pro(r), where ρ_pro(r) is the superposition of free atomic densities. Calculating a fragment's contribution is simply summing the contributions of the atoms it contains.

heading: Method selection for analyzing virtual orbitals
content: For high-energy virtual orbitals, the contribution of Ryd-type NAOs is non-negligible; in this case the summed contributions of the minimal-set NAOs deviate significantly from 100%. The NAO method is not recommended here; instead, the Hirshfeld method is recommended for analyzing atomic contributions.

heading: Analyzing basis function contributions in Multiwfn using the Mulliken method and others

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: Mulliken方法中基函数与壳层贡献的讨论
content: 除非分子的朝向已经清楚指定，否则讨论某个基函数（S型除外）的贡献没有意义，因为分子旋转后基函数贡献会变化。在不指明朝向时，只能讨论壳层的贡献，因为Mulliken方法得出的壳层贡献值不会因分子旋转而改变。Stout-Politzer方法下壳层贡献值也存在旋转依赖性。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: Discussion of basis function and shell contributions in the Mulliken method
content: Unless the molecular orientation has been clearly specified, discussing the contribution of a particular basis function (except S-type) is meaningless, because basis function contributions change upon rotation of the molecule. Without specifying the orientation, only shell contributions can be discussed, because shell contributions obtained by the Mulliken method do not change with molecular rotation. Under the Stout-Politzer method, shell contributions also exhibit rotational dependence.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: Multiwfn中定义片段分析轨道成份
content: 在Multiwfn中通过-1和-2选项可以定义片段（可包含特定基函数、壳层或原子）。选择选项4可输出片段对所有轨道的贡献。Mulliken方法下片段贡献Total由c^2（片段内基函数系数平方和）、Int.cross（片段内交叉项）和Ext.cross（片段与外部交叉项）组成。虚轨道中常出现负值。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: Defining fragments in Multiwfn for orbital composition analysis
content: In Multiwfn, fragments (which may contain specific basis functions, shells, or atoms) can be defined via options -1 and -2. Choosing option 4 outputs the fragment's contribution to all orbitals. Under the Mulliken method, a fragment's Total contribution consists of c^2 (sum of squared coefficients of the basis functions within the fragment), Int.cross (intra-fragment cross terms), and Ext.cross (cross terms between the fragment and the exterior). Negative values often occur in virtual orbitals.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: 片段间交叉项与Mulliken键级的关系
content: Mulliken方法将交叉项平分，两个片段间的总交叉项描述了片段间的相互作用程度。例如第三条MO中，片段1和2间的总交叉项为31.7743%，乘上轨道占据数2得到0.6354，即为此MO对片段1、2间Mulliken键级的贡献。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: Relationship between inter-fragment cross terms and Mulliken bond order
content: The Mulliken method splits cross terms equally; the total cross term between two fragments describes the degree of interaction between the fragments. For example, in the third MO, the total cross term between fragments 1 and 2 is 31.7743%; multiplying by the orbital occupation number of 2 gives 0.6354, which is this MO's contribution to the Mulliken bond order between fragments 1 and 2.

heading: Multiwfn中使用Hirshfeld方法分析原子贡献

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: 轨道成份的概念与层次
content: 计算轨道成份是计算构成轨道的各个组成部分的贡献，层次从小到大可分为：(1)计算基函数的贡献 (2)计算原子轨道的贡献 (3)计算原子的贡献 (4)计算某个片段的贡献。轨道成份不是可观测量，定义完全是人为的，文献中给出轨道成份时必须注明计算方法。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: The concept and hierarchy of orbital composition
content: Calculating orbital composition means calculating the contributions of the various components that make up an orbital. In increasing order of size, the hierarchy is: (1) calculation of basis function contributions (2) calculation of atomic orbital contributions (3) calculating atomic contributions (4) calculating the contribution of a particular fragment. Orbital composition is not an observable; its definition is entirely arbitrary, and when orbital compositions are reported in the literature the calculation method must be stated.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: 轨道成份计算方法总结
content: 对于计算基函数的贡献，最建议用SCPA方法；对于计算原子轨道的贡献，最建议用NAO方法；对于计算原子的贡献，推荐使用Hirshfeld、Hirshfeld-I、Becke方法或将NAO方法得到的原子轨道贡献加和。NAO方法不适合分析虚轨道。讨论某个基函数或原子轨道贡献时必须指明分子朝向，否则只能讨论壳层的贡献。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: Summary of orbital composition calculation methods
content: For calculation of basis function contributions, the SCPA method is most recommended; for calculation of atomic orbital contributions, the NAO method is most recommended; for calculating atomic contributions, the Hirshfeld, Hirshfeld-I, and Becke methods are recommended, or summing the atomic orbital contributions obtained by the NAO method. The NAO method is unsuitable for analyzing virtual orbitals. When discussing the contribution of a particular basis function or atomic orbital, the molecular orientation must be specified; otherwise only shell contributions can be discussed.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: 轨道成份计算方法的基本要求
content: 轨道成份计算方法必须满足归一（所有部分的贡献和为100%）且成份必须为正值。在满足这两个基本要求下，还应尽量满足旋转不变性、随基组增大而收敛、计算速度快、算法简单易于实现、物理意义清晰、结果与分子轨道图形定性相符、适用体系广泛以及数值稳定性好。

topic: 轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: Basic requirements for orbital composition calculation methods
content: An orbital composition calculation method must satisfy normalization (the contributions of all parts sum to 100%) and the compositions must be positive values. Beyond satisfying these two basic requirements, it should also, as far as possible, satisfy rotational invariance, convergence as the basis set increases in size, high computational speed, algorithmic simplicity and ease of implementation, clear physical meaning, qualitative agreement of results with molecular orbital plots, broad applicability to systems, and good numerical stability.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: 基函数成份计算的数学原理
content: 以HeH+体系HF/STO-3G计算为例，占据分子轨道波函数为ψ1=0.9*χ_1 + 0.1944*χ_2。归一化条件为1=<ψ1|ψ1>=0.9^2*S11+2*0.9*0.1944*S12+0.1944^2*S22。由于基函数非正交，重叠积分S12不为零，直接用轨道系数的平方（如0.9^2+0.1944^2=0.8478）计算成份是错误的，必须考虑对交叉项进行划分。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: Mathematical principles of basis function composition calculation
content: Taking an HF/STO-3G calculation on the HeH+ system as an example, the occupied molecular orbital wavefunction is ψ1=0.9*χ_1 + 0.1944*χ_2. The normalization condition is 1=<ψ1|ψ1>=0.9^2*S11+2*0.9*0.1944*S12+0.1944^2*S22. Since basis functions are non-orthogonal, the overlap integral S12 is nonzero, and directly using the squares of the orbital coefficients (e.g., 0.9^2+0.1944^2=0.8478) to calculate compositions is wrong; the division of cross terms must be considered.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: 基函数成份计算的Mulliken方法
content: Mulliken方法将基函数的定域项全部算作该基函数的贡献，并将该基函数与其它基函数间的交叉项的一半划给该基函数。对于HeH+例子，He基函数χ_1对轨道的贡献为(0.9^2+0.9*0.1944*S12)*100%。当S12=0.4343时，He贡献为88.6%。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: Mulliken method for basis function composition calculation
content: The Mulliken method assigns all of a basis function's diagonal terms as that basis function's contribution, and assigns one half of each cross term between that basis function and other basis functions to it. For the HeH+ example, the contribution of the He basis function χ_1 to the orbital is (0.9^2+0.9*0.1944*S12)*100%. When S12=0.4343, the He contribution is 88.6%.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: 基函数成份计算的Stout-Politzer方法
content: Stout-Politzer方法考虑基函数的不均等性，将交叉项按照相应两个基函数的系数平方比来划分。对于HeH+例子，χ_1所划得的交叉项为2*0.9*0.1944*S12* 0.9^2/(0.9^2+0.1944^2)。此方法数值不稳定性增加，出现负值的倾向加剧，且破坏了Mulliken方法的旋转不变性，不建议使用。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: Stout-Politzer method for basis function composition calculation
content: The Stout-Politzer method considers the inequivalence of basis functions, dividing the cross terms according to the ratio of the squares of the coefficients of the two corresponding basis functions. For the HeH+ example, the cross term allocated to χ_1 is 2*0.9*0.1944*S12* 0.9^2/(0.9^2+0.1944^2). This method has increased numerical instability, a stronger tendency to produce negative values, and destroys the rotational invariance of the Mulliken method, so it is not recommended.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: 基函数成份计算的SCPA方法
content: SCPA方法对应于将系数平方乘以归一化因子的做法，即χ_1的贡献为0.9^2/(0.9^2+0.1944^2)*100%。SCPA方法结果一定为正，计算简单，不需要考虑重叠积分，数值合理性比Mulliken和Stout-Politzer方法略强，是推荐使用的计算基函数贡献的方法。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: SCPA method for basis function composition calculation
content: The SCPA method corresponds to multiplying the squared coefficients by a normalization factor, i.e., the contribution of χ_1 is 0.9^2/(0.9^2+0.1944^2)*100%. The SCPA method's results are always positive, the calculation is simple, no consideration of overlap integrals is needed, its numerical reasonableness is slightly stronger than the Mulliken and Stout-Politzer methods, and it is the recommended method for calculating basis function contributions.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/131_轨道成分计算原理与Multiwfn实现_卡片.md
heading: 计算原子轨道成份的基函数加和方法
content: 利用基组与原子轨道的对应关系，将原子轨道对应的基函数的贡献相加作为原子轨道的贡献。例如在6-31G*基组下，氧的2px原子轨道贡献为2PX和3PX基函数贡献之和。此方法原理上不甚严格，不建议在含有弥散基函数或基组不平衡较强时使用。

heading: Basis function addition method for calculating atomic orbital compositions
content: Using the correspondence between the basis set and atomic orbitals, the contributions of the basis functions corresponding to an atomic orbital are summed as the atomic orbital's contribution. For example, with the 6-31G* basis set, the contribution of oxygen's 2px atomic orbital is the sum of the contributions of the 2PX and 3PX basis functions. This method is not very rigorous in principle, and it is not recommended when containing diffuse basis functions or strongly unbalanced basis sets.

heading: NAO方法计算原子轨道成份的原理
content: NBO分析可以得到自然原子轨道(NAO)，NAO彼此间正交，分子轨道以NAO展开的系数平方就是其在轨道中的成份。NAO中“极小集”部分对应于一般意义上的原子轨道，而Ryd型NAO主要用于描述高能态虚轨道，分析占据轨道时一般可忽略。

heading: Principle of the NAO method for calculating atomic orbital compositions
content: NBO analysis can yield natural atomic orbitals (NAO). NAOs are orthogonal to each other, and the squares of the coefficients of a molecular orbital expanded in NAOs are its compositions in the orbital. The "minimal set" part of the NAOs corresponds to atomic orbitals in the general sense, while Rydberg-type NAOs are mainly used to describe high-energy virtual orbitals and can generally be ignored when analyzing occupied orbitals.

heading: NBO-related orbitals and recommended plotting tools
content: The orbitals output by the NBO program include NBO (natural bond orbitals), NHO (natural hybrid orbitals), NAO (natural atomic orbitals), NLMO (natural localized molecular orbitals), as well as types prefixed with P. To visualize these orbitals you can use GaussView (NBO/NLMO only), ChemCraft (commercial, and may have errors when the basis set contains high angular momentum functions), NBOView (commercial with an outdated interface), or Molden. Multiwfn supports reading NBO plot files to plot all of the above orbitals, with fast display speed, the ability to display two orbitals simultaneously to analyze overlap, and it is free and flexible, making it the best choice.

heading: Constraints of plotting NBO orbitals from fch file
content: It is not recommended to view NBO orbitals via fch files, because the orbital indices must be matched against the NBO output information, and the fch file at that point cannot be used to view molecular orbitals or perform many wavefunction analyses. The orbitals in the fch file have been sorted by energy, and their numbering is inconsistent with the NBO output, so you need to refer to the "Reordering of NBOs for storage" information.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/136_Multiwfn绘制跃迁密度矩阵分析电子激发_卡片.md
heading: 原子标号跃迁密度矩阵构造方法
content: 跃迁密度矩阵用原子中心基函数展开后变成矩阵p，可根据基函数所属原子中心收缩成以原子为标号的矩阵P，变换公式为P(A,B)=∑[i∈A]∑[j∈B] p(i,j)^2。变换方式也可将p(i,j)^2改为p(i,j)的绝对值，这对最终图像效果有影响但定性结论一致。矩阵对角元代表原子在电子态跃迁中的电荷变化程度，非对角元代表电子跃迁时原子间的电子-空穴相干程度或“动态键级”。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/136_Multiwfn绘制跃迁密度矩阵分析电子激发_卡片.md
heading: Construction method of the atom-labeled transition density matrix
content: After being expanded in atom-centered basis functions, the transition density matrix becomes a matrix p, which can be contracted according to the atom centers to which the basis functions belong into an atom-labeled matrix P. The transformation formula is P(A,B)=∑[i∈A]∑[j∈B] p(i,j)^2. Alternatively, p(i,j)^2 in the transformation can be replaced by the absolute value of p(i,j); this affects the final visual appearance but the qualitative conclusions are the same. The diagonal elements represent the degree of charge change of an atom during the electronic-state transition, while the off-diagonal elements represent the degree of electron–hole coherence between atoms, i.e. the "dynamic bond order", during electron transition.

heading: Steps for calculating the transition density matrix with the ZINDO method
content: Use the ZINDO (also known as INDO/S) semiempirical method for the calculation of excited states and outputting transition density matrices. The Gaussian input file must contain the keywords `density=transition=1` and `iop(6/8=3)`; the former passes the S0->S1 transition density matrix to the L601 module, and the latter instructs the L601 module to output the passed transition density matrix to the output file. After the calculation, use formchk to perform the conversion of the chk file corresponding to the output file to an fch file.

content: 跃迁密度矩阵图中横纵坐标为原子编号，颜色表示数值大小，图中数值较大的区域集中表明电子跃迁主要涉及的原子片段。对角线区域数值整体较大，其长度Ld表现电子激发涉及的空间广度；靠近对角线的非对角元数值大表明主要涉及的原子与临近原子有较强的电子-空穴相干性；对角线带状区域的宽度Lc描述了原子间相干范围的大小。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/136_Multiwfn绘制跃迁密度矩阵分析电子激发_卡片.md
heading: Interpretation of the transition density matrix plot
content: In the transition density matrix plot, the horizontal and vertical axes are the atom indices, and the colors indicate the magnitude of the values. Regions with larger values in the plot indicate the atomic fragments mainly involved in the electron transition. The values in the diagonal region are generally large, and its length Ld reflects the spatial extent involved in the electronic excitation; large values of off-diagonal elements close to the diagonal indicate strong electron–hole coherence between the mainly involved atoms and their neighboring atoms; the width Lc of the diagonal band region describes the extent of the coherence range between atoms.

heading: Input file settings for the CIS, TDHF, and TDDFT methods

heading: Accelerating CIS and TDDFT calculations using existing wavefunctions
content: When using CIS or TDDFT for analyzing different excited states (e.g. analyzing S0->S4 after S0->S1) to save time, it is recommended to read an existing checkpoint file in the input file. A CIS example is `CIS(read)/6-31G* guess=read density=transition=4 iop(6/8=3)`, and a TDDFT example is `B3LYP/6-31G* TD(read,nstates=5) guess=read density=transition=4 iop(6/8=3)`; this is faster than a full recalculation.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/136_Multiwfn绘制跃迁密度矩阵分析电子激发_卡片.md
heading: 基组含弥散函数的注意事项
content: 在个别体系中，如果基组包含弥散函数，Gaussian（起码在G09 C.01版本）输出的跃迁密度矩阵可能是错的，导致图上表现的跃迁区域与考察跃迁主要涉及的MO分布所得结论严重不符。遇到这种情况不要使用该分析方法，或者应当去掉基组中的弥散函数。

heading: Cautions when the basis set contains diffuse functions
content: For certain systems, if the basis set contains diffuse functions, the transition density matrix output by Gaussian (at least in version G09 C.01) may be wrong, causing the transition region shown in the plot to severely contradict the conclusions drawn from examining the MO distributions mainly involved in the transition. In such cases, do not use this analysis method, or you should remove the diffuse functions from the basis set.

heading: 原子排序与跃迁密度矩阵图的对应关系
content: 若分子中原子编号在输入文件中混乱（如未按空间位置顺序排列），会导致无法将分子结构与跃迁密度矩阵图中的坐标轴对应。解决方法是重新对原子编号进行排序，例如将分子旋转至与X轴平行，将坐标导入Excel按X坐标排序后写回高斯输入文件，重新计算并作图即可使分子结构与坐标轴对照。

heading: Correspondence between atom ordering and the transition density matrix plot
content: If the atom numbering is disordered in the input file (e.g. not arranged in order of spatial position), it becomes impossible to match the molecular structure with the axes of the transition density matrix plot. The solution is to re-sort the atom numbering: for example, rotate the molecule to be parallel to the X axis, import the coordinates into Excel and sort by the X coordinate, write them back into the Gaussian input file, and recalculate and replot; then the molecular structure can be matched with the axes.

heading: TeraChem软件简介
content: TeraChem是第一个完全基于GPU运算的从头算量化程序，于2010年5月发布第一版，由Todd Martinez和Ufimtsev基于CUDA开发。其算法基础是发表在JCTC上的三篇文章（JCTC,4,222、JCTC,5,1004、JCTC,5,2619），分别阐述了利用GPU进行双电子积分、直接SCF、解析梯度的实现方法。与其他在CPU代码基础上改造的GPU加速程序不同，TeraChem是第一个完全从头编写以充分发挥GPU运算能力的量化程序。

heading: Introduction to the TeraChem software
content: TeraChem is the first fully GPU-based ab initio quantum chemistry program. Its first version was released in May 2010, developed based on CUDA. Its algorithmic foundation consists of three papers published in JCTC (JCTC,4,222, JCTC,5,1004, JCTC,5,2619), which respectively describe the implementation of two-electron integrals, direct SCF, and analytical gradients using GPUs. Unlike other GPU-accelerated programs adapted from CPU code, TeraChem is the first quantum chemistry program written entirely from scratch to fully exploit GPU computing power.

heading: Influence of video memory and GPU stream processors on performance
content: TeraChem consumes video memory heavily when calculating large systems; a GTX480 with 1.5 GB of video memory reports errors when calculating polyphenyls with N=14, and the main advantage of Tesla products lies in their larger video memory. GPU performance noticeably affects the computation speed: the GTX460M (192 stream processors) achieves less than 1/3 of the speed of the GTX480 (480 stream processors).

heading: TeraChem与Gaussian03速度对比

heading: TeraChem vs Gaussian03 speed comparison
content: Tests show that an i7-2630QM CPU running Gaussian03 takes roughly the same amount of time as two Tesla C2050 cards running TeraChem. In the test on magnesium porphyrin coordinated by imidazole, a single GTX480 + TeraChem took only one third less time than i7-2630QM + G03, and the efficiency of GTX460M + TeraChem was clearly inferior to i7-2630QM + G03.

heading: 不同精度模式的计算速度差异

heading: Computational speed differences among precision modes
content: In a B3LYP/6-31G* test on a system of 8 benzene rings, with two GTX480 cards pure double precision (205.9s) was much slower than pure single precision (54.3s), while dynamic mixed single/double precision (67.5s) took only slightly more time than single precision. The two C2050 cards showed a similar pattern, indicating that the default dynamic mixed mode achieves a good balance between accuracy and speed.

heading: TeraChem vs Gaussian calculation accuracy comparison

heading: Scrutiny of official TeraChem benchmark data

heading: 2019年补充测试与性价比分析
content: 2019年的补充测试显示，TeraChem v1.93P结合GTX1080Ti计算110原子体系耗时48s，而双路E5 2696v3服务器结合ORCA 4.1.1耗时61s，两者无明显区别。考虑到TeraChem约10000元的授权费和GTX1080Ti约12000元的价格，总计两万多的成本相比性能持平且ORCA免费的CPU服务器方案，性价比没有任何优势。

heading: TeraChem软件功能与局限性
content: TeraChem支持单点能、几何优化、找过渡态、BOMD、偶极矩和极化率计算，支持HF、GGA/杂化DFT及R/U/RO形式，但尚不支持激发态、频率、后HF方法、对称性及隐式溶剂模型等。程序支持Grimme的DFT-D2/D3色散校正并附带NBO6.0，但NBO分析时容易崩溃且部分功能如NBO deletion不可用。其QM/MM功能仅支持TIP3P水作为MM区域，且使用的基函数为高斯型基函数。

heading: TeraChem software features and limitations
content: TeraChem supports single-point energy, geometry optimization, transition state search, BOMD, dipole moment and polarizability calculation, and supports HF, GGA/hybrid DFT and R/U/RO forms, but does not yet support excited states, frequencies, post-HF methods, symmetry, or implicit solvent model, etc. The program supports Grimme's DFT-D2/D3 dispersion correction and comes with NBO6.0, but NBO analysis is prone to crashes with some features like NBO deletion unavailable. Its QM/MM functionality only supports TIP3P water as the MM region, and the basis functions used are Gaussian-type basis functions.

heading: TeraChem数值精度模式
content: TeraChem内部默认采用单双精度混合模式，对于数值大小高于阈值的双电子积分以及涉及到数值累加的变量一律用双精度以保证精确度，而数值较小的双电子积分采用单精度。这种混合模式旨在兼顾nVidia Geforce系列GPU双精度性能较弱的特点，在保证精度的同时利用单精度的高速度。

file: 08-其他量化软件/137_TeraChem_软件功能介绍与性能实测_卡片.md
heading: TeraChem numerical precision modes
content: TeraChem internally defaults to a mixed single/double precision mode: two-electron integrals with magnitudes above a threshold and variables involving numerical accumulation are always computed in double precision to ensure accuracy, while two-electron integrals with smaller magnitudes use single precision. This mixed mode is designed to accommodate the weak double-precision performance of nVidia Geforce series GPUs, exploiting the high speed of single precision while maintaining accuracy.

content: TeraChem的几何优化支持L-BFGS、共轭梯度、最陡下降法，但搜索过渡态仅支持NEB方法。NEB方法需要提供过渡态前后两个位置的初猜坐标，虽然能顺便得到能量极小路径，但比常用的基于GDIIS和准牛顿法只需单个初猜坐标的方法更麻烦。

heading: TeraChem geometry optimization and transition state search
content: TeraChem's geometry optimization supports L-BFGS, conjugate gradient, and steepest descent method, but transition state search only supports the NEB method. The NEB method requires initial-guess coordinates for two positions on either side of the transition state; although it also yields the minimum energy path along the way, it is more cumbersome than common methods based on GDIIS and quasi-Newton approaches that require only a single initial-guess coordinate.

heading: AdNDP analysis procedure for the B11- cluster
content: For the B11- system, 10 2c-2e AdNDP orbitals were found first, with residual electrons of 16.307. Then, three-center orbitals were searched and 5 3c-2e orbitals were picked out. By inspecting the canonical molecular orbitals, 3 totally delocalized orbitals related to pi electrons were found, so 11-center orbitals were searched directly, yielding 3 candidate orbitals with occupation of 2.0 (11c-2e). After picking them out, the residual electrons were 1.029 and the analysis was concluded.

heading: Calculation of multicenter bond order with Multiwfn
content: To calculate the multicenter bond order in Multiwfn, a .fch or similar file is needed as input. After loading it, enter main function 9, choose 2 to enter the multicenter bond order analysis feature, and input the indices of the atoms in the ring (they should be entered following the connectivity order of the atoms) to obtain the result. The multicenter bond order provides a quantitative measure of bond strength. The order of the input indices (clockwise or counterclockwise) may sometimes affect the result, but the difference is usually small; you can set iMCBOtype to 1 in settings.ini to output the average value.

heading: AdNDP分析的经验准则与总结
content: AdNDP 分析的经验准则包括：1.剩余电子数越少越好 2.每个 AdNDP 轨道占据数越接近 2.0 越好 3.挑出的轨道的中心数应尽量低 4.尽量避免占据数的 overcounting 5.AdNDP 轨道分布需满足分子对称性（必须遵循） 6.挑出的轨道能较合理地展现出体系中实际的强共轭区域。建议将 AdNDP、ELF/LOL 和多中心键级结合使用。

heading: Empirical guidelines and summary for AdNDP analysis
content: The empirical guidelines for AdNDP analysis include: 1. fewer residual electrons is better 2. AdNDP orbital occupation closer to 2.0 is better 3. the number of centers of the picked orbitals should be as low as possible 4. avoiding overcounting of occupation numbers as much as possible 5. the distribution of AdNDP orbitals must satisfy the molecular symmetry (mandatory) 6. the picked orbitals should reasonably reflect the actual strong conjugation regions in the system. It is recommended to use the combined use of AdNDP, ELF/LOL and multicenter bond orders.

heading: AdNDP与NBO方法的区别与联系
content: NBO 方法一般搜索孤对电子 (1c-2e) 和双中心双电子键 (2c-2e)，扩展后可搜索 3c-2e 键，但对于三中心以上的多中心键体系，NBO 方法很难处理。AdNDP 是基于将 NBO 搜索方法广义化的思路提出的，原则上可以利用体系的密度矩阵信息搜索出所有 Nc-2e 键（N 小于等于体系总原子数）。AdNDP 是高度离域化的正则分子轨道和高度定域化的 NBO 轨道之间平滑过渡的半定域轨道形式。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/138_Multiwfn中AdNDP及多中心键分析_卡片.md
heading: Differences and connections between the AdNDP and NBO methods
content: The NBO method generally searches for lone pairs (1c-2e) and two-center two-electron bonds (2c-2e); after extension it can search for 3c-2e bonds, but for systems with multi-center bonds of three or more centers, the NBO method is difficult to apply. AdNDP was proposed based on the idea of generalizing the NBO search method; in principle it can use the density matrix information of the system to search for all Nc-2e bonds (N less than or equal to the total number of atoms in the system). AdNDP is a semilocalized orbital form that smoothly transitions between highly delocalized canonical molecular orbitals and highly localized NBO orbitals.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/138_Multiwfn中AdNDP及多中心键分析_卡片.md
heading: NBO与AdNDP的搜索原理细节
content: NBO 轨道搜索过程基于以自然原子轨道 (NAO) 为基的密度矩阵进行：先扣除内核轨道贡献，搜索 1c-2e（对角块对角化，本征值即轨道占据数大于预设阈值），扣除贡献后再穷举搜索 2c-2e（组合密度矩阵子块对角化）。AdNDP 方法在搜索完 1c-2e、2c-2e、3c-2e 后，以完全相同的方法接着依次寻找 4c-2e、5c-2e、6c-2e...。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn中AdNDP及多中心键分析

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/138_Multiwfn中AdNDP及多中心键分析_卡片.md
heading: Details of the search principles of NBO and AdNDP
content: The NBO orbital search process is based on the density matrix in the basis of natural atomic orbitals (NAO): first the core orbital contributions are subtracted and 1c-2e is searched (diagonalization of the diagonal blocks, where eigenvalues are the orbital occupations greater than a preset threshold); after subtracting the contributions, an exhaustive search for 2c-2e is performed (diagonalization of the combined sub-blocks of the density matrix). After finishing the searches for 1c-2e, 2c-2e and 3c-2e, the AdNDP method continues to search for 4c-2e, 5c-2e, 6c-2e... in exactly the same way.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/138_Multiwfn中AdNDP及多中心键分析_卡片.md
heading: AdNDP方法的局限性与操作难点
content: AdNDP 搜索过程细节的处理（如轨道正交化及搜索顺序）比 NBO 更为关键，且没有绝对的规律可循，往往必须靠人工凭借经验进行操作，这是 AdNDP 方法最大的局限性。不同用户由于操作过程（搜索和选取轨道的顺序）的不同可能得到很不同的 AdNDP 图样。有的其它 AdNDP 程序号称能自动搜索 AdNDP 轨道，这实际上经常不靠谱，结果是有严重误导性的，因为 AdNDP 轨道搜索从原理上就不可能自动化。

topic: Multiwfn中AdNDP及多中心键分析

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/138_Multiwfn中AdNDP及多中心键分析_卡片.md
heading: Limitations and operational difficulties of the AdNDP method
content: Handling the details of the AdNDP search process (such as orbital orthogonalization and search order) is more critical than for NBO, and there are no absolute rules to follow; it often must be done manually based on experience, which is the greatest limitation of the AdNDP method. Different users may obtain very different AdNDP patterns due to differences in the operation process (order of searching and picking orbitals). Some other AdNDP programs claim to be able to automatically search for AdNDP orbitals, but this is often unreliable and the results are seriously misleading, because the AdNDP orbital search is in principle impossible to automate.

heading: 使用Multiwfn进行AdNDP分析的Gaussian输入设置
content: 在 Multiwfn 中做 AdNDP 分析需要 NBO 程序输出的含有以 NAO 为基的密度矩阵，以及包含原始基函数与 NAO 间的变换矩阵的.fch 文件。为了让 Gaussian 输出文件中包含这些信息，必须使用 pop=nboread 关键词，并在分子坐标末尾空一行写上 $NBO DMNAO AONAO $END。给 Multiwfn 用的 Gaussian 输出文件必须是单点计算的输出文件。

heading: 避免AdNDP轨道overcounting的操作原则
content: AdNDP 方法搜出的轨道彼此间并不是正交的，而是有交叠的，如果将一批轨道一次性取出，会令轨道的占据数偏高（即 overcounting）。通常应按照占据数从高到低，将简并轨道一批一批取出，每次取出后密度被扣除，剩下的候选轨道形状和占据数会被重新计算。如果取出高占据轨道后，剩下的轨道占据数最高值已小于期望值（如 1.7），就不理它们了。单中心轨道可以一次都取出来，因为它们是彼此正交的。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/138_Multiwfn中AdNDP及多中心键分析_卡片.md
heading: Operational principles for avoiding overcounting of AdNDP orbitals
content: The orbitals found by the AdNDP method are not orthogonal to each other but overlap; if a batch of orbitals is exported all at once, the occupations of the orbitals will be overestimated (i.e., overcounting). Usually, one should pick out degenerate orbitals batch by batch in order from high to low occupation; after each pick-out, the density is subtracted, and the shapes and occupations of the remaining candidate orbitals are recalculated. If, after picking out high-occupation orbitals, the highest occupation of the remaining orbitals has fallen below the expected value (e.g., 1.7), they are simply ignored. One-center orbitals can all be picked out at once because they are orthogonal to each other.

content:
The xtd file of Material Studio (M$) contains trajectory information of atoms or beads in coarse-grained simulation; the actual trajectory information is stored in a .trj hidden file of the same name in the same directory (binary file).

heading: Recommended method for decomposing NICS based on Gaussian and NBO
content: NICS (nucleus-independent chemical shift) can be decomposed into sigma and pi orbital contributions for studying aromaticity. The NCS feature of the NBO program is commonly used to decompose the magnetic shielding tensor into localized orbital or canonical molecular orbital (CMO) contributions; quantum chemistry programs in general do not support this decomposition, and the DeMon-Master program is difficult to obtain; performing NCS with the NBO 3.1 version built into Gaussian is more convenient than using NBO5.0, as it requires no purchase of NBO5.0 and involves no licensing issues.

heading: Definition of NICS and its derived indices
content: NICS is the negative of the magnetic shielding value at an artificially specified position; the more negative, the stronger the aromaticity. In JACS, 118, 6317 it is taken at the geometric center of the conjugated ring, called NICS(0); 1 angstrom above the ring plane, called NICS(1), mainly reflects pi electron contributions; examining only the ZZ component perpendicular to the ring plane, called NICS(1)_ZZ, is best suited to reflect pi aromaticity but still contains a small amount of sigma influence, and sigma aromaticity cannot be discussed separately.

heading: NICS及各向异性值的计算含义
content: Gaussian输出虚原子的Isotropic值为磁屏蔽张量迹的平均，如7.8997=(5.3444+5.3298+13.0249)/3；NICS值为Isotropic值的负值；Anisotropy衡量各向异性程度，计算公式为Eig(3) - (Eig(2) + Eig(1))*0.5，其中Eig(i)为从小到大排序的本征值。

heading: Computational meaning of NICS and anisotropy values
content: In the Gaussian output, the Isotropic value of a dummy atom is the average of the trace of the magnetic shielding tensor, e.g. 7.8997=(5.3444+5.3298+13.0249)/3; the NICS value is the negative of the Isotropic value; Anisotropy measures the degree of anisotropy, computed as Eig(3) - (Eig(2) + Eig(1))*0.5, where Eig(i) are the eigenvalues sorted from smallest to largest.

heading: Output format of NBO contributions to the shielding tensor in NBO 5.0
content: Adding <XYZ> after the NCS keyword outputs the contribution of each NBO to the magnetic shielding tensor of each atom; in the table, entries on the left are Lewis-type (L) NBOs and entries on the right are non-Lewis-type (NL) NBOs; under the XX label, a value such as 0.66 represents the effect of a small amount of electrons delocalized from NBO 1 to NBO 51 on the XX component; the L and NL of the Total row are the sums over all L and NL terms respectively, consistent with the Gaussian output values.

heading: 磁感应电流密度与电子离域性的关系
content: 分子体系中外加磁场时，电子离域性强的区域会产生明显的感应环形电流。环电流方向遵循左手规则称为diamagnetic环电流，电流越大芳香性越强；方向相反称为paratropic环电流，电流越大反芳香性越强；无净电流则为非芳香性。富勒烯在磁场下的诱导电流被称为球电流，可参阅相关文献。

heading: Relationship between magnetically induced current density and electron delocalization
content: When an external magnetic field is applied to a molecular system, regions with strong electron delocalization produce pronounced induced ring currents. Ring currents whose direction follows the left-hand rule are called diamagnetic ring currents; the stronger the current, the stronger the aromaticity; currents in the opposite direction are called paratropic ring currents; the stronger the current, the stronger the antiaromaticity; no net current means non-aromaticity. The induced current in fullerenes under a magnetic field is called a diatropic sphere current; see the relevant literature.

heading: AICD函数的定义与意义
content: AICD（Anisotropy of the Induced Current Density）定义为电流密度张量与外磁场矢量的点乘，其公式见原文。AICD本质上反映相应位置电子对磁场感应的各向异性强度，是一个不依赖外场选取且与电子密度无直接关系的三维实空间标量函数。通过AICD等值面可以方便地研究电子离域性，无需考虑复杂的截面选取或外磁场方向问题。

heading: Definition and significance of the AICD function
content: AICD (Anisotropy of the Induced Current Density) is defined as the dot product of the current density tensor and the external magnetic field vector; the formula is given in the original text. AICD essentially reflects the anisotropy strength of the magnetic-field-induced response of electrons at the corresponding position, and is a three-dimensional real-space scalar function that is independent of the choice of external field and has no direct relation to the electron density. Through the AICD isosurface, electron delocalization can be conveniently studied without considering complicated cross-section selection or external magnetic field direction issues.

file: 09-可视化与制图/14_VMD显示轨迹粒子空间密度分布_卡片.md
heading: VMD显示粒子空间密度的颜色深浅法
content:
第一种方法利用颜色深浅显示原子在不同位置出现的概率，适合描述少数几个粒子的密度分布，效果比较柔和。渲染模式需开启GLSL，将Materials对话框中Transparent材质复制到新材质a，把a的Ambient设为最大，Opacity设为0.03，然后在文本控制台source dis.tcl脚本。运行draw material a，再输入dis命令，例如查看index 444原子在前4444帧内的空间分布状况，输入dis 444 4444。
- 原理是GLSL渲染模式支持透明色，每次出现用一个透明的白色球表示，叠加次数越多该处越不透明，颜色越深说明出现概率越大。球半径0.13是图像效果较好的参数，若不满意可调整Opacity或运行draw delete all删除重绘。

file: 09-可视化与制图/14_VMD显示轨迹粒子空间密度分布_卡片.md
heading: Color shading method in VMD for displaying the spatial density of particles
content:
The first method uses color shading to display the probability of atoms appearing at different positions; it is suitable for describing the density distribution of a few particles, and the effect is rather soft. The rendering mode must have GLSL enabled. In the Materials dialog, copy the Transparent material to a new material a, set a's Ambient to maximum, set Opacity to 0.03, then source the dis.tcl script in the text console. Run draw material a, then enter the dis command; for example, to view the spatial distribution of the atom with index 444 over the first 4444 frames, enter dis 444 4444.
- The principle is that the GLSL rendering mode supports transparent colors: each occurrence is represented by a transparent white sphere, and the more they are superimposed, the more opaque that spot becomes; the deeper the color, the higher the probability of occurrence. A sphere radius of 0.13 is a parameter with good visual effect; if unsatisfied, adjust the Opacity or run draw delete all to delete and redraw.

file: 09-可视化与制图/14_VMD显示轨迹粒子空间密度分布_卡片.md
heading: 空间密度分布显示脚本dis.tcl的内容
content:
dis.tcl脚本通过循环遍历每一帧，获取指定原子的坐标并在该位置绘制一个球体，用于通过颜色深浅法可视化原子轨迹。脚本内容如下
proc dis {atom fps} {
draw color white
for {set i 0} {$i<$fps} {incr i 1} {
set nowselect [atomselect top "index $atom" frame $i]
set x [$nowselect get {x}]
set y [$nowselect get {y}]
set z [$nowselect get {z}]
draw sphere "$x $y $z" radius 0.13
- 运行此脚本前需要先设置好材质并执行draw material a命令。

heading: Contents of the dis.tcl script for displaying spatial density distribution
content:
The dis.tcl script loops through each frame, obtains the coordinates of a specified atom, and draws a sphere at that position, used to visualize atomic trajectories via the Color shading method. The script content is as follows
proc dis {atom fps} {
draw color white
for {set i 0} {$i<$fps} {incr i 1} {
set nowselect [atomselect top "index $atom" frame $i]
set x [$nowselect get {x}]
set y [$nowselect get {y}]
set z [$nowselect get {z}]
draw sphere "$x $y $z" radius 0.13
- Before running this script, the material must be set up and the draw material a command executed first.

file: 09-可视化与制图/14_VMD显示轨迹粒子空间密度分布_卡片.md
heading: 等值面法显示粒子空间密度的准备工作
content:
第二种方法是用等值面显示，适合描述大量粒子的空间分布，需使用g_spatial计算某个group在空间中每个点的出现几率。首先使用trjconv -f a-sol.trr -s a-sol.gro -fit rot+trans按照参考结构（如蛋白）进行align，以蛋白不发生整体运动为依据改变整个轨迹中的原子坐标。然后运行g_spatial -s a-sol.tpr -f a-sol.trr -n index.ndx计算空间几率并存为grid.cube文件。
- 如果遇到内存分配不够或段错误，使用-nab参数，设100一般够了；使用bin参数控制格点宽度，默认是0.05，设为0.03时文件会变得很大。

fm_title: VMD显示轨迹中粒子的空间密度分布的两种方法

file: 09-可视化与制图/14_VMD显示轨迹粒子空间密度分布_卡片.md
heading: Preparation for displaying the spatial density of particles with the isosurface method
content:
The second method uses isosurfaces for display, suitable for describing the spatial distribution of numerous particles; it requires using g_spatial to calculate the probability of a group appearing at each point in space. First use trjconv -f a-sol.trr -s a-sol.gro -fit rot+trans to align to a reference structure (e.g., a protein), changing the atomic coordinates throughout the trajectory based on the whole protein not undergoing overall motion. Then run g_spatial -s a-sol.tpr -f a-sol.trr -n index.ndx to compute the spatial probabilities and save them as a grid.cube file.
- If you encounter insufficient memory allocation or a segmentation fault, use the -nab parameter; 100 is generally enough. Use the bin parameter to control the grid point width; the default is 0.05, and setting it to 0.03 makes the file very large.

file: 09-可视化与制图/14_VMD显示轨迹粒子空间密度分布_卡片.md
heading: g_spatial选择group对输出结果的决定性作用
content: g_spatial第一次选择的group决定了空间格点各个值的大小，即决定了grid.cube的数据部分，最终得到的等值面图样完全取决于第一次选择的group。第二次选择group实际上是选择输出哪些原子到grid.cube头部的原子叙述部分，完全不影响结果，可随便设，一般设成溶质。例如第一组设为溶剂，第二组设为溶质，读进VMD后，用CPK模式看到的是溶质结构，用isosurface模式看到的是溶剂出现密度的等值面。

file: 09-可视化与制图/14_VMD显示轨迹粒子空间密度分布_卡片.md
heading: The decisive role of g_spatial group selection on the output results
content: The first selected group in g_spatial determines the values at each spatial grid point, i.e., it determines the data section of grid.cube; the resulting isosurface plot is entirely determined by the first selected group. The second group selection actually selects which atoms are output to the atom description section in grid.cube header, and has no effect on the results at all; it can be set arbitrarily, generally set to the solute. For example, if the first group is set to the solvent and the second to the solute, after loading into VMD, the solute structure is seen in CPK mode, and the isosurface of the solvent's appearance density is seen in isosurface mode.

heading: CFOUR程序概述与功能特点
content:
CFOUR是由ACESII-MAB改名而来的从头算程序，特别适合微扰和耦合簇的大规模并行计算，支持HF、微扰、CI、QCI计算但不支持DFT。CFOUR的耦合簇最高能做到CCSDT，且在这样的级别下还能支持二阶解析导数，对GIMIC, MRCC, DIRAC, NEWTON-X程序提供了接口。CFOUR是免费开源程序，需在主页下载授权表签字后通过传真或实体邮件发送给开发者才能获得，比ACESII相对更user-friendly但仍不适合初学者。

file: 08-其他量化软件/150_CFOUR程序编译安装与输入文件设置_卡片.md
heading: Overview and features of the CFOUR program
content:
CFOUR is an ab initio program renamed from ACESII-MAB, especially suited for large-scale parallel calculation of perturbation and coupled cluster methods. It supports HF, perturbation, CI, and QCI calculations but not DFT. CFOUR's coupled cluster can go up to CCSDT, and at this level it still supports second-order analytical derivatives; it provides interfaces to GIMIC, MRCC, DIRAC, and NEWTON-X programs. CFOUR is free open-source software; you must download the license form from the homepage, sign it, and send it by fax or physical mail to the developers to obtain it. It is relatively more user-friendly than ACESII but still not suitable for beginners.

file: 08-其他量化软件/150_CFOUR程序编译安装与输入文件设置_卡片.md
heading: CFOUR内存与SCF相关常用关键词
content:
CFOUR通过EMORY关键词设置可用内存，单位默认为INTEGERWORDS（32/64位平台需乘以4/8转换为KB），可用MEM_UNIT改变单位。SCF相关设置包括收敛标准SCF_CONV、阻尼SCF_DAMPING（设500有助于解决不收敛）、最大迭代次数SCF_MAXCYC、DIIS外推SCF_EXTRAPOLATION、高斯函数类型SPHERICAL、对称性SUBGROUP以及输出级别PRINT。
- 常用设置
- `SCF_CONV=N`：密度矩阵最大变化小于10^-N停止，默认7
- `SCF_DAMPING=500`：解决SCF不收敛
- `SCF_MAXCYC`：最大迭代次数，默认150
- `PRINT=1`：输出更多细节信息

file: 08-其他量化软件/150_CFOUR程序编译安装与输入文件设置_卡片.md
heading: Common CFOUR keywords for memory and SCF settings
content:
CFOUR uses the EMORY keyword to set available memory, with the unit defaulting to INTEGERWORDS (multiply by 4/8 on 32/64-bit platforms to convert to KB); MEM_UNIT can be used to change the unit. SCF-related settings include the convergence criterion SCF_CONV, damping SCF_DAMPING (setting 500 helps resolve non-convergence), maximum iteration count SCF_MAXCYC, DIIS extrapolation SCF_EXTRAPOLATION, Gaussian function type SPHERICAL, symmetry SUBGROUP, and output level PRINT.
- Common settings
- `SCF_CONV=N`: stops when the maximum change in the density matrix is less than 10^-N, default 7
- `SCF_DAMPING=500`: resolves SCF non-convergence
- `SCF_MAXCYC`: maximum number of iterations, default 150
- `PRINT=1`: outputs more detailed information

file: 08-其他量化软件/150_CFOUR程序编译安装与输入文件设置_卡片.md
heading: CFOUR几何优化与过渡态寻找关键词
content:
CFOUR中GEO_METHOD=TS用于寻找过渡态，GEO_CONV=N设定优化收敛限为N Hartree/bohr，GEO_MAXCYC设定最大优化步数（默认50），GEO_MAXSTEP设定几何优化的最大步长（单位millibohr，默认300）。EVAL_HESS=N用于设定每隔N个优化步计算一次精确Hessian，默认为从不（使用准牛顿法）。
- 关键词
- `GEO_METHOD=TS`：寻找过渡态
- `GEO_CONV=N`：优化收敛限
- `EVAL_HESS=N`：每隔N步算一次精确Hessian

file: 08-其他量化软件/150_CFOUR程序编译安装与输入文件设置_卡片.md
heading: CFOUR keywords for geometry optimization and transition state search
content:
In CFOUR, GEO_METHOD=TS is used for transition state search, GEO_CONV=N sets the optimization convergence limit to N Hartree/bohr, GEO_MAXCYC sets the maximum number of optimization steps (default 50), and GEO_MAXSTEP sets the maximum step size for geometry optimization (in millibohr, default 300). EVAL_HESS=N is used to compute the exact Hessian every N optimization steps; the default is never (using the quasi-Newton method).
- Keywords
- `GEO_METHOD=TS`: transition state search
- `GEO_CONV=N`: optimization convergence limit
- `EVAL_HESS=N`: compute the exact Hessian every N steps

file: 08-其他量化软件/150_CFOUR程序编译安装与输入文件设置_卡片.md
heading: CFOUR激发态、并行加速与属性计算关键词
content:
CFOUR使用EXCITE设定EOM-CC/LR-CC类型（EOMEE计算激发态，EOMIP计算离子化态，EOMEA计算电子附着态）。建议对最高至CCSD(T)的计算加上ABCDTYPE=AOBASIS以加快速度。CC_PROGRAM建议设为ECC以加速CCSD, CCSD+T, CCSD(T)等计算。PROPS、RAMAN_INT、RELATIVISTIC、DBOC、VIBRATION等关键词用于控制各种属性和频率计算。
- 关键词设置
- `EXCITE=EOMEE`：计算激发态
- `ABCDTYPE=AOBASIS`：加速计算
- `CC_PROGRAM=ECC`：控制CC计算程序
- `PROPS=NMR`：计算NMR
- `VIBRATION=ANALYTIC`：用解析二阶导数计算谐振频率

file: 08-其他量化软件/150_CFOUR程序编译安装与输入文件设置_卡片.md
heading: CFOUR keywords for excited states, computational acceleration, and property calculations
content:
CFOUR uses EXCITE to set the EOM-CC/LR-CC type (EOMEE for excited-state calculation, EOMIP for ionized states, EOMEA for electron-attached states). It is recommended to add ABCDTYPE=AOBASIS for calculations up to CCSD(T) to speed them up. CC_PROGRAM is recommended to be set to ECC to accelerate CCSD, CCSD+T, CCSD(T), etc. Keywords such as PROPS, RAMAN_INT, RELATIVISTIC, DBOC, and VIBRATION are used to control various properties and frequency calculations.
- Keyword settings
- `EXCITE=EOMEE`: calculation of excited states
- `ABCDTYPE=AOBASIS`: computational acceleration
- `CC_PROGRAM=ECC`: controls the CC calculation program
- `PROPS=NMR`: computing NMR
- `VIBRATION=ANALYTIC`: harmonic frequency calculation using analytical second derivatives

file: 08-其他量化软件/150_CFOUR程序编译安装与输入文件设置_卡片.md
heading: CFOUR轨道冻结、参考波函数与收敛控制关键词
content:
CFOUR在post-HF中默认不冻芯，FROZEN_CORE=ON可冻结内核轨道，DROPMO可具体指定冻结哪些轨道（如1>10-55-58>64）。HFSTABILITY=ON进行SCF波函数稳定性测试，REFERENCE选择参考波函数（RHF/UHF/ROHF/TCSCF）。RESTART_CC=1重启CC计算，CC_CONV=N设定CC收敛标准（系数最大改变值小于10^-N，默认7）。
- 关键词
- `FROZEN_CORE=ON`：post-HF中冻结内核轨道
- `DROPMO=1>10-55-58>64`：指定冻结轨道
- `CC_CONV=N`：CC收敛标准

file: 08-其他量化软件/150_CFOUR程序编译安装与输入文件设置_卡片.md
heading: CFOUR keywords for orbital freezing, reference wavefunction, and convergence control
content:
By default CFOUR does not freeze the core in post-HF methods; FROZEN_CORE=ON can freeze core orbitals, and DROPMO can specifically specify which orbitals to freeze (e.g., 1>10-55-58>64). HFSTABILITY=ON performs an SCF wavefunction stability test; REFERENCE selects the reference wavefunction (RHF/UHF/ROHF/TCSCF). RESTART_CC=1 restarts a CC calculation; CC_CONV=N sets the CC convergence criterion (maximum change in coefficients less than 10^-N, default 7).
- Keywords
- `FROZEN_CORE=ON`: frozen core orbitals in post-HF methods
- `DROPMO=1>10-55-58>64`: specifies frozen orbitals
- `CC_CONV=N`: CC convergence criterion

heading: CFOUR串行版本的编译方法
content:
在64bit Linux平台下编译CFOUR串行版本，需解压源代码包并进入目录，运行./configure FC=ifort（如果未安装ifort则改为FC=gfortran），然后执行make。编译出的文件会出现在bin目录下，最后需要将export PATH=$PATH:/[cfour目录]/bin加入到当前用户的.bashrc文件中并使其生效。
- 注意：如果使用ifort 12.x，由于bug，在./configure生成make.config文件后，必须将文件中的-O3都改为-O2才能继续编译。

heading: How to compile the serial version of CFOUR

heading: CFOUR并行版本（含MKL和GIMIC接口）的编译方法
content:
编译CFOUR并行版本（支持mpich2+MKL+GIMIC接口），需安装ifort和mpich2到默认路径，并设置MKLPATH环境变量。在CFOUR源代码目录下，执行带有--enable-gimic、--with-blas（含MKL库链接参数）、--enable-mpi=mpich等选项的./configure命令，之后运行make。最后同样需要将bin目录路径加入环境变量PATH中。
- 典型配置命令：`./configure FC=ifort MPIFC=mpif90 --enable-gimic --with-blas="$MKLPATH/libmkl_solver_ilp64.a -Wl,--start-group $MKLPATH/libmkl_intel_ilp64.a $MKLPATH/libmkl_intel_thread.a $MKLPATH/libmkl_core.a -Wl,--end-group -openmp -lpthread" --enable-mpi=mpich --with-mpirun="mpirun -np \$CFOUR_NUM_CORES" --with-exenodes="mpirun -np \$CFOUR_NUM_CORES"`

file: 08-其他量化软件/150_CFOUR程序编译安装与输入文件设置_卡片.md
heading: CFOUR并行计算的环境变量设置与效率优化
content:
使用并行+MKL版本运行CFOUR前需设定CFOUR_NUM_CORES和MKL_NUM_THREADS环境变量，前者控制MPI进程数（资源消耗成倍增加），后者控制每个MPI进程的MKL线程数（不增加资源消耗）。对于四核机器，通常CFOUR_NUM_CORES设为4、MKL_NUM_THREADS设为1比设为1/4快很多，但由于后HF计算硬盘I/O瓶颈，2/2的设置可能比4/1更快。
- 设置示例：`export CFOUR_NUM_CORES=4` 和 `export MKL_NUM_THREADS=2`
- 运行时直接输入xcfour，程序会自动加上mpirun指令，不要手动在命令行添加mpirun。

file: 08-其他量化软件/150_CFOUR程序编译安装与输入文件设置_卡片.md
heading: Environment variable setup and efficiency optimization for CFOUR parallel calculation
content:
Before running the parallel+MKL version of CFOUR, you need to set the CFOUR_NUM_CORES and MKL_NUM_THREADS environment variables. The former controls the number of MPI processes (resource consumption increases multiplicatively), while the latter controls the number of MKL threads per MPI process (no extra resource consumption). On a quad-core machine, setting CFOUR_NUM_CORES=4 and MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 is usually much faster than 1/4, but due to the disk I/O bottleneck of post-HF calculations, a 2/2 setting may be faster than 4/1.
- Example settings: `export CFOUR_NUM_CORES=4` and `export MKL_NUM_THREADS=2`
- At runtime, just type xcfour directly; the program will automatically add the mpirun command. Do not manually add mpirun on the command line.

heading: CFOUR并行计算的关键词要求与MP2并行策略
content:

file: 08-其他量化软件/150_CFOUR程序编译安装与输入文件设置_卡片.md
heading: Keyword requirements for CFOUR parallel calculation and MP2 parallelization strategy
content:
The main CFOUR functionality supporting MPI parallelization is coupled cluster calculation. The input file must contain the CC_PROGRAM=ECC and ABCDTYPE=AOBASIS keywords (even without parallelization, including them is faster than the default). For tasks that do not support MPI parallelization, such as MP2, the only way to parallelize is to rely on MKL_NUM_THREADS; in that case you should use the serial version and add MKL library support in the ./configure compilation step.
- MKL compilation option string: `--with-blas="$MKLPATH/libmkl_solver_ilp64.a -Wl,--start-group $MKLPATH/libmkl_intel_ilp64.a $MKLPATH/libmkl_intel_thread.a $MKLPATH/libmkl_core.a -Wl,--end-group -openmp -lpthread"`

heading: CFOUR输入文件基本格式与行宽限制
content:
CFOUR输入文件必须命名为ZMAT，第一行为注释，接着是分子坐标（默认单位为埃，元素名顶头写），然后是变量定义，最后是*CFOUR关键词部分及特殊任务输入。每行不得超过80个字符，关键词行若超长可分多行书写，换行处末尾不加逗号但必须保留一个空格。
- 示例
```text
Water CC-LR/DZP at experimental equilibrium geometry
O
H 1 R
H 1 R 2 A
R=0.958
A=104.5
*CFOUR(CALC=CCSD,BASIS=DZP,EXCITE=EOMEE)

heading: Basic format and line-width limit of the CFOUR input file
content:
The CFOUR input file must be named ZMAT. The first line is a comment, followed by molecular coordinates (default unit is Angstrom, with the element name written flush left), then variable definitions, and finally the *CFOUR keyword section and special task input. Each line must not exceed 80 characters. If a keyword line is too long, it can be split over multiple lines; at the line break, do not add a comma at the end but a space must be kept.
- Example
```text
Water CC-LR/DZP at experimental equilibrium geometry
O
H 1 R
H 1 R 2 A
R=0.958
A=104.5
*CFOUR(CALC=CCSD,BASIS=DZP,EXCITE=EOMEE)

heading: 热椭球图与十字形线的原理
content: 热椭球图用于描述晶体衍射实验中获得的原子热振动的各向异性，椭球在某个方向上拉得越长表明在该方向上原子振动幅度越大，三个正交方向振动幅度相同则为圆球。椭球大小设定有一定任意性，常令椭球包围的空间内发现相应原子的电子的概率为50%。十字形线的主要目的是让椭球形状表现得比较清晰精确，在没有光照效果时使原子球显示得更有立体感。

heading: Principles of thermal ellipsoid plots and cross-shaped lines
content: A thermal ellipsoid plot is used to describe the anisotropy of atomic thermal vibration obtained from crystal diffraction experiments. The longer an ellipsoid is stretched in a certain direction, the larger the atomic vibration amplitude in that direction; if the vibration amplitudes are equal in three orthogonal directions, the shape is a sphere. The setting of ellipsoid size involves some arbitrariness; commonly, the probability of finding the electron of the corresponding atom within the space enclosed by the ellipsoid is set to 50%. The main purpose of cross-shaped lines is to make the ellipsoid shape appear clearer and more precise, and to give atomic spheres a stronger sense of three-dimensionality in the absence of lighting effects.

heading: 使用Multiwfn与Gaussian绘制原子轨道图形的方法
content: 本卡片介绍使用Multiwfn程序结合Gaussian绘制各种类型的原子轨道图形，包括角度和径向部分。原子轨道对于多电子原子体系只是近似描述，类氢原子轨道波函数是径向部分波函数与角度部分（球谐函数）的乘积。卡片中的原子轨道指实数型原子轨道。文中使用的Multiwfn为2.4版，Gaussian为G09 A02。

heading: Plotting atomic orbital graphs with Multiwfn and Gaussian
content: This card introduces plotting various types of atomic orbital graphs using the Multiwfn program in combination with Gaussian, including the angular and radial parts. Atomic orbitals are only an approximate description for many-electron atomic systems; the hydrogen-like atomic orbital wavefunction is the product of the radial part of the wavefunction and the angular part (spherical harmonics). The atomic orbitals referred to in this card are real-type atomic orbitals. The Multiwfn used in the text is version 2.4, and Gaussian is G09 A02.

heading: 使用Multiwfn自定义函数绘制电子径向分布函数
content: 将settings.ini中的iuserfunc设为6，Multiwfn的用户自定义函数即变为4π*r^2*ρ(r)。操作步骤为：清空所有轨道占据数 -> 设定目标轨道占据数为2 -> 绘制曲线图（功能3） -> 选择用户自定义函数（功能100） -> 设定径向范围。此函数的积分值应接近轨道电子占据数，Multiwfn内部使用梯形法进行积分。

heading: Plotting the electron radial distribution function with a user-defined function in Multiwfn
content: With iuserfunc set to 6 in settings.ini, the user-defined function of Multiwfn becomes 4π*r^2*ρ(r). The procedure is: clear all orbital occupation numbers -> set the occupation number of the target orbital to 2 -> plot the curve plot (function 3) -> select the user-defined function (function 100) -> set the radial range. The integral of this function should be close to the orbital electron occupation number; Multiwfn uses the trapezoidal method for integration internally.

heading: 相对论效应对原子轨道径向分布的影响
content: 相对论效应（如DKH2方法）会使得1s轨道电子质量加大，轨道尺寸收缩，核电荷越大效应越明显。由于外层s轨道需与内层s轨道满足正交性，外层轨道尺寸也会随之收缩。通过对比相对论与非相对论计算下的2s、3s轨道电子径向分布函数，可观察到极大值点的径向位置变小。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/152_Multiwfn绘制原子轨道及壳层结构分析_卡片.md
heading: Influence of relativistic effects on the radial distribution of atomic orbitals
content: Relativistic effects (e.g., the DKH2 method) cause the electron mass of the 1s orbital to increase and the orbital size to contract; the larger the nuclear charge, the more pronounced the effect. Since outer s orbitals must satisfy orthogonality with inner s orbitals, the sizes of the outer orbitals also contract accordingly. By comparing the electron radial distribution functions of the 2s and 3s orbitals from relativistic and non-relativistic calculations, one can observe that the radial positions of the maxima become smaller.

heading: Setting up DKH2 relativistic calculations in Gaussian
content: To perform scalar relativistic calculations in Gaussian, you can use the int=dkh2 keyword (Douglas-Kroll-Hess 2nd order). It must be combined with IOP(3/93=1) to change the default finite-size nuclear model to the point charge model, so as to be compatible with most all-electron relativistic basis sets (e.g., the SARC basis set).

heading: 使用ELF函数研究原子壳层结构
content: 电子定域化函数（ELF）可用于展现原子主壳层（K、L、M、N等）结构。在Multiwfn中绘制ELF随径向距离变化的曲线（功能3 -> 9），曲线上的峰对应于各个壳层。ELF是辨别原子壳层结构的最佳选择，甚至能清晰展现Rn原子的6个壳层。

heading: Using the ELF function to study atomic shell structure
content: The electron localization function (ELF) can be used to reveal the structure of atomic main shells (K, L, M, N, etc.). In Multiwfn, plot the curve of ELF as a function of radial distance (function 3 -> 9); the peaks on the curve correspond to the individual shells. ELF is the best choice for identifying atomic shell structure, and can even clearly reveal the 6 shells of the Rn atom.

heading: 使用其他实空间函数研究原子壳层结构
content: 定域轨道定位器（LOL）与ELF类似，也能展现壳层结构。电子密度的拉普拉斯函数（负值区域对应壳层）对原子序数大于40的原子辨别能力下降。平均局部离子化能（ALII）随径向变化的曲线平台代表壳层，拐点代表分界。V(r)/ρ(r)函数在壳层处产生凹陷，可通过设置iuserfunc=8调用。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/152_Multiwfn绘制原子轨道及壳层结构分析_卡片.md
heading: Using other real space functions to study atomic shell structure
content: The localized orbital locator (LOL), similar to ELF, can also reveal shell structure. The Laplacian of electron density (regions of negative values correspond to shells) loses discriminating ability for atoms with atomic number greater than 40. In the curve of the averaged local ionization energy (ALII) versus radial distance, plateaus represent shells and inflection points represent boundaries. The V(r)/ρ(r) function produces depressions at shells and can be invoked by setting iuserfunc=8.

heading: Rn原子壳层结构研究的基组选择
content: 研究Rn等重原子的壳层结构时，推荐使用WTBS基组进行HF非相对论计算，因为该基组专为HF优化、涵盖全面且计算较快。SARC基组不支持主族元素，UGBS基组易出现积分精度问题，而ANO-RCC基组过大计算缓慢。ELF函数在Rn原子的壳层辨别上表现出色。
