heading: 密度差的盆分析和域分析
content: 利用Multiwfn的盆分析功能对密度差的盆进行积分，可定量获知不同局部特征区域的电子增减情况；域分析可以考察密度差特定数值等值面内包围区域的密度差积分值，参考手册3.200.14节和4.200.14节。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: Basin analysis and domain analysis of density difference
content: Using the basin analysis function of Multiwfn to integrate the basins of the density difference allows quantitative knowledge of electron gain and loss in different locally characteristic regions; domain analysis can examine the density difference integral value within the region enclosed by an isosurface of a specific density difference value, see Sections 3.200.14 and 4.200.14 of the manual for reference.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: 电荷分解分析(CDA)
content: CDA可以展现内在细节，能获知片段之间是如何通过复合物的各个分子轨道来贡献和反馈电子的，还能直接输出轨道相互作用图；可参考《使用Multiwfn做电荷分解分析(CDA)、绘制轨道相互作用图》一文。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: Charge decomposition analysis (CDA)
content: CDA can reveal intrinsic details, showing how fragments donate and back-donate electrons through each molecular orbital of the complex, and can directly output the orbital interaction diagram; see the article 《使用Multiwfn做电荷分解分析(CDA)、绘制轨道相互作用图》 for reference.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: 密度差统计分析
content: Multiwfn基于密度差数据能得到电子转移距离、转移电子分布的弥散程度等统计量，并将密度差数据变换为直观的描述形式；见手册3.21.3的介绍和4.18.3节的例子。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: Statistical analysis of density difference
content: Based on density difference data, Multiwfn can obtain statistical quantities such as the electron transfer distance and the degree of dispersion of the transferred electron distribution, and can transform the density difference data into intuitive descriptive forms; see the introduction in Section 3.21.3 of the manual and the example in Section 4.18.3.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: Hirshfeld表面分析
content: Hirshfeld表面分析可以十分清晰地给出分子间相互作用的界面，并从界面不同区域的颜色上能立刻了解到什么位置发生了明显的相互作用，还能绘制指纹图；详细介绍见《使用Multiwfn做Hirshfeld surface分析直观展现分子晶体和复合物中的相互作用》。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: Hirshfeld surface analysis
content: Hirshfeld surface analysis can very clearly reveal the interface of intermolecular interactions, and from the colors of different regions of the surface one can immediately know where significant interactions occur; fingerprint plots can also be drawn; for details, see 《使用Multiwfn做Hirshfeld surface分析直观展现分子晶体和复合物中的相互作用》.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: LOLIPOP指数
content: LOLIPOP是基于定域化轨道定位函数(LOL)定义的预测分子间pi-pi堆积能力的指数，和相互作用能有较好关系；介绍见手册3.100.14节，实例见4.100.14节。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: LOLIPOP index
content: The LOLIPOP index is defined based on the localized orbital locator (LOL) to predict the intermolecular pi-pi stacking capability, and it correlates well with the interaction energy; for an introduction see Section 3.100.14 of the manual, and for examples see Section 4.100.14.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: sobEDA和sobEDAw能量分解
content: sobEDA和sobEDAw是基于色散校正的密度泛函理论提出的能量分解方法，是片段间相互作用能分解的近乎完美的解决方案；介绍和使用例子见《使用sobEDA和sobEDAw方法做非常准确、快速、方便、普适的能量分解分析》。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: sobEDA and sobEDAw energy decomposition
content: sobEDA and sobEDAw are energy decomposition methods proposed based on dispersion-corrected density functional theory, and they are a nearly perfect solution for decomposition of inter-fragment interaction energy; for an introduction and usage examples, see 《使用sobEDA和sobEDAw方法做非常准确、快速、方便、普适的能量分解分析》.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: 基于分子力场的能量分解(EDA-FF)
content: EDA-FF分解形式简单，计算耗时极低，可用于巨大体系，片段可以随意划分用于研究分子内弱相互作用，还能直接给出各个原子的贡献并可视化；可参考《使用Multiwfn做基于分子力场的能量分解分析》一文。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: Energy decomposition based on molecular force field (EDA-FF)
content: EDA-FF has a simple decomposition form and extremely low computational cost, can be applied to very large systems, allows fragments to be divided freely for studying intramolecular weak interactions, and can directly give the atomic contribution of each atom with visualization; see the article 《使用Multiwfn做基于分子力场的能量分解分析》 for reference.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: 源函数分析
content: 源函数是Bader和Gatti在AIM框架下定义的实空间函数，可讨论不同空间区域对指定的一个点的电子密度的贡献；综述见Struct.&Bond.,147,193(2010)，Multiwfn分析实例见4.17.5节。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: Source function analysis
content: The source function is a real-space function defined by Bader and Gatti within the AIM framework, which can be used to discuss the contribution of different spatial regions to the electron density at a specified point; for a review see Struct.&Bond.,147,193(2010), and for a Multiwfn analysis example see Section 4.17.5.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: RDG可视化分析
content: 约化密度梯度(RDG)分析是重要的弱相互作用分析方法，使分析结果清晰直观，能考察如pi-pi堆积、无BCP出现等AIM理论不适用的场合；方法介绍见《使用Multiwfn图形化研究弱相互作用》和Multiwfn手册3.23.1节；RDG分析可扩展到分子动力学模拟环境，见《用Multiwfn研究分子动力学中的弱相互作用》。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: RDG visualization analysis
content: Reduced density gradient (RDG) analysis is an important method for weak interaction analysis that makes the results clear and intuitive, and can be applied to situations where AIM theory is not applicable, such as pi-pi stacking and cases where no BCP appears; for the method introduction, see 《使用Multiwfn图形化研究弱相互作用》 and Section 3.23.1 of the Multiwfn manual; RDG analysis can be extended to molecular dynamics simulation environments, see 《用Multiwfn研究分子动力学中的弱相互作用》.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: 范德华表面相互穿透距离分析
content: 弱相互作用会导致分子的范德华表面被彼此穿透，穿透距离越大通常弱相互作用越强；较准确的方法是在Multiwfn中做完定量分子表面分析后选10得到原子的非键原子半径，将两个非键半径相加减去实际距离即得穿透距离。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: Analysis of van der Waals surface interpenetration distance
content: Weak interactions cause the van der Waals surface of molecules to be penetrated by each other; the larger the penetration distance, the stronger the weak interaction typically is. A more accurate approach is to perform quantitative molecular surface analysis in Multiwfn and then choose option 10 to obtain the nonbonded atomic radius of each atom; the penetration distance equals the sum of the two nonbonded radii minus the actual distance.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: 原子多极矩分析
content: 原子多极矩用于描述原子附近电子分布的各向异性，更细致地讨论分子间静电相互作用需要把原子多极矩也进行考虑；Multiwfn中既可以基于模糊原子空间计算原子多极矩，也可以基于AIM原子盆来计算，见手册4.17.1节。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: Atomic multipole moment analysis
content: Atomic multipole moments describe the anisotropy of electron distribution near atoms; a more detailed discussion of intermolecular electrostatic interaction requires taking atomic multipole moments into account as well. In Multiwfn, atomic multipole moments can be calculated either based on fuzzy atomic spaces or based on AIM atomic basins; see Section 4.17.1 of the manual.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: 轨道重叠分析
content: 轨道重叠越厉害通常轨道作用往往越强；用Multiwfn可以计算两个单体轨道间的重叠积分并实现可视化轨道重叠的方法，见《分子间轨道重叠的图形显示和计算》。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: Orbital overlap analysis
content: The greater the orbital overlap, the stronger the orbital interaction tends to be. Multiwfn can calculate the overlap integrals between orbitals of two monomers and enable visualization of orbital overlap; see 《分子间轨道重叠的图形显示和计算》.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: 电子密度拉普拉斯函数分析
content: 电子密度拉普拉斯函数的符号和大小能体现原子周围哪里富电子和缺电子；在JMM,19,2035(2013)中，作者把σ-hole位置的电子密度拉普拉斯函数的(3,-1)型临界点密度与相互作用能很好地关联了起来。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: Electron density Laplacian analysis
content: The sign and magnitude of the electron density Laplacian indicate where electron-rich and electron-deficient regions are around an atom. In JMM,19,2035(2013), the authors correlated the density at the (3,-1) critical points of the electron density Laplacian at σ-hole positions well with the interaction energy.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: 亲电指数ωcubic
content: J. Phys. Chem. A, 124, 2090 (2020)提出的ωcubic可以与福井函数f+相乘成为函数形式，再积分得到简缩局部形式；作为Lewis酸的卤原子X的简缩局部ωcubic与卤键结合能的线性关系相当好；ωcubic计算见《使用Multiwfn超级方便地计算出概念密度泛函理论中定义的各种量》。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: Electrophilicity index ωcubic
content: The ωcubic proposed in J. Phys. Chem. A, 124, 2090 (2020) can be multiplied with the Fukui function f+ to form a function, which upon integration yields the condensed local form. The condensed local ωcubic of a halogen atom X acting as a Lewis acid shows a fairly good linear relationship with the halogen bond binding energy. For the ωcubic calculation, see 《使用Multiwfn超级方便地计算出概念密度泛函理论中定义的各种量》.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: 范德华势
content: 范德华势适用于范德华作用起关键作用的场合，例如非极性分子间的相互作用；Multiwfn可以极为快速、方便、灵活地分析范德华势，可参考《谈谈范德华势以及在Multiwfn中的计算、分析和绘制》一文。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: van der Waals potential
content: The van der Waals potential is applicable in situations where van der Waals interaction plays a key role, such as interactions between nonpolar molecules. Multiwfn can analyze the van der Waals potential extremely quickly, conveniently and flexibly; see the article 《谈谈范德华势以及在Multiwfn中的计算、分析和绘制》.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: 价层电子密度分析
content: 通过考察价层电子密度，对弱相互作用本质可以予以一定的解释；详细讨论见Revealing Molecular Electronic Structure via Analysis of Valence Electron Density。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: Valence electron density analysis
content: By examining the valence electron density, the nature of weak interactions can be explained to some extent; for a detailed discussion, see Revealing Molecular Electronic Structure via Analysis of Valence Electron Density.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: ETS-NOCV分析
content: ETS-NOCV方法专门深入考察片段间的轨道相互作用，可以将总的轨道相互作用进行分解，对每一部分都能得到它对轨道相互作用能的贡献并能给出与之对应的电子密度变化图；详细介绍见《使用Multiwfn通过ETS-NOCV方法深入分析片段间的轨道相互作用》。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: ETS-NOCV analysis
content: The ETS-NOCV method is specifically designed to deeply examine inter-fragment orbital interaction; it can decompose the total orbital interaction, and for each component it provides its contribution to the orbital interaction energy as well as the corresponding electron density change plot. For details, see 《使用Multiwfn通过ETS-NOCV方法深入分析片段间的轨道相互作用》.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: 局部电子附着能(LEAE)分析
content: 分子表面的局部电子附着能在电子密度0.004 a.u.等值面上的极小点数值与卤键相互作用能有极好的线性相关性；可参考《使用Multiwfn通过局部电子附着能(LEAE)考察亲核反应位点、难易及弱相互作用》一文。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览

heading: Local electron attachment energy (LEAE) analysis
content: The values at the minima of the local electron attachment energy (LEAE) on the 0.004 a.u. isosurface of electron density of the molecular surface show an excellent linear correlation with the halogen bond interaction energy. See the article 《使用Multiwfn通过局部电子附着能(LEAE)考察亲核反应位点、难易及弱相互作用》.

heading: 原子对色散能的贡献和色散密度
content: Multiwfn可以计算原子对色散能的贡献和色散密度，通过原子着色、绘制等值面图直观展现哪些原子对体系中的色散作用有显著贡献；详细介绍见《使用Multiwfn图形化展现原子对色散能的贡献以及色散密度》。

heading: Atomic contribution to dispersion energy and dispersion density
content: Multiwfn can calculate the atomic contribution to dispersion energy and the dispersion density, and intuitively show via atom coloring and plotting isosurface maps which atoms contribute significantly to the dispersion interaction in the system. For details, see 《使用Multiwfn图形化展现原子对色散能的贡献以及色散密度》.

heading: IRI可视化分析
content: IRI方法不仅像RDG一样可以展现弱相互作用，还可以把化学键相互作用同时展现，即一张图里展现体系中存在的所有相互作用；详细介绍见《使用IRI方法图形化考察化学体系中的化学键和弱相互作用》。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: IRI visualization analysis
content: Like RDG, the IRI method can reveal weak interactions, but it can also simultaneously reveal chemical bond interactions, i.e., showing all interactions present in the system in a single plot. For details, see 《使用IRI方法图形化考察化学体系中的化学键和弱相互作用》.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: NBO E(2)分析的局限性
content: NBO E(2)分析本质是轨道相互作用，在一般强度的弱相互作用中只占极小角色，更不是复合物中使单体能够保持结合的本质原因；拿讨论轨道作用的工具E(2)讨论静电和色散主导的作用是完全喧宾夺主，没有正确反映相互作用的物理本质。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: Limitations of NBO E(2) analysis
content: NBO E(2) analysis is essentially orbital interaction, which plays only a very minor role in weak interactions of ordinary strength, and is by no means the fundamental reason why monomers remain bound in a complex. Using E(2), a tool for discussing orbital interactions, to discuss interactions dominated by electrostatics and dispersion is completely putting the cart before the horse and does not correctly reflect the physical nature of the interaction.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: 键长和振动频率变化分析
content: 氢键形成后通常伴随着X-H键的削弱，键长会增长，振动频率也会降低（红移），但也有时相反；键长和频率的变化是氢键文章中经常讨论的，建议同时结合键级来分析。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: Analysis of bond length and vibrational frequency changes
content: Upon hydrogen bond formation, the X-H bond is usually weakened: the bond length increases and the vibrational frequency decreases (red shift), although sometimes the opposite occurs. Changes in bond length and frequency are frequently discussed in hydrogen bond papers; it is recommended to analyze them together with the bond order.
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: 磁感生电流分析
content: 磁感应电流穿过氢键的强度可以用来衡量氢键强度，因为氢键越强，相互作用原子间电子的离域能力越强，感应电流就越容易穿过去；相关程序介绍见GIMIC综述PCCP,13,20500(2011)。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览
fm_title: Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用的分析方法概览

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/252_Multiwfn支持的弱相互作用分析方法概览_卡片.md
heading: Magnetically induced current analysis
content: The strength of the magnetically induced current passing through a hydrogen bond can be used to measure the hydrogen bond strength, because the stronger the hydrogen bond, the stronger the electron delocalization between the interacting atoms, and the more easily the induced current passes through. For an introduction to the relevant program, see the GIMIC review PCCP,13,20500(2011).
topic: Overview of weak interaction analysis methods supported by Multiwfn

heading: Mayer能量分解
content: Mayer能量分解方法不需要定义片段，而是直接对整体进行分析，得到体系中不同原子间的各种成份的相互作用能（不含色散作用）；此方法在弱相互作用上的应用极少。

heading: Mayer energy decomposition
content: The Mayer energy decomposition method does not require defining fragments, but directly analyzes the whole, yielding the interaction energy components between different atoms in the system (excluding the dispersion interaction). This method has rarely been applied to weak interactions.

content: IQA方法能给出体系中每对儿原子间的相互作用能的物理成份，但用AIM原子盆定义原子空间导致计算量极大，目前只能用于非常小的体系；Multiwfn以后可能基于Hirshfeld方法定义原子空间来支持此方法。

heading: Interacting quantum atoms (IQA)
content: The IQA method can give the physical components of pairwise interaction energies between atoms in the system, but defining atomic space via atomic basins in AIM leads to an extremely large computational cost, so currently it can only be applied to very small systems; Multiwfn may in the future support this method by defining atomic space based on the Hirshfeld method.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/255_原子半径定义与Multiwfn计算实例_卡片.md
heading: 共价半径的定义与判断规则
content: 共价半径是指原子间形成化学键时键长相当于两原子共价半径之和。可视化程序如Multiwfn默认依据此规则判断成键，只要两原子间距离小于其CSD共价半径和的115%就显示化学键。这种仅基于几何结构的判断规则很粗糙，未考虑电子结构且没有严格的成键有无标准，仅适用于粗糙判断。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: 原子半径定义与Multiwfn计算实例
fm_title: 简谈原子半径

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/255_原子半径定义与Multiwfn计算实例_卡片.md
heading: Definition of covalent radii and bonding determination rules
content: The covalent radius refers to the fact that when atoms form a chemical bond, the bond length corresponds to the sum of the covalent radii of the two atoms. Visualization programs such as Multiwfn determine bonding by this rule by default: a chemical bond is displayed as long as the distance between two atoms is less than 115% of the sum of their CSD covalent radii. This rule, based only on the geometric structure, is very crude; it does not consider the electronic structure and lacks a strict criterion for whether a bond exists, so it is only suitable for rough judgment.
topic: Definitions of atomic radii and Multiwfn calculation examples
fm_title: 简谈原子半径

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/255_原子半径定义与Multiwfn计算实例_卡片.md
heading: 离子半径与共价半径的数值差异
content: 由于阳离子半径相对共价半径降低，阴离子半径相对共价半径增加，二者数值大小相近，因此阴阳离子半径加和与两个原子共价半径加和差异通常不太大。有人认为仅用一套共价半径讨论键长问题即可，没必要单独考虑离子半径。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: 原子半径定义与Multiwfn计算实例

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/255_原子半径定义与Multiwfn计算实例_卡片.md
heading: Numerical differences between ionic and covalent radii
content: Since the radii of cations decrease and those of anions increase relative to covalent radii, the two are similar in magnitude, so the sum of cation and anion radii usually does not differ much from the sum of the covalent radii of two atoms. Some people argue that discussing bond length issues using only a single set of covalent radii is sufficient, with no need to consider ionic radii separately.

heading: 范德华半径与相互作用
content: 原子间以范德华作用吸引时，平衡距离大致为二者范德华半径之和。如果原子间非共价相互作用很强（如氢键、卤键、pi-pi堆积），距离会明显小于范德华半径和；如果大于范德华半径和，表明相互作用很弱（范德华作用随距离呈1/r^6衰减）。

heading: Van der Waals radii and interactions
content: When atoms attract each other via van der Waals interaction, the equilibrium distance is roughly the sum of their van der Waals radii. If the noncovalent interaction between atoms is strong (such as hydrogen bond, halogen bond, pi-pi stacking), the distance will be significantly smaller than the sum of the van der Waals radii; if it is larger than the sum of the van der Waals radii, the interaction is very weak (van der Waals interaction decays as 1/r^6 with distance).

heading: Bondi van der Waals radii

heading: Environment-averaged nature of covalent radii
content: Atoms have different electronic structures in different chemical environments; for example, C has sp, sp2, and sp3 hybridization, and transition metals have high-spin and low-spin states, leading to varying bond lengths. content: Ionic radius specifically describes the state of atoms when forming ionic compounds, where the state differs greatly from that in forming covalent bonds. The radius of a cation is significantly smaller than its covalent radius, while the radius of an anion is significantly larger than its covalent radius. The sum of ionic radii agrees well with interionic distances.

heading: 最小信息增益原理
content: Nalewajski和Parr在PNAS, 97, 8879 (2000)中指出，如果用Hirshfeld方式划分分子空间来定义原子（其密度记为ρ_A、ρ_B、ρ_C...），那么形成分子后，各个原子相对于它在孤立状态（密度记为ρ0_A、ρ0_B、ρ0_C...）的信息熵变，或者说原子的信息增益，都是最小的（如A原子的增益=-∫ρ_A(r)ln[ρ_A(r)ρ0_A(r)] dr）。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/257_Hirshfeld电荷与信息增益标度亲电亲核性_卡片.md
heading: Minimum information gain principle
content: As pointed out by Nalewajski and Parr in PNAS, 97, 8879 (2000), if atoms are defined via molecular space partitioning via Hirshfeld scheme (their densities denoted ρ_A, ρ_B, ρ_C...), then after the molecule is formed, the information entropy change of each atom relative to its isolated state (densities denoted ρ0_A, ρ0_B, ρ0_C...), i.e., the atomic information gain, is minimized (e.g., the gain of atom A = -∫ρ_A(r)ln[ρ_A(r)/ρ0_A(r)] dr).

heading: 信息保守原理
content: 在J. Phys. Chem. A 2014, 118, 3698-3704中，作者指出在一阶近似下，Hirshfeld方式划分导致的分子信息增益恰为0，并称之为信息保守原理。

heading: Information conservation principle
content: In J. Phys. Chem. A 2014, 118, 3698-3704, the authors pointed out that to first-order approximation, the molecular information gain arising from Hirshfeld-scheme partitioning is exactly 0, which they called the information conservation principle.

content: 在J. Phys. Chem. A 2014, 118, 3698-3704中，作者指出在一阶近似下，原子的信息增益和原子的Hirshfeld电荷是等价的，这将抽象的信息熵概念和计算化学工作者熟知的原子电荷直接联系了起来。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/261_Multiwfn计算倾斜扭曲环NICS_ZZ_卡片.md
heading: NICS(1)_ZZ的定义与平面体系计算方法
content: NICS(1)_ZZ具体指的是垂直于环平面上方1埃处在垂直于环平面方向上的磁屏蔽值的负值。对于在XY平面上的平面体系，计算方法是先算出环中心，将Z坐标加1放置Bq原子，计算NMR后读取Bq原子的磁屏蔽张量的ZZ分量并取负号即可。NICS、NICS(1)_ZZ的定义详见《衡量芳香性的方法以及在Multiwfn中的计算》3.1节。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn计算倾斜扭曲环NICS_ZZ
fm_title: 利用Multiwfn计算倾斜、扭曲环的NICS_ZZ

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/261_Multiwfn计算倾斜扭曲环NICS_ZZ_卡片.md
heading: Definition of NICS(1)_ZZ and calculation method for planar systems
content: NICS(1)_ZZ specifically refers to the negative of the magnetic shielding value at a point 1 angstrom above the ring plane, along the direction perpendicular to the ring plane. For a planar system in the XY plane, the calculation method is: first compute the ring center, place a Bq atom by adding 1 to the Z coordinate, run the NMR calculation, then read the ZZ component of the magnetic shielding tensor of the Bq atom and take its negative. For the definitions of NICS and NICS(1)_ZZ, see Section 3.1 of 《衡量芳香性的方法以及在Multiwfn中的计算》.
topic: Multiwfn NICS_ZZ calculation for tilted and distorted rings

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/261_Multiwfn计算倾斜扭曲环NICS_ZZ_卡片.md
heading: 计算环上方和下方不同距离的NICS_ZZ
content: 若需计算平面上方和下方1埃处的NICS(1)_ZZ，在输入屏蔽张量界面分别粘贴对应点Bq原子的张量即可。计算NICS(0)_ZZ可将Bq放在环中心；计算NICS(5)_ZZ可将环中心坐标加上5倍单位法向量得到Bq坐标，后续步骤相同。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn计算倾斜扭曲环NICS_ZZ
fm_title: 利用Multiwfn计算倾斜、扭曲环的NICS_ZZ

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/261_Multiwfn计算倾斜扭曲环NICS_ZZ_卡片.md
heading: Calculating NICS_ZZ at different distances above and below the ring
content: If you need to calculate NICS(1)_ZZ at 1 angstrom above and below the plane, paste the tensors of the Bq atoms at the corresponding points in the shielding tensor input interface. To calculate NICS(0)_ZZ, place the Bq atom at the ring center; to calculate NICS(5)_ZZ, add 5 times the unit normal vector to the ring center coordinates to obtain the Bq coordinates, and the subsequent steps are the same.

heading: 多个环的NICS计算策略
content: 如果要研究多个环，可按照步骤确定各个环的Bq原子位置，并将所有Bq原子写入同一个Gaussian输入文件中。只需运行一次Gaussian计算即可获得所有Bq原子的屏蔽张量，无需每个环单独计算一次。

heading: NICS calculation strategy for multiple rings
content: If multiple rings are to be studied, determine the Bq atom positions of each ring following the procedure, and write all Bq atoms into the same Gaussian input file. A single Gaussian calculation suffices to obtain the shielding tensors of all Bq atoms, without needing a separate calculation for each ring.

heading: 倾斜扭曲环NICS(1)_ZZ计算的难点
content: 当被研究的环不在XY/YZ/XZ平面上，或者环本身是扭曲而非完美平面时，确定要计算的Bq原子位置变得困难。虽然可以通过旋转体系使环平行于XY平面来计算，但如果要研究的环很多，每研究一个环都旋转一次结构非常麻烦。

heading: Difficulty of NICS(1)_ZZ calculation for tilted and distorted rings
content: When the ring under study is not in the XY/YZ/XZ plane, or the ring itself is distorted rather than perfectly planar, determining the Bq atom position to be calculated becomes difficult. Although the calculation can be done by rotating the system so that the ring is parallel to the XY plane, if there are many rings to study, rotating the structure for each ring is very cumbersome.

heading: 计算环中心的常用方法
content: 计算环中心常用两种方法：取环的质心，或取环的AIM理论中的环临界点位置。前者不需要波函数文件，只要有结构即可；后者可通过Multiwfn的拓扑分析功能得到，具体可参考《使用Multiwfn做拓扑分析以及计算孤对电子角度》。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/261_Multiwfn计算倾斜扭曲环NICS_ZZ_卡片.md
heading: Common methods for calculating the ring center
content: Two methods are commonly used to calculate the ring center: taking the center of mass of the ring, or taking the ring critical point positions in AIM theory. The former does not require a wavefunction file, only the structure; the latter can be obtained via the Multiwfn topological analysis feature; see 《使用Multiwfn做拓扑分析以及计算孤对电子角度》 for details.

heading: Steps to calculate the ring center of mass with Multiwfn
content: Launch Multiwfn, input the structure file (e.g. Fullerene_No.1-C2.pdb), choose main function 100 (Other functions Part 1) and subfunction 21 (calculating various geometric-structure-based properties), then input the atomic indices composing the ring; the program will output the center of mass coordinates of ring.

heading: Multiwfn辅助计算非平面体系NICS_ZZ的功能
content: 在Multiwfn中选择主功能25（离域性与芳香性分析）和子功能4（辅助计算非平面体系的NICS_ZZ）。输入环的质心坐标（或直接回车让程序使用原子几何中心），再输入环上原子的序号，程序会根据最小二乘法拟合出代表性平面，并输出平面拟合误差、单位法向量以及距离中心上下1埃处的坐标。

heading: Multiwfn feature assisting calculation of NICS_ZZ for nonplanar systems
content: In Multiwfn, choose main function 25 (Delocalization and aromaticity analysis) and subfunction 4 (assisting calculation of NICS_ZZ for nonplanar systems). Input the center of mass coordinates of ring (or press Enter directly to let the program use the geometric center of the atoms), then input the indices of the atoms in the ring; the program will fit a representative plane by least squares method, and output the plane fitting error, the unit normal vector, and the coordinates 1 angstrom above and below the center.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/261_Multiwfn计算倾斜扭曲环NICS_ZZ_卡片.md
heading: 拟合平面的输出信息解读
content: Multiwfn会输出平面的RMS拟合误差（纯平面为0）、单位法向量，以及从定义点沿法向量向上和向下移动1埃后的坐标。这两个坐标可作为Bq原子位置来计算NICS(1)_ZZ，对于大体平面的体系取这两点的平均值较合理，对于笼状体系应取处在环外的那个点。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析

fm_title: 利用Multiwfn计算倾斜、扭曲环的NICS_ZZ

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/261_Multiwfn计算倾斜扭曲环NICS_ZZ_卡片.md
heading: Interpreting the output information of the fitted plane
content: Multiwfn outputs the RMS fitting error of the plane (0 for a purely planar one), the unit normal vector, and the coordinates obtained by moving 1 Å upward and downward along the normal vector from the defined points. These two coordinates can be used as Bq atom positions to calculate NICS(1)_ZZ. For a largely planar system, taking the average of these two points is reasonable; for a cage-like system, the point lying outside the ring should be used.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/261_Multiwfn计算倾斜扭曲环NICS_ZZ_卡片.md
heading: Gaussian计算NICS的输入文件设置
content: 基于C36结构创建Gaussian输入文件，将Multiwfn计算出的Bq原子坐标（如1.2769174726 -2.7999963248 0.7116924541）写入，使用NMR关键词。实际研究中基组决不能低于6-31G*（示例中使用STO-3G仅为节省计算量）。必须包含nosymm关键词，防止Gaussian自动旋转体系导致垂直于环平面的方向在计算前后改变。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn计算倾斜扭曲环NICS_ZZ
fm_title: 利用Multiwfn计算倾斜、扭曲环的NICS_ZZ

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/261_Multiwfn计算倾斜扭曲环NICS_ZZ_卡片.md
heading: Setting up the Gaussian input file for NICS calculation
content: Create a Gaussian input file based on the C36 structure and write in the Bq atom coordinates computed by Multiwfn (e.g., 1.2769174726 -2.7999963248 0.7116924541), using the NMR keyword. In actual research, the basis set must never be lower than 6-31G* (the use of STO-3G in the example is only to save computational cost). The nosymm keyword must be included to prevent Gaussian from automatically rotating the system, which would change the direction perpendicular to the ring plane between calculations.
topic: Using Multiwfn to calculate NICS_ZZ of tilted/distorted rings
fm_title: 利用Multiwfn计算倾斜、扭曲环的NICS_ZZ

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/261_Multiwfn计算倾斜扭曲环NICS_ZZ_卡片.md
heading: 提取屏蔽张量并计算NICS_ZZ值
content: 运行Gaussian计算后，在输出文件中找到Bq原子的磁屏蔽张量（XX, YX, ZX等3行数据）。切换回Multiwfn窗口，将这3行数据（或张量矩阵）输入，程序会输出垂直于平面的屏蔽值和NICS_ZZ值（即屏蔽值的负值）。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn计算倾斜扭曲环NICS_ZZ
fm_title: 利用Multiwfn计算倾斜、扭曲环的NICS_ZZ

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/261_Multiwfn计算倾斜扭曲环NICS_ZZ_卡片.md
heading: Extracting the shielding tensor and calculating the NICS_ZZ value
content: After running the Gaussian calculation, locate the magnetic shielding tensor of the Bq atom in the output file (3 rows of data such as XX, YX, ZX). Switch back to the Multiwfn window and input these 3 rows of data (or the tensor matrix); the program will output the shielding value perpendicular to the plane and the NICS_ZZ value (i.e., the negative of the shielding value).

heading: 简化操作：自动使用几何中心
content: 如果在进入主功能25的子功能4前没有特意计算质心，且定义拟合平面用的原子就是环上所有原子，可直接在输入环中心时敲回车。程序会自动将输入的环原子的几何中心作为环中心。

heading: Simplified operation: automatically using the geometric center
content: If you did not specifically calculate the center of mass before entering subfunction 4 of main function 25, and the atoms used to define the fitted plane are exactly all the atoms of the ring, you can simply press Enter when asked for the ring center. The program will automatically use the geometric center of the input ring atoms as the ring center.

heading: Installing and running the Windows version of MOPAC

heading: 双自由基定义与特征y
content: 双自由基指一个体系里有两个未成对电子，自旋相反，属于单重态体系。Yamanaka等人提出的双自由基特征y的数值从0到1，0对应闭壳层，越接近1说明体系双自由基特征越明显，1就是理想双自由基。主要讨论该特征y的计算以及使用CASSCF计算双自由基体系。计算使用Gaussian 09完成，Multiwfn可免费下载。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/264_CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征_卡片.md
heading: Definition of Diradical and Diradical Character y
content: A diradical refers to a system with two unpaired electrons of opposite spin, belonging to a singlet state. The diradical character y proposed in the literature ranges from 0 to 1; 0 corresponds to a closed shell, and the closer to 1, the more pronounced the diradical character of the system; 1 corresponds to an ideal diradical. This discussion mainly covers the calculation of the character y and the use of CASSCF for diradical systems calculated by CASSCF. Calculations are performed with Gaussian 09; Multiwfn can be downloaded free of charge.
topic: Calculating Diradical Character with CASSCF and UHF

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/264_CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征_卡片.md
heading: 基于<S^2>计算双自由基特征的局限
content: 对于C4H8体系，UHF计算后输出的<S^2>=ΔS^2=1.0142，代入y表达式会导致根号内为负值。这是由于除了单电子对应的一对轨道外，其它alpha和beta轨道间也出现了分离，影响了体系的<S^2>，因此只考虑一对轨道的简化公式在此不适用。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/264_CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征_卡片.md
heading: Limitations of Calculating Diradical Character Based on <S^2>
content: For the C4H8 system, the UHF calculation outputs <S^2>=ΔS^2=1.0142, which makes the expression under the square root negative when substituted into the y formula. This is because, besides the orbital pair corresponding to the single electrons, other alpha and beta orbitals have also become separated, affecting the system's <S^2>; therefore the simplified formula considering only one orbital pair is not applicable here.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/264_CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征_卡片.md
heading: 基于UNO占据数计算双自由基特征
content: 重叠积分T与UNO占据数相关，只考虑对应单电子的那一对轨道时，HOMO和LUMO的UNO占据数n_HOMO和n_LUMO分别为1+T和1-T，故T=(n_HOMO-n_LUMO)/2。对于理想双自由基，n_HOMO和n_LUMO都将为1。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/264_CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征_卡片.md
heading: Calculating Diradical Character Based on UNO Occupation Numbers
content: The overlap integral T is related to the UNO occupation numbers. When considering only the orbital pair corresponding to the single electrons, the UNO occupation numbers of the HOMO and LUMO, n_HOMO and n_LUMO, are 1+T and 1-T respectively, so T=(n_HOMO-n_LUMO)/2. For an ideal diradical, both n_HOMO and n_LUMO equal 1.

heading: C4H8基于UNO占据数的双自由基特征
content: C4H8的UNO占据数为n_HOMO=1.123073，n_LUMO=0.876927，计算得T=0.123，y=0.758。该结果与CAS(2,2)得到的0.732接近。如果不想做CAS而想基于UHF波函数定量考察双自由基特征，通过UNO占据数计算是较理想的选择。

heading: Diradical Character of C4H8 Based on UNO Occupation Numbers
content: The UNO occupation numbers of C4H8 are n_HOMO=1.123073 and n_LUMO=0.876927, giving T=0.123 and y=0.758. This result is close to 0.732 obtained from CAS(2,2). If one does not want to do a CAS calculation but wants a quantitative examination of diradical character based on the UHF wavefunction, the calculation via UNO occupation numbers is an ideal choice.

heading: 快速获取UNO占据数的计算方法
content: 只需要UNO占据数时，不需要分两步计算，只需使用#P UHF/6-31G* guess=mix pop=NO算一次。输出中的Eigenvalues即为UNO的占据数，也就是UHF无自旋密度矩阵的本征值。

heading: Fast Acquisition of UNO Occupation Numbers
content: When only the UNO occupation numbers are needed, there is no need for a two-step calculation; a single run with #P UHF/6-31G* guess=mix pop=NO suffices. The Eigenvalues in the output are the UNO occupation numbers, i.e., the eigenvalues of the UHF spin-free density matrix.

heading: UHF与CASSCF处理双自由基的优缺点
content: UHF计算双自由基虽然不如CASSCF准确，但速度快、方便，且能提供自旋密度，在Multiwfn中可以直接查看未成对电子分布。CASSCF波函数虽然精确表现了自旋相反状态，但得不到自旋密度。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/264_CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征_卡片.md
heading: Pros and Cons of UHF vs. CASSCF for Treating Diradicals
content: Although UHF is less accurate than CASSCF for calculating diradicals, it is fast and convenient, and it provides the spin density; in Multiwfn the unpaired electron distribution can be viewed directly. The CASSCF wavefunction accurately represents the opposite-spin state but does not yield the spin density.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/264_CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征_卡片.md
heading: 理想双自由基下的UHF自旋污染与能量
content: 对于H2完全解离这样的理想双自由基，UHF和FCI结果是一致的，尽管<S^2>与理想值的偏差达到1.0。<S^2>偏差大意味着波函数与真实波函数偏差大，但并不意味着能量不合理。DFT引入波函数的初衷是为了获得可靠的动能密度，故不应仅根据波函数的合理性讨论UDFT结果的合理性。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/264_CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征_卡片.md
heading: UHF Spin Contamination and Energy for an Ideal Diradical
content: For an ideal diradical such as the complete dissociation of H2, UHF and FCI give identical results, even though the deviation of <S^2> from the ideal value reaches 1.0. A large deviation in <S^2> means the wavefunction deviates considerably from the true wavefunction, but it does not imply the energy is unreasonable. DFT introduced the wavefunction in the first place in order to obtain a reliable kinetic energy density, so one should not discuss UDFT result reliability solely from wavefunction plausibility.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/264_CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征_卡片.md
heading: CI波函数下的双自由基特征计算公式
content: H2的CI波函数写为ψCI=c1*ψG+c2*ψD，其中ψG是基态组态，ψD是双激发组态。在解离极限下，c1=1/√2，c2=-1/√2，双激发组态权重c2^2越大，双自由基特征越强。Yamaguchi在Chem. Phys. Lett., 33, 330 (1975)中将双自由基特征定义为y=2*c2^2，当体系为完美双自由基时y恰为1。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征
fm_title: CASSCF计算双自由基以及双自由基特征的计算

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/264_CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征_卡片.md
heading: Formula for Diradical Character from a CI Wavefunction
content: The CI wavefunction of H2 is written as ψCI=c1*ψG+c2*ψD, where ψG is the ground-state configuration and ψD is the double-excitation configuration. In the dissociation limit, c1=1/√2 and c2=-1/√2; the larger the weight c2^2 of the double-excitation configuration, the stronger the diradical character. In Chem. Phys. Lett., 33, 330 (1975), the diradical character was defined as y=2*c2^2, which is exactly 1 for a perfect diradical.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/264_CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征_卡片.md
heading: CAS(2,2)描述双自由基的原理
content: 实际中常用CASSCF波函数描述双自由基，至少需用CAS(2,2)，将两个单电子轨道以相位相同和相位相反方式组合构成的两个分子轨道（通常是HOMO和LUMO）纳入活性空间，产生合理描述双自由基所需的ψG和ψD。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/264_CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征_卡片.md
heading: Principle of Describing Diradicals with CAS(2,2)
content: In practice, the CASSCF wavefunction is commonly used for describing diradicals; at least CAS(2,2) is required, incorporating into the active space the two molecular orbitals (usually the HOMO and LUMO) constructed from the in-phase and out-of-phase combinations of the two single-electron orbitals, which yields the ψG and ψD needed to reasonably describe the diradical.

heading: C4H8双自由基特征的CAS(2,2)计算
content: C4H8体系在HF/6-31G*下计算后，HOMO和LUMO分别是分子两端单电子轨道的相同和相反相位组合。计算过程为：第一步#P HF/6-31G*，第二步#P CAS(2,2)/6-31G* guess=read。输出中组态1为ψG，组态3为ψD，系数c1=0.7961444，c2=-0.6051067，双自由基特征y=2*(-0.6051067)^2=0.732。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/264_CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征_卡片.md
heading: CAS(2,2) Calculation of the Diradical Character of C4H8
content: For the C4H8 system calculated at HF/6-31G*, the HOMO and LUMO are respectively the in-phase and out-of-phase combinations of the single-electron orbitals at the two ends of the molecule. The procedure is: step one #P HF/6-31G*, step two #P CAS(2,2)/6-31G* guess=read. In the output, configuration 1 is ψG and configuration 3 is ψD, with coefficients c1=0.7961444 and c2=-0.6051067; the diradical character is y=2*(-0.6051067)^2=0.732.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/264_CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征_卡片.md
heading: 使用UNO作为CASSCF初猜轨道
content: 常用非限制性计算(UHF/UDFT)得到的自然轨道(UNO)作为CASSCF活性空间的轨道。获取UNO并进行CASSCF计算的三步过程为：#P UHF/6-31G* guess=mix，#P HF/6-31G* guess=(naturalorbitals,read,save,only)，#P CAS(2,2)/6-31G* guess=read。这可以简化为两步：#P UHF/6-31G* guess=mix，#P CAS(2,2,UNO)/6-31G* guess=read。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/264_CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征_卡片.md
heading: Using UNOs as the CASSCF Initial Guess Orbitals
content: The natural orbitals from unrestricted calculations (UHF/UDFT), i.e., UNOs, are commonly used as the orbitals of the CASSCF active space. The three-step procedure to obtain UNOs and perform the CASSCF calculation is: #P UHF/6-31G* guess=mix, #P HF/6-31G* guess=(naturalorbitals,read,save,only), #P CAS(2,2)/6-31G* guess=read. This can be simplified to two steps: #P UHF/6-31G* guess=mix, #P CAS(2,2,UNO)/6-31G* guess=read.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/264_CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征_卡片.md
heading: 基于alpha和beta轨道重叠积分计算双自由基特征
content: 基于自旋投影UHF理论，Chem. Phys. Lett., 33, 330 (1975)给出双自由基特征表达式y=1-(2*T)/(1+T^2)，其中T是空间发生分离的那一对alpha和beta轨道间的重叠积分。T可基于分子轨道或双正交化轨道计算，建议始终使用双正交化轨道计算以使alpha和beta电子分布的不匹配性尽可能只体现在一对轨道之间。

topic: CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/264_CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征_卡片.md
heading: Calculating diradical character from alpha-beta orbital overlap integrals
content: Based on spin-projected UHF theory, Chem. Phys. Lett., 33, 330 (1975) gives the diradical character expression y=1-(2*T)/(1+T^2), where T is the overlap integral between the spatially separated pair of alpha and beta orbitals. T can be calculated based on molecular orbitals or biorthogonalized orbitals; it is recommended to always use biorthogonalized orbitals for the calculation so that the mismatch between the alpha and beta electron distributions is reflected as much as possible only in one pair of orbitals.

heading: C4H8基于双正交化轨道重叠积分的双自由基特征

heading: Diradical character of C4H8 based on biorthogonalized orbital overlap integrals

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/264_CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征_卡片.md
heading: 基于<S^2>计算双自由基特征的理论公式
content: 波函数的自旋平方算符期望值<S^2>与精确值S^2_Exact的关系包含alpha和beta轨道重叠积分项。假设只考虑对应单电子的那一对alpha和beta轨道，ΔS^2=<S^2>-S^2_Exact=1-T^2，将T=√(1-ΔS^2)代入y表达式，得到y=1-2*√(1-ΔS^2)/(2-ΔS^2)。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征
fm_title: CASSCF计算双自由基以及双自由基特征的计算

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/264_CASSCF与UHF计算双自由基特征_卡片.md
heading: Theoretical formula for calculating diradical character based on <S^2>
content: The relation between the expectation value of the spin-squared operator <S^2> of the wavefunction and the exact value S^2_Exact contains terms of the alpha and beta orbital overlap integrals. Assuming only the pair of alpha and beta orbitals corresponding to a single electron is considered, ΔS^2=<S^2>-S^2_Exact=1-T^2; substituting T=√(1-ΔS^2) into the y expression gives y=1-2*√(1-ΔS^2)/(2-ΔS^2).

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: TDDFT基组选择：高阶价层与里德堡激发
content: 如果涉及高阶价层激发、里德堡激发态或阴离子体系，弥散函数必不可少，最低用6-31+G*，一般用aug-cc-pVTZ。若想更精确计算里德堡激发，最好用d-aug-cc-pVTZ基组，但TDDFT精度配不上此基组精度，应改用更精确方法。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Basis set selection in TDDFT: high-level valence and Rydberg excitations
content: If high-level valence excitations, Rydberg excited states, or anionic systems are involved, diffuse functions are indispensable; use at least 6-31+G*, and generally aug-cc-pVTZ. If you want to calculate Rydberg excitations more accurately, it is best to use the d-aug-cc-pVTZ basis set, but the TDDFT accuracy is insufficient to match this basis set, so more accurate methods should be used instead.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: TDDFT泛函选择：价层局域单重态激发
content: 价层局域激发（单重态）最好选择PBE0，误差约0.1~0.3eV，B3LYP仅次于PBE0。HF成份越大，计算出的激发能数值往往越大。纯泛函激发能明显偏低；高HF成份泛函如BHandHLYP(50%)、M06-2X(54%)高估激发能；范围分离泛函如CAM-B3LYP、wB97XD等激发能一律偏高。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Choice of functional in TDDFT: valence local singlet excitation
content: For valence local excitation (singlet state), PBE0 is the best choice, with errors of about 0.1~0.3 eV, and B3LYP is second only to PBE0. The larger the HF component, the larger the calculated excitation energy tends to be. Pure functionals significantly underestimate excitation energies; functionals with high HF content such as BHandHLYP (50%) and M06-2X (54%) overestimate excitation energies; range-separated functionals such as CAM-B3LYP and wB97XD systematically overestimate excitation energies.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: 大共轭体系泛函选择建议
content: 对于大共轭体系（如染料分子），25% HF成份的泛函（PBE0、B3LYP）有低估激发能的倾向，建议用HF成分更高的PBE38(37.5%)或BMK(42%)。常见泛函的HF成份总结见《不同DFT泛函的HF成份一览》。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Functional selection recommendations for large conjugated systems
content: For large conjugated systems (such as dye molecules), functionals with 25% HF component (PBE0, B3LYP) tend to underestimate excitation energies; it is recommended to use PBE38 (37.5%) or BMK (42%) with higher HF component. For a summary of the HF components of common functionals, see 《不同DFT泛函的HF成份一览》.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: TDDFT泛函选择：价层局域三重态激发
content: 价层局域激发（三重态）几乎所有方法无论HF成分高低都低估激发能，HF成份对激发能的影响趋势不如单重态明显。M06-2X对这种情况表现很好，PBE0/B3LYP表现平庸。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Choice of functional in TDDFT: valence local triplet excitation
content: For valence local excitation (triplet state), almost all methods underestimate excitation energies regardless of HF component, and the influence of the HF component on excitation energy is less pronounced than for singlet states. M06-2X performs very well in this case, while the Mediocre performance of PBE0/B3LYP.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: 电荷转移与里德堡激发的推荐泛函
content: 电荷转移和里德堡激发由于传统DFT交换泛函长程行为不对，误差较大，推荐使用CAM-B3LYP、wB97XD、M06-2X。范围分离泛函长程HF成份高，降低了这两类激发误差，但局域激发精度比起PBE0有差距。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Recommended functionals for charge transfer and Rydberg excitations
content: For charge transfer and Rydberg excitation, due to the incorrect long-range behavior of conventional DFT exchange functionals, the errors are large; CAM-B3LYP, wB97XD, and M06-2X are recommended. Range-separated functionals have high long-range HF component, which reduces the errors for these two types of excitations, but their accuracy for local excitations falls short of PBE0.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: w调控泛函的优势与流程
content: w调控泛函计算结果显著依赖于w参数，使用前需优化w参数，见《优化长程校正泛函w参数的简便工具optDFTw》。使用经过w调控后的泛函计算激发能的精度相当好，几乎总是比凭经验选的泛函结果更好，但优化过程耗时。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Advantages and workflow of ω-tuned functionals
content: Results of omega-tuned functionals strongly depend on the omega parameter; the omega parameter must be optimized before use, see 《优化长程校正泛函w参数的简便工具optDFTw》. The accuracy of excited energy calculation using an omega-tuned functional is quite good, almost always better than results from functionals chosen empirically, but the optimization process is time-consuming.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: 低HF成份泛函对电荷转移激发态结构的误导
content: 考察电荷转移体系，在优化时不宜用低HF成份的普通杂化泛函，纯泛函更是绝对别用。例如J. Chem. Theory Comput., 2012, 8, 2359–2372中的分子，B3LYP优化出的激发态结构是相互垂直的，而CAM-B3LYP下是接近平行的。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Misleading excited-state structures of charge transfer systems from low-HF-component functionals
content: For charge transfer systems, conventional hybrid functionals with low HF exchange component should not be used during geometry optimization, and pure functionals should absolutely be avoided. For example, for the molecule in J. Chem. Theory Comput., 2012, 8, 2359–2372, the excited-state structure optimized by B3LYP is mutually perpendicular, whereas with CAM-B3LYP it is nearly parallel.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: GGA泛函与Ghost态问题
content: 不要用GGA泛函做TDDFT计算，不仅严重低估激发能，由于自相互作用误差(SIE)，大共轭体系容易产生Ghost态。Ghost态激发能很低，有电荷转移特征，振子强度很小，是没有物理意义的虚假态。B3LYP等低HF成份泛函也可能出现Ghost态。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: GGA functionals and the ghost state problem
content: Do not perform TDDFT calculations with GGA functionals; they not only severely underestimate excitation energies, but also, due to self-interaction error (SIE), large conjugated systems are prone to ghost states. Ghost states have very low excitation energies, exhibit charge transfer character, and have very small oscillator strengths; they are spurious states with no physical meaning. Ghost states may also appear with low-HF-component functionals such as B3LYP.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Tamm-Dancoff approximation (TDA) 的特点
content: TDA指TDDFT计算中忽略B矩阵，形同基于DFT轨道做CIS。TDA可节约时间，编程容易。一般认为TDA略微降低单重态精度，对三重态有明显改进。TDA的坏处是振子强度比TDDFT有低估倾向，算UV-Vis和ECD谱一般不如TDDFT准。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Characteristics of the Tamm-Dancoff approximation (TDA)
content: TDA means neglecting the B matrix in TDDFT calculations, which is equivalent to CIS based on DFT orbitals. TDA saves time and is easy to implement. It is generally believed that TDA slightly reduces the accuracy for singlet states but markedly improves results for triplet states. The drawback of TDA is that oscillator strengths tend to be underestimated compared to TDDFT, so for UV-Vis and ECD spectra it is generally less accurate than TDDFT.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: 双杂化泛函在TDDFT中的应用
content: 以B2PLYP为代表的双杂化泛函用于TDDFT计算，类似于CIS(D)方式，即在TDDFT基础上做微扰修正。计算量比普通TDDFT大，精度提高，对于价层单重态激发态误差比PBE0可降低30%。目前只有ORCA支持，B2GP-PLYP结果比B2PLYP更好。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Application of double-hybrid functionals in TDDFT
content: Double-hybrid functionals represented by B2PLYP, when used in TDDFT calculations, work in a manner similar to CIS(D), i.e., performing perturbative corrections on top of TDDFT. The computational cost is larger than ordinary TDDFT, but the accuracy is improved; for valence singlet excited states, the error can be reduced by 30% compared to PBE0. Currently only ORCA supports this, and B2GP-PLYP gives better results than B2PLYP.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: 垂直激发能与最大吸收峰的关系
content: 垂直激发能是理论工作者假想的结构不发生变化的跃迁过程，其数值和实验最大吸收峰近似对应。即便垂直激发能计算绝对精确，由于没考虑振动耦合或实际过程没那么垂直，往往也会高估最大吸收峰位置0.1~0.3eV。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Relationship between vertical excitation energy and the maximum absorption peak
content: The vertical excitation energy is a hypothetical transition process conceived by theoreticians in which the structure does not change; its value approximately corresponds to the experimental maximum absorption peak. Even if the vertical excitation energy were computed with absolute precision, the maximum absorption peak position would typically still be overestimated by 0.1~0.3 eV, because vibrational coupling is not considered, or because the actual process is not that vertical.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: TDDFT中的溶剂效应处理
content: 溶剂在激发态计算中必须考虑，TDDFT可与主流PCM模型完美结合，考虑非平衡溶剂效应和做state-specific计算。需描述强相互作用可用显式溶剂模型，复杂环境可用QMMM或背景电荷。谱峰展宽等效应需通过模拟处理。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Treatment of solvent effects in TDDFT
content: The solvent must be considered in excited-state calculations. TDDFT combines perfectly with mainstream PCM models, allowing non-equilibrium solvent effects to be considered and state-specific calculations to be performed. For systems requiring description of strong interactions, an explicit solvent model can be used; for complex environments, QMMM or background charge can be used. Effects such as spectral peak broadening need to be handled through simulations.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: TDDFT的软肋
content: TDDFT有两点受制于自身形式难以处理：(1)不适合研究势能面交叉，这是多参考方法的天下；(2)不适合研究双电子激发特征明显的激发态。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: The weaknesses of TDDFT
content: TDDFT has two points that are difficult to handle due to its own formalism: (1) it is not suitable for studying potential energy surface crossings, which is the domain of multireference methods; (2) it is not suitable for studying excited states with prominent double-excitation character.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: 确定TDDFT计算态数的经验
content: 确定需要计算的态数需要经验，原子数很少时算10个态可能够，50个原子的有机分子可能得算近100个态。可先用sTDA方法做近似计算，估算需要多少态达到期望激发能，再做精确TDDFT。若体系太大需算好几百个态，可直接用sTDA结果。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Experience in determining the number of states in TDDFT calculations
content: Determining the number of states to calculate requires experience. For very few atoms, calculating 10 states may suffice, while an organic molecule with 50 atoms may require nearly 100 states. You can first perform an approximate calculation with the sTDA method to estimate how many states are needed to reach the desired excitation energy, and then perform an accurate TDDFT calculation. If the system is so large that several hundred states must be calculated, the sTDA results can be used directly.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: CIS方法的特点与局限
content: CIS是经典计算激发态方法，有尺寸一致性，但精度颇不理想，严重高估激发能达1~2eV。CIS计算快，算电荷转移激发较好，Gaussian支持二阶解析导数，一般用于定性计算，给出正确激发态能量顺序，不能指望定量精确。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Characteristics and limitations of the CIS method
content: CIS is a classic method for calculating excited states; it is size-consistent, but its accuracy is quite unsatisfactory, severely overestimating excitation energies by as much as 1~2 eV. CIS calculations are fast and perform reasonably well for charge transfer excitations; Gaussian supports second-order analytical derivatives. It is generally used for qualitative calculations, giving the correct ordering of excited-state energies, but quantitative accuracy should not be expected.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: TDHF方法的特点
content: TDHF需求解维度比CIS大一倍的矩阵本征值，计算矩阵元耗时比CIS多。TDHF比CIS改进甚微，跃迁偶极矩比CIS好，计算三重态糟糕。从性价比看TDHF不如CIS。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Characteristics of the TDHF method
content: TDHF requires solving a matrix eigenvalue problem with twice the dimensionality of CIS, and evaluating the matrix elements is more time-consuming than in CIS. TDHF improves on CIS only marginally; its transition dipole moment is better than CIS, but it performs poorly for triplet states. In terms of cost-effectiveness, TDHF is inferior to CIS.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: CIS(D)及其改进方法
content: CIS(D)是对CIS通过微扰方式引入双激发组态，修正了CIS的高估趋势，但计算量增加不少，如今用得不多。SCS-CIS(D)和SOS-CIS(D)借鉴SCS-MP2思想对微扰部分进行scale，最好的版本比CIS(D)有改进，但比起最佳泛函下的TDDFT无明显优势。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: CIS(D) and its improved variants
content: CIS(D) introduces double-excitation configurations into CIS perturbatively, correcting the overestimation trend of CIS, but the computational cost increases considerably, and it is not much used nowadays. SCS-CIS(D) and SOS-CIS(D) draw on the SCS-MP2 idea to scale the perturbative part; the best versions improve on CIS(D), but show no obvious advantage over TDDFT with the best functionals.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: CISD方法的特点
content: CISD一般用于算基态，也可同时计算基态和激发态。由于CISD中基态的动态相关考虑得比激发态充分得多，算激发能时误差抵消不好，会高估激发能，不如CIS(D)且计算量大，没人用。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Characteristics of the CISD method
content: CISD is generally used to calculate ground states, but can also calculate ground and excited states simultaneously. Because dynamic correlation of the ground state is treated far more thoroughly than that of the excited states in CISD, error cancellation is poor when calculating excitation energies, leading to overestimated excitation energies; it is inferior to CIS(D) and computationally expensive, so nobody uses it.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: EOM-CCSD方法特点
content: EOM-CCSD使用普遍，单参考态体系结果不错，对于单电子激发误差<0.3eV，强于TDDFT。对多参考态体系不好，双电子激发特征明显的体系误差也较大。计算较昂贵，能算的体系大小远小于TDDFT。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Characteristics of the EOM-CCSD method
content: EOM-CCSD is widely used and gives good results for single-reference systems, with errors below 0.3 eV for single-electron excitations, outperforming TDDFT. It performs poorly for multireference systems, and errors are also large for systems with prominent double-excitation character. It is relatively expensive computationally, and the size of systems it can handle is much smaller than TDDFT.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: LR-CC2与SCS-CC2方法
content: LR-CC2是CCSD的近似版本，算激发能精度低于EOM-CCSD不少，振子强度误差大一倍。只要泛函选择合适，CC2和TDDFT精度大体在同一档次。SCS-CC2借鉴SCS-MP2思想，但激发能计算精度并没比CC2提高。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: LR-CC2 and SCS-CC2 methods
content: LR-CC2 is an approximate version of CCSD; its accuracy in calculating excitation energies is considerably lower than EOM-CCSD, and its oscillator strength errors are twice as large. As long as the functional choice is appropriate, CC2 and TDDFT are roughly at the same level of accuracy. SCS-CC2 draws on the SCS-MP2 idea, but its accuracy in excitation energy calculation is not improved over CC2.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: LR-CC3作为金标准
content: LR-CC3基于CCSDT近似版本，精度介于CCSD与CCSDT之间，稍弱于EOM-CCSDT但精度极好。LR-CC3被认为是激发能计算的金标准，可放心当参考值，但多参考或双电子激发特征明显时更适合CASPT2。Dalton适合做LR-CC3计算，见《使用Dalton通过CC3方法极高精度计算激发态》。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: LR-CC3 as the gold standard
content: LR-CC3 is based on an approximate version of CCSDT; its accuracy lies between CCSD and CCSDT, slightly inferior to EOM-CCSDT but with excellent accuracy. LR-CC3 is regarded as the gold standard for excitation energy calculation and can be used as a reference value with confidence; however, for multireference cases or cases with prominent double-excitation character, CASPT2 is more suitable. Dalton is suitable for LR-CC3 calculations; see 《使用Dalton通过CC3方法极高精度计算激发态》.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: 绝热激发能与0-0跃迁的关系
content: 绝热激发能是从初态势能面最小点结构跃迁到末态势能面最小点结构的过程。绝热激发能可以作为实验得到的0-0跃迁能量的较好近似，但由于激发态ZPE通常低于基态，精确计算的绝热激发能往往会高估实际0-0值0.1eV左右。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Relationship between adiabatic excitation energy and the 0-0 transition
content: The adiabatic excitation energy is the process of transitioning from the structure at the minimum of the initial potential energy surface to the structure at the minimum of the final potential energy surface. The adiabatic excitation energy can serve as a good approximation of the experimentally obtained 0-0 transition energy, but since the excited-state ZPE is usually lower than that of the ground state, an accurately calculated adiabatic excitation energy often overestimates the actual 0-0 value by about 0.1 eV.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: MCSCF方法的作用
content: MCSCF（主要是CASSCF）主要不是用来定量准确算激发能，而是给微扰、CI等方法提供充分考虑了静态相关的参考态波函数。只有MCSCF或基于它的方法才能准确研究势能面交叉问题。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: The role of MCSCF methods
content: MCSCF (mainly CASSCF) is primarily not used for quantitatively accurate calculation of excitation energies, but rather to provide reference-state wavefunctions with fully considered static correlation for perturbation, CI, and other methods. Only MCSCF or methods based on it can accurately study potential energy surface crossing problems.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: CASPT2方法的特点
content: CASPT2是最常用的高精度计算小分子激发能方式，误差小于0.2eV，精度略逊于CC3但计算量低很多。它是研究光化学问题的王牌。缺点是活性空间选取需经验，有入侵态问题（可通过能级移动解决）。激发态计算一般用多态版本MS-CASPT2。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Characteristics of the CASPT2 method
content: CASPT2 is the most commonly used high-accuracy method for calculating excitation energies of small molecules, with errors below 0.2 eV; its accuracy is slightly inferior to CC3 but the computational cost is much lower. It is the trump card for studying photochemistry problems. Its drawbacks are that active space selection requires experience and that it suffers from the intruder state problem (which can be solved via level shifting). Excited-state calculations generally use the multistate version MS-CASPT2.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: MRCI与SORCI方法
content: MRCI（一般用MRCISD）基于MCSCF波函数做CI，计算量颇大，只能研究小分子，精度直逼FCI极限。SORCI是基于MRCI引入多参考二阶微扰的方法，专适合激发能研究，力求高精度同时也达到较好计算效率，计算量小于MRCI，可用于稍大体系，ORCA支持。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: MRCI and SORCI methods
content: MRCI (usually MRCISD) performs CI based on an MCSCF wavefunction; the computational cost is quite large, restricting it to small molecules, but its accuracy approaches the FCI limit. SORCI is a method based on MRCI that introduces multireference second-order perturbation, specially suited to studying excitation energies, striving for high accuracy while also achieving good computational efficiency; its computational cost is lower than MRCI, it can be applied to somewhat larger systems, and it is supported by ORCA.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: SAC-CI方法
content: SAC-CI可以说是EOM-CCSD的近似，理论等价于EOM-CC和LR-CC。由于被程序支持不广泛，优势不明显，没有广泛普及。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: SAC-CI method
content: SAC-CI can be regarded as an approximation to EOM-CCSD, theoretically equivalent to EOM-CC and LR-CC. Since it is not widely supported by programs and its advantages are not obvious, it has not been broadly adopted.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: DFT/MRCI方法
content: DFT/MRCI是Grimme提出的方法，基于DFT轨道构建CI矩阵做MRCI。它比传统MRCI省时，计算激发能比TDDFT好，但在主流量化程序中都不支持，程序只能找作者要。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: DFT/MRCI method
content: DFT/MRCI is a method proposed by Grimme that builds the CI matrix based on DFT orbitals to perform MRCI. It is less time-consuming than traditional MRCI and computes excitation energies better than TDDFT, but it is not supported by any mainstream quantum chemistry program; the program can only be obtained by requesting it from the author.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: ΔSCF技术的优缺点
content: ΔSCF通过调整初猜将电子挪到不同不可约表示的虚轨道上得到激发态。优点是耗时同基态，能得激发态轨道。缺点是：(1)轨道需有不同不可约表示否则坍塌；(2)难以计算多个激发态；(3)没法直接给出振子强度。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Advantages and disadvantages of the ΔSCF technique
content: ΔSCF obtains excited states by adjusting the initial guess to move electrons onto virtual orbitals belonging to different irreducible representations. Advantages: the cost is the same as the ground state, and excited-state orbitals can be obtained. Disadvantages: (1) orbitals must belong to different irreducible representations, otherwise collapse; (2) it is difficult to compute multiple excited states; (3) it cannot directly give oscillator strengths.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: 修改自旋多重度计算激发态
content: 研究与基态自旋多重度不同的态的最低激发态（如T1），最好的办法是修改输入文件中的自旋多重度。优点是省时且能得到自旋密度，缺点是只能算特定自旋多重度的最低激发态（如T2、T3只能用TDDFT）。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Calculating excited states by modifying spin multiplicity
content: To study the lowest excited state with spin multiplicity different from the ground state (e.g., T1), the best approach is to modify the spin multiplicity in the input file. The advantage is that it is time-saving and yields the spin density; the disadvantage is that only the lowest excited state of a specific spin multiplicity can be computed (e.g., T2 and T3 can only be obtained with TDDFT).
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: ZINDO半经验方法的特点
content: ZINDO/S（INDO/S）是很适合算激发能的半经验方法，对有机分子结果不错，特别适合pi-pi*、n-pi*激发，也可算不少过渡金属。缺点是不适合含电子转移、高阶激发态、里德堡态、阴离子、未成对电子金属及双电子激发体系，也不适合除激发能以外的计算。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Characteristics of the ZINDO semiempirical method
content: ZINDO/S (INDO/S) is a semiempirical method well suited for excited energy calculation; it gives good results for organic molecules, is particularly suitable for pi-pi* and n-pi* excitations, and can also handle quite a few transition metals. Its drawbacks are that it is unsuitable for systems involving electron transfer, higher excited states, Rydberg states, anions, metals with unpaired electrons, and double excitations, and it is also unsuitable for calculations other than excitation energies.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: INDO/X方法的特点
content: INDO/X是ZINDO的重新参数化，训练集主要用TBE-2垂直激发能数据。平均误差比ZINDO小一倍，振子强度准确度不错，但对某些体系误差较大。缺点是参数化元素目前只有CHON，程序不公开。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Characteristics of the INDO/X method
content: INDO/X is a reparameterization of ZINDO, with the training set based mainly on the TBE-2 vertical excitation energy data. Its average error is half that of ZINDO, and the accuracy of oscillator strengths is good, but errors can be large for certain systems. Drawbacks: currently only CHON elements are parameterized, and the program is not publicly available.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: 理论与实验光谱不符的因素
content: 理论计算的光谱如果和实验光谱对得不好，未必是方法本身不合理。振动耦合、溶剂效应（线性响应与state-specific、平衡与非平衡、强相互作用等）、不同跃迁吸收峰间的相互重叠等都是影响可比性的不可忽略因素。
topic: TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述
fm_title: 乱谈激发态的计算方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Factors causing discrepancies between theoretical and experimental spectra
content: If the theoretically computed spectrum does not match the experimental spectrum well, the method itself is not necessarily unreasonable. Vibrational coupling, solvent effects (linear response vs. state-specific, equilibrium vs. nonequilibrium, strong interaction, etc.), mutual overlap between absorption peaks of different transitions, and other factors are all non-negligible influences on comparability.
topic: Overview of TDDFT and various excited-state calculation methods

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: 理论光谱图的绘制
content: 各个态的振子强度加上各个态的激发能，经过展宽，就能得到理论计算的光谱图。绘制方法参见《使用Multiwfn绘制红外、拉曼、UV-Vis、ECD和VCD光谱图》。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Plotting theoretical spectra
content: By combining the oscillator strength of each state with the excitation energy of each state, and applying broadening, one obtains the theoretically computed spectrum. For spectrum plotting, see 《使用Multiwfn绘制红外、拉曼、UV-Vis、ECD和VCD光谱图》.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: 准确获得吸收/发射光谱的必要性
content: 要很准确地获得吸收/发射光谱或预测染料分子颜色，必须把整个吸收带能够较准确地预测出来，这必须考虑振动态与电子态的耦合，见《振动分辨的电子光谱的计算》。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Necessity of accurate acquisition of absorption/emission spectra
content: To accurately acquire absorption/emission spectra or predict the color of dye molecules, the entire absorption band must be predicted reasonably accurately, which requires considering the coupling between vibrational and electronic states; see 《振动分辨的电子光谱的计算》.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: 激发态几何结构分析
content: 电子激发导致体系几何结构发生变化是化学上感兴趣的问题，有时变化很显著，如氢的转移、分子结构的大幅运动，需要计算激发态几何结构。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Excited-state geometric structure analysis
content: Electronic excitation causing changes in the geometric structure of the system is a question of chemical interest; sometimes the changes are very significant, such as hydrogen transfer or large-scale motion of the molecular structure, requiring calculation of excited-state geometric structures.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: 激发态势能面研究
content: 激发态研究还包括考察激发态势能面上的势垒、研究激发态的振动模式、与基态间的圆锥/避免交叉点等。这对于光化学反应、无辐跃迁（系间窜越、内转换）的研究极其关键。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/265_TDDFT及各类激发态计算方法综述_卡片.md
heading: Study of excited-state potential energy surfaces
content: Excited-state research also includes examining potential barriers on the excited-state potential energy surface, studying the vibrational modes of excited states, and conical/avoided crossing points between excited and ground states. This is critically important for the study of photochemical reactions and non-radiative transitions (intersystem crossing, internal conversion).

heading: 激发态电子结构性质与跃迁特征分析
content: 激发态电子结构性质包括偶极矩、四极矩、极化率、原子电荷、成键方式、芳香性等，需要得到激发态波函数。跃迁特征分析可用Multiwfn作密度差图、hole-electron分析、跃迁密度矩阵分析、电荷转移分析、NTO分析等，详见《Multiwfn支持的电子激发分析方法一览》。

heading: Excited-state electronic structure properties and transition characteristic analysis
content: Excited-state electronic structure properties include dipole moment, quadrupole moment, polarizability, atomic charge, bonding patterns, aromaticity, etc., and require obtaining the excited-state wavefunction. heading: TDDFT基组选择：价层激发
content: 对于一般的价层激发，6-31G*是底限（适合较大体系），条件好点用6-311G*，富余用TZVP，若能用到def2-TZVP则基组方面已经完美。

heading: Basis set selection for TDDFT: valence excitations
content: For general valence excitation, 6-31G* is the bottom line (suitable for larger systems); with better conditions use 6-311G*, and if resources allow use TZVP; if def2-TZVP can be used, then the basis set aspect is already perfect.

heading: Atomic charge recommendations and calculating RESP/RESP2 charges with Multiwfn

file: 05-分子动力学与力场/266_GROMACS有机分子拓扑文件生成工具汇总_卡片.md
heading: Introduction and features of the ATB tool
content: Automated Topology Builder (ATB) is an online tool for generating GROMACS topology file; it can generate topology files for the GROMACS or GROMOS programs based on the GROMOS96 G54A7 force field (with extended atom types). ATB is more advanced and more reliable than PRODRG2: it solves PRODRG2's inability to automatically determine protonation states and its inaccurate charge group assignment, thereby ensuring reliable atomic charges; it can also exploit symmetry to guarantee charge equivalence; additionally, unlike PRODRG2, it has no limit on the number of daily submissions.

file: 05-分子动力学与力场/266_GROMACS有机分子拓扑文件生成工具汇总_卡片.md
heading: ATB的使用建议与分子库
content: ATB虽然设计得不错，可以作为产生小分子GROMOS力场的GROMACS拓扑文件的首选，但它生成的原子电荷、确定的参数的可靠性也只是一般，不能保证总是很理想。如果要做很严谨的模拟研究，还是建议自行计算RESP电荷并且手动检查ATB给出的拓扑文件的合理性，有必要时适当调节。ATB网站上也有个分子库，包含巨量事先搞好的小分子的参数和拓扑文件，其中有的是别人之前提交过的分子，有的是经过专人手工处理过的分子，显然后者可靠程度更高，对于比较常见的分子，提交到ATB之前建议先搜索一下分子库，如果已经有的话就直接用。

file: 05-分子动力学与力场/266_GROMACS有机分子拓扑文件生成工具汇总_卡片.md
heading: Usage recommendations for ATB and its molecule repository
content: Although ATB is well designed and can serve as the first choice for generating GROMACS topology files with the GROMOS force field for small molecules, the reliability of its generated atomic charges and determined parameters is only moderate and cannot be guaranteed to always be ideal. For rigorous simulation studies, it is still recommended to calculate RESP charges yourself and manually check the reasonableness of the topology file provided by ATB, adjusting it when necessary. The ATB website also has a molecule repository containing a huge number of pre-built parameters and topology files for small molecules; some of these were previously submitted by others, and some were manually curated by dedicated staff — the latter are evidently more reliable. For relatively common molecules, it is recommended to search the repository before submitting to ATB, and if one already exists, just use it directly.

file: 05-分子动力学与力场/266_GROMACS有机分子拓扑文件生成工具汇总_卡片.md
heading: LigParGen工具简介与电荷模型
content: LigParGen是生成GROMACS, NAMD, CHARMM, LAMMPS等程序OPLS-AA力场的拓扑文件的工具，支持SMILES字符串、.mol、.pdb文件作为输入，原子上限200个，可以顺带着让服务器对分子在OPLS-AA力场下做几何优化。分配的原子电荷是1.14*CM1A或1.14*CM1A-LBCC，前者是把CM1A电荷数值乘上1.14得到的，后者是在1.14*CM1A基础上再引入LBCC校正得到的，在J. Phys. Chem. B, 121, 3864 (2017)中已证明这两种原子电荷结合OPLS-AA模拟有机体系凝聚相可以得到不错结果。

file: 05-分子动力学与力场/266_GROMACS有机分子拓扑文件生成工具汇总_卡片.md
heading: Introduction to the LigParGen tool and its charge model
content: LigParGen is a tool for generating OPLS-AA force field topology files for programs such as GROMACS, NAMD, CHARMM and LAMMPS. It supports SMILES strings, .mol, and .pdb files as input, with an upper limit of 200 atoms, and the server can also perform a geometry optimization of the molecule under the OPLS-AA force field along the way. The assigned atomic charges are 1.14*CM1A or 1.14*CM1A-LBCC: the former is obtained by multiplying the CM1A charge values by 1.14, and the latter is obtained by further introducing the LBCC correction on top of 1.14*CM1A. It has been demonstrated in J. Phys. Chem. B, 121, 3864 (2017) that combining these two kinds of atomic charges with OPLS-AA simulations of condensed-phase organic systems can yield good results.

file: 05-分子动力学与力场/266_GROMACS有机分子拓扑文件生成工具汇总_卡片.md
heading: LigParGen的电荷替换建议
content: 该资料开头所述的Multiwfn可以计算的1.2*CM5电荷比LigParGen直接给出的电荷在多数情况下更适合做动力学模拟，特别是对于密度、蒸发焓的精度方面而言，这点在J. Phys. Chem. B, 121, 3864 (2017)的测试中充分体现了。而且对于一些分子，LigParGen给出的原子电荷加和不精确为0，而是比如0.0001，这导致此类分子数目较多时体系总电荷对整数有不可忽视的偏离，对模拟造成不良影响。因此建议将LigParGen给出的itp文件里的原子电荷部分替换为Multiwfn得到的1.2*CM5电荷。
topic: GROMACS有机分子拓扑文件生成工具汇总
fm_title: 几种生成有机分子GROMACS拓扑文件的工具

file: 05-分子动力学与力场/266_GROMACS有机分子拓扑文件生成工具汇总_卡片.md
heading: Charge replacement recommendation for LigParGen
content: The 1.2*CM5 charge that can be calculated with Multiwfn, as described at the beginning of this material, is more suitable than the charges directly output by LigParGen for running dynamics simulations in most cases, especially with regard to the accuracy of densities and evaporation enthalpies, as fully demonstrated in the tests in J. Phys. Chem. B, 121, 3864 (2017). Moreover, for some molecules the atomic charges from LigParGen not summing exactly to zero — for example 0.0001 — which leads to a non-negligible deviation of the total system charge from an integer when there are many such molecules, adversely affecting the simulation. Therefore, it is recommended to replace the atomic charge section in the itp file given by LigParGen with the 1.2*CM5 charges obtained from Multiwfn.

heading: How to use the MKTOP tool
content: MKTOP is a Perl script that supports the OPLS-AA and AMBER03 force fields; charges cannot be generated automatically and must be provided by yourself. Before using it, make sure that a Perl runtime environment is installed, and change the GROMACS topology file directory at the beginning of the mktop.pl script to the actual one on your machine, e.g. $gromacs_dir="/gmx/share/gromacs/top";. heading: Introduction to and limitations of OBGMX
content: OBGMX is an online tool for generating GROMACS topology files with the UFF force field. Since UFF covers almost the entire periodic table, it enables Gromacs to handle not only organic molecules but also inorganic compounds and periodic systems, such as MOFs. Because the functional form of the UFF force field is not fully compatible with what Gromacs supports, the parameters produced by this program are actually an approximation of the original UFF force field; some atom types may be identified incorrectly, and charges must be provided by yourself. heading: Deficiencies and current status of PRODRG2
content: PRODRG2 is an online tool for generating Gromacs topology files, supporting only the GROMOS87/96 force fields. Atomic charges are assigned based on charge groups; if the group recognition is wrong, the charges are unreliable. This tool was pointed out in J. Chem. Inf. Model., 50, 2221 (2010) to often fail to correctly assign charge groups, resulting in very unreasonable atomic charge assignment. Moreover, since the better ATB now exists, its use is strongly discouraged today.

heading: OPLS-AA力场推荐电荷与Multiwfn计算CM5电荷
content: OPLS-AA力场很适合结合1.2*CM5电荷使用，用Multiwfn的主功能7的子功能16直接就能计算出CM5电荷，将之手动乘以1.2即是1.2*CM5电荷。可用Gaussian、ORCA等程序产生的fch/wfn/wfx/molden等格式作为Multiwfn的输入文件，可参考《详谈Multiwfn支持的输入文件类型、产生方法以及相互转换》。《计算适用于OPLS-AA力场做模拟的1.2*CM5原子电荷的懒人脚本》可直接用一行命令算出结果，《ORCA结合Multiwfn计算RESP、RESP2和1.2*CM5原子电荷的懒人脚本》是专门结合ORCA用的傻瓜式脚本。

heading: Recommended charges for the OPLS-AA force field and calculating CM5 charges with Multiwfn
content: The OPLS-AA force field is well suited to being combined with the 1.2*CM5 charge. Using main function 7, subfunction 16 of Multiwfn, you can directly calculate the CM5 charge, and manually multiplying it by 1.2 gives the 1.2*CM5 charge. You can use files in formats such as fch/wfn/wfx/molden produced by programs like Gaussian and ORCA as input files for Multiwfn; see 《详谈Multiwfn支持的输入文件类型、产生方法以及相互转换》. 《计算适用于OPLS-AA力场做模拟的1.2*CM5原子电荷的懒人脚本》 can calculate the results directly with a single command line, and 《ORCA结合Multiwfn计算RESP、RESP2和1.2*CM5原子电荷的懒人脚本》 is a foolproof script specifically for use in combination with ORCA.

heading: Introduction and features of Sobtop
content: Sobtop is a GROMACS topology file generation tool, mainly producing topology files for the GAFF/GAFF2 and AMBER force fields. However, since its force field library can be very conveniently modified and extended by users, Sobtop is essentially fully universal and general-purpose. Sobtop can be regarded as the most ideal, most flexible, and easiest-to-use tool for generating GROMACS topology files. The program is extremely simple to use; no additional programs or special runtime environments need to be installed—it works right after extraction.

heading: Sobtop的适用体系与参数来源
content: Sobtop可以产生任意体系的拓扑文件，有机和无机小分子、过渡金属配合物、聚合物、共价团簇、晶体、二维材料等等全都可以产生，孤立体系和周期性体系都支持。Sobtop可以用于包含任意元素的体系，那些GAFF/GAFF2/AMBER不支持的元素可以自动让Sobtop用UFF的，或者自己定义额外原子类型。对于GAFF/GAFF2/AMBER力场里缺失的成键相关参数，可以直接让Sobtop基于量子化学程序产生的Hessian矩阵通过不同方法自动算出来，也可以自己把其它方式得到的（如自己单独拟合、文献中找的）添到力场库文件里让Sobtop直接用。
