heading: Systems supported by Sobtop and parameter sources
content: Sobtop can generate topology files for arbitrary systems: organic and inorganic small molecules, transition metal complexes, polymers, covalent clusters, crystals, two-dimensional materials, and so on can all be handled; both isolated and periodic systems are supported. Sobtop can be used for systems containing any element; elements not supported by GAFF/GAFF2/AMBER can automatically be handled by Sobtop using UFF, or you can define additional atom types yourself. For bonding-related parameters missing from the GAFF/GAFF2/AMBER force fields, you can have Sobtop automatically compute them via different methods based on the Hessian matrix from a quantum chemistry program, or you can add parameters obtained by other means (e.g., fitted separately yourself or found in the literature) to the force field library file for Sobtop to use directly.

heading: Atom type assignment and charge calculation capabilities of Sobtop

heading: Recommendations for atomic charge handling in acpype

heading: acpype处理大体系的参数建议
content: 对于稍大的体系，用独立的acpype时强烈建议加上-c user选项以避免acpype自动算AM1-BCC原子电荷，否则在处理期间acpype所调用的Antechamber会先调用SQM程序用半经验方法进行优化然后再算这个电荷。然而SQM不仅慢，做优化还容易不收敛，导致半天也无法成功产生拓扑文件，更何况最后也是要替换为Multiwfn算的RESP/RESP2电荷，故计算AM1-BCC电荷没实际意义。同理，用在线版acpype也是建议把charge method设为user。

file: 05-分子动力学与力场/266_GROMACS有机分子拓扑文件生成工具汇总_卡片.md
heading: Parameter recommendations for acpype with large systems
content: For somewhat larger systems, when using the standalone acpype it is strongly recommended to add the -c user option to avoid acpype automatically calculating AM1-BCC atomic charges; otherwise, during processing, the Antechamber invoked by acpype will first call the SQM program to optimize the structure with a semiempirical method and then calculate these charges. However, SQM is not only slow, its optimization also easily fails to converge, so that the topology file may fail to be generated for a very long time. Moreover, the charges will in the end have to be replaced with RESP/RESP2 charges calculated by Multiwfn anyway, so calculating AM1-BCC charges is of no practical significance. Likewise, when using the online version of acpype, it is recommended to set the charge method to user.

heading: Definition and basic properties of the reduced density gradient (RDG)
content:
The reduced density gradient (RDG) converts the gradient of the electron density into a dimensionless form, with the defining formula as follows
RDG is used in GGA functionals and can also be used for investigating weak interaction regions and assisting AIM critical point localization; the positions where RDG=0 are the same as the positions where the electron density gradient = 0, and the RDG values span a small range, making it convenient for plotting and analysis.

heading: Principle of determining AIM critical points based on RDG
content: AIM critical points refer to positions where the electron density gradient (specifically, its magnitude) is 0; graphically rendering the RDG is more convenient than rendering the electron density gradient, because the electron density gradient spans too many orders of magnitude; by examining isosurfaces of very small RDG values (which contain the points where RDG=0), one can intuitively investigate where AIM critical points are located.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/267_利用RDG图形辅助定位AIM临界点_卡片.md
heading: Procedure and precautions for plotting RDG isosurface to view bond critical points
content: When using Multiwfn to plot the RDG isosurface, if you need to display all regions you should first change RDG_maxrho in settings.ini to 0; in VMD, set the RDG isosurface value to a small value (e.g., 0.07), and the interior of the isosurface corresponds to regions of very small values. Note that this method usually only reveals the positions of bond critical points (BCP): the RDG values near atomic nuclei are far larger than near BCPs, so the corresponding isosurfaces are too small to be seen.

heading: 绘制RDG填色图精确定位临界点
content: 绘制RDG填色图是考察平面上临界点的更好方法，图中颜色最深（RDG最小）的点对应RDG=0，即AIM临界点位置；例如在尿嘧啶的RDG填色图中，原子之间及环中心颜色非常深的小块区域对应临界点，原子核位置也可见对应核临界点的深蓝小点。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/267_利用RDG图形辅助定位AIM临界点_卡片.md
heading: Precisely localizing critical points by plotting RDG filled color maps
content: Plotting RDG colored maps is a better way of investigating critical points on a plane; the points with the darkest color (smallest RDG) in the map correspond to RDG=0, i.e., the positions of AIM critical points. For example, in an RDG colored map of uracil, the very dark small regions between atoms and at ring centers correspond to critical points, and small dark blue dots corresponding to nuclear critical points can also be seen at the nuclear positions.

heading: Specific case of using RDG to explain the absence of critical points
content: Regarding the case where no bond critical point was found between Os1 and C9, and no ring critical point was found in the 1-5-9 three-membered ring, plotting the RDG colored map revealed that there is indeed no region of very small RDG within the three-membered ring; although a region of very small RDG exists between Os1 and C9, after expanding the color scale to 0~0.1 it can be seen that there are no dark blue (RDG = 0) points within it, thus confirming that the corresponding bond critical point does not actually exist.

heading: Custom force field recognition rule file
content: Create a file named atomname2type.n2t in the "share/gromacs/top/gromos54a7.ff" folder under the gromacs directory, and copy the specified content into it. This means that when using x2top topology file generation under the G54A7 force field, if a carbon atom has one, two, or three neighbors at a distance of about 0.142 nm, it will be recognized as the CR1 atom type.

heading: 原子类型CR1的物理意义
content: CR1原子类型对应G54A7力场中芳香族CH基团中的碳原子。该原子类型适用于表示碳纳米管碳原子与环境原子之间的范德华相互作用。

heading: Physical meaning of the CR1 atom type
content: The CR1 atom type corresponds to the carbon atom in aromatic CH groups in the G54A7 force field. This atom type is suitable for representing the van der Waals interactions between carbon nanotube atoms and environment atoms.

heading: Using x2top topology file generation
content: Run the command `g_x2top -f cnt10.pdb -o CNT10.top -ff select -nopbc -name CNT10 -kb 400000 -kt 600 -kp 150` to generate CNT10.top. heading: x2top命令参数含义
content: -kb、-kt和-kp参数用于定义键、角和二面角项的力常数。这些力常数主要用于在模拟过程中保持碳纳米管的近似刚性结构，因此可以简单地设置为一个较大的值。

file: 05-分子动力学与力场/268_Gromacs模拟碳纳米管及拓扑构建_卡片.md
heading: Meaning of the x2top command parameters
content: The -kb, -kt and -kp parameters define the force constants of bond, angle and dihedral terms. These force constants are mainly used for maintaining near-rigid structure of carbon nanotubes during the simulation, so they can simply be set to fairly large values.

heading: 拓扑文件中的键参数格式
content: 在CNT10.top的[ bonds ]字段中，第4列是基于输入几何结构确定的平衡长度，第5列是由-kb设置的力常数。最后两列是冗余的，可以直接忽略甚至删除，[ angles ]和[ dihedrals ]字段的内容与[ bonds ]类似。

file: 05-分子动力学与力场/268_Gromacs模拟碳纳米管及拓扑构建_卡片.md
heading: Format of bond parameters in the topology file
content: In the [ bonds ] section of CNT10.top, the 4th column is the equilibrium length determined from the input geometric structure, and the 5th column is the force constant set by -kb. The last two columns are redundant and can be directly ignored or even deleted. The content of the [ angles ] and [ dihedrals ] sections is similar to [ bonds ].

heading: Notes on setting force constants

heading: NWChem 6.6 在 CentOS 7.2 下的编译环境变量与路径设置
content:

export NWCHEM_TOP=/sob/nwchem-6.6
export NWCHEM_TARGET=LINUX64
export NWCHEM_MODULES=all
export USE_MPI=y
export USE_INTERNALBLAS=y
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$LD_LIBRARY_PATH:/usr/lib64/openmpi/lib/
export PATH=$PATH:/usr/lib64/openmpi/bin/

heading: CDFT的物理意义与注意事项
content: 用CDFT用对了可以讨论常规DFT研究不了的问题（如电荷转移、电子离域），用得不合理会得到毫无意义的结果。在使用时必须明确目的和所设定约束的物理意义。注意**CDFT用在了自旋约束上是不支持几何优化的**。

heading: Physical meaning of CDFT and points of caution
content: Used properly, CDFT can address problems that ordinary DFT cannot study (such as charge transfer and electron delocalization); used unreasonably, it will yield meaningless results. When using it, you must be clear about the purpose and the physical meaning of the constraints you set. Note that **CDFT applied with a spin constraint does not support geometry optimization**.

file: 01-量子化学方法/271_NWChem中约束性DFT原理与实例_卡片.md
heading: NWChem CDFT操作：基础约束语法
content:
在NWChem的dft...end段落中，可通过以下语法设置原子电荷约束
**语法示例**：`cdft 2 5 charge 0.5 pop becke`（设定2~5号原子的Becke原子电荷之和为0.5）。
**差值约束**：`cdft 2 5 10 13 charge 0.5 pop lowdin`（令2~5与10~13的Lowdin电荷差值为0.5）。
**自旋约束**：将`charge`改为`spin`即可设定自旋布居数约束。
**效率提示**：NWChem的CDFT效率较好，不比普通DFT计算多耗时多少。

file: 01-量子化学方法/271_NWChem中约束性DFT原理与实例_卡片.md
heading: NWChem CDFT usage: basic constraint syntax
content:
In NWChem's dft...end section, atomic charge constraints can be set with the following syntax
**Syntax example**: `cdft 2 5 charge 0.5 pop becke` (sets the sum of Becke atomic charges of atoms 2~5 to 0.5).
**Difference constraint**: `cdft 2 5 10 13 charge 0.5 pop lowdin` (sets the difference between the Lowdin charges of atoms 2~5 and 10~13 to 0.5).
**Spin constraint**: change `charge` to `spin` to set a spin population constraint.
**Efficiency tip**: NWChem's CDFT is quite efficient, costing little more time than an ordinary DFT calculation.

file: 01-量子化学方法/271_NWChem中约束性DFT原理与实例_卡片.md
heading: NWChem CDFT操作：收敛与布居方法
content:
**收敛技巧**：如果碰见CDFT不收敛，建议在dft...end中加入一行`convergence nolevelshifting`，如果还不行，尝试改变布居方法、改约束方式或改基组和泛函。
**布居方法支持**：支持Mulliken、Lowdin和Becke三种布居方法，默认是Lowdin。
**方法可靠性**：Mulliken和Lowdin方法都不适合含有弥散函数的情况，此时去掉弥散函数或使用不怕弥散函数的Becke布居。CDFT原文表明Mulliken布居下结果有问题。
**对称性与并行**：使用Becke布居时，若计算时出现`vectors were symmetry contaminated`，需用`noautosym`避免使用对称性，且几乎总要加此关键词。并行运算时Becke布居有时无法正常结束，应改用串行计算。

file: 01-量子化学方法/271_NWChem中约束性DFT原理与实例_卡片.md
heading: NWChem CDFT usage: convergence and population methods
content:
**Convergence tip**: if you encounter CDFT convergence failure, it is recommended to add a line `convergence nolevelshifting` in the dft...end section; if that still fails, try changing the population method, the constraint approach, or the basis set and functional.
**Supported population methods**: Mulliken, Lowdin, and Becke are supported, with Lowdin as the default.
**Method reliability**: neither Mulliken nor Lowdin is suitable for cases containing diffuse functions; in such cases, remove the diffuse functions or use the Becke population, which is insensitive to diffuse functions. The original CDFT paper indicates that results with Mulliken population are problematic.
**Symmetry and parallelism**: when using the Becke population, if `vectors were symmetry contaminated` appears during the calculation, you need `noautosym` to avoid using symmetry, and this keyword almost always needs to be added. Becke population sometimes fails to finish under parallel execution, so switch to serial calculation instead.

file: 01-量子化学方法/271_NWChem中约束性DFT原理与实例_卡片.md
heading: 实例1：乙酸钠电荷约束
content:
对乙酸钠体系进行常规B3LYP/6-31G*计算，**能量为-390.839634985795**。
不加约束时，Na的Lowdin布居数为10.63，对应原子电荷为11-10.63=0.37。
**施加约束**：在dft...end中加入`convergence nolevelshifting`和`cdft 8 8 charge 1.0`。
**结果**：此时Na的Lowdin布居数为10.0，原子电荷确实为设定的1.0。**能量为-390.589504441073**，比不加约束时高了656.7KJ/mol。
**几何优化**：若需优化，将`TASK dft`改为`TASK dft optimize`即可进行解析梯度优化。

file: 01-量子化学方法/271_NWChem中约束性DFT原理与实例_卡片.md
heading: Example 1: charge constraint on sodium acetate
content:
Perform an ordinary B3LYP/6-31G* calculation on the sodium acetate system; **the energy is -390.839634985795**.
Without constraints, the Lowdin population of Na is 10.63, corresponding to an atomic charge of 11-10.63=0.37.
**Applying the constraint**: add `convergence nolevelshifting` and `cdft 8 8 charge 1.0` in the dft...end section.
**Result**: the Lowdin population of Na becomes 10.0, so the atomic charge is indeed the set value of 1.0. **The energy is -390.589504441073**, which is 656.7 kJ/mol higher than without the constraint.
**Geometry optimization**: if optimization is needed, change `TASK dft` to `TASK dft optimize` to perform analytical gradient optimization.

file: 01-量子化学方法/271_NWChem中约束性DFT原理与实例_卡片.md
heading: 实例2：叔丁基碳正离子离域化能
content:
对叔丁基碳正离子体系进行常规B3LYP/6-31G*计算。
**能量为-157.554198182446**，中心碳的Lowdin电荷为+0.30，说明正电荷未完全定域在中心碳上。
**施加约束**：在dft...end中加入`cdft 1 1 charge 1.0`。
**结果**：**能量为-157.460833435721**，比不加约束时高了245.1KJ/mol。这表明三个甲基的电子向中心碳离域使能量降低了245.1KJ/mol，即离域化能。
**布居方法影响**：不同布居方法结果差异大。Lowdin和Becke结果相近（约245KJ/mol），Mulliken结果误差大（仅高6.4KJ/mol）。
**基函数占据**：CDFT计算后中心碳的pz基函数的Lowdin布居数之和为0.237（而非0），说明NWChem的CDFT尚不支持对特定基函数的约束。

file: 01-量子化学方法/271_NWChem中约束性DFT原理与实例_卡片.md
heading: Example 2: delocalization energy of the tert-butyl cation
content:
Perform an ordinary B3LYP/6-31G* calculation on the tert-butyl cation system.
**The energy is -157.554198182446**, and the Lowdin charge of the central carbon is +0.30, showing that the positive charge is not fully localized on the central carbon.
**Applying the constraint**: add `cdft 1 1 charge 1.0` in the dft...end section.
**Result**: **the energy is -157.460833435721**, which is 245.1 kJ/mol higher than without the constraint. This indicates that the electron delocalization from the three methyl groups toward the central carbon lowers the energy by 245.1 kJ/mol, i.e., the delocalization energy.
**Influence of population method**: results differ greatly across population methods. Lowdin and Becke give similar results (about 245 kJ/mol), while Mulliken has a large error (only 6.4 kJ/mol higher).
**Basis function occupancy**: after the CDFT calculation, the sum of the Lowdin populations of the central carbon's pz basis functions is 0.237 (not 0), showing that NWChem's CDFT does not yet support constraints on specific basis functions.

heading: 实例3：LiF电荷-能量关系
content:

heading: Example 3: charge-energy relationship of LiF
content:
For the LiF system, make the Lowdin charge of Li vary gradually from 0 to 1 (step size 0.05) and observe the energy change.
**Calculation script**: use a shell script to loop over generating input files and running nwchem.
**Result display**: in an ordinary DFT calculation, the Lowdin charge of Li is 0.46 (the lowest point in the plot); the further the constraint deviates from this value, the higher the energy.
**Optimization with charge 1.0**: with Li's charge constraint set to 1.0 and optimization performed, **the bond length increases from 1.52885 Å to 1.84477 Å**. **The CDFT energy is -107.12133927 a.u.**, much higher than the -107.33859717 a.u. at the equilibrium structure without the constraint.

file: 01-量子化学方法/271_NWChem中约束性DFT原理与实例_卡片.md
heading: 实例4：C4H8双自由基自旋约束
content:
对C4H8双自由基进行对称破缺B3LYP/6-31G*计算，末端两个碳的Lowdin自旋布居分别为0.919和-0.919。
**输入设置**：必须写`odft`，对有对称性的体系应写`noautosym`。约束语法：`cdft 1 1 10 10 spin 2.0`。
**结果**：体系末端两个碳的自旋布居之差恰为2.0，由于体系对称，使得其中一个碳的自旋布居数为1.0，另一个为-1.0。
**多约束示例**：可通过设定多个约束让体系末端两个CH2的自旋布居数分别为1和-1：`cdft 1 3 spin 1.0 pop becke` 和 `cdft 10 12 spin -1.0 pop becke`（需用Becke布居）。

file: 01-量子化学方法/271_NWChem中约束性DFT原理与实例_卡片.md
heading: Example 4: spin constraint on the C4H8 diradical
content:
Perform a broken-symmetry B3LYP/6-31G* calculation on the C4H8 diradical; the Lowdin spin populations of the two terminal carbons are 0.919 and -0.919 respectively.
**Input settings**: you must write `odft`, and for systems with symmetry you should write `noautosym`. Constraint syntax: `cdft 1 1 10 10 spin 2.0`.
**Result**: the difference between the spin populations of the two terminal carbons is exactly 2.0; since the system is symmetric, one carbon has a spin population of 1.0 and the other -1.0.
**Multiple-constraint example**: by setting multiple constraints, you can make the spin populations of the two terminal CH2 groups be 1 and -1 respectively: `cdft 1 3 spin 1.0 pop becke` and `cdft 10 12 spin -1.0 pop becke` (Becke population is required).

heading: 实例5：H+ H-体系与背景电荷等效性
content:
对相距5埃的H+ H-体系，使用NWChem CDFT计算H-（约束H电荷为-1）。
**CDFT结果**：**能量为-0.567651263156**。
**等效计算**：在Gaussian中计算H-体系，并在距离5埃处放一个单位正电荷（背景电荷），输入文件格式如下
#p b3lyp/6-31G* charge
test
-1 1
H 0. 0. 0.
0. 0. 5. 1.0
**Gaussian结果**：**能量为-0.5676521**。
**结论**：CDFT计算H+ H-和计算H-并在附近放一个质子，两种方式计算结果等同，体现了CDFT的合理性。

heading: Example 5: the H+ H- system and equivalence with a background charge
content:
For an H+ H- system separated by 5 Å, use NWChem CDFT to compute H- (with the charge of H constrained to -1).
**CDFT result**: **the energy is -0.567651263156**.
**Equivalent calculation**: compute the H- system in Gaussian with a unit positive charge (background charge) placed at a distance of 5 Å; the input file format is as follows
#p b3lyp/6-31G* charge
test
-1 1
H 0. 0. 0.
0. 0. 5. 1.0
**Gaussian result**: **the energy is -0.5676521**.
**Conclusion**: H+ and H- calculation via CDFT and computing H- and placing a proton nearby give equivalent results, demonstrating the soundness of CDFT.

The PWPB95-D3(BJ) double-hybrid functional has high robustness and good overall accuracy. It is especially suitable as a priority choice for organometallic reaction calculation, and for calculating intermolecular weak interactions it ranks among the top double hybrids. This functional is supported by ORCA and others, but cannot be used in Gaussian.

heading: B3LYP泛函的优势与局限
content:
B3LYP整体皮实且鲁棒性好，很少有泛函在普适性上显著超过它。B3LYP主要软肋是范德华作用中的色散吸引部分完全没法描述（加DFT-D3可解决）以及电荷转移(CT)激发、里德堡激发计算很烂（CAM-B3LYP可解决）。

heading: Advantages and limitations of the B3LYP functional
content:
B3LYP is overall tough and robust; few functionals significantly surpass it in generality. Its main weaknesses are that dispersion attraction in van der Waals interactions cannot be described at all (solvable by adding DFT-D3) and poor performance for charge-transfer (CT) and Rydberg excitations (CAM-B3LYP can solve this).

heading: Pros and cons of M06-2X and wB97XD
content:
M06-2X and wB97XD do not have the two key weaknesses of B3LYP, but their computational speed is slower than B3LYP. M06-2X places a very high demand on DFT integration grid accuracy; increasing the integration grid accuracy can solve convergence and imaginary frequency problems but increases cost. heading: Shortcomings of the MP2 method and its very few uses
content:
MP2 calculations are computationally time-consuming, have poor accuracy, and are easily criticized by reviewers. The very few uses of MP2 include: (1) computing hydrogen bond energy (but a large basis set must be combined); (2) computing NMR and hyperpolarizability (but double-hybrid functionals can surpass it); (3) estimating CCSD(T)/large basis set energy in a relatively inexpensive way.

content:
For local excitation and intramolecular charge transfer excitation, performing a TDDFT calculation with DSD-PBEP86 is the most ideal. For intermolecular charge transfer excitation, the RS-PBEP86 double-hybrid functional based on SOS-CIS(D) formalism is the best, and currently only the MRCC program supports it. content: 将以下代码拷贝到VMD文本窗口以定义alignplane命令，用于将指定平面旋转至XY平面：proc alignplane {ind1 ind2 ind3} { set atm1 [atomselect top "serial $ind1"]; set atm2 [atomselect top "serial $ind2"]; set atm3 [atomselect top "serial $ind3"]; set vec1x [expr [$atm2 get x] - [$atm1 get x]]; set vec1y [expr [$atm2 get y] - [$atm1 get y]]; set vec1z [expr [$atm2 get z] - [$atm1 get z]]; set vec2x [expr [$atm3 get x] - [$atm1 get x]]; set vec2y [expr [$atm3 get y] - [$atm1 get y]]; set vec2z [expr [$atm3 get z] - [$atm1 get z]]; set sel [atomselect top all]; $sel move [transvecinv [veccross "$vec1x $vec1y $vec1z" "$vec2x $vec2y $vec2z"]]; $sel move [transaxis y 90] }。

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: 几何优化收敛后Freq出现NO或虚频的普遍适用性
content:
几何优化收敛后Freq任务出现NO或虚频的问题及解决方法适用于过渡态优化，过渡态需消除的虚频是指多余存在的虚频而非感兴趣的那个；按所述做法消不掉虚频的情况不存在，消不掉一定是未认真领会该资料并充分尝试；遇到数值非常小的虚频且仅关注能量相关问题时，并非必须不惜一切代价消除虚频。
- 可参考《谈谈有小虚频时热力学量的计算》
topic: Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: General Applicability of NO or Imaginary Frequencies Appearing in Freq after Geometry Optimization Converges
content:
The problem of NO or imaginary frequencies appearing in a freq task after geometry optimization converges, and its solutions, also apply to transition state optimization; the imaginary frequency to be eliminated for a transition state refers to a spurious imaginary frequency, not the one of interest; cases where imaginary frequencies cannot be eliminated by the described methods do not exist—if they cannot be eliminated, the material has not been carefully understood and sufficiently attempted; when an extremely small imaginary frequency is present and only energy-related quantities are of concern, it is not strictly necessary to eliminate the imaginary frequency at all costs.
- See 《谈谈有小虚频时热力学量的计算》
topic: Causes and solutions of imaginary frequencies in Freq after Gaussian optimization converges
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: 结构对称性过高导致虚频的解决方法
content: 虚频有时由初始结构对称性太高导致，如联苯平面构型会出现扭转虚频；解决方法是在GaussView中沿虚频模式略微调整结构，保存新结构后重新优化和做振动分析；此方法对由对称性导致的虚频有效，但不建议作为解决虚频的首选通用方法。
topic: Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: Solutions for Imaginary Frequencies Caused by Excessively High Structural Symmetry
content: Imaginary frequencies are sometimes caused by excessively high symmetry of the initial structure; for example, the planar conformation of biphenyl exhibits a torsional imaginary frequency; the solution is to slightly displace the structure in GaussView along the imaginary frequency mode, save the new structure, and then re-run optimization and vibrational analysis; this method is effective for imaginary frequencies caused by symmetry, but is not recommended as the preferred general method for resolving imaginary frequencies.
topic: Causes and solutions of imaginary frequencies in Freq after Gaussian optimization converges
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: SMD隐式溶剂模型导致虚频的问题
content:
不建议对opt和freq任务使用SMD隐式模型，因为该模型容易因数值噪音产生虚假虚频并导致优化难收敛；优化和振动分析应在IEFPCM下进行，计算能量时再使用SMD；SMD的长处在于计算溶剂环境下的能量，而非对优化结构的影响。
- 可参考《谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算》
topic: Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: Imaginary Frequency Problems Caused by the SMD Implicit Solvent Model
content:
It is not recommended to use the SMD implicit model for opt and freq tasks, because this model is prone to producing spurious imaginary frequencies due to numerical noise and causing optimization convergence difficulties; optimization and vibrational analysis should be performed under IEFPCM, and SMD should be used when computing energies; the strength of SMD lies in computing energies in a solvent environment, not in its effect on the optimized structure.
- See 《谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算》
topic: Causes and solutions of imaginary frequencies in Freq after Gaussian optimization converges
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: 使用IOp自定义泛函时的Opt与Freq分离
content:
使用IOp定义自定义泛函时，IOp无法传递到下一个任务，因此结合opt freq使用时只对opt有效，freq无效会导致势能面不同而产生虚频；使用自定义泛函时opt和freq必须分开做。
- 可参考《Gaussian中非内置的理论方法和泛函的用法》、《在Gaussian中自定义范围分离泛函的方法》
topic: Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: Separating Opt and Freq When Using IOp to Define Custom Functionals
content:
When using IOp to define a custom functional, the IOp is not passed to subsequent jobs, so when combined with opt freq it is only effective for opt; being ineffective for freq means the potential energy surface differs, producing imaginary frequencies; when using a custom functional, opt and freq must be done separately.
- See 《Gaussian中非内置的理论方法和泛函的用法》 and 《在Gaussian中自定义范围分离泛函的方法》
topic: Causes and solutions of imaginary frequencies in Freq after Gaussian optimization converges

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: Gaussian中DFT-D3(BJ)的解析二阶导数Bug
content: Gaussian G09 D.01版中DFT-D3的BJ阻尼版本（em=gd3bj）解析二阶导数存在bug，会导致优化精确的情况下振动分析仍出现虚频；解决办法是使用G09 E.01及以后版本，或改用零阻尼版本DFT-D3(0)进行opt和freq。
topic: Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: Analytic Second Derivative Bug of DFT-D3(BJ) in Gaussian
content: In Gaussian 09 D.01 version, the BJ-damped version of DFT-D3 (em=gd3bj) has a bug in its analytic second derivatives, which can cause imaginary frequencies to appear in vibrational analysis even when the optimization is accurate; the solution is to use G09 E.01 or later versions, or switch to the zero-damping version DFT-D3(0) for opt and freq.

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: 使用Calcall后Freq判断标准仍不同的原因
content: 即便Opt时用了calcall，单独做Freq时判断标准仍可能不同甚至出现NO，原因包括：(1)Freq时级别或数值设定与Opt不一致；(2)GaussView保存输入文件时小数位数有限导致误差；(3)Opt时使用了GDIIS，其参考历史信息预测位移与Freq基于牛顿法的判断不同；(4)Freq未收敛到与Opt相同的波函数，可用guess=read解决。
topic: Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: Why the Freq Criteria Still Differ Even After Using Calcall
content: Even if calcall was used during Opt, the criteria when running a separate Freq may still differ or even yield NO; reasons include: (1) the level or numerical settings during Freq are inconsistent with those during Opt; (2) the limited number of decimal places when GaussView saves the input file introduces errors; (3) GDIIS was used during Opt, whose displacement prediction based on historical information differs from Freq's criteria based on the Newton method; (4) Freq did not converge to the same wavefunction as Opt, which can be resolved with guess=read.
topic: Causes and solutions of imaginary frequencies in Freq after Gaussian optimization converges
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: 几何优化收敛标准与Freq判断标准差异的原理
content:
Gaussian几何优化默认使用近似Hessian矩阵的准牛顿法，而Freq计算必须使用精确Hessian矩阵，这导致基于精确Hessian矩阵判断的最大位移和均方根位移与优化时可能存在差异；Freq任务会根据精确Hessian矩阵和当前结构受力重新用四个判断标准考察结构是否收敛；Opt显示YES但Freq显示NO说明优化精度不够，若出现较大虚频说明结构偏离极小点明显。
- 可参考《基于fch中的Hessian矩阵计算振动频率的简单程序Hess2freq》
topic: Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: Principle of the Difference between Geometry Optimization Convergence Criteria and Freq Criteria
content:
Gaussian geometry optimization by default uses a quasi-Newton method with an approximate Hessian matrix, whereas a freq calculation must use the exact Hessian matrix; this can cause differences between the maximum displacement and root-mean-square displacement judged based on the exact Hessian matrix and those during optimization; the freq task re-examines whether the structure has converged using the four criteria based on the exact Hessian matrix and the forces on the current structure; Opt shows YES but Freq shows NO indicates insufficient optimization accuracy, and a large imaginary frequency indicates the structure deviates significantly from the minimum.
- See 《基于fch中的Hessian矩阵计算振动频率的简单程序Hess2freq》
topic: Causes and solutions of imaginary frequencies in Freq after Gaussian optimization converges
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: Opt收敛但Freq出现NO的结果可用性判断
content: 如果Opt收敛但Freq出现NO，只要数值不超过默认收敛限的2倍且没有虚频出现，结果一般是可以接受的；如果对频率或结构准确度要求高，或者出现了虚频，则应当进行更精确的优化。
topic: Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: Judging the Usability of Results When Opt Converges but Freq Shows NO
content: If Opt converges but Freq shows NO, the results are generally acceptable as long as the values do not exceed 2 times the default convergence limits and no imaginary frequencies appear; if high accuracy of frequencies or the structure is required, or imaginary frequencies appear, a more accurate optimization should be performed.
topic: Causes and solutions of imaginary frequencies in Freq after Gaussian optimization converges
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: 使用Opt=Tight提升优化精度
content: 在Opt中加入tight关键词可以将默认优化收敛限设严一个数量级以上，能降低出现虚频的可能性；代价是达到收敛难度增加，优化步数和耗时大大提升，且增加了震荡无法收敛的概率；注意若写opt=tight freq，Freq最后也会用tight标准判断，但Freq只需满足默认标准即可。
topic: Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: Using Opt=Tight to Improve Optimization Accuracy
content: Adding the tight keyword to Opt tightens the default optimization convergence limits by more than one order of magnitude, which can reduce the likelihood of imaginary frequencies; the cost is increased difficulty in reaching convergence, greatly increased optimization steps and time, and a higher probability of oscillation and failure to converge; note that if opt=tight freq is written, Freq will also be judged by the tight criteria at the end, but Freq only needs to satisfy the default criteria.
topic: Causes and solutions of imaginary frequencies in Freq after Gaussian optimization converges
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: DFT积分格点精度对虚频的影响
content:
DFT计算的积分格点质量不够理想会导致受力和Hessian精度不足，这往往是造成虚频的原因；使用Tight收敛限无法解决此问题；Gaussian 09用户使用opt=tight时应搭配int=ultrafine；Gaussian 16开始int=ultrafine为默认。
- 可参考《密度泛函计算中的格点积分方法》
topic: Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: Effect of DFT integration grid accuracy on imaginary frequencies
content:
Suboptimal integration grid quality in DFT calculations leads to insufficient accuracy in forces and the Hessian, which is often the cause of imaginary frequencies; using Tight convergence criteria cannot solve this problem; Gaussian 09 users should pair opt=tight with int=ultrafine; starting from Gaussian 16, int=ultrafine is the default.
- See 《密度泛函计算中的格点积分方法》
topic: Causes and solutions for imaginary frequencies appearing in Freq after Gaussian optimization converges
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: 高精度积分格点Int=Superfine的使用场景
content: 明尼苏达系列泛函（如M06-2X）对积分格点精度要求比B3LYP、PBE0等高，在int=ultrafine下仍可能因精度不够出现微小虚频，可尝试int=superfine；对于极个别色散作用主导的弱相互作用体系，也可能需要int=superfine来消除微小虚频，但这非常昂贵且情况极度罕见。
topic: Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: Use cases for the high-accuracy grid Int=Superfine
content: Minnesota family functionals (e.g., M06-2X) demand higher integration grid accuracy than B3LYP, PBE0, etc.; even with int=ultrafine, small imaginary frequencies may still appear due to insufficient accuracy, so int=superfine can be tried; for a very few dispersion-dominated weakly interacting systems, int=superfine may also be needed to eliminate small imaginary frequencies, but this is very expensive and extremely rare.
topic: Causes and solutions for imaginary frequencies appearing in Freq after Gaussian optimization converges
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: 使用Opt=Calcall精确计算Hessian
content: 在Opt里写上calcall会使每一步都精确计算Hessian，优化结果比准牛顿法更准确，此时Opt和Freq的Hessian一致，收敛判断结果也相同；Opt=calcall结束后会自动做振动分析，无需再单独写freq；每步精确计算Hessian非常耗时。
topic: Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: Accurately computing the Hessian with Opt=Calcall
content: Adding calcall to Opt makes the Hessian computed exactly at every step, giving optimization results more accurate than quasi-Newton methods; in this case the Hessians of Opt and Freq are consistent, and the convergence judgments are identical; after Opt=calcall finishes, vibrational analysis is performed automatically, so there is no need to write freq separately; computing the Hessian exactly at every step is very time-consuming.
topic: Causes and solutions for imaginary frequencies appearing in Freq after Gaussian optimization converges
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: 使用Opt=Calcfc在优化初始计算精确Hessian
content: 若已在默认情况下优化过，可取最后结构重新优化并在opt里写上calcfc，只在第一步精确计算Hessian，之后近似估计；这种方法往往能避免Freq后出现NO和虚频，但如果初始结构离极小点太远则无效。
topic: Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: Computing the exact Hessian at the start of optimization with Opt=Calcfc
content: If the optimization has already been run under default settings, you can take the final structure, re-optimize it with calcfc in opt, so that the Hessian is computed exactly only in the first step and approximated afterwards; this approach often prevents NO and imaginary frequencies appearing after Freq, but it is ineffective if the initial structure is too far from the minimum.
topic: Causes and solutions for imaginary frequencies appearing in Freq after Gaussian optimization converges
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: 使用Opt=Recalc定期重算Hessian
content: 从Gaussian 16开始，opt加入recalc选项，opt=recalc=n代表第一步精确计算Hessian，之后每n步重算一次；效果和耗时介于calcfc和calcall之间；计算Hessian成本不高时n取3~5，成本较高时n取5~10。
topic: Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/278_Gaussian优化收敛后Freq出现虚频原因与解决_卡片.md
heading: Recomputing the Hessian periodically with Opt=Recalc
content: Starting from Gaussian 16, opt supports the recalc option: opt=recalc=n means the Hessian is computed exactly in the first step and then recomputed every n steps; its effectiveness and cost lie between calcfc and calcall; when Hessian computation is not expensive, take n = 3~5; when it is costly, take n = 5~10.
topic: Causes and solutions for imaginary frequencies appearing in Freq after Gaussian optimization converges
fm_title: Gaussian中几何优化收敛后Freq时出现NO或虚频的原因和解决方法

content: 将Left和Right文件夹中所有重命名后的PDF文件移入All文件夹，利用Acrobat的右键菜单Combine supported files分批合并。先选择编号<10的文件合并为1.pdf，再选择编号10~99的合并为10.pdf，最后选择编号100~999的合并为100.pdf，防止文件排序错乱。

heading: Merging the renamed single-page files in batches
content: Move all renamed PDF files from the Left and Right folders into the All folder, and use Acrobat's right-click menu Combine supported files to batch merge. heading: CPU峰值浮点性能计算公式
content:
CPU峰值性能是CPU运算能力在理想情况下的理论性能，实际性能应以软件实测为准。计算峰值浮点性能的公式为：峰值浮点性能=CPU核数*CPU频率*每周期执行的浮点操作数。目前世界顶尖的高性能计算机(HPC)的浮点性能常以PFLOPs来计，1P=1000T=1000000G。
- FLOPs (FLoating-point Operations Per Second)是衡量浮点性能的常用单位，即每秒做的浮点运算次数，1GFLOPs代表每秒十亿次浮点运算。

heading: CPU Peak Floating-Point Performance Formula
content:
CPU peak performance is the theoretical performance of a CPU's computing capability under ideal conditions; actual performance should be determined by software benchmarks. The formula for calculating peak floating-point performance is: peak floating-point performance = CPU core count * CPU frequency * floating-point operations per cycle. Currently, the world's top high-performance computers (HPC) often have their floating-point performance measured in PFLOPs, where 1P = 1000T = 1000000G.
- FLOPs (FLoating-point Operations Per Second) is a common unit for measuring floating-point performance, i.e., the number of floating-point operations per second; 1GFLOPs represents one billion floating-point operations per second.

file: 11-软件安装与环境/281_CPU与GPU峰值浮点性能计算及硬件选购_卡片.md
heading: 常见CPU内核每周期浮点操作数
content:
目前常见的几类CPU内核的每周期浮点操作数如下（引自网络，见）Intel Core 2 and Nehalem为4 DP FLOPs/cycle (2-wide SSE2 addition + 2-wide SSE2 multiplication) 和 8 SP FLOPs/cycle (4-wide SSE addition + 4-wide SSE multiplication)。Intel Sandy Bridge/Ivy Bridge为8 DP FLOPs/cycle (4-wide AVX addition + 4-wide AVX multiplication) 和 16 SP FLOPs/cycle (8-wide AVX addition + 8-wide AVX multiplication)。Intel Haswell为16 DP FLOPs/cycle (two 4-wide FMA instructions) 和 32 SP FLOPs/cycle (two 8-wide FMA instructions)。AMD K10为4 DP FLOPs/cycle (2-wide SSE2 addition + 2-wide SSE2 multiplication) 和 8 SP FLOPs/cycle (4-wide SSE addition + 4-wide SSE multiplication)。AMD Bulldozer/Piledriver/Steamroller (per module, two cores)为8 DP FLOPs/cycle (4-wide FMA) 和 16 SP FLOPs/cycle (8-wide FMA)。
- 普通CPU的单精度(SP)浮点性能通常是双精度(DP)浮点性能的两倍。

heading: Floating-Point Operations per Cycle of Common CPU Cores
content:
The floating-point operations per cycle of several common CPU cores are as follows (commonly cited values): Intel Core 2 and Nehalem are 4 DP FLOPs/cycle (2-wide SSE2 addition + 2-wide SSE2 multiplication) and 8 SP FLOPs/cycle (4-wide SSE addition + 4-wide SSE multiplication). Intel Sandy Bridge/Ivy Bridge are 8 DP FLOPs/cycle (4-wide AVX addition + 4-wide AVX multiplication) and 16 SP FLOPs/cycle (8-wide AVX addition + 8-wide AVX multiplication). Intel Haswell is 16 DP FLOPs/cycle (two 4-wide FMA instructions) and 32 SP FLOPs/cycle (two 8-wide FMA instructions). AMD K10 is 4 DP FLOPs/cycle (2-wide SSE2 addition + 2-wide SSE2 multiplication) and 8 SP FLOPs/cycle (4-wide SSE addition + 4-wide SSE multiplication). AMD Bulldozer/Piledriver/Steamroller (per module, two cores) are 8 DP FLOPs/cycle (4-wide FMA) and 16 SP FLOPs/cycle (8-wide FMA).
- The single-precision (SP) floating-point performance of ordinary CPUs is usually twice the double-precision (DP) floating-point performance.

heading: AVX指令集对Sandy Bridge/Ivy Bridge性能的影响
content: Sandy Bridge/Ivy Bridge支持AVX指令集，可以一次处理256bit浮点指令，双精度浮点数长度为64bit，即一次可以做四个双精度浮点运算。理论上一个周期可以执行一次AVX浮点乘和一次AVX浮点加，共8个双精度浮点运算，但这只是理论最大值。实际上程序中不能完全利用AVX指令集，且指令类型（如仅有加法或仅有乘法）不匹配会导致运算单元空闲，因此实际性能提升远低于理论值，一般应用中同频同核下性能比Nehalem高近一半。

file: 11-软件安装与环境/281_CPU与GPU峰值浮点性能计算及硬件选购_卡片.md
heading: Impact of the AVX Instruction Set on Sandy Bridge/Ivy Bridge Performance
content: Sandy Bridge/Ivy Bridge supports the AVX instruction set, which can process 256-bit floating-point instructions at once; a double-precision floating-point number is 64 bits long, meaning four double-precision floating-point operations can be performed at once. Theoretically, one cycle can execute one AVX floating-point multiply and one AVX floating-point add, totaling 8 double-precision floating-point operations, but this is only the theoretical maximum. In practice, programs cannot fully exploit the AVX instruction set, and mismatched instruction types (e.g., only additions or only multiplications) leave execution units idle, so the actual performance improvement is far below the theoretical value; in typical applications, at the same frequency and core count, performance is nearly 50% higher than Nehalem.

heading: FMA指令对Haswell (XEON v3) 性能的影响
content: Haswell支持AVX 2.0和FMA3指令，FMA（Fused Multiply-Add）指令可以在一个周期内完成result=a+(b*c)运算，相当于两次常规浮点运算。Haswell每个内核一个周期可处理两条FMA指令，包含4个双精度浮点数，故每核每周期满打满算可做2*4*2=16次双精度浮点操作。表面上看XEON v3比v2浮点性能高一倍，但这水分巨大，因为并非总是乘加运算（如仅有乘法时v3与v2性能相等）。实际测试显示Haswell比Ivy Bridge性能高不到10%。

file: 11-软件安装与环境/281_CPU与GPU峰值浮点性能计算及硬件选购_卡片.md
heading: Impact of FMA Instructions on Haswell (XEON v3) Performance
content: Haswell supports AVX 2.0 and FMA3 instructions; the FMA (Fused Multiply-Add) instruction can complete result=a+(b*c) in a single cycle, equivalent to two ordinary floating-point operations. Each Haswell core can process two FMA instructions per cycle, containing 4 double-precision floating-point numbers each, so at full capacity each core can perform 2*4*2 = 16 double-precision floating-point operations per cycle. On the surface, XEON v3 has twice the floating-point performance of v2, but this is greatly inflated, because multiply-add operations are not always available (e.g., with multiplication only, v3's performance equals v2's). Actual tests show Haswell's performance is less than 10% higher than Ivy Bridge's.

heading: AMD推土机架构浮点性能弱点
content: 从推土机架构（Bulldozer/Piledriver/Steamroller）开始，AMD采用两个核心作为一个模块共用一个浮点单元的设计，一个周期只能处理一次256bit FMA指令。相比Haswell每个核能同时处理两条256bit FMA指令，AMD的四个核才顶Haswell一个核的峰值浮点性能。实际使用中，要达到XEON v2或v3 N个核的实际性能，同频下现在的Opteron需要用>2N个核，且并行效率低时效能极差，不适合计算化学。

file: 11-软件安装与环境/281_CPU与GPU峰值浮点性能计算及硬件选购_卡片.md
heading: Weak Floating-Point Performance of AMD Bulldozer Architecture
content: Starting from the Bulldozer architecture (Bulldozer/Piledriver/Steamroller), AMD adopted a design in which two cores share one floating-point unit as a module, which can only process one 256-bit FMA instruction per cycle. Compared with Haswell, where each core can simultaneously process two 256-bit FMA instructions, four AMD cores are needed to match the peak floating-point performance of one Haswell core. In practice, to achieve the actual performance of N XEON v2 or v3 cores, current Opterons require >2N cores at the same frequency, and when parallel efficiency is low the effectiveness is extremely poor, making them unsuitable for computational chemistry.

heading: Single- vs. Double-Precision Performance Gap in Consumer GPUs
content: GPU single-precision floating-point performance is far more cost-effective than CPU, but most consumer GPUs have poor double-precision performance. file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: 电子激发的分类体系
content: 电子激发分为价层激发和里德堡激发。价层激发是指电子从价层占据轨道激发到价层空轨道，轨道由价层原子轨道混合构成。里德堡激发是指电子从价层占据轨道激发到里德堡轨道，轨道分布弥散，表现类似原子轨道特征。价层激发按电荷转移分为局域激发(LE)和电荷转移激发(CT)，按轨道特征分为sigma、pi、n、d等轨道间的跃迁。
topic: 电子激发类型分类与指认方法
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: Classification system of electron excitations
content: Electron excitations are divided into valence excitations and Rydberg excitations. A valence excitation refers to excitation of an electron from a valence occupied orbital to a valence virtual orbital, with the orbitals constructed from mixtures of valence atomic orbitals. A Rydberg excitation refers to excitation of an electron from a valence occupied orbital to a Rydberg orbital; the orbital distribution is diffuse and exhibits atomic-orbital-like character. Valence excitations are classified by charge transfer into local excitations (LE) and charge transfer excitations (CT), and by orbital character into transitions among sigma, pi, n, d orbitals, etc.
topic: Classification and assignment of electron excitation types

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: sigma与pi轨道的指认
content: 指认轨道类型时需考虑主要特征，忽略次要特征。环丙烯MO10是C-C sigma成键轨道，指认为sigma轨道。MO11主要表现C=C pi轨道特征，指认为pi轨道。MO12是C=C反pi(pi*)轨道。环丙烯第一激发态是pi->pi*，第二激发态是sigma->pi*。
topic: 电子激发类型分类与指认方法
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: Assigning sigma and pi orbitals
content: When assigning orbital types, the main character should be considered and minor character ignored. MO10 of cyclopropene is a C-C sigma bonding orbital and is assigned as a sigma orbital. MO11 mainly shows the character of a C=C pi orbital and is assigned as a pi orbital. MO12 is a C=C antibonding pi (pi*) orbital. The first excited state of cyclopropene is pi->pi*, and the second excited state is sigma->pi*.
topic: Classification and assignment of electron excitation types
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: 孤对电子轨道的指认技巧
content: 丙酮MO16在默认等值面0.05下难以指认，增加等值面到0.15后，特征主要表现为氧的孤对电子。丙酮第一激发态16->17应指认为n->pi*跃迁。吡嗪MO21在等值面0.15下主要显示氮原子孤对电子特征，应指认为n轨道。
topic: 电子激发类型分类与指认方法
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: Techniques for assigning lone pair orbitals
content: MO16 of acetone is difficult to assign at the default isosurface value of 0.05; after increasing the isosurface value to 0.15, its character mainly manifests as the oxygen lone pair. The first excited state of acetone, 16->17, should be assigned as an n->pi* transition. MO21 of pyrazine at an isosurface value of 0.15 mainly shows the character of the nitrogen lone pairs and should be assigned as an n orbital.
topic: Classification and assignment of electron excitation types
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: 吡嗪的激发态类型指认
content: 吡嗪MO21指认为n轨道，MO22指认为pi*轨道，S0->S1是n->pi*激发。MO20是pi轨道，S0->S3是pi->pi*激发。MO19是n轨道，MO23是pi*轨道，S0->S5是n->pi*激发。
topic: 电子激发类型分类与指认方法
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: Assigning excited state types of pyrazine
content: MO21 of pyrazine is assigned as an n orbital and MO22 as a pi* orbital, so S0->S1 is an n->pi* excitation. MO20 is a pi orbital, and S0->S3 is a pi->pi* excitation. MO19 is an n orbital and MO23 a pi* orbital, so S0->S5 is an n->pi* excitation.

fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: 里德堡激发的命名规则
content: 里德堡激发轨道形状类似原子轨道，常用如n->3pz表示。3pz指激发后轨道形状类似pz，主量子数为3。指认时需考察轨道的整体形状特征和主量子数。对于丙酮里德堡激发，MO19形状类似py，主量子数为3，故记为n->3py。
topic: 电子激发类型分类与指认方法
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: Naming rules for Rydberg excitations
content: Orbitals involved in Rydberg excitations have shapes similar to atomic orbitals and are commonly denoted as e.g. n->3pz. 3pz means the orbital after excitation has a shape similar to pz with principal quantum number 3. Assignment requires examining the overall shape character of the orbital and its principal quantum number. For the Rydberg excitations of acetone, MO19 has a shape similar to py with principal quantum number 3, hence it is recorded as n->3py.
topic: Classification and assignment of electron excitation types
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: 里德堡轨道的绘图参数
content: 里德堡轨道分布弥散，数值较小，考察时需用较小的等值面数值。丙酮MO19在默认0.05下特征不明显，降到0.015后显示出明显的py轨道特征。不同轨道可视情况选用0.015或0.01等值面。
topic: 电子激发类型分类与指认方法
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: Plotting parameters for Rydberg orbitals
content: Rydberg orbitals have diffuse distributions and small values, so a smaller isosurface value must be used when examining them. MO19 of acetone shows no obvious character at the default 0.05; after lowering to 0.015, clear py orbital character is revealed. Depending on the situation, an isosurface value of 0.015 or 0.01 may be chosen for different orbitals.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: 丙酮里德堡轨道的具体指认
content: 丙酮MO18轮廓呈球状，指认为3s轨道，S0->S2记为n->3s。MO19、20、21展现3p特征。MO22指认为dz2(类似)，MO23~26展现3d特征。文献书写时应注意将计算坐标轴的z替换为y，y替换为z以符合通常符号。
topic: 电子激发类型分类与指认方法

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: Specific assignment of Rydberg orbitals of acetone
content: The contour of MO18 of acetone is spherical and is assigned as a 3s orbital; S0->S2 is recorded as n->3s. MO19, 20, 21 show 3p character. MO22 is assigned as dz2(-like), and MO23~26 show 3d character. When writing in the literature, note that the z of the computational coordinate axes should be replaced with y, and y with z, to conform to the usual notation.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: 里德堡激发与价层激发的能量关系
content: 里德堡轨道与价层空轨道能量高低不定。含pi键体系最低空轨道通常是pi*，里德堡轨道能量可能高于LUMO但低于sigma*。判断激发类型不看能量高低，而是看电子激发后分布是否弥散。有机大共轭体系感兴趣的能量范围主要是价层激发。
topic: 电子激发类型分类与指认方法
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: Energy relationship between Rydberg and valence excitations
content: The relative energies of Rydberg orbitals and valence virtual orbitals are not fixed. For systems containing pi bonds, the lowest virtual orbital is usually pi*, and Rydberg orbital energies may be above the LUMO but below sigma*. Determining excitation type does not rely on energy ordering, but on whether electron distribution becomes diffuse after excitation. The energy range of interest for organic large conjugated systems mainly involves valence excitations.
topic: Classification and assignment of electron excitation types
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: 弥散函数对里德堡激发计算的影响
content: 使用B3LYP/TZVP(无弥散函数)计算丙酮，里德堡激发能(如S0->S2为6.6967eV)显著高于使用B3LYP/aug-cc-pVTZ的结果(5.7706eV)。无弥散函数导致能量顺序改变，里德堡激发能上升。若只研究价层激发，可故意使用无弥散函数基组以减少里德堡激发态出现。
topic: 电子激发类型分类与指认方法
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: Effect of diffuse functions on Rydberg excitation calculations
content: Calculating acetone with B3LYP/TZVP (no diffuse functions) gives Rydberg excitation energies (e.g. S0->S2 at 6.6967 eV) significantly higher than the results with B3LYP/aug-cc-pVTZ (5.7706 eV). Missing diffuse functions altering energy ordering and raising Rydberg excitation energies. If only valence excitations are of interest, one may deliberately use a basis set without diffuse functions to reduce the appearance of Rydberg excited states.
topic: Classification and assignment of electron excitation types
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: 局域激发与电荷转移激发的定义
content: 局域激发(LE)指电子被激发前后分布区域没有明显变化，即使分布范围覆盖整个体系也算局域激发。电荷转移激发(CT)指电子被激发后分布区域发生明显转移，可以在分子内或分子间转移。过渡金属配合物中LE可分为MC、LC，CT可分为MMCT、LLCT、MLCT、LMCT。
topic: 电子激发类型分类与指认方法
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: Definitions of local excitation and charge transfer excitation
content: A local excitation (LE) means the distribution region shows no obvious change before and after excitation; even if the distribution covers the entire system, it is still a local excitation. A charge transfer excitation (CT) means the distribution region undergoes an obvious transfer after excitation, which may be intra- or intermolecular. For transition metal complexes, LE is divided into MC and LC, and CT into MMCT, LLCT, MLCT, LMCT.
topic: Classification and assignment of electron excitation types
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: 电子激发类型的轨道判断法
content: 电子激发实际是电子态跃迁，涉及多个轨道对。如果某个轨道对贡献占绝对主导(大于75%)，可通过分析这两个轨道特征判断激发类型。计算各轨道对跃迁贡献的方法详见《电子激发任务中轨道跃迁贡献的计算》。
topic: 电子激发类型分类与指认方法
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: Orbital-based determination of excitation type
content: An electron excitation is actually a transition between electron states, involving multiple orbital pairs. If a certain orbital pair contributes absolutely dominantly (greater than 75%), the excitation type can be determined by analyzing the character of these two orbitals. For the method of computing transition contributions of each orbital pair, see 《电子激发任务中轨道跃迁贡献的计算》.
topic: Classification and assignment of electron excitation types
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: 电子激发类型的分析方法
content: 当没有主导轨道对时，需用其他方法考察。可用Multiwfn做electron-hole分析，给出电子从hole区域跃迁到electron区域的分布图，详见《使用Multiwfn做空穴-电子分析全面考察电子激发特征》。也可做NTO分析，将电子态跃迁近似转化为单个NTO对跃迁，详见《使用Multiwfn做自然跃迁轨道(NTO)分析》和《跃迁密度分析方法-自然跃迁轨道(NTO)简介》。
topic: 电子激发类型分类与指认方法
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: Methods for analyzing electron excitation types
content: When there is no dominant orbital pair, other methods must be used. Multiwfn can perform electron-hole analysis, giving distribution plots of the electron transitioning from the hole region to the electron region; see 《使用Multiwfn做空穴-电子分析全面考察电子激发特征》. NTO analysis can also be performed, approximating the electron state transition as a single NTO pair transition; see 《使用Multiwfn做自然跃迁轨道(NTO)分析》 and 《跃迁密度分析方法-自然跃迁轨道(NTO)简介》.
topic: Classification and assignment of electron excitation types
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: 电荷转移与里德堡激发的计算方法要求
content: CT激发和里德堡激发的特点是电子激发前后分布范围变化大，electron和hole重叠小。计算此类激发必须用范围分离泛函(如wB97XD)或HF成份高的泛函(如M06-2X)。计算里德堡激发必须使用有充足弥散函数的基组，如aug-cc-pVDZ。
topic: 电子激发类型分类与指认方法
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: Computational method requirements for charge transfer and Rydberg excitations
content: Charge transfer excitations and Rydberg excitations are characterized by large changes in distribution extent before and after excitation and small overlap between the electron and hole. Calculating such excitations requires a range-separated functional (e.g. wB97XD) or functionals with high HF character (e.g., M06-2X). Calculating Rydberg excitations requires a basis set with sufficient diffuse functions, e.g. aug-cc-pVDZ.
topic: Classification and assignment of electron excitation types
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: N-苯基吡咯的局域激发实例
content: 在cam-b3lyp/6-31+g(d)下计算N-苯基吡咯的S0->S1跃迁，38->39(HOMO->LUMO)贡献达90%。HOMO和LUMO都是整体分布，电子分布无明显转移，S0->S1是局域激发。
topic: 电子激发类型分类与指认方法
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: Example of local excitation in N-phenylpyrrole
content: Calculating the S0->S1 transition of N-phenylpyrrole at cam-b3lyp/6-31+g(d), the contribution of 38->39 (HOMO->LUMO) reaches 90%. Both HOMO and LUMO are distributed over the whole system, with no obvious transfer of electron distribution, so S0->S1 is a local excitation.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: N-苯基吡咯的电荷转移激发实例
content: 在cam-b3lyp/6-31+g(d)下计算N-苯基吡咯的S0->S5跃迁，37->40贡献达95%。37号轨道分布在吡咯上，40号轨道分布在苯基上，电子从吡咯向苯基转移，S0->S5是电荷转移跃迁。
topic: 电子激发类型分类与指认方法
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: Example of charge transfer excitation in N-phenylpyrrole
content: For the S0->S5 transition of N-phenylpyrrole computed at cam-b3lyp/6-31+g(d), orbitals 37->40 contribute 95%. Orbital 37 is distributed on the pyrrole, and orbital 40 on the phenyl group; the electron transfers from pyrrole to the phenyl group, so S0->S5 is a charge transfer transition.
topic: Classification and assignment methods for electronic excitation types
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: 复杂激发态的空穴-电子分析
content: 对于没有主导轨道对的激发，如N-苯基吡咯S0->S2，直接看轨道不可靠。使用Multiwfn做electron-hole分析，结果显示hole大部分在苯基，electron完全在苯基。此激发有少量CT特征，但主要为LE特征，归为局域激发。该分析还能给出质心距离、重叠积分、密度差图等，详见《Multiwfn支持的电子激发分析方法一览》。
topic: 电子激发类型分类与指认方法
fm_title: 图解电子激发的分类

file: 03-激发态与光谱/284_电子激发类型分类与指认方法_卡片.md
heading: Hole-electron analysis of complex excited states
content: For excitations without a dominant orbital pair, such as N-phenylpyrrole S0->S2, directly viewing orbitals is unreliable. Using Multiwfn for electron-hole analysis, the results show the hole is mostly on the phenyl group and the electron is entirely on the phenyl group. This excitation has a small amount of CT character but is mainly LE character, and is classified as a local excitation. heading: 势能面交叉条件
content: 两个态波函数分别为|1>和|2>，构成2*2哈密顿矩阵，矩阵元包括对角元H11=<1|H|1>、H22=<2|H|2>和耦合矩阵元H12=<1|H|2>=H21。两态能量E1、E2相同需同时满足两个条件：(1) H11=H22 (2) H12=0。对于自旋多重度不同的态，不考虑旋轨耦合时H12总为0，只需满足H11=H22。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/286_sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点_卡片.md
heading: Conditions for potential energy surface crossing
content: Given two states with wavefunctions |1> and |2>, they form a 2*2 Hamiltonian matrix whose matrix elements include the diagonal elements H11=<1|H|1>, H22=<2|H|2>, and the coupling matrix element H12=<1|H|2>=H21. Equal energies E1 and E2 of the two states require satisfying two conditions simultaneously: (1) H11=H22 (2) H12=0. For states with different spin multiplicities, H12 is always 0 when spin-orbit coupling is not considered, so only H11=H22 needs to be satisfied.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/286_sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点_卡片.md
heading: MECP处的自由能计算问题
content: 计算MECP自由能应计算两个态能量简并的3N-7维空间里的3N-7个振动模式频率，但无简单工具。使用Gaussian的freq=projected关键词计算自由能不具备普适性，因为垂直于downhill路径的子空间不等同于能量简并的3N-7维空间，结果依赖于自旋多重度选取且不唯一。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/286_sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点_卡片.md
heading: Free energy calculation at the MECP
content: To compute the free energy at an MECP, one should compute the frequencies of the 3N-7 vibrational modes in the 3N-7 dimensional space where the energies of the two states are degenerate, but no simple tool exists. Computing the free energy with Gaussian's freq=projected keyword is not generally applicable, because the subspace perpendicular to the downhill path is not equivalent to the energy-degenerate 3N-7 dimensional space; the result depends on the choice of spin multiplicity and is not unique.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/286_sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点_卡片.md
heading: 极小能量交叉点定义
content: 不考虑旋轨耦合下，两个自旋多重度不同的态的交叉在3N-7维超曲面中进行。极小能量交叉点(MECP)是指两个态能量相同的3N-7维超曲面中能量最低的那个结构。两个态之间可以存在多个MECP，搜索到的具体结果取决于初猜结构。
topic: sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点
fm_title: 使用sobMECP程序结合Gaussian程序搜索极小能量交叉点

file: 03-激发态与光谱/286_sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点_卡片.md
heading: Definition of the minimum energy crossing point
content: Without considering spin-orbit coupling, the crossing between two states with different spin multiplicities occurs in a (3N-7)-dimensional hypersurface. The minimum energy crossing point (MECP) is the structure with the lowest energy on the (3N-7)-dimensional hypersurface where the energies of the two states are equal. Multiple MECPs can exist between two states, and the specific search result depends on the initial guess structure.
topic: Searching for minimum energy crossing points with sobMECP combined with Gaussian
fm_title: 使用sobMECP程序结合Gaussian程序搜索极小能量交叉点

file: 03-激发态与光谱/286_sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点_卡片.md
heading: 系间窜越与MECP
content: 系间窜越是重要的光化学过程，指电子激发后，由于不同自旋多重度的态的势能面之间存在交叉，导致体系经历这样的结构时以非辐射方式改变自旋多重度。寻找MECP的结构对光化学研究十分重要。
topic: sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点
fm_title: 使用sobMECP程序结合Gaussian程序搜索极小能量交叉点

file: 03-激发态与光谱/286_sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点_卡片.md
heading: Intersystem crossing and the MECP
content: Intersystem crossing is an important photochemical process. After electronic excitation, because crossings exist between the potential energy surfaces of states with different spin multiplicities, the system can change its spin multiplicity non-radiatively when passing through such structures. Locating the structure of the MECP is very important for photochemical study.
topic: Searching for minimum energy crossing points with sobMECP combined with Gaussian
fm_title: 使用sobMECP程序结合Gaussian程序搜索极小能量交叉点

file: 03-激发态与光谱/286_sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点_卡片.md
heading: MECP理论方法选择
content: 搜索MECP可用的理论方法有两类：一类是做态平均CASSCF（或MS-CASPT2、MRCI）计算；另一类是用普通方法如DFT、MP2、CCSD分别对两个态做单点计算。基于DFT搜索MECP是首选，便宜、方便且可用于大体系，如果对精度要求高可考虑CCSD或CASSCF。
topic: sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点
fm_title: 使用sobMECP程序结合Gaussian程序搜索极小能量交叉点

file: 03-激发态与光谱/286_sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点_卡片.md
heading: Choice of theoretical method for MECP search
content: There are two classes of theoretical methods available for the MECP search: one is performing state-averaged CASSCF (or MS-CASPT2, MRCI) calculations; the other is using ordinary methods such as DFT, MP2, or CCSD to perform single-point calculations for the two states separately. MECP search based on DFT is the preferred choice: it is cheap, convenient, and applicable to large systems. If high accuracy is required, CCSD or CASSCF can be considered.
topic: Searching for minimum energy crossing points with sobMECP combined with Gaussian
fm_title: 使用sobMECP程序结合Gaussian程序搜索极小能量交叉点

file: 03-激发态与光谱/286_sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点_卡片.md
heading: Robb的MECP搜索算法
content: Robb提出的MECP搜索算法定义两个有效梯度f和g。f是(E1-E2)^2对核坐标求导，即E1-E2乘以两个态的梯度矢量之差，沿f移动减小能量差。g是E1对核坐标求导并投影掉f方向的分量，沿g移动降低第一个态能量。按f+g作为有效受力进行优化，最后得到MECP结构。
topic: sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点
fm_title: 使用sobMECP程序结合Gaussian程序搜索极小能量交叉点

file: 03-激发态与光谱/286_sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点_卡片.md
heading: Robb's MECP search algorithm
content: Robb's MECP search algorithm defines two effective gradients f and g. f is the derivative of (E1-E2)^2 with respect to the nuclear coordinates, i.e., E1-E2 multiplied by the difference between the gradient vectors of the two states; moving along f reduces the energy difference. g is the derivative of E1 with respect to the nuclear coordinates with the component along the f direction projected out; moving along g lowers the energy of the first state. Optimization is performed with f+g as the effective force, finally yielding the MECP structure.
topic: Searching for minimum energy crossing points with sobMECP combined with Gaussian
fm_title: 使用sobMECP程序结合Gaussian程序搜索极小能量交叉点

file: 03-激发态与光谱/286_sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点_卡片.md
heading: MECP搜索收敛标准与算法应用
content: MECP搜索一般同时使用位移、受力、两个态能量差作为收敛判断标准。若去掉能量差必须接近0的收敛标准，该算法也可直接用于搜索避免交叉极小点。搜索MECP用的初猜取平衡结构或过渡态结构即可，该算法基于牛顿法或赝牛顿法。
topic: sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点
fm_title: 使用sobMECP程序结合Gaussian程序搜索极小能量交叉点

file: 03-激发态与光谱/286_sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点_卡片.md
heading: Convergence criteria for MECP search and application of the algorithm
content: The MECP search generally uses displacement, force, and energy difference between two states together as the convergence criteria. If the convergence criterion requiring energy difference near zero is removed, the algorithm can also be directly used to search for avoided-crossing minima. The initial guess for the MECP search can simply be taken from an equilibrium structure or a transition state structure; the algorithm is based on the Newton or quasi-Newton method.
topic: Searching for minimum energy crossing points with sobMECP combined with Gaussian
fm_title: 使用sobMECP程序结合Gaussian程序搜索极小能量交叉点

file: 03-激发态与光谱/286_sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点_卡片.md
heading: sobMECP的Input_Header文件设置
content: 设定Input_Header_A和Input_Header_B文件，内容分别是两个态的分子坐标之前的部分。%chk必须写，force和guess(read)关键词必须写，其它关键词根据实际情况填写，必须用#n。如果需要用gen或genECP从坐标末尾读取基组，需在Input_Tail文件中写明定义，否则留空。
topic: sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点
fm_title: 使用sobMECP程序结合Gaussian程序搜索极小能量交叉点

file: 03-激发态与光谱/286_sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点_卡片.md
heading: Settings of the sobMECP Input_Header files
content: Set the Input_Header_A and Input_Header_B files, whose contents are respectively the parts of the two states preceding the molecular coordinates. %chk must be specified, the force and guess(read) keywords must be included, other keywords should be filled in according to actual needs, and #n must be used. If gen or genECP is needed to read the basis set from the end of the coordinates, the definitions must be written in the Input_Tail file; otherwise leave it empty.
topic: Searching for minimum energy crossing points with sobMECP combined with Gaussian
fm_title: 使用sobMECP程序结合Gaussian程序搜索极小能量交叉点

heading: sobMECP的geom文件格式
content: 在geom文件中填好体系初始结构，末尾必须空一行，原子名必须用元素的序号代替。运行./prepare.sh会编译产生MECP.x、运行进度文件ProgFile和主脚本runMECP.sh。
topic: sobMECP结合Gaussian搜索极小能量交叉点
fm_title: 使用sobMECP程序结合Gaussian程序搜索极小能量交叉点

heading: geom file format of sobMECP
content: Fill in the initial structure of the system in the geom file; an empty line must be left at the end, and the atom names must be replaced by the atomic numbers of the elements. Running ./prepare.sh compiles and produces MECP.x, the running-progress file ProgFile, and the main script runMECP.sh.

heading: GaussView查看优化轨迹
content: 在GaussView中打开Gaussian优化输出文件时勾选Read Intermediate Geometries复选框，即可查看几何优化轨迹，这对于了解优化过程中结构的变化非常重要。

heading: Viewing optimization trajectories in GaussView
content: When opening a Gaussian optimization output file in GaussView, check the Read Intermediate Geometries checkbox to view the geometry optimization trajectory, which is very important for understanding how the structure changes during the optimization process.

file: 07-Gaussian使用/289_GaussView查看优化轨迹避免结构跳变_卡片.md
heading: 结构跳变的原因
content: Gaussian默认将每一步结构旋转平移成标准朝向（Standard orientation），导致结构细微变化可能在经过标准朝向处理后与上一步产生巨大的朝向差异，从而在GaussView播放轨迹时出现结构跳变；使用nosymm关键词虽可利用Input orientation坐标避免跳变，但会损失利用对称性加速计算的好处。
topic: GaussView查看优化轨迹避免结构跳变
fm_title: GaussView观看Gaussian优化轨迹时避免结构跳变的方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/289_GaussView查看优化轨迹避免结构跳变_卡片.md
heading: Cause of structural jumps
content: By default, Gaussian rotates and translates the structure at every step into the standard orientation. As a result, a subtle structural change may, after standard-orientation processing, show a huge orientation difference from the previous step, causing structural jumps when playing the trajectory in GaussView. Using the nosymm keyword allows reading the Input orientation coordinates to avoid the jumps, but this loses the benefit of exploiting symmetry for computational acceleration.
topic: Viewing optimization trajectories in GaussView to avoid structural jumps
fm_title: GaussView观看Gaussian优化轨迹时避免结构跳变的方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/289_GaussView查看优化轨迹避免结构跳变_卡片.md
heading: G16版本限制
content: Gaussian 16已经解决了因标准朝向导致的180度翻转问题，但截至G16 A.03版本，仍未能解决由此类原因导致的如90度翻转等跳变问题。
topic: GaussView查看优化轨迹避免结构跳变
fm_title: GaussView观看Gaussian优化轨迹时避免结构跳变的方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/289_GaussView查看优化轨迹避免结构跳变_卡片.md
heading: Limitations of G16 versions
content: Gaussian 16 has already solved the 180-degree flip problem caused by the standard orientation, but as of version G16 A.03, jumps such as 90-degree flips caused by this kind of reason remain unsolved.
topic: Viewing optimization trajectories in GaussView to avoid structural jumps
fm_title: GaussView观看Gaussian优化轨迹时避免结构跳变的方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/289_GaussView查看优化轨迹避免结构跳变_卡片.md
heading: 两种坐标输出形式
content: Gaussian优化过程的每一步不仅输出Standard orientation坐标，还输出Input orientation坐标，其中Input orientation是相对于初始输入文件里朝向的坐标。
topic: GaussView查看优化轨迹避免结构跳变
fm_title: GaussView观看Gaussian优化轨迹时避免结构跳变的方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/289_GaussView查看优化轨迹避免结构跳变_卡片.md
heading: Two coordinate output forms
content: At every step of a Gaussian optimization, not only the Standard orientation coordinates but also the Input orientation coordinates are output; the Input orientation refers to the coordinates relative to the orientation in the initial input file.
topic: Viewing optimization trajectories in GaussView to avoid structural jumps
fm_title: GaussView观看Gaussian优化轨迹时避免结构跳变的方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/289_GaussView查看优化轨迹避免结构跳变_卡片.md
heading: 解决跳变的基本原理
content: GaussView默认读取Standard orientation坐标从而导致跳变，只要将其修改为读取Input orientation坐标，即可避免优化轨迹出现跳变。
topic: GaussView查看优化轨迹避免结构跳变
fm_title: GaussView观看Gaussian优化轨迹时避免结构跳变的方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/289_GaussView查看优化轨迹避免结构跳变_卡片.md
heading: Basic principle for solving jumps
content: GaussView by default reads the Standard orientation coordinates, which causes the jumps. As long as it is changed to read the Input orientation coordinates, the jumps in the optimization trajectory can be avoided.
topic: Viewing optimization trajectories in GaussView to avoid structural jumps
fm_title: GaussView观看Gaussian优化轨迹时避免结构跳变的方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/289_GaussView查看优化轨迹避免结构跳变_卡片.md
heading: 修改输出文件的具体操作
content: 修改Gaussian输出文件，将所有"Standard orientation:"替换成任意字符使GaussView无法识别，然后将所有"Input orientation:"替换成"Standard orientation:"，即可欺骗GaussView读取正确的坐标以实现连续轨迹播放。
topic: GaussView查看优化轨迹避免结构跳变
fm_title: GaussView观看Gaussian优化轨迹时避免结构跳变的方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/289_GaussView查看优化轨迹避免结构跳变_卡片.md
heading: Concrete procedure for modifying the output file
content: Modify the Gaussian output file: replace all "Standard orientation:" with arbitrary characters so that GaussView cannot recognize them, then replace all "Input orientation:" with "Standard orientation:". This tricks GaussView into reading the correct coordinates, enabling continuous trajectory playback.
topic: Viewing optimization trajectories in GaussView to avoid structural jumps
fm_title: GaussView观看Gaussian优化轨迹时避免结构跳变的方法

file: 07-Gaussian使用/289_GaussView查看优化轨迹避免结构跳变_卡片.md
heading: 输出Input orientation的限定条件
content: 当原子数超过50时，Gaussian默认不输出Input orientation，必须在输入文件中使用geom=printinputorient关键词来强行要求输出。

heading: Conditions for outputting the Input orientation
content: When the number of atoms exceeds 50, Gaussian by default does not output the Input orientation; the geom=printinputorient keyword must be used in the input file to force its output.

file: 10-化学信息学与脚本/28_Gromacs轨迹gro文件空间区域筛选工具_卡片.md
heading: grostat程序简介
content: grostat是用于统计并提取Gromacs的.gro文件里指定原子的小工具，版本为V1.3。该程序根据输入的坐标范围、原子类型和原子所属残基名称计算出总数，并将结果自动存到程序所在目录下的result.gro中，可以直接用VMD打开。所选原子的原子序号都输出到list.ndx，group名称为[selected-atoms]，可以在Gromacs一些子程序中用-n读取。
topic: Gromacs轨迹gro文件空间区域筛选工具

file: 10-化学信息学与脚本/28_Gromacs轨迹gro文件空间区域筛选工具_卡片.md
heading: Introduction to the grostat program
content: grostat is a small tool for counting and extracting specified atoms from Gromacs .gro files, version V1.3. Based on the input coordinate range, atom type, and residue name to which the atoms belong, the program computes the total count and automatically saves the result to result.gro in the directory where the program resides, which can be opened directly in VMD. The atomic indices of the selected atoms are all output to list.ndx, with the group name [selected-atoms], which can be read with -n in some Gromacs subroutines.
topic: Tool for spatial-region filtering of Gromacs trajectory gro files

file: 10-化学信息学与脚本/28_Gromacs轨迹gro文件空间区域筛选工具_卡片.md
heading: 坐标范围定义方式
content: grostat支持三种空间范围定义方式：通过输入最小xyz和最大xyz限定的长方形盒子；通过输入球形的中心和半径得到的球形范围；通过输入圆柱的半径，X、Y坐标，柱的最下端和最上端Z轴坐标得到的平行于Z轴的圆柱选择范围。

file: 10-化学信息学与脚本/28_Gromacs轨迹gro文件空间区域筛选工具_卡片.md
heading: Coordinate range definition methods
content: grostat supports three ways of defining a spatial range: a rectangular box specified by inputting minimum xyz and maximum xyz; a spherical range obtained by inputting the center and radius of a sphere; a cylindrical selection range parallel to the Z axis obtained by inputting the radius of the cylinder, the X and Y coordinates, and the lowest and highest Z-axis coordinates of the cylinder.
topic: Tool for spatial region filtering of Gromacs trajectory gro files

file: 10-化学信息学与脚本/28_Gromacs轨迹gro文件空间区域筛选工具_卡片.md
heading: 保留完整残基功能
content: 1.1版增加了保留完整残基功能，开启后所有被选区域内的原子都会保留它所在的残基的全部原子。所有符合条件的残基的序号都会输出到residue.txt。此功能可防止处于边界的残基被截成两半，例如设原子类型为CA、残基为ALA时，会得到这个区域内所有ALA的全部原子而不是仅仅得到CA。

file: 10-化学信息学与脚本/28_Gromacs轨迹gro文件空间区域筛选工具_卡片.md
heading: Retain whole residue function
content: Version 1.1 added the retain whole residue function; when enabled, all atoms selected within the region retain all atoms of the residue they belong to. The indices of all residues meeting the criteria are output to residue.txt. This function prevents boundary residues from being split in half. For example, with atom type set to CA and residue type to ALA, all atoms of every ALA in the region are retained rather than only the CA atoms.
topic: Tool for spatial region filtering of Gromacs trajectory gro files
fm_title: grostat V1.3--Gromacs .gro文件分析、统计小工具

file: 10-化学信息学与脚本/28_Gromacs轨迹gro文件空间区域筛选工具_卡片.md
heading: 范围反转功能
content: 1.2版加入了反转选择范围的功能，即实际所选的空间范围是输入的空间范围以外的范围。结合保留完整残基功能，此功能可用于处理膜蛋白嵌入及去除膜层间水分子。通过将.gro文件读入grostat反复处理多次，可以弄出合适的结果。
topic: Gromacs轨迹gro文件空间区域筛选工具
fm_title: grostat V1.3--Gromacs .gro文件分析、统计小工具

file: 10-化学信息学与脚本/28_Gromacs轨迹gro文件空间区域筛选工具_卡片.md
heading: Range inversion function
content: Version 1.2 added the selection range inversion function, i.e. the actual spatial range selected is the region outside the input spatial range. Combined with the retain whole residue function, this function can be used for embedding membrane proteins and removing water molecules between membrane layers. By loading the .gro file into grostat and processing it repeatedly several times, a suitable result can be obtained.

heading: 程序处理限制
content: grostat最大只能处理100000个原子的gro文件。如果原子数超过这个数值，gro中的原子序号会从0重新开始，造成grostat误判。对这种情况应手动在原子序号重新循环处将.gro分割，分别用grostat处理后合并。

file: 10-化学信息学与脚本/28_Gromacs轨迹gro文件空间区域筛选工具_卡片.md
heading: Program processing limitations
content: grostat can process gro files with at most 100000 atoms. If the number of atoms exceeds this value, the atom indices in the gro file restart from 0, causing grostat to misjudge. In such cases, you should manually split the .gro file at the point where the atom indices restart, process each part with grostat separately, and then merge the results.

heading: Cylindrical range selection function
content: Version 1.3 added the cylindrical range selection function, corresponding to range options 5 and 6 (cylindrical inversion selection). The cylinder axis is parallel to the Z axis; you need to input the radius of the cylinder, the X and Y coordinates, and the lowest and highest Z-axis coordinates of the cylinder. This function is suitable for cases where the phospholipids of the phospholipid layer are generally parallel to the Z axis; it can create a circular hole in the lipid layer for embedding membrane protein.

file: 09-可视化与制图/290_VMD计算结构RMSD及叠合操作_卡片.md
heading: RMSD的定义与用途
content: RMSD（Root mean square displacement/deviation）用于衡量两个结构间的整体几何偏差，适用于比较极小点构型差异、电子激发/电离/外加电场前后几何结构改变或形成复合物后的单体结构变化。RMSD定义公式为$\sqrt{\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^N [(x_i-x_i')^2 + (y_i-y_i')^2 + (z_i-z_i')^2]}$，其中i循环所有原子，x_i和x_i'分别是第i个原子在两个结构中的坐标。计算RMSD前必须先进行叠合（align），即通过平移和旋转一个结构来最小化RMSD，否则结果无法有效衡量内部差异。
topic: VMD计算结构RMSD及叠合操作
fm_title: 在VMD中计算RMSD衡量两个结构间的几何偏差

file: 09-可视化与制图/290_VMD计算结构RMSD及叠合操作_卡片.md
heading: Definition and uses of RMSD
content: RMSD (Root mean square displacement/deviation) is used for measuring overall geometric deviation between two structures. It is suitable for comparing differences between minimum-point geometries, geometric structure changes upon electronic excitation/ionization or under an external electric field, or changes in monomer structures upon complex formation. The RMSD is defined as $\sqrt{\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^N [(x_i-x_i')^2 + (y_i-y_i')^2 + (z_i-z_i')^2]}$, where i runs over all atoms, and x_i and x_i' are the coordinates of the i-th atom in the two structures, respectively. Before calculating RMSD, alignment (align) must be performed first, i.e. minimizing the RMSD by translating and rotating one structure; otherwise the result cannot effectively measure the internal difference.

file: 09-可视化与制图/290_VMD计算结构RMSD及叠合操作_卡片.md
heading: 使用VMD计算RMSD的操作步骤
content: 启动VMD并将两个结构文件拖入载入，选择Extensions - Analysis - RMSD Calculator；将左上角文本框内容改为all，取消选择Backbone only复选框，点击Align进行叠合，随后点击RMSD按钮，窗口下方显示的Total RMSD即为两个结构间的RMSD值。若只需计算指定原子，可在文本框输入对应的选择语句（如serial 2 to 4 8），Align和RMSD操作将仅针对这些原子进行。

file: 09-可视化与制图/290_VMD计算结构RMSD及叠合操作_卡片.md
heading: Procedure for calculating RMSD in VMD
content: Start VMD and load the two structure files by dragging them in; select Extensions - Analysis - RMSD Calculator; change the text in the upper-left text box to all, uncheck the Backbone only checkbox, click Align to perform the alignment, then click the RMSD button; the Total RMSD shown at the bottom of the window is the RMSD value between the two structures. If you only need to calculate for specified atoms, you can enter the corresponding selection statement in the text box (e.g. serial 2 to 4 8), and the Align and RMSD operations will be performed only for those atoms.

heading: 丙烷体系结构文件的数据格式

heading: Data format of the propane system structure files

heading: Plotting settings for intuitively visualizing structural differences in VMD
content: Select Graphics - Representation, choose the two systems respectively in Selected Molecule, set the Coloring Method to Color ID and select colors for each (e.g. 13 Mauve and blue), and set Thickness to 4 for bolder display. file: 09-可视化与制图/290_VMD计算结构RMSD及叠合操作_卡片.md
heading: 局部区域RMSD计算的原子顺序要求
content: 对两个主体结构相同但局部不同的分子（如苯酚和间硝基苯腈）计算局部区域RMSD时，被叠合部分必须满足两个条件：(1)原子数相同，(2)原子顺序一致。若原子顺序不一致（如交错排列），需在叠合前自行编辑结构文件调整原子顺序。

file: 09-可视化与制图/290_VMD计算结构RMSD及叠合操作_卡片.md
heading: Atom ordering requirement for local region RMSD calculation
content: When performing a local region RMSD calculation for two molecules with the same main body but different local regions (such as phenol and 3-cyanonitrobenzene), the aligned part must satisfy two conditions: (1) the same number of atoms, and (2) consistent atom ordering. If the atom ordering is inconsistent (e.g. interleaved), you need to edit the structure files yourself to adjust the atom ordering before alignment.

file: 09-可视化与制图/290_VMD计算结构RMSD及叠合操作_卡片.md
heading: 解决VMD叠合算法局部极小问题的方法
content: 若VMD的Align算法未能实现理想叠合（类似落入局部极小点），可手动调节分子位置以提供更好的初猜。操作方法为：选Mouse - Move - Molecule，按住alt键并用鼠标左键拖动某原子可平移整个体系，按住alt+shift并用鼠标左键拖动可旋转整个分子，按住alt+shift并用鼠标右键拖动可令整个分子沿屏幕旋转；调节接近后再次点击Align按钮即可完成正确叠合。

file: 09-可视化与制图/290_VMD计算结构RMSD及叠合操作_卡片.md
heading: Resolving the local minimum problem of the VMD alignment algorithm
content: If the Align algorithm in VMD is failing to achieve ideal superposition (akin to falling into local minimum), you can manually adjust the molecular positions to provide a better initial guess. How to do it: select Mouse - Move - Molecule; hold the alt key and drag an atom with the left mouse button to translate the entire system; hold alt+shift and drag with the left mouse button to rotate the entire molecule; hold alt+shift and drag with the right mouse button to rotate the entire molecule about the screen axis; once the adjustment is close enough, click the Align button again to complete the correct alignment.

heading: RDG分析背景与相关方法介绍

heading: Background of RDG analysis and introduction of related methods
content: Using quantum chemistry output files combined with VMD to plot RDG colored isosurface maps is a common method for studying weak interactions; see 《使用Multiwfn图形化研究弱相互作用》. Many of the issues discussed in this text are also generally applicable to plotting IGM, IGMH, and IRI maps; for introductions to these methods, see 《通过独立梯度模型(IGM)考察分子间弱相互作用》、《使用Multiwfn做IGMH分析非常清晰直观地展现化学体系中的相互作用》 and 《使用IRI方法图形化考察化学体系中的化学键和弱相互作用》. For comprehensive introductions to all these methods, see 《一篇最全面介绍各种弱相互作用可视化分析方法的文章已发表！》 and 《Angew. Chem.上发表了全面介绍各种共价和非共价相互作用可视化分析方法的综述》.

heading: RDG散点图中未完全触底spike的物理意义
content: 散点图中一些未完全戳到底但离底部很近的spike是合理的，一般也有意义。这些弱相互作用用AIM分析可能无法展现（不会出现临界点），但RDG方法可以表现出来，这是RDG相对于AIM的一个优势。相关讨论见Chemistry—Methods, 1, 231-239 (2021) DOI: 10.1002/cmtd.202100007的2.4节。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/291_Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题_卡片.md
heading: Physical meaning of spikes not fully reaching the bottom in the RDG scatter plot
content: In the scatter plot, some spikes that do not fully poke to the bottom but come very close to it are reasonable and generally meaningful. Such weak interactions may not be revealed by AIM analysis (no critical points appear), but the RDG method can show them, which is an advantage of RDG over AIM. For related discussion, see Section 2.4 of Chemistry—Methods, 1, 231-239 (2021) DOI: 10.1002/cmtd.202100007.

heading: RDG分析的定量化方法
content: RDG定量讨论可看spike的位置，或结合AIM定量分析（见《AIM学习资料和重要文献合集》）。氢键靠AIM理论可以准确地估计作用能，见《透彻认识氢键本质、简单可靠地估计氢键强度：一篇2019年JCC上的重要研究文章介绍》。还有人提出积分RDG等值面内部区域的做法（J. Phys. Chem. A, 115, 12983 (2011)），可通过Multiwfn的域分析功能实现（见手册4.200.14.1节）。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/291_Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题_卡片.md
heading: Quantitative approaches for RDG analysis
content: For quantitative discussion of RDG, one can look at the position of the spike, or combine it with quantitative AIM analysis (see 《AIM学习资料和重要文献合集》). Based on AIM theory, hydrogen bond interaction energies can be accurately estimated; see 《透彻认识氢键本质、简单可靠地估计氢键强度：一篇2019年JCC上的重要研究文章介绍》. There are also proposals to integrate the region inside the RDG isosurface (J. Phys. Chem. A, 115, 12983 (2011)), which can be realized via the domain analysis function of Multiwfn (see Section 4.200.14.1 of the manual).

heading: 绘制周期性体系RDG图的方法与限制
content: 从Multiwfn 3.8版开始支持绘制周期性体系的RDG图，通常建议结合CP2K实现，详情见《使用Multiwfn结合CP2K通过NCI和IGM方法图形化考察固体和表面的弱相互作用》。对于Multiwfn不直接支持的程序，可以基于promolecular近似作RDG图，仅需坐标信息（.pdb、.xyz等格式），结果定性正确但不如基于波函数准确。

heading: Methods and constraints for plotting RDG maps of periodic systems
content: Starting from Multiwfn version 3.8, plotting RDG maps for periodic systems is supported, usually recommended in combination with CP2K; for details see 《使用Multiwfn结合CP2K通过NCI和IGM方法图形化考察固体和表面的弱相互作用》. For programs not directly supported by Multiwfn, RDG maps can be plotted based on the promolecular approximation, requiring only coordinate information (.pdb, .xyz, etc. formats); the results are qualitatively correct but less accurate than those based on wavefunctions.

heading: 处理大体系RDG等值面过多不便分析的方法
content: 处理大体系RDG等值面过多的方法包括：用Multiwfn主功能13处理RDG格点数据屏蔽不感兴趣的部分（见手册4.13.4节）；设置格点时让空间范围只涵盖感兴趣区域；借助第三方程序控制每个单独的等值面显示。更推荐改用IGMH方法直接指定考虑哪些部分间的相互作用，见《使用Multiwfn做IGMH分析非常清晰直观地展现化学体系中的相互作用》。
