file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/291_Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题_卡片.md
heading: Handling excessive RDG isosurfaces for large systems
content: Methods for handling excessive RDG isosurfaces in large systems include: using main function 13 of Multiwfn to process the RDG grid data and mask uninteresting parts (see Section 4.13.4 of the manual); setting the grid so that the spatial range only covers the region of interest; or using third-party programs to control the display of each individual isosurface. It is more recommended to switch to the IGMH method, where you can directly specify which parts' interactions to consider; see 《使用Multiwfn做IGMH分析非常清晰直观地展现化学体系中的相互作用》.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/291_Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题_卡片.md
heading: 区分散点图中不同spike对应的相互作用
content: 区分散点图spike对应相互作用的方法有：(1)用Multiwfn做AIM分析得到BCP的sign(lambda2)rho值并与散点图对照；(2)设定格点数据计算范围仅囊括某个弱相互作用区域；(3)在Multiwfn中选择"Set function2 value where the value of function1 is out of a certain range"屏蔽特定sign(lambda2)rho范围的格点，仅显示特定spike对应的等值面；(4)绘制带有填色效果的散点图对比等值面颜色（见）。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/291_Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题_卡片.md
heading: Distinguishing the interactions corresponding to different spikes in the scatter plot
content: Methods to distinguish the interactions corresponding to spikes in the scatter plot include: (1) perform AIM analysis with Multiwfn to obtain the sign(lambda2)rho values of BCPs and compare them with the scatter plot; (2) set the grid data calculation range to cover only a particular weak interaction region; (3) in Multiwfn, choose "Set function2 value where the value of function1 is out of a certain range" to mask grid points within a specific sign(lambda2)rho range, showing only the isosurface corresponding to a particular spike; (4) plot scatter plots with coloring effects to compare with the isosurface colors (see).

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/291_Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题_卡片.md
heading: 判断弱相互作用应优先查看RDG填色等值面图
content: 判断弱相互作用绝对不要光看散点图，应优先查看RDG填色等值面图，因为弱相互作用的位置和特征在等值面图上一目了然。散点图过于抽象，且仅当需要定量考察、对比时才应结合散点图一起看。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/291_Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题_卡片.md
heading: When judging weak interactions, prioritize examining the RDG colored isosurface plot
content: When judging weak interactions, never rely solely on the scatter plot; you should first examine the RDG colored isosurface plot, because the locations and characteristics of weak interactions are immediately clear on the isosurface plot. The scatter plot is too abstract, and it should only be examined together with the isosurface plot when quantitative examination or comparison is needed.

heading: 使用VMD以外的程序绘制RDG图的可行性
content: VMD作RDG填色等值面图效果最好且方便。Chemcraft也能作但效果难看；Jmol、Gabedit、AIMALL等开始支持但效果差、速度慢且功能不全。Multiwfn+VMD是RDG分析的黄金组合。此外，基于Multiwfn输出的格点文件用Pymol也可以绘制，着色效果更鲜亮。

heading: Feasibility of plotting RDG maps with programs other than VMD
content: VMD gives the best and most convenient results for plotting RDG colored isosurface plots. Chemcraft can also do it but the results are ugly; Jmol, Gabedit, AIMALL and others have begun to support it, but with poor results, slow speed, and incomplete functionality. file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/291_Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题_卡片.md
heading: RDG图中出现蓝内红外环状等值面的原因
content: 相互作用很强的两个原子间，中央部分电子密度可能超过默认阈值0.05 a.u.而被屏蔽，只剩外围一圈形成环状。settings.ini文件的默认设置RDG_maxrho=0.05旨在展现弱相互作用（低电子密度区域）。这种情况可视作较弱化学键，若想展现完整等值面可将RDG_maxrho设为0，但化学键区域会出现无意义的等值面。强烈建议使用IRI方法展现所有类型相互作用，见《使用IRI方法图形化考察化学体系中的化学键和弱相互作用》。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/291_Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题_卡片.md
heading: Reasons for blue inner and red outer ring-shaped isosurfaces in RDG maps
content: For two atoms with very strong interaction, the electron density in the central part may exceed the default threshold of 0.05 a.u. and be masked, leaving only an outer ring forming a ring shape. The default setting RDG_maxrho=0.05 in the settings.ini file is intended to reveal weak interactions (low electron density regions). This can be regarded as a relatively weak chemical bond; if you want to display the complete isosurface, you can set RDG_maxrho to 0, but meaningless isosurfaces will appear in the chemical bond region. It is strongly recommended to use the IRI method to visualize all types of interactions; see 《使用IRI方法图形化考察化学体系中的化学键和弱相互作用》.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/291_Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题_卡片.md
heading: 蓝色等值面外圈出现红色无化学意义的原因
content: 蓝色等值面外圈出现红色是由于投影函数sign(lambda2)rho自身的特征所致。在lambda2数值非常接近0的地方，轻微变化就会引起符号突变，导致颜色突变。这圈红色没有化学意义，无法解释，直接无视即可。若想避免，可加大RDG等值面数值使等值面收缩，避免涉及到sign(lambda2)rho为正的区域。

topic: Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题
fm_title: 用Multiwfn+VMD做RDG分析时的一些要点和常见问题

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/291_Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题_卡片.md
heading: Reasons for chemically meaningless red appearing at the outer edge of blue isosurfaces
content: The red appearing at the outer edge of blue isosurfaces is due to the intrinsic characteristics of the projection function sign(lambda2)rho. Where the value of lambda2 is very close to 0, slight variations cause abrupt sign changes, leading to abrupt color changes. This ring of red has no chemical meaning and cannot be interpreted; simply ignore it. To avoid it, you can increase the RDG isosurface value to shrink the isosurface, avoiding regions where sign(lambda2)rho is positive.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/291_Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题_卡片.md
heading: 弱相互作用区域未显示出来的原因及解决
content: 弱相互作用区域未显示可能是因为相互作用强度很强（如键能超过100 kJ/mol），区域电子密度超过默认RDG_maxrho=0.05而被屏蔽。此时应适当调大RDG_maxrho重新作图，或改用IRI方法。此外，使用RDG方法前必须优化结构，特别是晶体结构中的氢原子位置不准会导致电子密度被高估，从而无法显示等值面。

topic: Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/291_Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题_卡片.md
heading: Reasons for weak interaction regions not being displayed and solutions
content: Weak interaction regions not being displayed may be because the interaction strength is very strong (e.g., bond energy exceeding 100 kJ/mol), and the electron density in the region exceeds the default RDG_maxrho=0.05 and is masked. In this case, you should increase RDG_maxrho and replot, or switch to the IRI method. In addition, the structure must be optimized before using the RDG method; in particular, inaccurate hydrogen atom positions in a crystal structure can lead to overestimated electron density, so that no isosurface can be displayed.

heading: 关闭VMD的Depth cueing以提升白背景图像通透度
content: 默认情况下VMD开启Depth cueing会使距离观测者越远的部分被雾化得越重，在白背景下绘制RDG图会使图像变得朦胧。建议选择Display-Depth cueing将此设定关掉，图像会变得鲜艳、通透。注：目前最新版本的Multiwfn里自带的RDG作图脚本默认就是将Depth cueing关闭的。

heading: Turning off VMD's Depth cueing to improve image clarity on white background
content: By default, VMD enables Depth cueing, which causes parts farther from the observer to be fogged more heavily; when plotting RDG graphs on white background, the image becomes hazy. It is recommended to select Display-Depth cueing to turn this setting off, making the image vivid and transparent. Note: in the latest version of Multiwfn, the bundled RDG plotting script has Depth cueing disabled by default.

heading: RDG散点图spike上点比较散的原因
content: 散点图spike上的点比较散不体现化学意义，仅说明落在弱相互作用区域的格点比较少。原因可能是格点间距偏大或弱相互作用区域比较小。解决方法包括：在第三方程序里加大点的尺寸，或者在RDG分析前把弱相互作用区域的格点间距改小一些。格点设定知识见《Multiwfn FAQ》第3节。

heading: Reasons for scattered points on RDG scatter plot spikes
content: Scattered points on RDG scatter plot spikes carry no chemical meaning; it merely indicates that relatively few grid points fall in the weak interaction region. Possible reasons are that the grid spacing is too large or the weak interaction region is relatively small. Solutions include: increasing the point size in a third-party program, or reducing the grid spacing in the weak interaction region before performing RDG analysis. For knowledge about grid settings, see Section 3 of 《Multiwfn FAQ》.

heading: RDG等值面显示为灰色或黑色的排查方法
content: RDG等值面显示为灰色或黑色有三种可能：(1)VMD和显卡兼容性问题，尝试更新显卡驱动、换机子尝试或用Tachyon渲染器（纯软件渲染）；(2)cub文件太大而用了Windows 32bit版VMD导致内存不足，改用64bit版VMD；(3)cub文件有问题，检查文件名、目录、大小和内容是否正常。

heading: Troubleshooting RDG isosurfaces displayed in gray or black
content: There are three possibilities for RDG isosurfaces displayed in gray or black: (1) Compatibility issues between VMD and the graphics card; try updating the graphics card driver, trying a different machine, or using the Tachyon rendering (pure software rendering); (2) the cub file is too large and the Windows 32bit version of VMD is used, causing insufficient memory; switch to the 64bit version of VMD; (3) the cub file has problems; check whether the file name, directory, size, and content are normal.

heading: 开启VMD抗锯齿以消除等值面边缘锯齿
content: VMD显示的图形在白背景下边缘的锯齿看起来往往比较明显，建议开启抗锯齿。如果Display里能选Antialiasing，点它即可；如果是灰色的，可以在显卡驱动面板里强行开启抗锯齿，或者使用Tachyon渲染器渲染。此外，获得大尺寸图像后用PS等程序缩小也能等效实现抗锯齿效果。

heading: Enabling VMD anti-aliasing to remove jaggies at isosurface edges
content: Graphics displayed by VMD often show rather noticeable jaggies at edges against a white background; it is recommended to enable anti-aliasing. If Antialiasing is selectable under Display, just click it; if it is grayed out, you can force anti-aliasing in the graphics driver control panel, or use the Tachyon renderer for rendering. In addition, rendering a large image and then shrinking it with programs such as PS equivalently achieves an anti-aliasing effect.

heading: 调整VMD光源以照亮等值面暗处
content: 默认光源设定下，有些等值面可能看起来偏黑，不好看甚至影响对颜色的判断。此时可以选Display里面的Light 2或3开启没使用的光源，并使用Mouse - Move Light移动光源。注：目前最新版本的Multiwfn里自带的RDG作图脚本默认就是开启Light 3光源的。

heading: Adjusting VMD lights to illuminate dark areas of isosurfaces
content: With the default light settings, some isosurfaces may look dark, which is unattractive and may even interfere with judging colors. file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/291_Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题_卡片.md
heading: 使用Tachyon渲染器获得高分辨率RDG图像
content: 作RDG图推荐用VMD自带的Tachyon渲染器，选File-Render-Tachyon (internal, in-memory rendering)可直接调用Tachyon渲染当前窗口得到.tga文件。若想渲染出更大尺寸的图像，选择Tachyon并Start Rendering得到vmdscene.dat文件，然后建立.bat文件运行命令：`tachyon_WIN32.exe vmdscene.dat -aasamples 24 -mediumshade -trans_vmd -res 1024 768 -format BMP -o vmdscene.bmp`。其中-res控制分辨率，-aasamples越大锯齿越不明显，修改vmdscene.dat里的zoom可调节图像内体系的尺寸。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/291_Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题_卡片.md
heading: Using the Tachyon renderer to obtain high-resolution RDG images
content: For plotting RDG maps, it is recommended to use the Tachyon renderer bundled with VMD. Select File-Render-Tachyon (internal, in-memory rendering) to directly invoke Tachyon rendering of the current window and obtain a .tga file. If you want to render a larger image, select Tachyon and Start Rendering to obtain the vmdscene.dat file, then create a .bat file and run the command: `tachyon_WIN32.exe vmdscene.dat -aasamples 24 -mediumshade -trans_vmd -res 1024 768 -format BMP -o vmdscene.bmp`. Here -res controls the resolution, a larger -aasamples makes jaggies less noticeable, and modifying zoom in vmdscene.dat adjusts the size of the system within the image.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/291_Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题_卡片.md
heading: 通过调整格点间距解决RDG等值面锯齿和窟窿问题
content: 格点间距越小，等值面边缘越平滑，中间有窟窿的可能性越低。建议指定更高数目的格点或更小的格点间距，在RDG分析界面选择"4 Input the number of points or grid spacing in X,Y,Z, covering whole system"输入恰当的格点间距（如0.08 Bohr）。对于大体系，即便high quality grid对应的格点间距也可能偏大，此时自设格点间距尤为重要。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/291_Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题_卡片.md
heading: Resolving isosurface jaggies and holes in RDG by adjusting grid spacing
content: The smaller the grid spacing, the smoother the isosurface edges and the lower the likelihood of holes in the middle. It is recommended to specify a higher number of grid points or smaller grid spacing: in the RDG analysis interface, choose "4 Input the number of points or grid spacing in X,Y,Z, covering whole system" and enter an appropriate grid spacing (e.g., 0.08 Bohr). For large systems, even the grid spacing corresponding to the high quality grid may be too large, in which case setting the grid spacing yourself is especially important.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/291_Multiwfn结合VMD绘制RDG图的要点与常见问题_卡片.md
heading: RDG分析色彩刻度的合理设定范围
content: RDG的色彩刻度选择具有任意性，一般建议用-0.035~0.02，或者-0.03~0.02。下限越接近0，吸引作用区域越容易显蓝色；反之越容易显绿色。虽然-0.04~0.02很常用，但这样设定下一些偏弱的氢键区域就不怎么显蓝色了。

heading: Reasonable setting range for the color scale in RDG analysis
content: The choice of the color scale of RDG is arbitrary; generally -0.035~0.02 or -0.03~0.02 is recommended. The closer the lower bound is to 0, the more easily the attractive interaction regions appear blue; conversely, they tend to appear green. Although -0.04~0.02 is very commonly used, with this setting some weaker hydrogen bond regions no longer appear very blue.

heading: Calculating and displaying RDG isosurfaces of different regions of a system separately in VMD
content: During the calculation, compute the grid data only for different regions by appropriately setting the calculation range. heading: GaussView issue of internal coordinate variables displayed as numbers
content:
When GaussView saves a Gaussian input file, if the write cartesian option is deselected so as to save in internal coordinate format, the internal coordinate variables may be displayed directly as numbers rather than letter variables. This manifests as atomic connection lines directly listing specific bond length and bond angle values.
- The problem reflects the unfriendly design of the GaussView software, which has no direct option to control variables being represented by letters.

heading: GaussView内坐标字母变量的变通解决法
content:
解决GaussView内坐标变量显示数字的方法是先将体系保存为.mol等其他格式，随后重新载入该文件，再保存为Gaussian输入文件。重新载入后保存的文件内坐标将显示为字母变量。
- 操作步骤为先存为.mol格式，载入后再次保存，即可得到含字母变量（如B1、A1）的内坐标输入文件。

heading: Workaround for obtaining letter variables in GaussView internal coordinates
content:
The way to solve the GaussView issue of internal coordinate variables displayed as numbers is saving the system as .mol format or another format first, reloading that file, and then saving as a Gaussian input file. When saved after reloading, the internal coordinates in the file will be displayed as letter variables.
- The procedure is to first save as .mol format, then load it and save again, yielding an internal coordinate input file with letter variables (such as B1, A1).

heading: 非限制性开壳层计算中的轨道编号规则
content: 非限制性开壳层（U）计算中，指定轨道时beta占据轨道的序号排在alpha占据轨道后面。若有6个alpha占据轨道和4个beta占据轨道，输入1-10表示考虑所有10个占据轨道。若想考虑alpha后三个（编号4-6）和beta第2个，应写为4-6 8（即6+2）。包含超过占据轨道总数序号的空轨道不会影响结果。

heading: Orbital numbering rules in unrestricted open-shell calculations
content: In unrestricted open-shell (U) calculations, when specifying orbitals, the beta occupied orbitals are numbered after the alpha occupied orbitals. If there are 6 alpha occupied orbitals and 4 beta occupied orbitals, entering 1-10 means considering all 10 occupied orbitals. To consider the last three alpha orbitals (indices 4-6) and the 2nd beta orbital, write 4-6 8 (i.e. 6+2). Including virtual orbitals with indices exceeding the total number of occupied orbitals does not affect the result.

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: Gaussian计算中利用对称性的优势
content: Gaussian默认启用对称性以避免计算重复的电子积分，从而显著节约计算时间并降低内存/硬盘占用，且对称性越高加速越明显。启动对称性还能显示轨道、电子态、振动模式的不可约表示，并确保不同不可约表示的分子轨道在SCF过程中不混合。例如使用XEON E5-2650v2 16核+G09 D.01在CCSD(T)/def2-TZVP级别下计算面对面构型的苯二聚体，D6h点群下计算需1.5小时，而不启用对称性需2.5天。

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: Advantages of exploiting symmetry in Gaussian calculations
content: Symmetry is enabled by default in Gaussian to avoid redundant electron integral calculations, thereby significantly saving computation time and reducing memory/disk usage; the higher the symmetry, the greater the computational acceleration. Enabling symmetry also displays the irreducible representations of orbitals, electronic states, and vibrational modes, and ensures that molecular orbitals of different irreducible representations do not mix during the SCF process. For example, using a XEON E5-2650v2 16-core CPU with G09 D.01 at the CCSD(T)/def2-TZVP level to calculate a face-to-face benzene dimer, the calculation in the D6h point group took 1.5 hours, whereas without symmetry it took 2.5 days.

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: 优化中出现对称性降低的排查步骤
content: 如果在优化中出现不希望的对称性降低，首先可尝试去掉弥散函数重新优化；对于DFT计算，可以提升积分格点精度（G09加int=ultrafine，G16加int=superfine）。若问题依旧，可更换其它泛函或尝试不依赖积分格点的MP2、CCSD方法。如果对称性仍下降，极大可能是高对称性结构确实不稳定，低对称性结构才是真正的极小点。
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: Troubleshooting unwanted symmetry reduction during optimization
content: If unwanted symmetry breaking during optimization occurs, first try reoptimization without diffuse functions; for DFT calculations, the integration grid accuracy can be increased (int=ultrafine for G09, int=superfine for G16). If the problem persists, switch to other functionals or try MP2 or CCSD methods that do not depend on the integration grid. If the symmetry still drops, it is very likely that the high-symmetry structure is indeed unstable and the low-symmetry structure is the true minimum.
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: 几何优化中允许对称性破坏的方法
content: 若允许优化过程中对称性发生变化以寻找实际极小点，可人为破坏初始结构的对称性，如稍微扭曲一个二面角或对所有原子进行随机位移。如果优化后结构自发变得有对称性，说明极小点确实具有对称性，建议对称化后重新优化以提高精度并获得不可约表示。若优化后有对称性且存在导致对称性破坏的虚频，可按虚频模式调节结构继续优化。
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: Methods for allowing symmetry breaking in geometry optimization
content: If symmetry changes are allowed during optimization to find the actual minimum, you can deliberately break the symmetry of the initial structure, e.g. slightly twist a dihedral angle or apply random displacements to all atoms. If the optimized structure spontaneously becomes symmetric, the minimum does have symmetry; it is recommended to symmetrize it and reoptimize for higher accuracy and to obtain irreducible representations. If the optimized structure has symmetry but has an imaginary frequency causing symmetry breaking, you can displace the structure along the imaginary frequency mode and continue optimizing.
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: symm=loose和symm=veryloose的用途
content: Gaussian默认的点群判断标准较严，坐标稍有偏离就无法识别，symm=loose或symm=veryloose关键词用于使用更宽松的判断标准。例如在GaussView中对称化后的C60分子被识别为Ih点群，但直接输入Gaussian可能因坐标精度有限被判断为C1，此时使用symm=loose可使其被正确识别为Ih，从而大幅提升计算速度。
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: Purpose of symm=loose and symm=veryloose
content: Gaussian's default point group detection criteria are strict, and slight coordinate deviations prevent recognition. The symm=loose or symm=veryloose keywords use looser detection criteria. For example, a C60 molecule symmetrized in GaussView is recognized as the Ih point group, but when entered directly into Gaussian it may be judged as C1 due to limited coordinate precision; in this case symm=loose allows it to be correctly recognized as Ih, greatly improving computational speed.
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: ORCA程序与nosymm关键词的对比
content: ORCA程序不会利用对称性加速计算，也不会像Gaussian那样将体系调整到标准朝向，因此没有类似nosymm的关键词。PSI4程序会自动调整体系到标准朝向，若想实现nosymm效果，需在输入块中添加nocom（禁止平移）和noreorient（禁止旋转）命令。
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: Comparison of the ORCA program with the nosymm keyword
content: The ORCA program does not exploit symmetry for computational acceleration, nor does it adjust the system to the standard orientation as Gaussian does, so it has no keyword analogous to nosymm. The PSI4 program automatically adjusts the system to the standard orientation; to achieve the effect of nosymm, you need to add nocom (no translation) and noreorient (no rotation) commands in the input block.
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: 输入朝向与标准朝向
content: Gaussian会将输入文件中的坐标（输入朝向）调整为标准朝向，即将原子核电荷中心置于笛卡尔坐标原点并按特定规则旋转，然后再进行点群判断及后续计算。即便体系没有对称性（C1点群），Gaussian也会照样对体系进行平移和旋转以符合标准朝向。
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: Input orientation and standard orientation
content: Gaussian adjusts the coordinates in the input file (input orientation) to the standard orientation, i.e. placing the center of nuclear charge at the origin of the Cartesian coordinates and rotating according to specific rules, before performing point group detection and subsequent calculations. Even if the system has no symmetry (C1 point group), Gaussian still translates and rotates the system to conform to the standard orientation.
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: 标准朝向带来的坐标系不对应问题
content: 将体系调整到标准朝向会导致实际计算坐标与输入文件不一致，这对于需要特定坐标系相对位置的任务会产生问题。例如：使用field关键词沿键轴加外电场时，体系被旋转会导致外场方向错误；在Multiwfn中进行二聚体与单体密度差图、CDA分析、ETS-NOCV分析时，若整体与片段坐标不对应，分析结果将毫无意义。
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: Coordinate frame correspondence problems caused by the standard orientation
content: Adjusting the system to the standard orientation means the actual calculation coordinates differ from the input file, which causes problems for tasks requiring specific relative positions of coordinate systems. For example: when applying an external electric field along a bond axis with the field keyword, rotation of the system makes the external field direction wrong; in Multiwfn, when performing density difference maps of a dimer and monomers, CDA analysis, or ETS-NOCV analysis, if the coordinates of the whole and the fragments do not correspond, the analysis results are meaningless.
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: nosymm关键词防止坐标系调整
content: nosymm关键词的作用是让Gaussian在计算中完全不利用对称性，从而不再试图判断点群或将体系调整到标准朝向。使用nosymm可确保实际计算过程中的坐标与输入文件完全一致，避免因坐标系自动调整导致外电场方向错误或后续分析（如密度差图、CDA、ETS-NOCV）中坐标不对应的问题。
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: The nosymm keyword preventing coordinate frame adjustment
content: The role of the nosymm keyword is to make Gaussian completely avoid exploiting symmetry during the calculation, so it no longer attempts to detect the point group or adjust the system to the standard orientation. Using nosymm ensures the coordinates during the actual calculation are fully consistent with the input file, avoiding an incorrect external electric field direction or coordinate correspondence problems in subsequent analyses (such as density difference maps, CDA analysis, ETS-NOCV analysis) caused by automatic coordinate frame adjustment.
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: nosymm解决几何优化轨迹跳变
content: 在几何优化或柔性扫描中，Gaussian默认将每一步坐标调整为标准朝向，导致笛卡尔坐标变化不连续，在GaussView中观看轨迹时体系朝向会发生剧烈跳变。解决方法之一是使用nosymm，这样每一步结构只输出Input orientation坐标，轨迹看起来就是连续的。
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: Using nosymm to solve geometry optimization trajectory jumps
content: In geometry optimization or a relaxed scan, Gaussian adjusts the coordinates to the standard orientation at every step by default, causing discontinuous changes in Cartesian coordinates and severe orientation jumps when viewing the trajectory in GaussView. One solution is to use nosymm, so that each step's structure only outputs the Input orientation coordinates and the trajectory appears continuous.
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: nosymm用于对称破缺计算
content: 进行对称破缺计算时，如果体系本身具有对称性，加上nosymm往往才能得到对称破缺态。例如将乙烯扭转90度破坏pi键形成双自由基状态，直接用UB3LYP/6-31G* guess=mix可能因波函数对称性约束得到闭壳层波函数，而加上nosymm则可以得到双自由基状态。
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: nosymm for symmetry-broken calculations
content: When performing a symmetry-broken calculation, if the system itself has symmetry, adding nosymm is often necessary to obtain a symmetry-broken state. For example, twisting ethylene by 90 degrees to break the pi bond and form a diradical state: directly using UB3LYP/6-31G* guess=mix may yield a closed-shell wavefunction due to wavefunction symmetry constraints, whereas adding nosymm can give the diradical state.
topic: Exploiting symmetry in Gaussian and the nosymm keyword
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: nosymm的适用范围与禁用建议
content: nosymm仅适用于防止坐标系调整、解决轨迹跳变和进行对称破缺计算这三种情况，若不属于这三种情况则不应使用。对于有对称性的体系滥用nosymm会导致无法利用对称性加速计算、无法显示不可约表示，从而白白浪费大量计算时间。
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: Scope of applicability of nosymm and recommendation against its misuse
content: nosymm is only applicable in three situations: preventing coordinate-system reorientation, resolving trajectory jumps, and performing symmetry-broken calculations; outside these three cases it should not be used. For systems with symmetry, abuse of nosymm leads to the inability to exploit symmetry to accelerate calculations and the inability to display irreducible representations, thus wasting a large amount of computational time for nothing.
topic: Exploiting symmetry in Gaussian and the nosymm keyword
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: 几何优化中对称性的自然变化
content: 在默认利用对称性时，即便初始判断为高对称性，优化过程中对称性也可能因能量更低或数值问题（如使用弥散函数、DFT格点积分精度不够）而降低甚至消失。在使用nosymm禁止使用对称性时，高对称性结构也可能因受力对称（如D3h的NH3）而继续保持，因此对称性是否改变与是否使用nosymm无必然联系。
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: Natural symmetry change during geometry optimization
content: When symmetry is exploited by default, even if the initial structure is judged to have high symmetry, during optimization the symmetry may decrease or even disappear due to lower energy or numerical issues (such as using diffuse functions or insufficient accuracy of DFT grid integration). When nosymm is used to disable symmetry, a high-symmetry structure may still be maintained because the forces are symmetric (e.g., NH3 with D3h symmetry). Therefore, whether symmetry changes has no necessary connection with whether nosymm is used.
topic: Exploiting symmetry in Gaussian and the nosymm keyword
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: 几何优化中严格维持对称性的方法
content: 若想在几何优化过程中100%保证对称性不发生改变，必须使用内坐标描述结构，根据对称性使等价坐标共享相同变量，并使用opt=z-matrix在内坐标下优化。虽然Gaussian有IOp(2/16=2)试图在优化中沿用旧对称性，但实际发现往往不奏效。
topic: Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

file: 07-Gaussian使用/297_Gaussian对称性利用与nosymm关键词_卡片.md
heading: Methods for strictly maintaining symmetry during geometry optimization
content: If you want a 100% guarantee of unchanged symmetry during geometry optimization, you must describe the structure using internal coordinates, make equivalent coordinates share the same variables according to symmetry, and optimize in internal coordinates using opt=z-matrix. Although Gaussian provides IOp(2/16=2), which attempts keeping old symmetry during optimization, in practice it is often found to be ineffective.
topic: Exploiting symmetry in Gaussian and the nosymm keyword
fm_title: 谈谈Gaussian中的对称性与nosymm关键词的使用

heading: 平面法向量计算原理
content: 程序通过输入平面上的三个点坐标，计算向量v1=(x2-x1, y2-y1, z2-z1)和v2=(x3-x1, y3-y1, z3-z1)，利用行列式求解向量积得到法向量(A,B,C)，其中A=v1y*v2z-v1z*v2y，B=-(v1x*v2z-v1z*v2x)，C=v1x*v2y-v1y*v2x。

heading: Principle of plane normal vector calculation

通过在原子空间内对$-Z \cdot \rho^{(3)}_{zzzz}$的格点数据进行积分，可以得到各原子对超极化率的定量贡献。操作步骤为：将settings.ini的iuserfunc设为-1，载入格点文件，选择模糊空间分析并在原子空间内对第100号函数（用户自定义函数）进行积分。
- 示例中O、H原子的贡献远大于C原子，且所有原子加和值（1425.02 a.u.）与立方格点积分值（1429.51 a.u.）基本一致。

heading: Quantitative analysis of atomic contribution to hyperpolarizability
content:
By performing grid integration of $-Z \cdot \rho^{(3)}_{zzzz}$ within atomic spaces, the quantitative contribution of each atom to the hyperpolarizability can be obtained. The procedure is: set iuserfunc in settings.ini to -1, load the grid file, select fuzzy space analysis and integrate function 100 (user-defined function) within atomic spaces.
- In the example, the contributions of the O and H atoms are far larger than that of the C atom, and the sum over all atoms (1425.02 a.u.) is basically consistent with the cubic grid integration value (1429.51 a.u.).

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/305_Multiwfn计算绘制超极化率密度_卡片.md
heading: 偶极矩与电子密度的泰勒展开关系
content:
将体系偶极矩向外电场进行Taylor展开，并与电子密度的Taylor展开式对比，可知各阶(超)极化率与电子密度的各阶响应函数$\rho^{(n)}$相对应。通过$\rho^{(n)}$可以考察体系不同区域对(超)极化率数值的贡献，这种密度被称为(超)极化率密度。
- $\rho^{(0)}$对应无外场时的电子密度分布。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/305_Multiwfn计算绘制超极化率密度_卡片.md
heading: Taylor expansion relationship between dipole moment and electron density
content:
Expanding the dipole moment of the system in a Taylor series with respect to the external electric field, and comparing with the Taylor expansion of the electron density, each order of (hyper)polarizability corresponds to the corresponding-order response function of the electron density, $\rho^{(n)}$. Through $\rho^{(n)}$, the contributions of different regions of the system to (hyper)polarizability values can be examined; this density is called the (hyper)polarizability density.
- $\rho^{(0)}$ corresponds to the electron density distribution in the absence of an external field.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/305_Multiwfn计算绘制超极化率密度_卡片.md
heading: 第二超极化率密度$\rho^{(3)}_{zzzz}$的计算公式
content:
第二超极化率密度$\rho^{(3)}_{zzzz}$是考察体系不同区域对$\gamma_{zzzz}$贡献的三阶张量函数，其计算需使用有限差分法。具体的计算公式为：$\rho^{(3)}_{zzzz} = [\rho(2F_z) - 2\rho(F_z) + 2\rho(-F_z) - \rho(-2F_z)] / [2(F_z)^3]$。
- 式中的$F_z$代表在z方向外加微量电场（差分步长），根据测试用0.003 a.u.左右比较不错。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/305_Multiwfn计算绘制超极化率密度_卡片.md
heading: Calculation formula for second hyperpolarizability density $\rho^{(3)}_{zzzz}$
content:
The second hyperpolarizability density $\rho^{(3)}_{zzzz}$ is a third-order tensor function for examining the contributions of different regions of the system to $\gamma_{zzzz}$, and its calculation requires the finite difference method. The specific calculation formula is: $\rho^{(3)}_{zzzz} = [\rho(2F_z) - 2\rho(F_z) + 2\rho(-F_z) - \rho(-2F_z)] / [2(F_z)^3]$.
- $F_z$ in the formula represents a small external electric field applied along the z direction (the difference step size); according to tests, a value of about 0.003 a.u. is quite good.

heading: Generating wavefunction files under different external fields for calculation
content:
Calculating $\rho^{(3)}_{zzzz}$ requires four wavefunction files under different external electric fields, corresponding to the external fields -2Fz, -Fz, Fz, 2Fz. content:

heading: Steps for calculating $\rho^{(3)}_{zzzz}$ using Multiwfn custom operations
content:
After starting Multiwfn, use the real space function custom operation feature to perform addition and subtraction operations on the five wavefunction files according to the formula's numerator definition, and finally divide by the denominator $2(F_z)^3$ to obtain the grid data of $\rho^{(3)}_{zzzz}$. The operation path is main function 5 -> subfunction 0 -> define operations on 5 files -> select electron density -> select medium-quality grid points.

heading: $-Z \cdot \rho^{(3)}_{zzzz}$图的意义与绘制方法
content:
将$\rho^{(3)}_{zzzz}$乘以-Z并绘图可以更直观地看到不同位置对$\gamma_{zzzz}$的贡献，因为该函数的全空间积分直接等于$\gamma_{zzzz}$。在Multiwfn中可通过主功能13（处理格点数据）的子功能11和20来实现乘以坐标变量Z和常数-1的操作。
- 绿色等值面越大的区域对$\gamma_{zzzz}$的正贡献越大，蓝色等值面越大的区域负贡献越大。

heading: Significance and plotting method of the $-Z \cdot \rho^{(3)}_{zzzz}$ map
content:
Multiplying $\rho^{(3)}_{zzzz}$ by -Z and plotting makes it more intuitive to see the contributions of different positions to $\gamma_{zzzz}$, because the full-space integration of this function directly equals $\gamma_{zzzz}$. In Multiwfn, this can be done via subfunctions 11 and 20 of main function 13 (processing grid data) to multiply by the coordinate variable Z and the constant -1.
- The larger the green isosurface region, the greater its positive contribution to $\gamma_{zzzz}$; the larger the blue isosurface region, the greater its negative contribution.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/305_Multiwfn计算绘制超极化率密度_卡片.md
heading: 弥散函数对超极化率计算的重要性
content:
计算超极化率$\gamma$必须使用包含充足弥散函数的基组，否则会严重低估$\gamma$值甚至导致符号错误。示例中甲醛在cc-pVDZ下结果仅为26.4 a.u.，在6-31G*下为-108.85 a.u.，而加入弥散函数的6-31++G*下结果变为726.27 a.u.。
- 这是因为没有弥散函数无法合理描述分子边缘弥散程度较高且对$\gamma_{zzzz}$有较大正贡献的绿色区域。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/305_Multiwfn计算绘制超极化率密度_卡片.md
heading: Importance of diffuse functions for hyperpolarizability calculation
content:
Calculating the hyperpolarizability $\gamma$ requires a basis set with sufficient diffuse functions; otherwise the $\gamma$ value will be severely underestimated, or even the sign will be wrong. In the example, the result for formaldehyde is only 26.4 a.u. with cc-pVDZ, -108.85 a.u. with 6-31G*, while with 6-31++G* that includes diffuse functions, the result becomes 726.27 a.u.
- This is because without diffuse functions, the green region at the molecular edge, which is rather diffuse and makes a large positive contribution to $\gamma_{zzzz}$, cannot be reasonably described.

heading: $\gamma_{zzzz}$数值积分验证方法
content:

heading: Numerical integration verification method for $\gamma_{zzzz}$
content:
In Multiwfn, by performing full-space integration on the grid data of $-Z \cdot \rho^{(3)}_{zzzz}$, you can verify whether the result is consistent with the $\gamma_{zzzz}$ computed by derivative method. Entering the grid data statistics option allows you to view the integration value.

heading: Basis Set Exchange (BSE) basis set database
content:
Reference: J. Chem. Inf. Model., 47, 1045-1052 (2007)
The most important basis set + pseudopotential database, established by the Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL); it has incorporated the vast majority of published basis sets and pseudopotentials, and supports multiple program output formats. Possible errors may exist in rare basis set definitions for a few elements, so if strange results are obtained, one should check whether the copied basis set definitions are reasonable. Enabling the Optimized General Contractions option reduces the number of GTF shells displayed for Dunning correlation-consistent basis sets, because shells with linear dependencies are removed (see CPL,260,513).

heading: Generating random spherical points via coordinate axis rotation
content: The algorithm generates spherical points by choosing the starting point (1,0,0) and successively rotating by random angles from $0$ to $2\pi$ around the X, Y, and Z axes. heading: 基于经纬度的球面点分布算法及缺陷
content: 算法通过随机生成极角$\theta=\pi \cdot \text{rotval}$和方位角$\phi=2\pi \cdot \text{rotval}$，利用公式$x=\sin(\theta)\cos(\phi)$、$y=\sin(\theta)\sin(\phi)$、$z=\cos(\theta)$计算坐标。该方法存在严重缺陷，会导致生成的点在球的两极严重聚集，无法得到均匀分布。

heading: Spherical point distribution algorithm based on latitude and longitude and its defects
content: The algorithm randomly generates the polar angle $\theta=\pi \cdot \text{rotval}$ and azimuthal angle $\phi=2\pi \cdot \text{rotval}$, and computes the coordinates via the formulas $x=\sin(\theta)\cos(\phi)$, $y=\sin(\theta)\sin(\phi)$, $z=\cos(\theta)$. This method has a serious defect: it causes severe point clustering at the sphere poles, and a uniform distribution cannot be obtained.

file: 10-化学信息学与脚本/311_球面上随机均匀分布点算法_卡片.md
heading: Marsaglia球面点均匀分布算法
content: Marsaglia方法是在(-1,1)区间内随机取两个值$x1$和$x2$，若$x1^2+x2^2 \ge 1$则重新选取，直到满足条件。球面坐标计算公式为$x=2 \cdot x1 \cdot \sqrt{1-x1^2-x2^2}$、$y=2 \cdot x2 \cdot \sqrt{1-x1^2-x2^2}$、$z=1-2 \cdot (x1^2+x2^2)$。该方法简单实用，生成的点在球面上分布非常均匀。

file: 10-化学信息学与脚本/311_球面上随机均匀分布点算法_卡片.md
heading: Marsaglia algorithm for uniform spherical point distribution
content: The Marsaglia method randomly draws two values $x1$ and $x2$ in the interval (-1,1); if $x1^2+x2^2 \ge 1$, redraw until the condition is satisfied. The spherical coordinates are computed as $x=2 \cdot x1 \cdot \sqrt{1-x1^2-x2^2}$, $y=2 \cdot x2 \cdot \sqrt{1-x1^2-x2^2}$, $z=1-2 \cdot (x1^2+x2^2)$. This method is simple and practical, and the generated points are very uniformly distributed on the sphere.

file: 10-化学信息学与脚本/311_球面上随机均匀分布点算法_卡片.md
heading: Marsaglia算法的Fortran实现
content: Fortran代码实现Marsaglia算法时，通过`do while`循环调用`RANDOM_NUMBER`生成随机数，利用`x=2*(x-0.5D0)`将区间转换到(-1,1)。进入循环条件判断`if (x1**2+x2**2<1) exit`，满足条件后使用`dsqrt`计算开方并代入最终公式得到$x$、$y$、$z$坐标。

file: 10-化学信息学与脚本/311_球面上随机均匀分布点算法_卡片.md
heading: Fortran implementation of the Marsaglia algorithm
content: When implementing the Marsaglia algorithm in Fortran code, a `do while` loop calls `RANDOM_NUMBER` to generate random numbers, and `x=2*(x-0.5D0)` converts the interval to (-1,1). The loop exit condition is `if (x1**2+x2**2<1) exit`; after the condition is met, `dsqrt` is used to compute square roots, and the values are substituted into the final formulas to obtain the $x$, $y$, $z$ coordinates.

heading: TDDFT方法概述与适用性
content: 含时密度泛函理论（TDDFT）是当下最主流的电子激发问题的计算方法，达到了精度与效率的较好平衡点。TDDFT计算精度严重依赖于泛函，必须根据体系特征、激发类型选择合适的泛函，而基组选择若泛函得当，大体系用6-31G*即可定性正确，想改进定量精度建议用def-TZVP（Gaussian里直接写为TZVP）。若计算里德堡激发，则必须有弥散函数，至少aug-cc-pVDZ。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: Overview of the TDDFT method and its applicability
content: Time-dependent density functional theory (TDDFT) is currently the most mainstream computational method for electron excitation problems, achieving a good balance between accuracy and efficiency. The accuracy of a TDDFT calculation depends heavily on the functional; an appropriate functional must be chosen according to the characteristics of the system and the type of excitation. As for basis set selection, if the functional is well chosen, 6-31G* is qualitatively correct even for large systems; to improve quantitative accuracy, def-TZVP is recommended (written directly as TZVP in Gaussian). For Rydberg excitations, diffuse functions are mandatory, at least aug-cc-pVDZ.

heading: Notes on TDDFT frequency calculations, transition states, and IRC calculations
content: Gaussian09 does not support the TDDFT analytical Hessian, making vibrational analysis extremely time-consuming; using CIS instead is recommended. For transition state search, opt=(TS,modRedundant,noeigen) or opt=(TS,gediis,noeigen) is recommended; for IRC calculation, IRC(gradientonly,euler) is recommended to avoid expensive Hessian calculations. Gaussian16 already supports the TDDFT analytical Hessian, so frequency, transition state, and IRC calculations can be performed directly just as for the ground state.

heading: Output of excited-state wavefunctions and densities
content: By default, a TDDFT calculation produces the ground-state density; if the density keyword is added, the excited-state density of the root specified by root is produced, in which case multipole moments, NBO analysis, etc. are computed for that excited state. Note that the chk file still records the ground-state DFT orbitals; transferring excited-state natural orbitals requires additional operations, or they can be generated directly with Multiwfn from the excited-state density matrix in the fch file.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: T1态几何优化的推荐方法
content: 优化T1推荐使用UDFT（自旋多重度设3，不写TD关键词，如# PBE1PBE/6-31G* opt 0 3），因耗时仅比基态优化略增。若用TD(triplet)优化（0 1），计算量增加约一个数量级，且不要写成0 3结合TD(triplet)。UDFT只能优化T1，而TDDFT可优化任意三重态并提供轨道跃迁信息。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: Recommended method for T1 state geometry optimization
content: For optimizing the T1 state, UDFT is recommended (spin multiplicity set to 3, without the TD keyword, e.g., # PBE1PBE/6-31G* opt 0 3), since the cost is only slightly higher than a ground-state geometry optimization. If TD(triplet) optimization is used (0 1), the computational cost increases by about an order of magnitude, and do not write 0 3 combined with TD(triplet). UDFT can only optimize the T1 state, whereas TDDFT can optimize any triplet state and provides orbital transition information.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: Gaussian中线性响应(LR)与态特定(SS)溶剂模型的使用
content: 使用SCRF=solvent=xxx即调用PCM模型，默认为线性响应(LR)，耗时少且有解析梯度适合优化。使用态特定(SS)需在SCRF中写ExternalIteration，虽更准但极耗时且无解析梯度。考虑非平衡溶剂(neq)效应时，LR下垂直跃迁自动处理，SS下需通过SCRF里的read关键词配合noneq=write/read在输入文件末尾额外设定。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: Use of the linear response (LR) and state-specific (SS) solvation models in Gaussian
content: Using SCRF=solvent=xxx invokes the PCM model, which defaults to linear response (LR); it is less time-consuming and has an analytical gradient, making it suitable for geometry optimization. Using state-specific (SS) requires writing ExternalIteration in SCRF; although more accurate, it is extremely time-consuming and has no analytical gradient. When considering non-equilibrium solvation (neq) effects, vertical transitions are handled automatically under LR, whereas under SS, additional settings must be made at the end of the input file via the read keyword in SCRF combined with noneq=write/read.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: 气相下计算垂直激发能与绘制光谱的步骤
content: 先优化基态几何（# PBE1PBE/6-31G* opt），再在基态结构下计算垂直激发能（# PBE1PBE/TZVP TD(nstates=5)）。输出文件包含各激发态的激发能、振子强度、跃迁偶极矩等信息。利用输出文件通过Multiwfn或GaussView可绘制UV-Vis和ECD光谱，建议nstates设为所需态数的两倍以保证高态准确性。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: Steps for calculating vertical excitation energies and plotting spectra in the gas phase
content: First optimize the ground-state geometry (# PBE1PBE/6-31G* opt), then calculate vertical excitation energies at the ground-state structure (# PBE1PBE/TZVP TD(nstates=5)). The output file contains the excitation energy, oscillator strength, transition dipole moment, etc., of each excited state. The output file can be used with Multiwfn or GaussView to plot UV-Vis and ECD spectra; it is recommended to set nstates to twice the number of states needed to ensure accuracy for high-lying states.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: 气相下计算S1结构和荧光发射能的步骤
content: 先基态优化，再用# PBE1PBE/6-311g(d) TD opt优化S1结构（TD默认root=1）。最后输出的S0->S1激发能即为荧光发射能。利用输出文件绘图时需只保留S1态信息，用Multiwfn可将其他态振子强度设为0。若要优化Sn，需设nstates=n+3并指定root=n。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: Steps for calculating the S1 structure and fluorescence emission energy in the gas phase
content: First perform a ground-state geometry optimization, then optimize the S1 structure using # PBE1PBE/6-311g(d) TD opt (TD defaults to root=1). The S0->S1 excitation energy printed at the end of the output is the fluorescence emission energy. When plotting from the output file, keep only the S1 state information; with Multiwfn you can set the oscillator strengths of other states to 0. To optimize Sn, set nstates=n+3 and specify root=n.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: 气相下计算T1结构和磷光发射能的两种方法
content: 方法一：用UDFT优化T1（0 3 # B3LYP/6-31G* opt），再用TDDFT计算发射能（0 1 # B3LYP/6-31G* TD(triplet)）。方法二：用UDFT优化T1得其能量，再算T1结构下的单点能（0 1），两者之差为发射能。方法二考虑轨道弛豫更精确且耗时短，但无轨道跃迁信息。由于Gaussian不支持TDDFT旋轨耦合，磷光振子强度为0，需用ORCA或Dalton等程序计算。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: Two methods for calculating the T1 structure and phosphorescence emission energy in the gas phase
content: Method one: optimize T1 with UDFT (0 3 # B3LYP/6-31G* opt), then calculate the emission energy with TDDFT (0 1 # B3LYP/6-31G* TD(triplet)). Method two: optimize T1 with UDFT to obtain its energy, then calculate the single-point energy at the T1 structure (0 1); the difference between the two is the emission energy. Method two accounts for orbital relaxation, is more accurate and faster, but provides no orbital transition information. Since Gaussian lacks TDDFT spin-orbit coupling, phosphorescence oscillator strengths are zero; programs such as ORCA or Dalton must be used instead.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: 基于线性响应(LR)溶剂模型的TDDFT计算步骤
content: 在气相计算关键词基础上加入scrf=solvent=xxx即可。步骤包括：溶剂下基态几何优化、计算激发能（如TD(nstates=20)）、溶剂下S1结构优化（TD scrf=... opt），发射能直接取S1优化最后一步的S0->S1激发能。若取S1结构单独算发射能，需在TD里加Eqsolv使激发态处于平衡溶剂。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: TDDFT calculation procedure based on the linear response (LR) solvation model
content: Simply add scrf=solvent=xxx to the gas-phase calculation keywords. Steps include: ground-state geometry optimization in solvent, calculation of excitation energies (e.g., TD(nstates=20)), excited-state (S1) geometry optimization in solvent (TD scrf=... opt); the emission energy is taken directly as the S0->S1 excitation energy from the final step of the S1 optimization. If calculating the emission energy separately at the S1 structure, add Eqsolv in TD so that the excited state is in equilibrium solvation.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: 基于态特定(SS)溶剂模型的TDDFT计算步骤
content: (1)溶剂下基态优化（同LR）。(2)计算吸收能：先基态单点写溶剂信息（scrf(read,...) noneq=write），再激发态单点读溶剂信息（TD scrf(externaliteration,read,...) noneq=read），能量差为激发能。(3)激发态优化仍用LR。(4)计算发射能：先激发态单点写溶剂信息，再基态单点读溶剂信息，能量差为发射能。此法比LR繁琐且慢得多。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: TDDFT calculation procedure based on the state-specific (SS) solvation model
content: (1) Ground-state optimization in solvent (same as LR). (2) Calculating the absorption energy: first run a ground-state single-point calculation writing the solvation information (scrf(read,...) noneq=write), then an excited-state single-point calculation reading the solvation information (TD scrf(externaliteration,read,...) noneq=read); the energy difference is the excitation energy. (3) Excited-state optimization still uses LR. (4) Calculating the emission energy: first run an excited-state single-point calculation writing the solvation information, then a ground-state single-point calculation reading the solvation information; the energy difference is the emission energy. This approach is more cumbersome and much slower than LR.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: 优化激发态时需注意破坏对称性
content: 激发态和基态对称性往往不同，若直接用基态结构作为初始结构优化激发态，可能得到保持基态对称性的错误结构（含虚频）。建议在优化激发态前先人为扭曲基态结构（如扭动二面角）以破坏对称性。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: Symmetry must be broken when optimizing excited states
content: The symmetry of an excited state often differs from that of the ground state. If the ground-state structure is used directly as the initial structure for excited-state optimization, an incorrect structure retaining the ground-state symmetry (with imaginary frequencies) may be obtained. It is recommended to artificially distort the ground-state structure before excited-state optimization (e.g., by twisting dihedrals) to break the symmetry.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: 垂直吸收、垂直发射与绝热跃迁的计算步骤
content: 垂直吸收计算包含基态几何优化和在基态结构下计算激发能两步，垂直发射计算包含激发态几何优化和在激发态结构下计算激发能两步，绝热吸收计算包含基态几何优化、激发态几何优化以及将两个极小点能量求差值三步。实际吸收、发射光谱的最大峰位置一般分别比较接近于垂直吸收能和垂直发射能，而0-0跃迁能比较接近于绝热激发能。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: Calculation steps for vertical absorption, vertical emission, and adiabatic transitions
content: The vertical absorption calculation consists of two steps: ground-state geometry optimization and calculation of excitation energies at the ground-state structure. The vertical emission calculation consists of two steps: excited-state geometry optimization and calculation of excitation energies at the excited-state structure. The adiabatic absorption calculation consists of three steps: ground-state geometry optimization, excited-state geometry optimization, and taking the energy difference between the two minima. In practice, the peak maxima of absorption and emission spectra are generally close to the vertical absorption energy and the vertical emission energy, respectively, while the 0-0 transition energy is close to the adiabatic excitation energy.

heading: 构象搜索与光谱权重平均
content: 柔性分子不同构象光谱差异可能明显，若用非最低能构象计算可能与实验不符。推荐使用Molclus进行构象搜索。若多构象能量相近且能转化，必须按Boltzmann分布计算权重并绘制权重平均光谱。

heading: Conformational search and Boltzmann-weighted averaging of spectra
content: The spectra of different conformations of a flexible molecule may differ significantly; using a non-lowest-energy conformation may give results inconsistent with experiment. Molclus is recommended for conformational search. If multiple conformations have similar energies and can interconvert, Boltzmann-weighted averaging and plotting of spectra is required.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: 激发能为负值的处理
content: 激发能为负值说明SCF参考波函数不是真正的基态波函数。解决方法：先检查自旋多重度设定是否正确；若无误，做一次stable=opt单点计算让Gaussian找出真正基态波函数，之后在激发态计算时用guess=read读取。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: Handling negative excitation energies
content: A negative excitation energy indicates that the SCF reference wavefunction is not the true ground-state wavefunction. Solutions: first check whether the spin multiplicity is set correctly; if it is, run a stable=opt single-point calculation to let Gaussian find the true ground-state wavefunction, and then use guess=read to read it in subsequent excited-state calculations.

heading: 电子激发特征分析工具

heading: Tools for electron excitation characteristic analysis

heading: 势能面交叉对激发态优化的影响
content: 激发态能级密集且存在势能面交叉，导致优化复杂，如不同激发态可能优化到相同结构。彻底掌握该内容后应阅读《谈谈势能面交叉对激发态优化的影响》以理解相关现象。

heading: Influence of potential energy surface crossings on excited-state optimization
content: Excited-state energy levels are dense and potential energy surface crossings exist, making optimization complicated; for example, different excited states may optimize to the same structure. After fully mastering this content, read 《谈谈势能面交叉对激发态优化的影响》 to understand the related phenomena.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: 荧光与磷光发射对应的态
content: 荧光发射是从单重态激发态发射光子退激到基态，根据Kasha规则多数情况是从S1退激到S0，少数如Azulene从S2退激。磷光发射是从三重态激发态发射光子退激到基态，是从T1（能量最低的三重态激发态）退激到S0的。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: States corresponding to fluorescence and phosphorescence emission
content: Fluorescence emission is the emission of a photon from a singlet excited state, decaying back to the ground state; according to Kasha's rule, in most cases it is S1 decaying to S0, with a few exceptions such as Azulene decaying from S2. Phosphorescence emission is the emission of a photon from a triplet excited state, decaying back to the ground state; it proceeds from T1 (lowest-energy triplet excited state) to S0.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: 振子强度的物理意义与寿命计算公式
content: 振子强度f的计算公式为(2/3)ΔE*|<i|-r|j>|^2，其值越大吸收峰越强，小于0.01一般可认为跃迁禁阻。通过振子强度和能差ΔE可根据爱因斯坦公式计算激发态寿命τ=1.5/(f*ΔE^2)，寿命单位为秒，ΔE以cm-1为单位。三重态和单重态之间是自旋禁阻的，仅当考虑旋轨耦合时振子强度才不为零，故磷光寿命远比荧光寿命长。

heading: Physical meaning of oscillator strength and the lifetime formula
content: The oscillator strength f is calculated as (2/3)ΔE*|<i|-r|j>|^2; the larger its value, the stronger the absorption peak, and values below 0.01 are generally considered forbidden transitions. Using the oscillator strength and the energy difference ΔE, the excited-state lifetime can be calculated from the Einstein formula: τ=1.5/(f*ΔE^2), where the lifetime is in seconds and ΔE is in cm-1. Transitions between triplet and singlet states are spin-forbidden; the oscillator strength is nonzero only when spin-orbit coupling is considered, which is why phosphorescence lifetimes are far longer than fluorescence lifetimes.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: 电子光谱图的产生原理
content: UV-Vis光谱通过在基态结构下计算一批激发态的激发能和振子强度，用高斯函数展宽叠加得到；荧光光谱在优化的S1结构下计算S1->S0垂直发射能和振子强度展宽得到；磷光光谱在优化的T1结构下计算T1->S0垂直发射能和振子强度（需考虑旋轨耦合）展宽得到。这种不考虑核振动的计算方式得到的理论光谱没有精细结构，若要获得振动分辨的精细结构需考虑核振动波函数，计算成本高得多。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: Principle underlying electronic spectra generation
content: A UV-Vis spectrum is obtained by calculating the excitation energies and oscillator strengths of a batch of excited states at the ground-state structure, then broadening and summing them with Gaussian functions. A fluorescence spectrum is obtained by calculating the S1->S0 vertical emission energy and oscillator strength at the optimized S1 structure and broadening them. A phosphorescence spectrum is obtained by calculating the T1->S0 vertical emission energy and oscillator strength at the optimized T1 structure (spin-orbit coupling must be considered) and broadening them. Theoretical spectra obtained this way, which neglect nuclear vibrations, lack fine structure; obtaining vibrationally resolved fine structure requires considering nuclear vibrational wavefunctions, at a much higher computational cost.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: 隐式溶剂模型中的线性响应(LR)与态特定(SS)方法
content: 线性响应(LR)模型溶剂对激发能的修正是跃迁密度与溶剂极化的相互作用，计算量增加不多且有解析梯度，适合几何优化。态特定(SS)方法令溶剂直接对激发态密度响应并完全自洽（外迭代），计算耗时增加一个数量级且失去解析梯度，一般仅用于高精度要求且不用于优化过程，对非电荷转移激发态优势不明显。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: Linear response (LR) versus state-specific (SS) methods in implicit solvation models
content: In the linear response (LR) model, the solvent correction to the excitation energy is the interaction between the transition density and the solvent polarization; the computational cost increases only slightly and an analytical gradient is available, making it suitable for geometry optimization. The state-specific (SS) method makes the solvent respond directly to the excited-state density and is fully self-consistent (external iteration); the computational cost increases by an order of magnitude and the analytical gradient is lost. It is generally used only for high accuracy requirements and not in optimization; its advantage is not evident for non-charge-transfer excited states.

heading: 非平衡溶剂效应在垂直与绝热跃迁中的处理

heading: Treatment of non-equilibrium solvent effect in vertical and adiabatic transitions
content: The vertical absorption energy is defined as E_ES(R_GS, neq) - E_GS(R_GS, eq), the vertical emission energy is defined as E_ES(R_ES, eq) - E_GS(R_ES, neq), and the adiabatic absorption/emission energy is defined as E_ES(R_ES, eq) - E_GS(R_GS, eq). For a vertical process, only the fast part of the solvent has time to polarize in the final state (non-equilibrium, neq), whereas in an adiabatic process the solvent is fully relaxed in both the initial and final states (equilibrium, eq).

heading: Gaussian中TDDFT的关键词选项
content: Gaussian中做TDDFT计算的基本格式是“# 泛函/基组 TD(选项)”。常用选项包括：nstates=N设定计算N个最低激发态（默认3），root=i选择第i个激发态进行优化或分析，singlet计算单重态（默认），triplet计算三重态，50-50同时计算N个单重态和N个三重态。基态为开壳层时无法指定自旋多重度，需根据<S**2>值判断。

heading: Keyword options for TDDFT in Gaussian
content: The basic format for performing a TDDFT calculation in Gaussian is "# functional/basis set TD(options)". Common options include: nstates=N to set the calculation of the N lowest excited states (default 3), root=i to select the i-th excited state for optimization or analysis, singlet to compute singlet states (default), triplet to compute triplet states, and 50-50 to compute N singlet states and N triplet states simultaneously. It is unable to specify spin multiplicity when ground state is open-shell; in that case, judge from the <S**2> value.

heading: nstates参数的设置策略
content: 研究特定第i个激发态时，建议总共计算至少i+3个态，最好i+5个态，因为Davidson迭代求解时高态误差更大。计算电子光谱时，nstates大小取决于需覆盖的波长范围（一般2~7eV）、体系共轭程度和原子数，通常需要经验或用低级别方法测试，小体系可能算10个足矣，大共轭分子可能需算上百至几百个态。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/314_Gaussian中TDDFT计算激发态与光谱_卡片.md
heading: Strategy for setting the nstates parameter
content: When studying a specific i-th excited state, it is recommended to compute at least i+3 states in total, preferably i+5 states, because higher states have larger errors in the Davidson iterative solution. For calculating electronic spectra, the value of nstates depends on the wavelength range to be covered (generally 2~7 eV), the degree of conjugation of the system, and the number of atoms; usually empirical experience or testing with a lower-level method is needed. For small systems, 10 states may suffice, while large conjugated molecules may require hundreds of states.

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: 隐式溶剂模型的定义与优缺点
content: 隐式溶剂模型将溶剂环境视为可极化的连续介质而不具体描述溶剂分子结构，好处是能表现平均效应且计算耗时增加不高。该模型无法表现溶剂与溶质间的强相互作用如氢键及溶剂的催化作用，且对电荷转移激发描述不当。隐式溶剂模型计算离子溶解自由能的精度明显低于中性分子。
topic: 隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算
fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Definition, advantages and disadvantages of implicit solvation models
content: Implicit solvation models treat the solvent environment as a polarizable continuum without explicitly describing the structure of solvent molecules; the advantage is that they capture average effects with only a modest increase in computational time. Such models cannot represent strong interactions between solvent and solute such as hydrogen bonds, nor the catalytic role of the solvent, and they describe charge transfer excitation improperly. The accuracy of implicit solvation model calculations of ionic solvation free energy is markedly lower than for neutral molecules.
topic: Solvation free energy and system free energy calculation with implicit solvation models

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: 避免在Gaussian中使用CPCM模型
content: CPCM是PCM的近似形式，Gaussian中默认的IEFPCM是更好的实现。J. Chem. Theory Comput., 11, 4220 (2015)指出CPCM在Gaussian中对中性体系使用的参数是错误的，结果不可靠，因此绝对不要在Gaussian里使用CPCM。

fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Avoid using the CPCM model in Gaussian
content: CPCM is an approximate form of PCM, and the default IEFPCM in Gaussian is a better implementation. J. Chem. Theory Comput., 11, 4220 (2015) pointed out that the parameters used by CPCM in Gaussian for neutral systems are wrong and the results are unreliable; therefore never use CPCM in Gaussian.
topic: Solvation free energy and system free energy calculation with implicit solvation models

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: 溶解自由能的基本计算公式
content: 溶解自由能的计算方法是：在溶剂模型下计算的单点能减去气相下计算的单点能。例如计算某分子在乙醇中的溶解自由能，用# M052X/6-31G* scrf(SMD,solvent=ethanol)得到的单点能减去# M052X/6-31G*得到的单点能。
topic: 隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算
fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Basic formula for calculating solvation free energy
content: The solvation free energy is calculated as: the single-point energy computed under a solvation model minus the single-point energy computed in the gas phase. For example, to calculate the solvation free energy of a molecule in ethanol, subtract the single-point energy from # M052X/6-31G* from that obtained with # M052X/6-31G* scrf(SMD,solvent=ethanol).
topic: Solvation free energy and system free energy calculation with implicit solvation models
fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: 溶解自由能计算的标准态校正
content: 隐式溶剂模型计算的溶解自由能对应的是从1M气相状态挪入1M溶剂化状态的过程，而化学上标准态定义是从1atm气相状态挪入1M溶剂化状态。在298.15K下，需将隐式溶剂模型计算结果加上1.89kcal/mol以校正1atm->1M的浓度变化自由能。
topic: 隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算
fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Standard-state correction in solvation free energy calculation
content: The solvation free energy computed by implicit solvation models corresponds to moving from the 1M gas-phase state to the 1M solvated state, whereas the standard state in chemistry is defined as moving from the 1atm gas-phase state to the 1M solvated state. At 298.15K, 1.89 kcal/mol must be added to the implicit solvation model result to correct for the free energy change of the 1atm->1M concentration change.
topic: Solvation free energy and system free energy calculation with implicit solvation models

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: 溶解自由能计算的理论级别要求
content: 计算溶解自由能必须使用溶剂模型参数化的级别，否则即便使用更高级别精度也会更差。PCM/UAHF模型应在HF/6-31G*（阴离子用6-31+G*）下计算；SMD模型必须在M05-2X/6-31G*下计算，即便是阴离子或过渡金属配合物（配体原子为主）也建议使用此级别。
topic: 隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算
fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Level-of-theory requirements for solvation free energy calculation
content: Solvation free energy calculations must use the level of theory at which the solvation model was parameterized; otherwise, even higher levels give worse accuracy. The PCM/UAHF model should be used at HF/6-31G* (6-31+G* for anions); the SMD model must be used at M05-2X/6-31G*, and even for anions or transition metal complexes (main-group ligand atoms) this level is recommended.
topic: Solvation free energy and system free energy calculation with implicit solvation models
fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: 计算溶解自由能时的结构选择
content: 绝大多数中性分子气相和溶剂下结构差异小，用气相优化结构计算溶解自由能即可；对于气相和溶剂下结构差异大的体系，应在溶剂模型下优化结构。使用气相结构往往更适合计算溶解自由能，这一点在JPCB,115,14556(2011)中得到了支持。
topic: 隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算
fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Choice of structure when calculating solvation free energy
content: For the vast majority of neutral molecules, the structures in the gas phase and in solution differ little, so the gas-phase optimized structure can be used to calculate the solvation free energy; for systems whose structures differ greatly between gas phase and solution, the structure should be optimized under the solvation model. Using gas-phase structures is often more suitable for calculating solvation free energy, as supported in JPCB, 115, 14556 (2011).
topic: Solvation free energy and system free energy calculation with implicit solvation models
fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: 隐式溶剂模型的计算局限性
content: 隐式溶剂模型无法直接得到不同温度下的溶解自由能、溶解焓和溶解熵，因为模型参数是针对标况下的实验溶解自由能拟合的。考虑气相和溶剂下平动/转动熵差异的额外校正通常没有必要，且往往导致结果变差，详见J. Phys. Chem. A, 122, 1392 (2018)。
topic: 隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算
fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Computational limitations of implicit solvation models
content: Implicit solvation models cannot directly yield the solvation free energy, solvation enthalpy, or solvation entropy at different temperatures, because the model parameters were fitted to experimental solvation free energies under standard conditions. Additional corrections accounting for translational/rotational entropy differences between the gas phase and solution are usually unnecessary and often worsen the results; see J. Phys. Chem. A, 122, 1392 (2018).
topic: Solvation free energy and system free energy calculation with implicit solvation models
fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: 单原子离子溶解自由能的计算限制
content: 对于质子、锂离子等小的高电荷密度单原子离子，不能仅靠SMD模型计算溶解自由能，因其无法体现强相互作用。质子在水中的溶解自由能推荐使用-265.9 kcal/mol（J. Phys. Chem. A, 102, 7787 (1998)），准确计算需结合显式+隐式溶剂模型，至少需考虑一个显式溶剂分子。
topic: 隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算
fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Limitations on calculating solvation free energy of single-atomic ions
content: For small single-atomic ions with high charge density such as the proton and the lithium ion, the solvation free energy cannot be computed with the SMD model alone, because it cannot capture strong interactions. For the solvation free energy of the proton in water, -265.9 kcal/mol is recommended (J. Phys. Chem. A, 102, 7787 (1998)); accurate calculation requires combining an explicit + implicit solvation model, with at least one explicit solvent molecule included.
topic: Solvation free energy and system free energy calculation with implicit solvation models
fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: 多原子离子的uESE溶剂模型推荐
content: 对于净电荷为+1或-1且不想使用显式溶剂模型的多原子离子，计算溶解自由能强烈建议使用uESE溶剂模型，其精度比SMD高得多。
topic: 隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算
fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Recommendation of the uESE solvation model for polyatomic ions
content: For polyatomic ions with a net charge of +1 or -1 for which an explicit solvent model is not desired, the uESE solvation model is strongly recommended for calculating solvation free energy, as its accuracy is much higher than that of SMD.
topic: Solvation free energy and system free energy calculation with implicit solvation models
fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: 溶剂环境下溶质自由能的计算公式
content: 溶质在溶剂环境下标况（298.15K、1M）时的自由能 = 溶质在1atm气相下的自由能 + 直接通过隐式溶剂模型计算的溶解自由能（始末都是1M） + 1.89kcal/mol（标况下1atm→1M自由能变）。气相自由能计算级别与溶解自由能计算级别互不影响。
topic: 隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算
fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Formula for calculating solute free energy in solvent environment
content: Free energy of the solute in solvent environment under standard conditions (298.15K, 1M) = free energy of the solute in the gas phase at 1atm + solvation free energy computed directly by an implicit solvation model (both initial and final states at 1M) + 1.89 kcal/mol (free energy change of 1atm→1M under standard conditions). The level of theory for the gas-phase free energy calculation and that for the solvation free energy calculation do not affect each other.

heading: 气相自由能计算的“粗人”与“讲究”流程
content: “粗人”流程：用B3LYP/6-31G* opt freq得到热校正量，再用高精度单点能（如B2PLYP-D3(BJ)/def2-TZVP）相加。“讲究”流程：可参考开源工具完成该计算，对柔性体系准确性大幅提升。

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: The "quick and dirty" and "rigorous" workflows for gas-phase free energy calculation
content: "Quick and dirty" workflow: obtain the thermal correction value with B3LYP/6-31G* opt freq, then add a high-precision single-point energy (e.g., B2PLYP-D3(BJ)/def2-TZVP). "Rigorous" workflow: open-source tools can be used to carry out this calculation, greatly improving accuracy for flexible systems.

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: 溶剂效应的极性与非极性部分
content: 溶剂效应分为极性部分和非极性部分，极性部分体现静电相互作用和极化，非极性部分体现非静电作用如孔洞做功、熵效应、交换互斥和色散吸引。Onsager、PCM、COSMO等模型只明确定义了极性部分，而SMD、SMx系列明确定义了非极性部分并进行了参数拟合，整体精度优于PCM等模型。
topic: 隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算
fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Polar and nonpolar parts of the solvent effect
content: The solvent effect is divided into a polar part and a nonpolar part: the polar part represents electrostatic interaction and polarization, while the nonpolar part represents non-electrostatic effects such as cavity formation work, entropic effects, exchange exclusion, and dispersion attraction. Models such as Onsager, PCM, and COSMO explicitly define only the polar part, whereas SMD and the SMx series explicitly define and parameterize the nonpolar part, giving overall accuracy superior to PCM-type models.
topic: Solvation free energy and system free energy calculation with implicit solvation models
fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: 溶剂下自由能计算实例：环氧乙烷
content: 环氧乙烷在乙醇中的自由能计算分四步：1. B3LYP-D3(BJ)/6-311G* opt freq(SMD,ethanol)得到热校正量；2. B2PLYP-D3(BJ)/def2-TZVP单点得到气相高精度电子能；3. M052X/6-31G*气相单点；4. M052X/6-31G* SMD(ethanol)单点。最终自由能 = 气相高精度电子能 + 热校正量 + (溶剂单点能-气相单点能) + 1.89kcal/mol。
topic: 隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算
fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Example of free energy calculation in solution: ethylene oxide
content: The free energy calculation of ethylene oxide in ethanol proceeds in four steps: 1. B3LYP-D3(BJ)/6-311G* opt freq(SMD,ethanol) to obtain the thermal correction value; 2. B2PLYP-D3(BJ)/def2-TZVP single point to obtain the high-accuracy gas-phase electronic energy; 3. M052X/6-31G* gas-phase single point; 4. M052X/6-31G* SMD(ethanol) single point. Final free energy = high-accuracy gas-phase electronic energy + thermal correction value + (solvated single-point energy - gas-phase single-point energy) + 1.89 kcal/mol.
topic: Solvation free energy and system free energy calculation with implicit solvation models

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: 自由能计算实例中的特殊注意事项
content: 实例中B3LYP-D3(BJ)/6-311G* opt freq虽带溶剂模型，但对中性分子其热校正量可视作气相校正量，带溶剂模型是为了增加关键词普适性。对于大体系，建议用M06-2X代替B2PLYP-D3(BJ)以节省时间；使用Gaussian优化时建议默认IEFPCM以避免SMD可能导致的收敛问题或虚频。
topic: 隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Special notes for the free energy calculation example
content: In the example, although B3LYP-D3(BJ)/6-311G* opt freq includes a solvation model, for neutral molecules its thermal correction value can be regarded as a gas-phase correction value; the solvation model is included only for generality of the keywords. For large systems, it is advisable to use M06-2X instead of B2PLYP-D3(BJ) to save time; when using Gaussian optimization, the default IEFPCM is recommended to avoid convergence problems or imaginary frequencies that SMD may cause.

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: 隐式溶剂模型对体系性质的影响
content: 隐式溶剂模型会改变体系势能面、电子结构以及NMR等性质，其中激发能、HOMO-LUMO gap、偶极矩受影响大，几何结构、NMR化学位移受影响小。对于局部带显著电荷的体系，必须在溶剂模型下进行结构优化以避免定性错误，研究溶液下反应过程建议所有计算都加上隐式溶剂模型。
topic: 隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Influence of implicit solvent models on system properties
content: Implicit solvent models alter the potential energy surface, electronic structure, and properties such as NMR of a system. Among these, excitation energies, HOMO-LUMO gaps, and dipole moments are strongly affected, while geometric structures and NMR chemical shifts are only weakly affected. For systems with significant localized charges, geometry optimization must be performed under a solvent model to avoid qualitative errors. When studying reaction processes in solution, it is recommended to include an implicit solvent model in all calculations.

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Gaussian中隐式溶剂模型的选择建议
content: Gaussian默认使用IEFPCM模型，直接使用默认不计算非极性部分，需在scrf里写read并输入Dis/Rep/Cav来计算非极性部分。SMD模型是目前最好的隐式溶剂模型，建议算单点能时使用scrf=SMD；但在优化和振动分析时，若SMD导致高对称性结构出现虚频或收敛困难，建议改用默认的IEFPCM。
topic: 隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Recommendations for choosing implicit solvent models in Gaussian
content: Gaussian uses the IEFPCM model by default. Using the default directly does not compute the nonpolar part; you must write read in scrf and input Dis/Rep/Cav to compute the nonpolar part. The SMD model is currently the best implicit solvent model; it is recommended to use scrf=SMD for single-point calculations. However, for optimization and vibrational analysis, if SMD causes imaginary frequencies or convergence difficulty for high-symmetry structures, it is recommended to switch to the default IEFPCM.

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Gaussian中使用内置溶剂的方法
content: 使用scrf关键词，通过solvent=xxx指定内置溶剂名，溶剂名需遵循Gaussian手册列表，部分溶剂支持简写如DMSO。例如在SMD模型下表现乙醇溶剂应写scrf(SMD,solvent=ethanol)。

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: How to use built-in solvents in Gaussian
content: Use the scrf keyword and specify a built-in solvent name via solvent=xxx. The solvent name must follow the list in the Gaussian manual, and some solvents support abbreviations such as DMSO. For example, to represent ethanol solvent under the SMD model, write scrf(SMD,solvent=ethanol).

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Gaussian中自定义溶剂参数（仅极性部分）
content: 若溶剂不在内置列表且不考虑非极性部分，可在scrf里写read，在输入文件末尾定义eps（静态介电常数）和epsinf（动态介电常数）。做基态计算只需定义eps，做TDDFT或含频极化率计算必须定义epsinf，对于非极性溶剂可设epsinf=eps，极性溶剂可设epsinf=1.9。

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Custom solvent parameters in Gaussian (polar part only)
content: If the solvent is not in the built-in list and the nonpolar part is not considered, write read in scrf and define eps (static dielectric constant) and epsinf (dynamic dielectric constant) at the end of the input file. For a ground state calculation, only eps needs to be defined; for TDDFT or frequency-dependent polarizability calculations, epsinf must be defined. For nonpolar solvents, epsinf=eps can be set; for polar solvents, epsinf=1.9 can be set.

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Gaussian中自定义SMD溶剂参数
content: 在SMD模型下自定义溶剂需写scrf(read,SMD,solvent=generic)并输入完整的SMD参数，包括eps、epsinf、HBondAcidity、HBondBasicity、SurfaceTensionAtInterface、CarbonAromaticity、ElectronegativeHalogenicity。若无法获得新溶剂的Abraham酸碱度参数，可借用最接近内置溶剂的非极性参数。
topic: 隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: Custom SMD solvent parameters in Gaussian
content: To define a custom solvent under the SMD model, write scrf(read,SMD,solvent=generic) and input the full set of SMD parameters, including eps, epsinf, HBondAcidity, HBondBasicity, SurfaceTensionAtInterface, CarbonAromaticity, and ElectronegativeHalogenicity. If the Abraham acidity/basicity parameters of a new solvent cannot be obtained, the nonpolar parameters of the closest built-in solvent may be borrowed.
topic: Solvation free energy and system free energy calculation under implicit solvent models

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: 混合溶剂的设置方法
content: 对于混合溶剂，应将各组分溶剂的eps和epsinf按体积比例混合来定义。若使用SMD模型，需将内置溶剂的SMD参数（可查MNSODB数据库）按体积比混合；对于含水混合溶剂，建议分别计算水和另一纯溶剂中的溶解自由能后按体积比权重。
topic: 隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算
fm_title: 谈谈隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能和体系自由能的计算

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: How to set up mixed solvents
content: For mixed solvents, the eps and epsinf of the component solvents should be mixed according to their volume fractions. If the SMD model is used, the SMD parameters of the built-in solvents (which can be found in the MNSODB database) should be mixed by volume ratio; for aqueous mixed solvents, it is recommended to separately calculate the solvation free energy in water and in the other pure solvent, and then weight them by volume ratio.
topic: Solvation free energy and system free energy calculation under implicit solvent models

file: 07-Gaussian使用/327_隐式溶剂模型下溶解自由能与体系自由能计算_卡片.md
heading: 隐式溶剂模型计算中的外迭代
content: 外迭代是指让溶剂反应场与后HF密度（如TDDFT）达成自洽的过程，需在scrf中写externaliteration。外迭代仅对后HF和TDDFT计算有意义，对于HF、DFT、MCSCF等本身就是SCF的过程，写externaliteration没有意义，严禁滥用。

The vibrational vectors of these two modes correspond to the twisting where, in the T1 structure relative to the S0 structure, the nitrogen atom tilts upward and the hydrogen atom moves downward. The 386 cm^-1 mode does not contribute to the structural change, so its contribution to the reorganization energy is 0.

heading: Calculation Formula for the Huang-Rhys Factor
content: The Huang-Rhys factor of the i-th vibrational mode is S_i=λ_i/(h*ν_i), which is dimensionless. In the calculation, λ_i must be converted from cm^-1 to J, and ν_i from cm^-1 to s^-1. For example, for the 427 cm^-1 mode of S0, λ_i=3607.6 cm^-1, and the calculated S_i=3607.6/219474.6363*2625500/6.02214179E23 / (427*2.99792458E10*6.6260696E-34)=8.45.

heading: Plotting Vibrationally Resolved Electronic Spectra

heading: 重组能的定义与分类
content: 重组能是基于Marcus理论计算电子转移速率的关键量，分为内重组能和外重组能。内重组能衡量电子得失后因几何结构弛豫导致的体系能量变化；外重组能对应周围环境分子重新极化所花费的能量。溶液下外重组能常经验取0.2~0.6eV，晶体下会小一个多数量级，相关计算参考JPCL,1,941(2010)和JACS,130,12377(2008)。

heading: Definition and Classification of Reorganization Energy
content: The reorganization energy is a key quantity for calculating electron transfer rates based on Marcus theory, and is divided into inner reorganization energy and outer reorganization energy. The inner reorganization energy measures the change in the system's energy due to geometric structure relaxation after gaining or losing an electron; the outer reorganization energy corresponds to the energy spent on repolarization of the surrounding environmental molecules. In solution, the outer reorganization energy is often empirically taken as 0.2~0.6 eV; in crystals it is more than an order of magnitude smaller; for related calculations see JPCL,1,941(2010) and JACS,130,12377(2008).

heading: Representation of Hole Reorganization Energy and Electron Reorganization Energy

heading: 重组能λh的计算步骤
content: 计算λh需要以下步骤：(a)优化中性状态结构；(b)在(a)的结构下算中性状态能量E1；(c)在(a)的结构下算阳离子状态能量E2；(d)优化阳离子状态结构；(e)在(d)的结构下算中性状态能量E3；(f)在(d)的结构下算阳离子状态能量E4。重组能λ(I)=|E3-E1|，λ(II)=|E2-E4|，λh=λ(I)+λ(II)。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/330_Dushin分解重组能与Huang-Rhys因子计算_卡片.md
heading: Calculation steps for the reorganization energy λh
content: Calculating λh requires the following steps: (a) optimize the neutral state structure; (b) calculate the neutral state energy E1 at the structure from (a); (c) calculate the cation state energy E2 at the structure from (a); (d) optimize the cation state structure; (e) calculate the neutral state energy E3 at the structure from (d); (f) calculate the cation state energy E4 at the structure from (d). The reorganization energies are λ(I)=|E3-E1|, λ(II)=|E2-E4|, and λh=λ(I)+λ(II).

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/330_Dushin分解重组能与Huang-Rhys因子计算_卡片.md
heading: 重组能的模态分解原理
content: 基于谐振势公式E=(1/2)*k*x^2，λ(I)可分解为各个正则模式的贡献λ_i=(1/2)*k_i*(ΔQ_i)^2，其中k_i为力常数，ΔQ_i为位移在正则坐标上的分量。∑λ_i并不精确等于λ(I)但定性相符。分解λ(I)必须用S0极小点处的正则模式，分解λ(II)必须用T1极小点处的正则模式，不可混用。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/330_Dushin分解重组能与Huang-Rhys因子计算_卡片.md
heading: Principle of modal decomposition of the reorganization energy
content: Based on the harmonic potential formula E=(1/2)*k*x^2, λ(I) can be decomposed into contributions from each normal mode, λ_i=(1/2)*k_i*(ΔQ_i)^2, where k_i is the force constant and ΔQ_i is the component of the displacement along the normal coordinate. ∑λ_i does not exactly equal λ(I) but is qualitatively consistent. To decompose λ(I), the normal modes at the S0 minimum must be used; to decompose λ(II), the normal modes at the T1 minimum must be used, and the two must not be mixed.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/330_Dushin分解重组能与Huang-Rhys因子计算_卡片.md
heading: Duschinsky旋转（混合效应）
content: S0和T1极小点下的正则坐标间存在线性变换关系，即Duschinsky旋转，表达为Q''=J*Q'+ΔQ。Q'和Q''分别代表两个电子态极小点下的正则模式，J为Duschinsky矩阵，记录了线性变换的组合系数。如果J是单位矩阵说明没有混合，J偏离单位矩阵越大说明混合越强烈。

fm_title: 使用Dushin分解重组能和计算Huang-Rhys因子

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/330_Dushin分解重组能与Huang-Rhys因子计算_卡片.md
heading: Duschinsky rotation (mixing effect)
content: There is a linear transformation relationship between the normal coordinates at the S0 and T1 minima, i.e., the Duschinsky rotation, expressed as Q''=J*Q'+ΔQ. Q' and Q'' represent the normal modes at the minima of the two electronic states, respectively, and J is the Duschinsky matrix recording the combination coefficients of the linear transformation. If J is the identity matrix, there is no mixing; the further J deviates from the identity matrix, the stronger the mixing.
