file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: Special cases when using SDD
content: When calculating rare-earth element clusters, the default Stuttgart small-core pseudopotential is time-consuming and makes SCF convergence difficult, so it is necessary to switch to the large-core version; when calculating main-group elements, for better results or to facilitate wavefunction analysis, the small-core version can be used instead (not built in; it must be downloaded from the Stuttgart website).
topic: Guide to selecting pseudopotential basis sets and comparison of Lanl and def2 series
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: cc-pVnZ-PP系列赝势基组
content: cc-pVnZ-PP系列是最适合后HF计算的赝势基组，适合搭配cc-pVnZ给轻原子使用；结合的是Stuttgart小核MDF赝势；目前对从Cu到Rn的d,ds,p族元素、K开始的碱金属、Ca开始的碱土金属、Th/Pa/U有定义。
topic: 赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: The cc-pVnZ-PP series pseudopotential basis sets
content: The cc-pVnZ-PP basis set series is the most suitable pseudopotential basis set for post-HF calculations, and can be combined with cc-pVnZ for light atoms; it is combined with Stuttgart small-core MDF pseudopotentials; definitions currently exist for the d, ds and p group elements from Cu to Rn, the alkali metals from K, the alkaline earth metals from Ca, and Th/Pa/U.
topic: Guide to selecting pseudopotential basis sets and comparison of Lanl and def2 series
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: cc-pVnZ-PP系列获取与适用性
content: cc-pVnZ-PP系列最新最全版本可在作者主页下载；由于此系列高角动量函数多、收缩度高，用在DFT计算上较昂贵不值得；aug-cc-pVnZ-PP是带弥散函数的版本，完全可以简化成月份基组的版本来节约时间。
topic: 赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: Obtaining the cc-pVnZ-PP series and its applicability
content: The latest and most complete versions of the cc-pVnZ-PP series can be downloaded from the author's homepage; since this series has many high angular momentum functions and high contraction, it is expensive and not worthwhile for DFT calculations; aug-cc-pVnZ-PP is the version with diffuse functions, and can perfectly well be simplified into a monthly basis set version to save time.
topic: Guide to selecting pseudopotential basis sets and comparison of Lanl and def2 series
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: SDB-cc-pVnZ-PP系列赝势基组
content: SDB-cc-pVnZ-PP系列结合Stuttgart大核MWB赝势，力图达到全电子cc-pVnZ的质量；仅对于Ga~Kr和In~Xe有定义；精度略逊于cc-pVnZ-PP，但由于是大核所以更便宜。
topic: 赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: The SDB-cc-pVnZ-PP series pseudopotential basis sets
content: The SDB-cc-pVnZ-PP series is combined with Stuttgart large-core MWB pseudopotentials, aiming to reach the quality of all-electron cc-pVnZ; definitions exist only for Ga~Kr and In~Xe; its accuracy is slightly inferior to cc-pVnZ-PP, but since it is large-core it is cheaper.
topic: Guide to selecting pseudopotential basis sets and comparison of Lanl and def2 series
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: def2系列赝势基组定义
content: def2系列基组从def2-SV(P)到def2-QZVPP精度逐级增高；对前四周期是全电子基组，从第五周期开始是赝势基组，结合的是Stuttgart小核赝势；除锕系及最后一个周期外覆盖了周期表所有元素；既适合DFT也适合后HF计算，但对后者起码得用def2-TZVP。
topic: 赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: Definition of the def2 series pseudopotential basis sets
content: The accuracy of the def2 series basis sets increases stepwise from def2-SV(P) to def2-QZVPP; for the first four periods they are all-electron basis sets, and starting from the fifth period they are pseudopotential basis sets, combined with Stuttgart small-core pseudopotentials; they cover all elements of the periodic table except the actinides and the last period; they suit both DFT calculations and post-HF calculations, but for the latter at least def2-TZVP must be used.
topic: Guide to selecting pseudopotential basis sets and comparison of Lanl and def2 series
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: def2系列基组定义获取
content: Gaussian直接内置了def2系列，但镧系的定义没有内置；镧系的定义得从BSE或Turbomole基组库里获得；def2系列没有标配的弥散函数，需要时可以按特定方式加上。
topic: 赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: Obtaining the def2 series basis set definitions
content: Gaussian has the def2 series built in directly, but the lanthanide definitions are not included; the lanthanide definitions must be obtained from the BSE or Turbomole basis set libraries; the def2 series has no standard diffuse functions, which can be added in a specific manner when needed.
topic: Guide to selecting pseudopotential basis sets and comparison of Lanl and def2 series
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: 使用赝势基组的坏处
content: 使用赝势基组可能导致计算精度受影响，大核版本精度大多不如小核版本；无法计算使用了赝势原子的NMR、超精细耦合、内核电子激发等依赖于内层电子的性质；内层电子缺失可能有碍一些波函数分析。
topic: 赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: Drawbacks of using pseudopotential basis sets
content: Using pseudopotential basis sets may affect computational accuracy, and the large-core version is generally less accurate than the small-core version; properties that depend on core electrons, such as NMR, hyperfine coupling, and core-electron excitations of atoms described by pseudopotentials, cannot be computed; the absence of core electrons may hinder some wavefunction analyses.
topic: Guide to selecting pseudopotential basis sets and comparison of Lanl and def2 series
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: dhf系列与def系列赝势基组
content: dhf系列赝势基组只包含第五、六周期，是将def2对s、d族元素用的Stuttgart赝势从MWB改为MDF并重新优化；dhf系列比同级别cc-pVnZ-PP结果更好，但没被Gaussian等主流程序内置；def系列基组除def2支持的元素外还多定义了锕系。
topic: 赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: The dhf series and def series pseudopotential basis sets
content: The dhf family pseudopotential basis sets cover only the fifth and sixth periods, obtained by taking the Stuttgart pseudopotentials used by def2 for the s and d group elements, changing MWB to MDF, and reoptimizing; the dhf series gives better results than the cc-pVnZ-PP series of the same level, but is not built into Gaussian or other mainstream programs; the def series basis sets define the actinides in addition to the elements supported by def2.
topic: Guide to selecting pseudopotential basis sets and comparison of Lanl and def2 series
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: DFT计算时赝势基组选择建议
content: DFT计算时赝势基组选择建议如下：计算条件差用Lanl2DZ；计算条件一般过渡金属用lanl2TZ，主族用lanl08(d)；计算条件不错过渡金属用lanl2TZ(f)或SDD，主族用lanl08(d)；计算条件很好用def2-TZVP；计算条件无限好用def2-QZVP（DFT用QZ级别很浪费）。
topic: 赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: Recommendations for pseudopotential and basis set selection in DFT calculations
content: Recommendations for pseudopotential and basis set selection in DFT calculations are as follows: with poor computational resources use Lanl2DZ; with average computational resources use lanl2TZ for transition metals and lanl08(d) for main-group elements; with fairly good computational resources use lanl2TZ(f) or SDD for transition metals and lanl08(d) for main-group elements; with very good computational resources use def2-TZVP; with unlimited computational resources use def2-QZVP (using QZ level for DFT is quite wasteful).
topic: Pseudopotential basis set selection guide and comparison of Lanl and def2 series
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: 后HF或多参考方法计算时赝势基组选择建议
content: 后HF或多参考方法计算时赝势基组选择建议如下：计算条件奇差无比用cc-pVDZ-PP或def2-SVP；计算条件一般过渡金属用Lanl2TZ(f)或SDD，主族用lanl08(d)；计算条件不错用cc-pVTZ-PP或def2-TZVPP；计算条件很好用cc-pVQZ-PP或def2-QZVPP。
topic: 赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: Recommendations for pseudopotential and basis set selection in post-HF or multireference method calculations
content: Recommendations for pseudopotential and basis set selection when using post-HF or multireference methods are as follows: with extremely poor computational resources use cc-pVDZ-PP or def2-SVP; with average computational resources use Lanl2TZ(f) or SDD for transition metals and lanl08(d) for main-group elements; with fairly good computational resources use cc-pVTZ-PP or def2-TZVPP; with very good computational resources use cc-pVQZ-PP or def2-QZVPP.
topic: Pseudopotential basis set selection guide and comparison of Lanl and def2 series
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: 赝势基组选择的补充提示
content: 提示1：对前三周期不要用赝势基组，能接受的基组底限是6-31G*；提示2：做波函数分析时一定要用小核赝势；提示3：镧系可用Stuttgart赝势+标配基组或def2系列，锕系一般用Stuttgart赝势+标配基组或def-TZVP，对Th、Pa、U也可用cc-pVnZ-PP系列。
topic: 赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: Additional tips on pseudopotential basis set selection
content: Tip 1: avoiding pseudopotential basis sets for first three periods; the lowest acceptable basis set is 6-31G*. Tip 2: Requiring small-core pseudopotentials for wavefunction analysis. Tip 3: For lanthanides, one can use Stuttgart pseudopotentials with their standard accompanying basis sets or the def2 series; for actinides, Stuttgart pseudopotentials with their standard accompanying basis sets or def-TZVP are generally used, and for Th, Pa, and U, the cc-pVnZ-PP basis set series can also be used.
topic: Pseudopotential basis set selection guide and comparison of Lanl and def2 series
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: 需要弥散函数时的赝势基组选择
content: 如果研究问题需要基组含有弥散函数，cc-pVnZ-PP前面带上aug即可；def2可以按特定方式加弥散；lanl系列赝势基组直接也有带弥散的版本；对于SDD标配的赝势基组，可自行用even-tempered方式加弥散或者借用lanl的带弥散版本。
topic: 赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: Pseudopotential basis set selection when diffuse functions are required
content: If the research problem requires the basis set to contain diffuse functions, simply prefix cc-pVnZ-PP with aug; the def2 series can have diffuse functions added in a specific manner; the Lanl series pseudopotential basis sets also directly have diffuse-augmented versions; for the standard SDD pseudopotential basis set, you can add diffuse functions yourself in an even-tempered manner or borrow the diffuse-augmented version from Lanl.
topic: Pseudopotential basis set selection guide and comparison of Lanl and def2 series
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: 配合物计算时赝势基组与全电子基组的匹配
content: 计算过渡金属配合物时，如果按基组的价层分裂数来划分，过渡金属用的赝势基组档次约等于配体的全电子基组，或者前者比后者高一个档都是完全可以的；主张过渡金属用的赝势基组档次比配体更高一点，因为过渡金属重要性最高。
topic: 赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: Matching pseudopotential basis sets with all-electron basis sets in complex calculations
content: When calculating transition metal complexes, if classified by the valence splitting level of the basis set, the grade of the pseudopotential basis set used for the transition metal should be roughly equal to the all-electron basis set of the ligands, or one grade higher than the latter—both are perfectly acceptable. It is advocated that the pseudopotential basis set for the transition metal be slightly higher in grade than that of the ligands, because the transition metal is the most important.
topic: Pseudopotential basis set selection guide and comparison of Lanl and def2 series
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: 配合物计算基组匹配的反面教材
content: 计算配合物时，过渡金属用较烂的lanl2DZ而配体用较好的TZVP是严重不合理的，明显主次不分；也不建议过渡金属用的赝势基组高过轻原子太多，例如Pt用def2-TZVPP而配体用6-31G*，差距过于悬殊会使配体的烂基组成为计算精度的瓶颈。
topic: 赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: Negative examples of basis set matching in complex calculations
content: When calculating complexes, using poor lanl2DZ for transition metal while ligands use better TZVP is seriously unreasonable and clearly confuses priorities. It is also not recommended that the pseudopotential basis set for transition metal much higher than that of light atoms; for example, Pt using def2-TZVPP while ligands use 6-31G*—such an excessively large gap makes the poor ligand basis set the bottleneck of the calculation accuracy.
topic: Pseudopotential basis set selection guide and comparison of Lanl and def2 series
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: 前三周期元素的赝势使用建议
content: 前三周期元素强烈不建议使用赝势基组，因为此时赝势带来的优点不明显，且坏处是实实在在的；前三周期可用的赝势基组比较有限，可选余地很小。
topic: 赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: Recommendations on pseudopotential use for first- to third-period elements
content: Pseudopotential basis sets strongly discouraged for first- to third-period elements, because the advantages brought by pseudopotentials are not obvious in this case, while the disadvantages are real; the available pseudopotential basis sets for first- to third-period elements are quite limited, leaving very little room for choice.
topic: Pseudopotential basis set selection guide and comparison of Lanl and def2 series
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: 第四周期元素的赝势使用建议
content: 第四周期元素用不用赝势基组皆可，一般推荐用赝势基组；如果体系中只有很少量第四周期元素，为了省事或统一基组可以用全电子基组；如果有大量第四周期元素则强烈建议用赝势基组以节约耗时。
topic: 赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: Recommendations on pseudopotential use for fourth-period elements
content: For fourth-period elements, pseudopotential basis sets may or may not be used; in general, using pseudopotential basis sets is recommended. If the system contains only a very small amount of fourth-period elements, all-electron basis sets may be used for convenience or for basis set uniformity. If there are many fourth-period elements, using pseudopotential basis sets is strongly recommended to save computation time.
topic: Pseudopotential basis set selection guide and comparison of Lanl and def2 series
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: 第五周期及之后元素的赝势使用建议
content: 第五周期及之后的元素，除非有特殊原因必须用全电子基组，否则强烈建议使用赝势基组；此时赝势带来的省时和等效处理相对论效应的好处已经重要到必不可少。
topic: 赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: Recommendations on pseudopotential use for elements of period 5 and beyond
content: For elements of period 5 and beyond, unless there are special reasons requiring all-electron basis sets, using pseudopotential basis sets is strongly recommended. In this case, the benefits of time savings and effective treatment of relativistic effects brought by pseudopotentials have become so important as to be indispensable.
topic: Pseudopotential basis set selection guide and comparison of Lanl and def2 series
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: Lanl系列赝势分类
content: Lanl系列赝势对第四周期元素未考虑相对论效应，对更重元素考虑了相对论效应；对s族和过渡金属，Lanl1是大核赝势，Lanl2是小核赝势；对p族二者等价，是大核赝势；都有MB和DZ两种配套赝势基组，最常用的是Lanl2DZ。
topic: 赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: Classification of the Lanl series pseudopotentials
content: The Lanl series pseudopotentials do not account for relativistic effects for fourth-period elements but do account for them for heavier elements. For s-block and transition metals, Lanl1 is a large-core pseudopotential and Lanl2 is a small-core pseudopotential; for p-block elements the two are equivalent and are large-core pseudopotentials. Both have two accompanying pseudopotential basis sets, MB and DZ; the most commonly used is Lanl2DZ.
topic: Pseudopotential basis set selection guide and comparison of Lanl and def2 series
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: Lanl系列赝势变体精度对比
content: Lanl2DZ曾被广泛使用但不推荐，因为精度明显偏低；如今算过渡金属起码用lanl2TZ，资源富裕建议用Lanl2TZ(f)；对于主族，lanl2DZ不理想，如今起码用lanl08，条件稍好建议用lanl08(d)。
topic: 赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: Accuracy comparison of Lanl series pseudopotential variants
content: Lanl2DZ was once widely used but is not recommended, because its accuracy is clearly low. Nowadays, lanl2TZ should be used at minimum for calculating transition metals, and Lanl2TZ(f) is suggested if resources permit. For main-group elements, lanl2DZ is not ideal; nowadays lanl08 should be used at minimum, and lanl08(d) is suggested if conditions allow.
topic: Pseudopotential basis set selection guide and comparison of Lanl and def2 series
fm_title: 谈谈赝势基组的选用

file: 01-量子化学方法/373_赝势基组选用指南与Lanl_def2系列对比_卡片.md
heading: Lanl系列赝势变体定义
content: Lanl2DZdp是在Lanl2DZ基础上加了层p弥散和d极化；Lanl2TZ是对Lanl2DZ重新进行收缩得到的准3-zeta基组；Lanl2TZ+是对第一周期金属增加一层d弥散；Lanl2TZ(f)是对过渡金属增加一层f极化。

heading: Limitations of NTO analysis and recommendation of hole-electron analysis
content: For some excited states, after the NTO transformation, the maximum contribution of a single orbital pair may still be relatively low (e.g., just over 70%), failing to adequately reflect the characteristics of electronic excitation. In such cases, the hole-electron analysis feature of Multiwfn should be used; since it has stronger universality and does not require particular attention to phase, it is suggested to use hole-electron analysis instead of NTO analysis.

heading: NTO本征值大于1的情况处理
content: 对于CIS和TDA近似的TDDFT，NTO本征值范围在[0,1]内。对于TDHF和TDDFT，本征值可能大于1，若轻微大于1（如1.02）可视为1.0；若显著大于1（如1.5），则暗示去激发组态贡献巨大或计算本身不合理，建议做波函数稳定性测试或改用TDA近似。

heading: Handling NTO eigenvalues greater than 1
content: For CIS and TDDFT with the TDA approximation, the NTO eigenvalues lie within [0,1]. For TDHF and full TDDFT, eigenvalues can exceed 1; if only slightly above 1 (e.g., 1.02), they may be treated as 1.0; if significantly above 1 (e.g., 1.5), this implies a huge contribution from de-excitation configurations or that the calculation itself is unreasonable — it is recommended to perform a wavefunction stability test or switch to the TDA approximation.

heading: 密度泛函方法的表现差异
content: B3LYP在HCN异构化中意外地不错，但这属于巧合；M06-2X在当前体系栽了。是否考虑DFT-D3(BJ)对B3LYP、B2PLYP的精度影响甚微，不涉及弱相互作用时别指望带来多大益处。DFT的可靠性终究和中高级别后HF有着显著差距。APFD表现差强人意，wB97XD和M062X表现相近且状态不好。

file: 01-量子化学方法/378_后HF方法精度与计算成本横测_卡片.md
heading: Performance differences among density functional methods
content: B3LYP was unexpectedly decent for the HCN isomerization, but this is a coincidence; M06-2X failed on this system. Whether or not DFT-D3(BJ) is considered has negligible effect on the accuracy of B3LYP and B2PLYP; do not expect much benefit when weak interactions are not involved. The reliability of DFT still has a significant gap compared with mid- and high-level post-HF methods. APFD performed passably; wB97XD and M062X performed similarly and poorly.

heading: 双杂化泛函与GGA泛函的表现
content: B2PLYP在当前体系侥幸赢了DSD-PBEP86-D3(BJ)，但即便表现好也没法和CCSD一拼。MP4精度<=双杂化泛函且耗时高得多。PBE算反应能很不错但属于巧合，算势垒精度不理想，但仍比昂贵的MP2强。MP2如今对于化学反应研究无用武之地，精度比它好的泛函一大把，更是被双杂化完爆。

heading: Performance of double-hybrid and GGA functionals
content: B2PLYP narrowly beat DSD-PBEP86-D3(BJ) on this system by luck, but even with good performance it cannot compete with CCSD. MP4 accuracy is <= double-hybrid functionals while being far more time-consuming. PBE was very good for reaction energies but that is a coincidence; its barrier calculation accuracy is unsatisfactory, yet it still beats the expensive MP2. MP2 nowadays has no place in the study of chemical reactions — plenty of functionals are more accurate than it, and double-hybrids completely outclass it.

heading: 半经验方法的势垒计算风险
content: PM6算反应能误差为1.48kcal/mol，碰巧结果倒也不赖，但其算的反应能垒大约是CCSD(T)的两倍，非常离谱。一般半经验根本没考虑势垒的计算，误差这么离谱倒也能理解。唯一一个专门算势垒的半经验方法是PM7-TS，用半经验方法算势垒风险极大。

heading: Risk of barrier calculations with semiempirical methods
content: PM6 gave a reaction energy error of 1.48 kcal/mol — coincidentally not bad — but its computed reaction energy barrier was about twice the CCSD(T) value, which is absurd. Semiempirical methods generally do not consider barrier calculation at all, so such an absurd error is understandable. The only semiempirical method specifically designed for barrier calculation is PM7-TS; there is a high risk of computing barriers with semiempirical methods.

heading: CCSD(T)大基组能量的估算公式
content: 获得CCSD(T)/大基组能量可通过公式估算：CCSD(T)/大基组 = CCSD(T)/小基组 + (MP2/大基组-MP2/小基组)。以CCSD(T)/cc-pVQZ为参照，使用cc-pVDZ作为小基组时，势垒误差0.13 kcal/mol，反应能误差0.11 kcal/mol；使用cc-pVTZ作为小基组时，势垒误差0.06 kcal/mol，反应能误差0.02 kcal/mol。

file: 01-量子化学方法/378_后HF方法精度与计算成本横测_卡片.md
heading: Estimation formula for CCSD(T)/large basis set energy
content: The CCSD(T)/large basis set energy can be estimated via the formula: CCSD(T)/large basis set = CCSD(T)/small basis set + (MP2/large basis - MP2/small basis). Taking CCSD(T)/cc-pVQZ as reference: using cc-pVDZ as the small basis set gives a potential barrier error of 0.13 kcal/mol and a reaction energy error of 0.11 kcal/mol; using cc-pVTZ as the small basis set gives a potential barrier error of 0.06 kcal/mol and a reaction energy error of 0.02 kcal/mol.

file: 01-量子化学方法/378_后HF方法精度与计算成本横测_卡片.md
heading: 大基组估算公式的适用性原因
content: MP2近似计算CCSD(T)/大基组的方法误差极小，原因有三：(1)MP2和CCSD(T)相关能本身差异就只有不到10%；(2)所利用的是MP2和CCSD(T)下E(QZ)-E(DZ)的差值，差异进一步缩小；(3)化学上研究的是体系间相对能量，求差时误差进一步抵消。此法实用性极强，降低的耗时以数量级论。

file: 01-量子化学方法/378_后HF方法精度与计算成本横测_卡片.md
heading: Why the large basis set estimation formula is applicable
content: The error of approximating the CCSD(T)/large basis set energy via MP2 is extremely small, for three reasons: (1) the intrinsic difference between MP2 and CCSD(T) correlation energies is less than 10%; (2) what is used is the difference E(QZ)-E(DZ) under MP2 and CCSD(T), which further narrows the discrepancy; (3) chemically one studies relative energies between systems, and taking differences further cancels the errors. This approach is extremely practical, reducing the cost by orders of magnitude.

heading: Post-HF calculation based on a DFT wavefunction in NWChem

heading: 单参考CI方法的性能与评价
content: CISD对相关能的描述很差，CISDT依然不理想，CISDTQ虽然结果理想但耗时极高，因此单参考CI算基态几乎没人用。CI系列方法对相关能考虑效率低，在实际化学问题（如HCN异构化）中计算结果差，很昂贵的CISDT误差依然挺大，完全无价值。

heading: Performance and evaluation of single-reference CI methods
content: CISD gives a poor description of the correlation energy; CISDT is still unsatisfactory; CISDTQ gives good results but is extremely expensive, so single-reference CI is almost never used for ground states. The CI family accounts for correlation energy inefficiently, performs poorly on practical chemical problems (such as HCN isomerization), and even the very expensive CISDT still has considerable error — utterly worthless.

heading: MP系列方法的精度与特点
content: MP2是最廉价的后HF方法，在当前体系中比CISD强，但在HCN异构化中表现令人失望，比M06-2X误差还大，对化学反应早已过时。MP3比MP2在此例中没改进且更贵，MP4明显高估相关能，MP5明显低估，精度远不及同档次耦合簇，性价比极差。MP4(SDQ)是MP4(SDTQ)的近似，耗时降低但误差增加。

file: 01-量子化学方法/378_后HF方法精度与计算成本横测_卡片.md
heading: Accuracy and characteristics of MP-series methods
content: MP2 is the cheapest post-HF method and outperforms CISD in the current system, but its performance on HCN isomerization is disappointing, with error even larger than M06-2X; it has long been obsolete for chemical reactions. MP3 shows no improvement over MP2 in this case and is more expensive; MP4 notably overestimates correlation energy, MP5 notably underestimates it, and the accuracy falls far short of coupled cluster methods of the same tier — extremely poor value for money. MP4(SDQ) is an approximation to MP4(SDTQ): cheaper but with increased error.

file: 01-量子化学方法/378_后HF方法精度与计算成本横测_卡片.md
heading: CC系列方法与QCI、BD的对比
content: CCSD比MP2强得多，和QCISD半斤八两；CCSD(T)、QCISD(T)、BD(T)这一档精度很高，接近CCSDTQ。CCSDT(2)Q类似于CCSDT(Q)，精度几乎和CCSDTQ无差异但耗时低得多，可作为极高精度的“钻石标准”。QCI、BD比起耦合簇没有优势，BD耗时还更高，QCI早该被遗忘。CCSD(2)T和CCSD[T]精度略逊于CCSD(T)。

file: 01-量子化学方法/378_后HF方法精度与计算成本横测_卡片.md
heading: Comparison of CC-series methods with QCI and BD
content: CCSD is far better than MP2 and roughly on par with QCISD; CCSD(T), QCISD(T), and BD(T) at this tier are of high accuracy, approaching CCSDTQ. CCSDT(2)Q is similar to CCSDT(Q): its accuracy is nearly indistinguishable from CCSDTQ but much cheaper, and it can serve as a "diamond standard" of extremely high accuracy. QCI and BD offer no advantage over coupled cluster; BD is even more expensive, and QCI should have long been forgotten. CCSD(2)T and CCSD[T] are slightly less accurate than CCSD(T).

heading: 高阶方法的成本与耗时
content: 在cc-pVDZ下，CCSDTQ耗时高达6622秒（约1.8小时），无实用性；CCSDT耗时82秒；CCSDT(2)Q耗时394秒。在cc-pVTZ下，CCSDT(2)Q耗时9435秒，CCSDT耗时885秒，CCSD(T)仅耗时35.3秒。(TQ)级别方法比(T)贵一个数量级以上，如QCISD(TQ)耗时577秒，而QCISD(T)仅8秒。

file: 01-量子化学方法/378_后HF方法精度与计算成本横测_卡片.md
heading: Cost and timing of higher-level methods
content: With cc-pVDZ, CCSDTQ takes as long as 6622 seconds (about 1.8 hours), impractical; CCSDT takes 82 seconds; CCSDT(2)Q takes 394 seconds. With cc-pVTZ, CCSDT(2)Q takes 9435 seconds, CCSDT takes 885 seconds, while CCSD(T) takes only 35.3 seconds. (TQ)-level methods are more than an order of magnitude more expensive than (T), e.g., QCISD(TQ) takes 577 seconds while QCISD(T) takes only 8 seconds.

heading: SCS系列与DFT后HF方法的评价
content: SCS-MP2除弱相互作用外通常比MP2更好，但在此例对相关能的考虑上未体现，且在HCN异构化中表现糟糕。SCS-CCSD高估了相关能，在HCN异构化中比CCSD并无优势。CCSD(T)-M062X、CCSD(T)-B3LYP和MP2-B3LYP等基于DFT波函数的后HF计算误差很大，精度比标准基于HF轨道的形式差得远。

heading: Evaluation of SCS-series and DFT-based post-HF methods
content: SCS-MP2 is usually better than MP2 except for weak interactions, but in this case its treatment of correlation energy showed no advantage, and it performed terribly on HCN isomerization. SCS-CCSD overestimates correlation energy and offers no advantage over CCSD for HCN isomerization. DFT-wavefunction-based post-HF calculations such as CCSD(T)-M062X, CCSD(T)-B3LYP, and MP2-B3LYP have large errors, far inferior in accuracy to the standard HF-orbital-based formalism.

file: 01-量子化学方法/378_后HF方法精度与计算成本横测_卡片.md
heading: CCSD(T)与CCSDT的精度比较
content: 在HCN异构化测试中，CCSD(T)表现极好，胜过所有其它方法，而CCSDT的误差反倒比它的近似CCSD(T)更大。这是因为CCSD(T)对T的微扰近似误差与忽略Q的贡献产生了误差抵消，因此不要盲目以为CCSDT一定比CCSD(T)更好，不要为了追求形式上的严格而强行使用CCSDT。

file: 01-量子化学方法/378_后HF方法精度与计算成本横测_卡片.md
heading: Accuracy comparison of CCSD(T) and CCSDT
content: In the HCN isomerization test, CCSD(T) performed excellently, beating all other methods, whereas the error of CCSDT was actually larger than that of its approximation CCSD(T). This is because the perturbative error of the (T) approximation to T and the error from neglecting the Q contribution cancel each other. Therefore do not blindly assume CCSDT is always better than CCSD(T), and do not insist on using CCSDT just for the sake of formal rigor.

file: 01-量子化学方法/378_后HF方法精度与计算成本横测_卡片.md
heading: (TQ)级别方法的实用性
content: (TQ)级别方法（如QCISD(TQ)、BD(TQ)）通过微扰方式考虑四重激发算符，但在HCN异构化测试中并未体现出比(T)更好的精度，误差反而更大，且耗时高得多。试图用(TQ)级别方法获得比CCSD(T)更高的精度往往会自取其辱，追求更高精度应选择CCSDT(2)Q。

file: 01-量子化学方法/378_后HF方法精度与计算成本横测_卡片.md
heading: Practicality of (TQ)-level methods
content: (TQ)-level methods (e.g., QCISD(TQ), BD(TQ)) account for quadruple excitation operators perturbatively, but in the HCN isomerization test they did not show better accuracy than (T); their errors were actually larger and the cost much higher. Attempting to achieve higher accuracy than CCSD(T) with (TQ)-level methods often ends in embarrassment; for pursuing higher accuracy, choose CCSDT(2)Q instead.

heading: CC系列中T1算符的重要性
content: CCD算反应能在此例中不错，但算势垒远不如CCSD，说明考虑T1算符对于获得准确势垒至关重要。CC2是CCSD的近似，对相关能考虑比CCSD差，在HCN异构化中误差非常大，仅以LR-CC2形式算激发能有点用，对于算化学反应毫无用处。

file: 01-量子化学方法/378_后HF方法精度与计算成本横测_卡片.md
heading: Importance of the T1 operator among CC-series methods
content: CCD performs decently for reaction energies in this case, but far worse than CCSD for barrier calculation, showing that including the T1 operator is essential for obtaining accurate potential barriers. CC2 is an approximation to CCSD; its treatment of correlation energy is worse than CCSD, and its error in HCN isomerization is very large. It is only somewhat useful for computing excitation energies in the LR-CC2 formalism and is useless for computing chemical reactions.

heading: Multiwfn功能所需的信息类型
content: Multiwfn的绝大多数功能需要的信息可归为四大类：(1)原子坐标，用于基于promolecular的RDG/aRDG分析、计算HOMA/Bird芳香性指标等；(2)GTF信息（原始高斯型函数定义、轨道系数等），用于绘制实空间函数图、拓扑分析、计算ADCH/CHELPG/Hirshfeld电荷等；(3)基函数信息（收缩基函数定义、轨道系数等），用于计算Mayer/Lowdin/Mulliken键级、绘制PDOS/OPDOS、轨道成份分析、CDA分析等；(4)格点数据，用于主功能13的格点数据处理。某些功能如光谱图绘制需要跃迁能量和强度，AdNDP分析需要NBO输出信息，ICSS计算需要磁屏蔽张量。

heading: Types of information required by Multiwfn functions
content: The information needed by the vast majority of Multiwfn functions falls into four categories: (1) atomic coordinates, used for promolecular-based RDG/aRDG analysis, computing HOMA/Bird aromaticity indices, etc.; (2) GTF information (definitions of primitive Gaussian type functions, orbital coefficients, etc.), used for plotting real space function maps, topological analysis, computing ADCH/CHELPG/Hirshfeld charges, etc.; (3) basis function information (definitions of contracted basis functions, orbital coefficients, etc.), used for computing Mayer/Lowdin/Mulliken bond orders, plotting PDOS/OPDOS, orbital composition analysis, CDA analysis, etc.; (4) grid data, used for grid data processing in main function 13. Some functions, such as spectral plot drawing, require transition energies and intensities; AdNDP analysis requires NBO output information; ICSS calculation requires the magnetic shielding tensor.

heading: Characteristics and generation of the fch file
content: The fch file is the text form of a Gaussian chk file, containing basis function information and virtual orbital information, supporting more functions than wfn/wfx. To generate a chk file, specify `%chk=path/to/file.chk` at the beginning of the input file. On Windows, convert chk to fch via Utilities - FormChk in the Gaussian interface; on Linux, use the `formchk` utility, e.g., `formchk MADLAX.chk`. If the chk file is too large and conversion fails, set an environment variable such as `export GAUSS_MEMDEF=4GB`.

heading: chk转换为fch的常见错误与处理
content: chk转换为fch时出错通常有三种可能：(1)chk文件损坏，需删除重算；(2)产生chk的任务未正常结束，需修改关键词；(3)产生chk的Gaussian版本/平台与formchk不一致，应使用配套的formchk。若不想手动转换，可将settings.ini里的formchkpath设为formchk路径，Multiwfn载入chk时会自动转换并清理。

heading: Common errors and handling in chk to fch conversion
content: Errors when converting chk to fch usually have three possible causes: (1) the chk file is corrupted, which requires deleting it and recomputing; (2) the task producing the chk did not finish normally, so keywords need to be modified; (3) the Gaussian version/platform producing the chk is inconsistent with formchk, in which case the matching formchk should be used. If you do not want to convert manually, set formchkpath in settings.ini to the path of formchk; when Multiwfn loads a chk file it will automatically convert and clean up.

heading: Post-HF or TDDFT natural orbital analysis based on an fch file

heading: molden文件的特征与兼容性
content: molden文件提供基函数信息，可记录轨道不可约表示，明确注明轨道占据数和自旋类型。其缺点是没有核电荷数段落（只记录原子序数），在赝势下计算需手动将[atoms]字段第三列原子序数改为实际核电荷数（ORCA 6.0+的[Pseudo]字段会被Multiwfn自动读取）。Multiwfn完美支持Molpro、ORCA、MRCC、NWChem、deMon2k、Dalton、xtb、BDF产生的molden文件，其他程序产生的需用Molden2AIM标准化。

heading: Characteristics and compatibility of molden files
content: A molden file provides basis function information, can record the irreducible representations of orbitals, and explicitly states orbital occupation numbers and spin types. Its drawback is that it has no nuclear charge section (only atomic numbers are recorded); for calculations with a pseudopotential, you must manually change the atomic number in the third column of the [atoms] field to the actual nuclear charge (the [Pseudo] field of ORCA 6.0+ is automatically read by Multiwfn). Multiwfn perfectly supports molden files produced by Molpro, ORCA, MRCC, NWChem, deMon2k, Dalton, xtb, and BDF; those produced by other programs need to be standardized with Molden2AIM.

heading: Characteristics and caveats of gms files

heading: Characteristics of cub, grd, vti, and dx files
content: The cub file is a popular format defined by Gaussian for recording grid data, and Multiwfn only supports the case where the three translation vectors correspond to the X, Y, and Z axes, respectively. The grd file (DMol3) is similar to cub but does not record atomic coordinates, so Multiwfn cannot display the structure. vti files (GIMIC 2.0, ParaView) and dx files (VMD Volmap plugin) are also grid data formats and do not contain atomic coordinates.

heading: Characteristics of NBO plot files
content: NBO plot files refer to files with suffixes 31~40: file 31 records basis function definitions, while files 32~40 record the expansion coefficients of PNAO/NAO/PNHO/NHO/PNBO/NBO/PNLMO/NLMO/MO in the basis functions, respectively. After loading file 31 and then loading one of files 32-40, the corresponding orbitals can be visualized. If you examine real space functions, you can only use NBO (37) or NLMO (39); otherwise the results are meaningless.

heading: 坐标文件格式（pdb、xyz、mol等）的特征
content: pdb、xyz、mol、mol2、gro、cif等文件用于提供原子坐标。pdb优先根据元素名指认，若无元素名则根据原子名猜测，易出错；xyz文件原子名应为元素名；.mol和.mol2记录原子间连接关系，对EEM电荷计算等必须；chg文件是Multiwfn自定义格式，记录坐标和电荷；gro文件靠原子名猜元素；cif文件用于晶体结构，不支持原子占据数不为1。

heading: Characteristics of coordinate file formats (pdb, xyz, mol, etc.)
content: Files such as pdb, xyz, mol, mol2, gro, and cif are used to provide atomic coordinates. For pdb, elements are assigned by element name first, and guessed from the atom name otherwise, which is error-prone; in xyz files, atom names should be element names; atomic connectivity recorded in mol and mol2 files is essential for tasks such as EEM charge calculation; the chg file is a Multiwfn custom format that records coordinates and charges; gro files guess elements from atom names; the cif file is for crystal structures and does not support atomic occupation numbers other than 1.

heading: Basic rules for choosing the input file
content: The input file should be chosen according to the type of information required by the function: for any analysis requiring basis function information, wfn files cannot be used; you need fch, mwfn, molden, etc.; for analyses that only require GTF information, wfn and fch are both suitable. Files containing basis function information automatically yield GTF information upon loading, so wherever a wfn file is used, it can be replaced by fch, mwfn, molden, etc. The information required by a specific function can be found in the "Information needed" field at the end of the corresponding subsection of Chapter 3 of the manual, or by referring to the examples in Chapter 4 of the manual.

heading: Using CP2K, Quantum ESPRESSO, and VASP files

file: 11-软件安装与环境/37_限制内存容量的硬件与系统因素_卡片.md
heading: 决定程序可用内存容量的瓶颈因素
content:
程序实际能使用的内存容量取决于CPU、内存控制器、操作系统、程序和主板，其中支持内存容量最小的一个环节即为瓶颈。
- CPU:能用到多大和CPU的位数没有直接关系，因为通用寄存器的宽度并不等于地址总线的宽度。比如8086是16bit通用寄存器但地址总线是20bit(=1MB)；P6架构虽然是32bit的，但其外部地址总线为36bit，寻址范围已经到了2^36=64G了；x86-64的AMD CPU，内存寻址范围是48bit(256T)，没有达到64bit。
- 注意若在32bit系统下实现36bit寻址需要通过PAE(Physical Address Extension)。
topic: 限制内存容量的硬件与系统因素
fm_title: 浅谈限制可用内存容量的屏障

file: 11-软件安装与环境/37_限制内存容量的硬件与系统因素_卡片.md
heading: Bottleneck factors determining the memory capacity available to a program
content:
The memory capacity a program can actually use depends on the CPU, memory controller, operating system, program, and motherboard; the component supporting the smallest memory capacity is the bottleneck.
- CPU: how much memory can be used has no direct relationship with the CPU's bit width, because the width of general-purpose registers does not equal the width of the address bus. For example, the 8086 has 16-bit general-purpose registers but a 20-bit address bus (=1MB); the P6 architecture is 32-bit, but its external address bus is 36-bit, with an addressing range reaching 2^36=64G; for x86-64 AMD CPUs, the memory addressing range is 48-bit (256T), not reaching 64-bit.
- Note that 36-bit addressing in 32-bit systems requires PAE (Physical Address Extension).

file: 11-软件安装与环境/37_限制内存容量的硬件与系统因素_卡片.md
heading: 主板与内存控制器对内存容量的限制
content:
主板支持的内存容量取决于主板有多少槽和芯片组最大支持容量。内存控制器方面，如果是K8及之后的，因为集成内存控制器，所以是CPU负责，这一般没有问题，可达48bit。而对于intel CPU由芯片组负责，老的芯片组比如945就只能支持32bit寻址即4G，这就需要新的芯片组，如965系列寻址空间达到36bit，但实际最大支持8G。服务器芯片组一般实际支持得比较大，寻址空间一般为36/38bit。
- Intel 945芯片组只支持32bit寻址即4G。
- Intel 965系列寻址空间达到36bit，实际最大支持8G。
- 服务器芯片组寻址空间一般为36/38bit。
topic: 限制内存容量的硬件与系统因素
fm_title: 浅谈限制可用内存容量的屏障

file: 11-软件安装与环境/37_限制内存容量的硬件与系统因素_卡片.md
heading: Motherboard and memory controller limits on memory capacity
content:
The memory capacity supported by a motherboard depends on how many slots it has and the maximum capacity supported by the chipset. As for the memory controller, for K8 and later AMD processors it is handled by the CPU due to the integrated memory controller, which is generally fine, reaching 48-bit. For Intel CPUs, the chipset is responsible; old chipsets such as the 945 only support 32-bit addressing corresponding to 4 GB, so a new chipset is needed, e.g. the 965 series has an addressing space of 36-bit, but actually supports at most 8G. Server chipsets generally support fairly large capacities, with addressing space typically 36/38-bit.
- The Intel 945 chipset only supports 32-bit addressing corresponding to 4 GB.
- The Intel 965 series has an addressing space of 36-bit, but actually supports at most 8G.
- Server chipsets typically have an addressing space of 36/38-bit.

heading: Windows操作系统对内存容量的支持
content:
Windows操作系统如果是64bit的，至少支持8G，无需PAE，目前支持容量最高的数据中心版本可支持2T，用的是44bit寻址(16T)但没有全开放。如果是32bit版本，XP和Vista任何版本皆最多4G，因为都不支持PAE。若用server版本，都支持PAE，可以超过4G，最强Datacenter版可达128G。
- 64bit Windows数据中心版支持2T内存，使用44bit寻址(16T)但没有全开放。
- 32bit XP和Vista任何版本皆最多4G，因为都不支持PAE。
- 32bit Windows Server版支持PAE，最强Datacenter版可达128G。

file: 11-软件安装与环境/37_限制内存容量的硬件与系统因素_卡片.md
heading: Memory capacity support in the Windows operating system
content:
For the Windows operating system, 64-bit versions support at least 8G without PAE; the highest-capacity version currently, the Datacenter edition, supports 2T, using 44-bit addressing (16T) but not fully opened up. For 32-bit versions, any edition of XP and Vista supports at most 4G, because none of them support PAE. Server editions all support PAE and can exceed 4G; the most powerful Datacenter edition can reach 128G.
- 64-bit Windows Datacenter edition supports 2T of memory, using 44-bit addressing (16T) but not fully opened up.
- 32-bit XP and Vista, any edition, support at most 4G because they do not support PAE.
- 32-bit Windows Server editions support PAE; the most powerful Datacenter edition can reach 128G.

file: 11-软件安装与环境/37_限制内存容量的硬件与系统因素_卡片.md
heading: 程序在32位Windows系统下的内存分配限制
content:
对于32bit windows系统，无论真正可用内存有多大，用户模式的程序最大只能分配2G虚拟内存，其它部分由系统核心调用。用了4GT即4GB内存调优技术，可分配最大3G，仅server版支持，启动时加/3GB即可。如果程序设计时使用AWE API集而且系统支持PAE，寻址范围可以扩至64GB。另外驱动也必须合适，比如一些老驱动程序在大内存下不能正常工作。在64bit windows下，用户模式的程序直接就可以访问8T空间。
- 使用4GT技术在启动时加/3GB，可分配最大3G，仅server版支持。
- 使用AWE API集且系统支持PAE，寻址范围可以扩至64GB。

file: 11-软件安装与环境/37_限制内存容量的硬件与系统因素_卡片.md
heading: Memory allocation limits for programs in 32-bit Windows systems
content:
On a 32-bit Windows operating system, no matter how much memory is actually available, a user-mode program can allocate at most 2G of virtual memory, with the rest used by the system kernel. With 4GT (4GB memory tuning technology), up to 3G can be allocated; only server editions support this, enabled by adding /3GB at boot. If the program is designed to use the AWE API set and the system supporting PAE, the addressing range can be extended to 64GB. In addition, drivers must be appropriate; for example, some outdated driver do not work properly with large memory. On 64-bit Windows, user-mode programs can directly access 8T of address space.
- Using 4GT technology by adding /3GB at boot allows allocating up to 3G; only server editions support this.
- Using the AWE API set with a system supporting PAE extends the addressing range to 64GB.

heading: Conditions for a program to use more than 4G of memory on 32-bit platforms
content: On a 32-bit platform, for a program to use more than 4G of memory, you need a Windows Server edition system + a suitable chipset + a motherboard with many slots + a suitable program. file: 11-软件安装与环境/37_限制内存容量的硬件与系统因素_卡片.md
heading: 4G内存可见空间减少的原因及MMIO机制
content: 4G内存时发现可见内存被吞掉750MB或者更多，是因为一些设备固定占据挨着并且低于4GB位置的一段空间，称为MMIO(PCI内存占其中很大部分)，这是内存控制器将这些设备映射到这个地址实现的，好处是系统可以方便快速地通过内存地址来访问这些设备，但原来在这个部位的物理内存就访问不到了，很浪费，也叫memory hole，尤其是GPU越多占得越多。
topic: 限制内存容量的硬件与系统因素
fm_title: 浅谈限制可用内存容量的屏障

file: 11-软件安装与环境/37_限制内存容量的硬件与系统因素_卡片.md
heading: Why visible memory is reduced with 4G of RAM and the MMIO mechanism
content: When 4G of memory is installed, if you find that 750MB or more of visible memory is swallowed, it is because some devices permanently occupy a region located just below 4GB, called MMIO (PCI memory accounts for a large part of it). This is realized by the memory controller mapping these devices to this address region; the benefit is that the system can conveniently and quickly access these devices via memory addresses, but the physical memory originally at this location becomes inaccessible, which is wasteful; this is also called a memory hole, and the more GPUs, the more is occupied.

file: 11-软件安装与环境/37_限制内存容量的硬件与系统因素_卡片.md
heading: 内存重映射(Memory Remapping)解决内存浪费
content: 解决内存被MMIO占用的方法是使用内存重映射(Memory Remapping)，内存控制器把这个部位的内存地址映射到4G位置后面的一段空间，然后将这样转化过的地址告诉CPU，这样CPU用大于FFFFFFFF的地址就可以访问到原本被MMIO覆盖的内存空间，就不会浪费了。
topic: 限制内存容量的硬件与系统因素
fm_title: 浅谈限制可用内存容量的屏障

file: 11-软件安装与环境/37_限制内存容量的硬件与系统因素_卡片.md
heading: Memory Remapping solves memory waste
content: The way to solve memory being occupied by MMIO is to use memory remapping: the memory controller maps the memory addresses at that location to a region behind the 4G position, and then informs the CPU of the converted addresses. In this way, the CPU can access the memory space originally covered by MMIO using addresses greater than FFFFFFFF, so it is no longer wasted.

heading: Software and hardware requirements for implementing memory remapping
content:
To use memory remapping, if the OS is 32-bit it must support PAE, otherwise the mapped space above 4G is still inaccessible; support for remapping differs among operating systems, and Server editions are better. The chipset must support remapping and have it enabled (for A64 and later this is implemented by the memory controller inside the CPU): at least the 680i, 955X, 965 series or above, or a server chipset. file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/380_Multiwfn轨道定域化与NBO、AdNDP对比_卡片.md
heading: 分子轨道定域化的含义与原理
content: 正则分子轨道是Fock或KS算符的本征函数，往往具有强离域性，无法直接与化学键对应；通过酉变换将正则分子轨道变换成定域化分子轨道，可使离域程度尽可能低，从而将轨道与化学键联系起来。这种变换不改变体系能量、电子密度、静电势等可观测量，也不影响电子定域化函数(ELF)。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/380_Multiwfn轨道定域化与NBO、AdNDP对比_卡片.md
heading: Meaning and principle of molecular orbital localization
content: Canonical molecular orbitals are eigenfunctions of the Fock or KS operator and are often strongly delocalized, so they cannot be directly mapped onto chemical bonds; through a unitary transformation, canonical molecular orbitals can be transformed into localized molecular orbitals, minimizing the degree of delocalization and thereby relating orbitals to chemical bonds. This transformation does not change observables such as the energy of the system, the electron density, or the electrostatic potential, nor does it affect the electron localization function (ELF).

heading: Common orbital localization methods
content: Edmiston-Ruedenberg localization is achieved by maximizing the mutual repulsion energy of orbitals, but is time-consuming; Boys localization is achieved by minimizing the spatial extent covered by orbitals and is widely used; Pipek-Mezey localization is achieved by maximizing the sum of squares of Mulliken atomic populations, is simple to program and fast, and is widely used; NLMO localization is a method proposed by the NBO developers, mixing high-occupancy and low-occupancy NBOs to obtain localized orbitals with integer occupations, and it depends on the NBO program.

heading: Limitations of NBO analysis for systems with complex electronic structures
content: NBO searches for bonding orbitals by diagonalizing block density matrices of different atomic combinations; this approach works for typical organic systems, but is extremely unscientific for systems with complex electronic structure involving multicenter delocalization; using NBO to discuss such systems often leads to absurd conclusions and seriously misleads the analysis.

heading: Principles of computing orbital energies of LMOs, NBOs, and AdNDP orbitals
content: Although LMOs, NBOs, and AdNDP orbitals are not eigenfunctions of the Fock or KS operators, orbital energies can still be discussed under the one-electron approximation; by transforming the Fock or KS matrix from the original basis function representation to the representation of the corresponding orbitals, the diagonal elements give the orbital energies, expressed as <φi|f|φi>.

heading: Orbital localization methods supported by Multiwfn and their applicability

heading: 计算化学键键能时考虑BSSE的一般原则
content: 只要基组选用合理，计算化学键键能时根本没必要用counterpoise方式考虑BSSE；强行使用不仅纯属多余，甚至可能因矫枉过正导致结果精度变差。该原则已通过乙烷均裂（典型共价键）和NaCl异裂（典型离子键）在不同基组下的计算验证，参考结果是在jul-cc-pV5Z基组下计算得到的HF极限值。若审稿人在基组合理时强行要求考察BSSE，可引用相关数据进行反驳。
topic: 化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析

file: 01-量子化学方法/381_化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析_卡片.md
heading: General principle regarding BSSE consideration in chemical bond energy calculation
content: As long as the basis set selection is reasonable, there is absolutely no need to use the counterpoise approach to consider BSSE when calculating chemical bond energies; forcing its use is not only completely redundant, but may even degrade the accuracy of the results due to overcorrection. This principle has been verified through calculations of ethane homolysis (a typical covalent bond) and NaCl heterolysis (a typical ionic bond) with different basis sets, with the reference results being HF-limit values obtained with the jul-cc-pV5Z basis set. If a reviewer insists on examining BSSE when the basis set is already reasonable, the relevant data can be cited for rebuttal.
topic: Applicability analysis of BSSE correction in chemical bond energy calculation

file: 01-量子化学方法/381_化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析_卡片.md
heading: 计算共价键键能时的合理基组选择
content: 计算共价键体系键能时，使用3-zeta级别基组（如cc-pVTZ）且无需加弥散函数；对于HF/DFT计算，提升至cc-pVQZ对结果改进甚微，仅高级别电子相关方法才有必要使用4-zeta级别。在cc-pVTZ级别时BSSE影响已极小，忽略BSSE带来的误差通常小于方法本身的固有误差。
topic: 化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析
fm_title: 计算化学键键能时以counterpoise方式考虑BSSE不仅是多余的甚至是有害的

file: 01-量子化学方法/381_化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析_卡片.md
heading: Reasonable basis set selection for calculating covalent bond energies
content: When calculating bond energies of covalent systems, use a triple-zeta basis set (e.g. cc-pVTZ) without adding diffuse functions; for HF/DFT calculations, going up to cc-pVQZ yields negligible improvement, and only high-level electron correlation methods justify using quadruple-zeta level basis sets. At the cc-pVTZ level, the BSSE effect is already extremely small, and the error from neglecting BSSE is usually smaller than the intrinsic error of the method itself.
topic: Applicability analysis of BSSE correction in chemical bond energy calculation

file: 01-量子化学方法/381_化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析_卡片.md
heading: 低质量基组计算键能时的BSSE行为
content: 在使用STO-3G等极小基计算键能时，BSSE校正能显著改善结果（如乙烷均裂误差从25kcal/mol降至14kcal/mol），但实际工作中无人会使用此类低质量基组，因此不能作为计算键能必须考虑BSSE的理由。
topic: 化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析

file: 01-量子化学方法/381_化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析_卡片.md
heading: BSSE behavior when calculating bond energies with low-quality basis sets
content: When calculating bond energies with minimal basis sets such as STO-3G, BSSE correction significantly improves the results (e.g., the error for ethane homolysis drops from 25 kcal/mol to 14 kcal/mol), but in practice nobody uses such low-quality basis sets, so this cannot serve as a reason for the claim that BSSE must be considered in bond energy calculation.

file: 01-量子化学方法/381_化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析_卡片.md
heading: 常用基组在HF计算中的极化函数效果
content: 对于HF计算，给6-311G**增加更多极化函数至6-311G(2df,2p)不会带来明显精度改进；def2-TZVP的完备性高于TZVP和6-311G**，其原始结果更接近参考值且BSSE校正能更小，建议优先使用def/def2系列基组代替Pople系列基组。

file: 01-量子化学方法/381_化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析_卡片.md
heading: Effect of polarization functions of common basis sets in HF calculations
content: For HF calculations, adding more polarization functions to 6-311G** to obtain 6-311G(2df,2p) does not bring noticeable accuracy improvement; def2-TZVP has higher completeness than TZVP and 6-311G**, its raw results are closer to the reference values and its BSSE correction energy is smaller. It is recommended to preferentially use the def/def2 basis set series instead of the Pople basis set series.

file: 01-量子化学方法/381_化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析_卡片.md
heading: 计算离子键键能时弥散函数的关键作用
content: 计算NaCl等离子键异裂键能时，弥散函数对带负电荷的原子（如Cl-）至关重要；加上弥散函数（如maug-cc-pVTZ）对结果的改进远大于提升基组zeta数（如从cc-pVTZ升至cc-pV5Z）。计算时仅需给带显著负电荷的原子加弥散函数即可达到与全加弥散函数（aug-cc-pVTZ）几乎相同的效果。

file: 01-量子化学方法/381_化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析_卡片.md
heading: Key role of diffuse functions in calculating ionic bond energies
content: When calculating heterolytic bond energies of ionic bonds such as NaCl, diffuse functions are crucial for atoms carrying negative charge (e.g., Cl-). Adding diffuse functions (e.g., maug-cc-pVTZ) improves the results far more than increasing the zeta number of the basis set (e.g., from cc-pVTZ to cc-pV5Z). In practice, it suffices to add diffuse functions only to atoms carrying significant negative charge to achieve almost the same effect as adding them to all atoms (aug-cc-pVTZ).

file: 01-量子化学方法/381_化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析_卡片.md
heading: 离子键计算中弥散函数与BSSE校正的对比
content: 在离子键计算中，引入弥散函数和进行BSSE校正都能显著改进结果，但二者选其一即可；当已使用弥散函数时，BSSE影响微乎其微，再次进行校正纯属多余。弥散函数能改进体系多种性质（如静电势、极化率），而counterpoise校正仅能改进键能且无法用于优化和振动分析。
topic: 化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析
fm_title: 计算化学键键能时以counterpoise方式考虑BSSE不仅是多余的甚至是有害的

file: 01-量子化学方法/381_化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析_卡片.md
heading: Comparison between diffuse functions and BSSE correction in ionic bond calculations
content: In ionic bond calculations, both adding diffuse functions and performing BSSE correction can significantly improve the results, but either one alone suffices; when diffuse functions are already used, the BSSE effect is negligible and applying the correction again is purely redundant. Diffuse functions can improve various properties of the system (such as electrostatic potential and polarizability), whereas counterpoise correction can only improve bond energies and cannot be used in optimization and vibrational analysis.

file: 01-量子化学方法/381_化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析_卡片.md
heading: Counterpoise方法在极性键计算中的原理性失效
content: 计算极性键（如H3C-F）键能时，counterpoise方法因无法确定片段状态而原理上失效；片段若取为离子态或中性自由基，计算出的E(BSSE)差异巨大（如H3C-F体系中分别为8.30 kcal/mol和0.52 kcal/mol）。由于实际分子中电子转移是部分的，无论选取哪种状态均不合理，强行使用counterpoise必然导致键能计算误差增加。
topic: 化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析
fm_title: 计算化学键键能时以counterpoise方式考虑BSSE不仅是多余的甚至是有害的

file: 01-量子化学方法/381_化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析_卡片.md
heading: Principled failure of the counterpoise method in polar bond calculations
content: When calculating bond energies of polar bonds (e.g., H3C-F), the counterpoise method fails in principle because the fragment states cannot be determined; whether the fragments are taken as ionic or neutral radical states, the calculated E(BSSE) values differ enormously (e.g., 8.30 kcal/mol and 0.52 kcal/mol respectively for the H3C-F system). Since electron transfer in real molecules is partial, neither choice of state is reasonable, and forcibly using counterpoise inevitably increases the error in bond energy calculations.
topic: Applicability analysis of BSSE correction in chemical bond energy calculation
fm_title: 计算化学键键能时以counterpoise方式考虑BSSE不仅是多余的甚至是有害的

file: 01-量子化学方法/381_化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析_卡片.md
heading: Counterpoise校正能量计算公式
content: Counterpoise方法通过计算单体在自身基组与复合物基组下的能量差来估算BSSE校正能，公式为：E(BSSE) = [ E_A(A的基组)-E_A(AB的基组) ] + [ E_B(B的基组)-E_B(AB的基组) ]。该公式在计算弱相互作用时常用，但在计算化学键键能时若基组合理则不适用。
topic: 化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析
fm_title: 计算化学键键能时以counterpoise方式考虑BSSE不仅是多余的甚至是有害的

file: 01-量子化学方法/381_化学键键能计算中BSSE校正的适用性分析_卡片.md
heading: Formula for calculating the counterpoise correction energy
content: The counterpoise method estimates the BSSE correction energy by calculating the energy difference of each monomer with its own basis set versus the complex's basis set, with the formula: E(BSSE) = [ E_A(A's basis set) - E_A(AB's basis set) ] + [ E_B(B's basis set) - E_B(AB's basis set) ]. This formula is commonly used in the calculation of weak interactions, but it is not applicable when calculating chemical bond energies if the basis set is reasonable.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/383_Multiwfn绘制构象权重平均光谱_卡片.md
heading: 构象权重平均光谱的定义与计算规则
content: 柔性分子在热平衡状态下的构象分布比例使用Boltzmann公式基于相对自由能计算，为了得到与实际相符的理论光谱，应对分布大于10%（严格时大于5%）的所有构象分别计算光谱，并按照构象分布比例进行加权线性组合，这种方式得到的理论光谱称为权重平均光谱或构象平均光谱。Multiwfn从3.4版开始支持直接绘制此类光谱。具体原理和构象分布计算可参考《根据Boltzmann分布计算分子不同构象所占比例》一文。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/383_Multiwfn绘制构象权重平均光谱_卡片.md
heading: Definition and calculation rules of the conformationally weighted average spectrum
content: The conformational distribution proportions of a flexible molecule under thermal equilibrium are calculated using the Boltzmann formula based on relative free energies. To obtain theoretical spectra consistent with experiment, spectra should be calculated separately for all conformers with population greater than 10% (strictly greater than 5%), and then combined as a weighted linear combination according to the conformational distribution proportions; the theoretical spectrum obtained this way is called the weighted average spectrum or conformationally averaged spectrum. Starting from version 3.4, Multiwfn supports directly plotting such spectra. For the detailed principles and calculation of conformational distributions, refer to the article 《根据Boltzmann分布计算分子不同构象所占比例》.

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/383_Multiwfn绘制构象权重平均光谱_卡片.md
heading: 实例计算步骤与参数设置
content: 以plumericin的四种构象a,b,c,d为例，计算其构象平均UV-Vis和ECD光谱需依次执行：(1)在B3LYP/6-31G*下优化结构；(2)在B3LYP/6-31G*下进行振动分析并加入ZPE校正因子0.9806得到自由能校正量；(3)在M06-2X/def2-TZVP下做单点计算；(4)将自由能校正量与单点能相加得到自由能并计算常温下的分布比例；(5)用PBE1PBE/TZVP TD(nstates=20)关键词计算最低20个激发态。若追求定量准确的分布比例，应使用更高级别如DSD-PBEP86-D3/def2-QZVP计算单点能，且涉及溶剂时必须使用溶剂模型。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析
topic: Multiwfn绘制构象权重平均光谱
fm_title: 使用Multiwfn绘制构象权重平均的光谱

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/383_Multiwfn绘制构象权重平均光谱_卡片.md
heading: Example calculation steps and parameter settings
content: Taking the four conformers a, b, c, d of plumericin as an example, calculating their conformationally averaged UV-Vis and ECD spectra involves the following steps: (1) obtain optimized structures at B3LYP/6-31G*; (2) perform vibrational analysis at B3LYP/6-31G* and apply the ZPE correction factor of 0.9806 to obtain the free energy correction; (3) perform single-point calculations at M06-2X/def2-TZVP; (4) add the free energy correction to the single-point energy to obtain free energies and calculate the room-temperature distribution proportions; (5) use the PBE1PBE/TZVP TD(nstates=20) keyword to calculate the lowest 20 excited states. If quantitatively accurate distribution proportions are desired, single-point energies should be computed at a higher level such as DSD-PBEP86-D3/def2-QZVP, and a solvation model must be used when solvent is involved.

heading: 权重配置文件multiple.txt的格式
content: 使用Multiwfn绘制构象平均光谱需在当前目录下创建名为multiple.txt的文件，每一行填写一个构象的计算输出文件路径和相应的出现比率。文件路径可使用相对路径或绝对路径，在Linux环境下若路径包含/符号或空格，必须在路径两边加上双引号。虽然本例使用Gaussian输出文件，但Multiwfn也支持ORCA、sTDA等程序输出文件，且允许在multiple.txt中混用不同来源的文件。

heading: Format of the weight configuration file multiple.txt
content: To plot conformationally averaged spectra with Multiwfn, create a file named multiple.txt in the current directory, with each line containing the path to a conformer's calculation output file and the corresponding population ratio. File paths can be relative paths or absolute paths; on Linux, if a path contains the / symbol or spaces, double quotes must be placed around the path. Although this example uses Gaussian output files, Multiwfn also supports output files from programs such as ORCA and sTDA, and allows mixing files from different sources in multiple.txt.

heading: 绘制构象平均UV-Vis光谱的操作
content: 启动Multiwfn并载入multiple.txt文件，依次输入11（绘制光谱主功能）、3（UV-Vis）、0（显示光谱）即可生成构象平均UV-Vis光谱。图中红色粗曲线为权重平均光谱，其余颜色曲线分别为各构象的光谱，黑色竖线是所有构象经过权重乘积后的激发能和强度数据集合。若要查看各构象对平均光谱的贡献曲线，需先关闭当前图，选择选项18，再选0重新绘制，此时各构象曲线高度已乘以分布比率，其和即为权重平均光谱。

heading: Procedure for plotting the conformationally averaged UV-Vis spectrum
content: Launch Multiwfn, load the multiple.txt file, then enter 11 (plotting main function), 3 (UV-Vis), 0 (show spectrum) to generate the conformationally averaged UV-Vis spectrum. In the plot, the thick red curve is the weighted average spectrum, the other colored curves are the spectra of the individual conformers, and the black vertical lines are the set of excitation energies and intensities of all conformers after weighted aggregation. To view the contribution curves of each conformer to the average spectrum, first close the current plot, choose option 18, then choose 0 to redraw; the conformer curves are then scaled by their population ratios, and their sum is the weighted average spectrum.

heading: 绘制构象平均ECD光谱的操作
content: 载入multiple.txt文件后，依次输入11（绘制光谱主功能）、4（ECD）、2（载入速度表象的转子强度）。为便于分析，可先选16找出权重平均ECD谱的极值点，再选0显示光谱。圆二色谱对构象敏感度高，通过比较权重平均谱（红曲线）与各构象谱（如a构象绿曲线）可看出构象贡献差异。选择选项18后再选0，可绘制各构象对平均ECD谱的贡献曲线，通过分析曲线正负叠加情况（如c构象在181.7nm处的正贡献与a构象的抵消）可解析峰的来源。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/383_Multiwfn绘制构象权重平均光谱_卡片.md
heading: Procedure for plotting the conformationally averaged ECD spectrum
content: After loading the multiple.txt file, enter 11 (plotting main function), 4 (ECD), 2 (load rotatory strengths in velocity representation). For easier analysis, first choose 16 to locate the extrema of the weighted average ECD spectrum, then choose 0 to display the spectrum. Circular dichroism spectra are highly sensitive to conformation; by comparing the weighted average spectrum (red curve) with the spectra of individual conformers (e.g., the green curve of conformer a), the differences in conformational contributions can be seen. After choosing option 18 and then 0, the contribution curves of each conformer to the average ECD spectrum can be plotted; by analyzing how the curves superpose positively and negatively (e.g., the positive contribution of conformer c at 181.7 nm being cancelled out by conformer a), the origin of the peaks can be resolved.

heading: Spectrum data export and display settings

heading: 多体系光谱的同时绘制
content: 在2017-Aug-14及之后更新的Multiwfn版本中，可以通过修改multiple.txt实现多个体系光谱的对比绘制。将multiple.txt中的权重值替换为自定义的图例文字，程序将不会计算总光谱，而是同时显示所有指定体系的曲线。例如，将文件内容写为"文件路径 图例文字"的格式，即可将不同分子或不同计算级别（如ZINDO、TD-PBE0）的光谱绘制在同一张图上进行对比。

heading: Simultaneous Plotting of Spectra for Multiple Systems
content: In Multiwfn versions updated on 2017-Aug-14 and later, comparative plotting of spectra for multiple systems can be achieved by modifying multiple.txt. file: 01-量子化学方法/387_几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略_卡片.md
heading: 几何优化和振动分析的基组选择常识
content: 量化计算中有两个常识：(1)优化和振动分析必须在相同级别下进行，否则振动分析结果无意义；(2)在高耗时计算时建议对优化和振动分析使用中小基组，仅在单点能计算时使用大基组，这能大幅降低耗时而精度损失很小。
topic: 几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略
fm_title: 浅谈为什么优化和振动分析不需要用大基组

file: 01-量子化学方法/387_几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略_卡片.md
heading: Common Knowledge on Basis Set Selection for Geometry Optimization and Vibrational Analysis
content: There are two pieces of common knowledge in quantum chemical calculation: (1) optimization and vibrational analysis must be performed at the same level, otherwise the vibrational analysis results are meaningless; (2) for highly time-consuming calculation, it is recommended to use small-to-medium basis sets for optimization and vibrational analysis, and use large basis set only for single-point energy calculation, which can greatly reduce the time cost with very little loss of accuracy.
topic: Basis set selection strategy for geometry optimization and vibrational analysis

heading: 热力学量对优化基组的敏感性
content: J. Chem. Theory Comput. (2023) DOI: 10.1021/acs.jctc.3c00388 系统性测试发现，几何优化+振动分析用从小到大不同基组时，对最终热力学量的影响大多小于1 kcal/mol。
topic: 几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略

heading: Sensitivity of Thermodynamic Quantities to the Optimization Basis Set
content: A systematic test in J. Chem. Theory Comput. (2023) DOI: 10.1021/acs.jctc.3c00388 found that when geometry optimization plus vibrational analysis is performed with basis sets from small to large, the effect on the final thermodynamic quantities is mostly less than 1 kcal/mol.

heading: 低频模式下的基组敏感度与准RRHO模型
content: 存在低频模式时，反应自由能对优化+振动分析用的基组更敏感，但如果使用准RRHO模型计算热力学校正量代替默认的RRHO，则敏感度会大幅降低。
topic: 几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略

file: 01-量子化学方法/387_几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略_卡片.md
heading: Basis Set Sensitivity with Low-Frequency Modes and the Quasi-RRHO Model
content: When low-frequency modes are present, the reaction free energy is more sensitive to the basis set used for optimization plus vibrational analysis; however, if the quasi-RRHO model is used to compute thermodynamic corrections instead of the default RRHO model, the sensitivity is greatly reduced.
topic: Basis set selection strategy for geometry optimization and vibrational analysis

file: 01-量子化学方法/387_几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略_卡片.md
heading: 几何结构对基组的敏感性
content: 几何优化结果对基组的敏感性远低于能量计算，从def2-SVP提升到def2-QZVP，HF分子键长误差仅0.3%，振动频率误差仅0.13%，在要求不高时完全可接受；但能量误差达4.5%，完全不可忽略。
topic: 几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略
fm_title: 浅谈为什么优化和振动分析不需要用大基组

file: 01-量子化学方法/387_几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略_卡片.md
heading: Sensitivity of Geometric Structure to the Basis Set
content: The results of geometry optimization are far less sensitive to the basis set than energy calculation: from def2-SVP up to def2-QZVP, the HF molecule bond length error is only 0.3% and the vibrational frequency error is only 0.13%, which is fully acceptable when requirements are not high; but the energy error reaches 4.5%, which is completely non-negligible.
topic: Basis set selection strategy for geometry optimization and vibrational analysis
fm_title: 浅谈为什么优化和振动分析不需要用大基组

file: 01-量子化学方法/387_几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略_卡片.md
heading: 高精度计算的基组搭配策略
content: 对于想要高精度结构和能量数据的情况，优化用到def2-TZVPP就已经绝对足够，再提升是白费时间；算能量时基组则完全有必要用到def2-QZVP，特别是对于后HF计算。
topic: 几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略
fm_title: 浅谈为什么优化和振动分析不需要用大基组

file: 01-量子化学方法/387_几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略_卡片.md
heading: Basis Set Combination Strategy for High-Accuracy Calculations
content: For cases where high-accuracy structural and energetic data are desired, def2-TZVPP for optimization is absolutely sufficient; going higher is a waste of time. Meanwhile, def2-QZVP basis set fully necessary for single-point energy calculations, especially for post-HF calculation.
topic: Basis set selection strategy for geometry optimization and vibrational analysis
fm_title: 浅谈为什么优化和振动分析不需要用大基组

file: 01-量子化学方法/387_几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略_卡片.md
heading: 氢原子极化函数的影响
content: 对于HF等与氢密切相关的体系，给氢加极化函数至关重要，砍掉氢的p极化会导致键长和频率误差显著增加，因此建议起码使用def2-SVP或6-31G**。
topic: 几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略
fm_title: 浅谈为什么优化和振动分析不需要用大基组

file: 01-量子化学方法/387_几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略_卡片.md
heading: Effect of Polarization Functions on Hydrogen Atoms
content: For hydrogen-related systems such as HF, adding polarization functions on hydrogen is crucial: removing the p polarization on hydrogen leads to a significant increase in bond length and frequency errors, so it is recommended to use at least def2-SVP or 6-31G**.
topic: Basis set selection strategy for geometry optimization and vibrational analysis

file: 01-量子化学方法/387_几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略_卡片.md
heading: 势能面扫描解释基组敏感度
content: 势能面扫描显示，def2-TZVPP与def2-QZVP的曲线几乎重合，导致结构和频率差异极小；def2-SVP的谷底横坐标与def2-TZVPP几乎无差别，因此几何优化误差可忽略，但能量（势阱深度）误差明显。
topic: 几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略
fm_title: 浅谈为什么优化和振动分析不需要用大基组

file: 01-量子化学方法/387_几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略_卡片.md
heading: Potential Energy Surface Scan Explains Basis Set Sensitivity
content: A potential energy surface scan shows that the curves of def2-TZVPP and def2-QZVP almost overlap, resulting in extremely small differences in structure and frequency; the abscissa of the valley bottom of def2-SVP is nearly indistinguishable from that of def2-TZVPP, so the geometry optimization error is negligible, but the energy (potential well depth) error is evident.
topic: Basis set selection strategy for geometry optimization and vibrational analysis
fm_title: 浅谈为什么优化和振动分析不需要用大基组

file: 01-量子化学方法/387_几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略_卡片.md
heading: 过渡金属和特殊体系的基组敏感度
content: 不同体系对基组的敏感性有差异，如过渡金属配位键键长的优化结果在def2-SVP和def2-TZVP下差异往往明显；18碳环在6-31G*下优化结果不合理，需用如6-311G*、def-TZVP等更贵的基组。
topic: 几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略

file: 01-量子化学方法/387_几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略_卡片.md
heading: Basis Set Sensitivity of Transition Metals and Special Systems
content: Different systems differ in their sensitivity to the basis set. For example, the optimized bond lengths of transition metal coordination bonds often differ noticeably between def2-SVP and def2-TZVP; the 18-carbon ring gives unreasonable optimization results with 6-31G*, requiring more expensive basis sets such as 6-311G*, def-TZVP, etc.
topic: Basis set selection strategy for geometry optimization and vibrational analysis
fm_title: 浅谈为什么优化和振动分析不需要用大基组

file: 01-量子化学方法/387_几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略_卡片.md
heading: 电子结构性质的基组敏感度
content: 偶极矩、(超)极化率、NMR等与电子结构直接相关的属性对基组的敏感度远高于几何优化和振动分析，因此计算这些属性前的优化过程建议使用中小基组。
topic: 几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略
fm_title: 浅谈为什么优化和振动分析不需要用大基组

file: 01-量子化学方法/387_几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略_卡片.md
heading: Basis Set Sensitivity of Electronic-Structure Properties
content: Electronic-structure-dependent properties such as dipole moment, (hyper)polarizability, and NMR are far more sensitive to the basis set than geometry optimization and vibrational analysis; therefore, it is recommended to use small-to-medium basis sets for the optimization prior to calculating these properties.
topic: Basis set selection strategy for geometry optimization and vibrational analysis

file: 01-量子化学方法/387_几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略_卡片.md
heading: Raman和ROA计算的基组策略
content: Raman或ROA计算允许两步分开做：(1)优化和振动分析用不带弥散函数的基组以节约时间；(2)计算极化率导数时用带弥散函数的基组以改进结果，因为弥散函数对极化率计算改进明显。
topic: 几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略
fm_title: 浅谈为什么优化和振动分析不需要用大基组

file: 01-量子化学方法/387_几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略_卡片.md
heading: Basis Set Strategy for Raman and ROA Calculations
content: Raman or ROA calculation allows the two steps to be done separately: (1) basis set without diffuse functions for optimization and vibrational analysis to save time; (2) basis set with diffuse functions for polarizability derivative calculations to improve the results, because diffuse functions clearly improve polarizability calculation.
topic: Basis set selection strategy for geometry optimization and vibrational analysis

file: 01-量子化学方法/387_几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略_卡片.md
heading: 几何优化与单点能计算的理论方法搭配
content: 为节约时间，几何优化+振动分析不仅可以用更小的基组，还可以用更便宜的理论方法，例如CCSD(T)算能量而DFT做几何优化和振动分析，或者前者用双杂化泛函后者用普通泛函。
topic: 几何优化与振动分析基组选择策略

heading: Combining Theoretical Methods for Geometry Optimization and Single-Point Energy Calculation
content: To save time, geometry optimization plus vibrational analysis can use not only a smaller basis set, but also a cheaper theoretical method, for example CCSD(T) for energies while DFT for geometry optimization and vibrational analysis, or double-hybrid functional for the former, ordinary functional for the latter.

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: DFT/MRCI方法原理与特点
content: DFT/MRCI是基于DFT轨道并用DFT交换相关势构造CI哈密顿来做MRCI的方法，对CI非对角矩阵元做了scale使之指数地降为0以避免动态相关double-counting，且只选取重要的CSF。该方法比传统MRCI省时，可引入RI进一步降低耗时，精度和CASPT2差不多（相对误差<0.2eV），计算激发能比TDDFT好。文献出处：JCP,111,5645(1999)。
topic: Grimme理论化学贡献盘点
fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: Principles and Features of the DFT/MRCI Method
content: DFT/MRCI is a method that performs MRCI using DFT orbitals and a CI Hamiltonian constructed with the DFT exchange-correlation potential; the off-diagonal CI matrix elements are scaled so that they decay exponentially to 0 to avoid double-counting of dynamic correlation, and only important CSFs are selected. The method is faster than traditional MRCI, RI can be introduced to further reduce the time cost, and its accuracy is comparable to CASPT2 (relative error <0.2 eV); for excited energy calculation it performs better than TDDFT. Reference: JCP,111,5645(1999).
topic: Overview of theoretical chemistry contributions
fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: 大体系弱相互作用计算推荐组合
content: "RI-纯泛函-gCP-D3/def2-SVP"是计算大体系弱相互作用又快又好的推荐组合，其中RIJ技术加速纯泛函计算，gCP解决中小基组的不足，DFT-D解决泛函的不足。一般推荐优化用这个组合，算能量时切换到更好的def2-TZVP。
topic: Grimme理论化学贡献盘点
fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: Recommended Combination for Weak Interaction Calculation of Large Systems
content: "RI pure functional gCP-D3/def2-SVP" is the recommended combination for calculation of weak interactions in large systems, being both fast and good: the RIJ technique accelerates pure functional calculations, gCP remedies the deficiency of small-to-medium basis sets, and DFT-D remedies the deficiency of the functional. It is generally recommended to use this combination for optimization and to switch to the better def2-TZVP for energy calculation.
topic: Overview of theoretical chemistry contributions
fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: 低频振动模式对熵贡献的处理
content: 对于大体系中经常出现的低频振动模式（如小于100cm-1），Grimme提出用谐振模型得到的熵和按照自由转子模型考虑得到的熵进行插值来得到其对熵的贡献，这比直接用阈值频率替换更为优雅、准确。文献出处：Chem. Eur. J., 18, 9955 (2012)。
topic: Grimme理论化学贡献盘点
fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: Treatment of the Entropy Contribution of Low-Frequency Vibrational Modes
content: For low-frequency modes (e.g., below 100 cm-1) that frequently occur in large systems, it was proposed to obtain their entropy contribution by interpolating between the entropy from the harmonic model and the entropy based on the free-rotor model, which is more elegant and accurate than directly replacing them with a threshold frequency. Reference: Chem. Eur. J., 18, 9955 (2012).
topic: Overview of theoretical chemistry contributions
fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: sTDA与sTD-DFT方法
content: sTDA是基于DFT轨道的快速做TDA近似形式的TDDFT计算方法，计算大体系大量激发态的总耗时基本上等同于DFT单点耗时。sTD-DFT是把sTDA的思想直接用在TDDFT上以避免TDA-DFT算振子强度和转子强度差的问题。两者在ORCA中都已直接支持。文献出处：JCP,138,244104(2013)；CTC,1040-1041,45(2014)。
topic: Grimme理论化学贡献盘点
fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: The sTDA and sTD-DFT methods
content: sTDA is a fast method for TDDFT calculation within the TDA approximation based on DFT orbitals; the total time for computing a large number of excited states of a large system is roughly the same as the cost of a DFT single-point calculation. sTD-DFT applies the sTDA idea directly to TDDFT to avoid the poor oscillator and rotatory strengths of TDA-DFT. Both are directly supported in ORCA. References: JCP,138,244104(2013); CTC,1040-1041,45(2014).
topic: Overview of contributions to theoretical chemistry
fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: sTDA-xTB方法
content: sTDA-xTB把sTDA过程的基态部分计算用类似SCC-DFTB的形式来实现，用于甚至蛋白质、核酸这样的巨大体系都不成问题，适合结合动力学平均计算光谱。文献出处：JCP,145,054103(2016)。
topic: Grimme理论化学贡献盘点
fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: The sTDA-xTB method
content: sTDA-xTB implements the ground-state part of the sTDA procedure in a manner similar to SCC-DFTB; it works without problem even for very large systems such as proteins and nucleic acids, and is well suited to computing spectra combined with dynamics. Reference: JCP,145,054103(2016).
topic: Overview of contributions to theoretical chemistry
fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: HF-3c方法
content: HF-3c是用HF结合MINIX基组进行计算，并引入DFT-D3校正、gCP校正以及对基组的短程修正项这三个校正，因此叫3c。HF-3c耗时介于B3LYP/6-31G*与半经验方法之间，适合快速粗糙地计算大体系。文献出处：JCC,34,1672(2013)。
topic: Grimme理论化学贡献盘点
fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: The HF-3c method
content: HF-3c uses HF combined with the MINIX basis set, and introduces three corrections: the DFT-D3 correction, the gCP correction, and a short-range basis set correction term, hence the name 3c. The cost of HF-3c lies between B3LYP/6-31G* and semiempirical methods, and it is suitable for fast approximate calculation of large systems. Reference: JCC,34,1672(2013).
topic: Overview of contributions to theoretical chemistry
fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: PBEh-3c方法
content: PBEh-3c使用PBEh泛函（PBE0的HF成份提升到42%）结合修改版def2-SV(P)进行计算，同时引入gCP、DFT-D3校正项（另一个c指对基组的修改）。PBEh-3c在能量、结构、振动分析方面结果不错，但在ORCA中目前无法用RIJCOSX加速所以较昂贵。文献出处：JCP,143,054107(2015)。
topic: Grimme理论化学贡献盘点
fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: The PBEh-3c method
content: PBEh-3c uses the PBEh functional (PBE0 with the HF component raised to 42%) combined with a modified def2-SV(P) basis set, and also introduces gCP and DFT-D3 correction terms (the other c refers to the basis set modification). PBEh-3c gives good results for energy, structure and vibration analysis, but in ORCA it currently cannot be accelerated with RIJCOSX, so it is rather expensive. Reference: JCP,143,054107(2015).
topic: Overview of contributions to theoretical chemistry
fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: HSE-3c方法
content: HSE-3c是将gCP和D3用到HSE06上并结合特定基组，思想和PBEh-3c类似，主要适合周期性、凝聚相体系，相比PBEh-3c对这类问题计算耗时低得多。文献出处：Phys.Chem.Chem.Phys.,18,15519(2016)。
topic: Grimme理论化学贡献盘点
fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: The HSE-3c method
content: HSE-3c applies gCP and D3 to HSE06 combined with a specific basis set; its idea is similar to PBEh-3c, and it is mainly suited to periodic and condensed-phase systems, for which its computational cost is much lower than PBEh-3c. Reference: Phys.Chem.Chem.Phys.,18,15519(2016).
topic: Overview of contributions to theoretical chemistry
fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: B97-3c方法
content: B97-3c是修改版B97纯泛函与mTZVP基组、D3校正、SRB校正的组合，SRB用于校正纯泛函高估键长的问题。B97-3c没有gCP校正项，计算分子晶体晶格能好于HSE-3c，是一个很值得使用的方法，在ORCA里对较大体系耗时和RI-BLYP/def2-SVP基本持平。文献出处：JCP,148,064104(2018)。

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: The B97-3c method
content: B97-3c is a combination of a modified B97 pure functional with the mTZVP basis set, the D3 correction, and the SRB correction, where SRB corrects the tendency of pure functionals to overestimate bond lengths. B97-3c has no gCP correction term, performs better than HSE-3c for the lattice energy of molecular crystals, and is a method well worth using; in ORCA its cost for larger systems is essentially the same as RI-BLYP/def2-SVP. Reference: JCP,148,064104(2018).

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: r2SCAN-3c方法
content: r2SCAN-3c使用原版r2SCAN泛函，结合修改版def2-TZVP基组（mTZVPP）、重新拟合参数的DFT-D4、gCP，没有SRB校正。其结果比B97-3c改进挺大，算相互作用能往往强于B3LYP-D4和B97-3c，耗时是B97-3c的两倍左右。从ORCA 5.0开始支持。文献出处：JCP,154,064103(2020)。
topic: Grimme理论化学贡献盘点
fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: The r2SCAN-3c method
content: r2SCAN-3c uses the original r2SCAN functional, combined with a modified def2-TZVP basis set (mTZVPP), a re-fitted DFT-D4, and gCP, without the SRB correction. Its results improve considerably over B97-3c; for interaction energy it often outperforms B3LYP-D4 and B97-3c, while costing about twice as much as B97-3c. Supported from ORCA 5.0 onward. Reference: JCP,154,064103(2020).

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: wB97X-3c方法
content: wB97X-3c把wB97X-V泛函的VV10改成了D4，并优化了一种叫vDZP的2-zeta档次的基组（对重元素结合大核赝势）。wB97X-3c算势垒、反应能、弱相互作用不错，整体比r2SCAN-3c更强，离域性误差问题很小，是截止到2024年精度最高的3c方法。文献出处：JCP, 158, 014103 (2023)。
topic: Grimme理论化学贡献盘点
fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: The wB97X-3c method
content: wB97X-3c replaces the VV10 of the wB97X-V functional with D4, and optimizes a new double-zeta quality basis set called vDZP (with a large-core pseudopotential for heavy elements). wB97X-3c is good for calculation of barrier and reaction energy as well as weak interactions, is overall stronger than r2SCAN-3c, exhibits very little delocalization error, and is the most accurate 3c method as of 2024. Reference: JCP, 158, 014103 (2023).

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: SCS-MP2方法的原理与优势
content: SCS-MP2方法给MP2相关能中自旋平行电子对和自旋相反电子对的贡献分别乘以结合理论和经验选择的系数，使得计算化学反应能量方面精度比MP2提升巨大，而耗时和MP2完全一样。SCS-MP2在ORCA等程序中可直接使用，在Gaussian中也可通过IOp实现。文献出处：JCP,118,9095(2003)。
topic: Grimme理论化学贡献盘点
fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: Principle and advantages of the SCS-MP2 method
content: The SCS-MP2 method multiplies the contributions of parallel-spin and opposite-spin electron pairs in the MP2 correlation energy by coefficients chosen from combined theoretical and empirical considerations, greatly improving the accuracy over MP2 for computing chemical reaction energies while the cost is exactly the same as MP2. SCS-MP2 can be used directly in programs such as ORCA, and can also be realized in Gaussian via IOp. Reference: JCP,118,9095(2003).

fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: FOD（分数占据数加权电子密度）
content: FOD（Fractional occupation number weighted electron density）是以图形化方式展现不同区域静态相关强弱的方法，基于轨道密度定义，涉及的轨道占据数需要做有限温度的分数占据DFT计算。对FOD进行全空间积分的N_FOD值可以定量考察整体的静态相关强弱。文献出处：Angew. Chem. Int. Ed., 54, 1 (2015)。

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: FOD (fractionally occupied orbital weighted electron density)
content: FOD (Fractional occupation number weighted electron density) is a method for visualizing the strength of static correlation in different regions graphically. It is defined in terms of orbital densities, and the orbital occupations involved require a fractional-occupation DFT calculation at finite temperature. The N_FOD value obtained by full-space integration of the FOD allows a quantitative assessment of the overall strength of static correlation. Reference: Angew. Chem. Int. Ed., 54, 1 (2015).

fm_title: 盘点Grimme迄今对理论化学的贡献

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: GFN-xTB半经验方法
content: GFN-xTB（Geometry, Frequency, Noncovalent, eXtended TB）期望以很便宜的方式把几何优化、频率计算、弱相互作用等问题都算得不错，能用于上千原子大体系。GFN2-xTB结合了DFT-D4，基本在计算弱相互作用方面总能胜过PM6-D3H4X。参数化元素非常全（一直到86号元素），对过渡金属体系可靠性远高于PM6、PM7。文献出处：JCTC,13,1989(2017)；DOI: 10.1021/acs.jctc.8b01176 (2019)。

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: The GFN-xTB semiempirical method
content: GFN-xTB (Geometry, Frequency, Noncovalent, eXtended TB) aims to handle geometry optimization, frequency calculation, weak interactions and other problems reasonably well at very low cost, and can be used for large systems with thousands of atoms. GFN2-xTB incorporates DFT-D4 and essentially always beats PM6-D3H4X for the calculation of weak interactions. Its parametrized elements are very comprehensive (up to element 86), and its reliability for transition metal systems is far higher than PM6 and PM7. References: JCTC,13,1989(2017); DOI: 10.1021/acs.jctc.8b01176 (2019).

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: GFN-FF力场
content: GFN-FF是一个普适的可极化力场，支持1到86号元素，各类体系都能算，形式比常见的AMBER、GROMOS、OPLS-AA复杂不少。在2021年将其推广到了周期性体系后叫做pGFN-FF。文献出处：Angew. Chem. Int. Ed., 59, 15665 (2020)；JCTC DOI:10.1021/acs.jctc.1c00832 (2021)。

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: The GFN-FF force field
content: GFN-FF is a universal polarizable force field supporting elements 1 to 86, applicable to all kinds of systems, with a form considerably more complex than the common AMBER, GROMOS, and OPLS-AA. In 2021 it was extended to periodic systems under the name pGFN-FF. References: Angew. Chem. Int. Ed., 59, 15665 (2020); JCTC DOI:10.1021/acs.jctc.1c00832 (2021).

file: 01-量子化学方法/388_Grimme理论化学贡献盘点_卡片.md
heading: GMTKN测试集
content: GMTKN测试集是大规模、全面性的用于测试理论方法计算精度的测试集，并且不断扩充。最初的GMTKN24测试集原文为JCTC,6,107(2010)，目前最新的版本是GMTKN55。文献出处：PCCP,19,32184(2017)。
