file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 结构合理性检查
content: SCF是否容易收敛和结构的合理性关系极大，化学意义越强的结构通常越容易收敛。遇到SCF很难收敛时，需要结合结构化学、固体物理常识检查结构是否靠谱，如模型是否有意义、是否漏了原子、是否某些原子所处的化学环境和实际明显不符。且要结合图像肉眼检查，确保不存在不该出现的结构严重扭曲、盒子边缘原子和周期镜像原子发生过近接触等问题，否则SCF能收敛也毫无意义。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Structural plausibility check
content: Whether SCF converges easily is strongly related to the plausibility of the structure; structures with stronger chemical meaning are usually easier to converge. When difficult SCF convergence is encountered, use knowledge of structural chemistry and solid-state physics to check whether the structure is plausible, e.g., whether the model is meaningful, whether any atoms are missing, or whether the chemical environment of some atoms clearly contradicts reality. Also perform a visual inspection with graphical tools to ensure there are no problems that should not occur, such as severe structural distortions or atoms at the box edge being in too-close contact with their periodic mirror images; otherwise, even if SCF converges, the result is meaningless.
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence problems in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 杂化泛函积分屏蔽注意事项
content: 做杂化泛函计算时（特别是对于周期性体系）通常会在&DFT / &XC / &HF / &SCREENING里开启SCREEN_ON_INITIAL_P从而基于初始的密度矩阵做双电子积分的屏蔽。若此时没有读取之前收敛的波函数当初猜（通常是便宜得多的纯泛函计算的），则CP2K会基于自动初猜的波函数对应的密度矩阵做积分屏蔽，此时结果通常无意义，SCF能收敛的概率也非常低。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Notes on integral screening in hybrid functional calculations
content: When performing hybrid functional calculations (especially for periodic systems), SCREEN_ON_INITIAL_P is usually enabled in &DFT / &XC / &HF / &SCREENING so that two-electron integrals are screened based on the initial density matrix. If at this point a previously converged wavefunction (usually from a much cheaper pure functional calculation) is not read as the initial guess, CP2K will perform integral screening based on the density matrix corresponding to the automatically generated initial guess wavefunction; in this case the results are usually meaningless, and the probability of SCF convergence is also very low.
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence problems in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: k点设置
content: 确保恰当考虑了k点、k点数够多。如果晶胞边长不够大，显然必须考虑k点而不能只用默认的Gamma点。而且k点设得还得够多，否则SCF难收敛极为正常。k点如果设置不当，就算SCF能收敛了也没意义，算能量问题时k点应当大到足以令能量随k点数增加而基本收敛的程度。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: k-point settings
content: Make sure k-points are properly considered and that the number of k-points is sufficiently large. If the unit cell edge length is not large enough, k-points obviously must be considered rather than using only the default Gamma point. Moreover, the k-point sampling must be dense enough; otherwise, difficult SCF convergence is completely normal. If the k-points are set improperly, even if SCF converges the result is meaningless; for energy calculations, the k-point sampling should be large enough that the energy is essentially converged with respect to increasing the number of k-points.
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence problems in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 调整格点截断能
content: 尝试增大&DFT / &MGRID里的CUTOFF、REL_CUTOFF。这两个截断能设置控制格点精度，不够大的话不仅结果不准，甚至可能造成SCF难收敛。如果当前明显已经够大了，就没必要再盲目尝试再增加了。虽然有说法尝试&DFT / &XC / &XC_GRID里写USE_FINER_GRID T将计算交换-相关泛函部分的格点精度提升为CUTOFF的四倍，但根据经验这并没有什么实际用处，而耗时暴增。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Adjusting grid cutoff energies
content: Try increasing CUTOFF and REL_CUTOFF in &DFT / &MGRID. These two cutoff energy settings control the grid accuracy; if they are not large enough, not only will the results be inaccurate, but difficult SCF convergence may even result. If the current values are clearly already large enough, there is no need to blindly keep increasing them. Although it has been suggested to set USE_FINER_GRID T in &DFT / &XC / &XC_GRID to raise the grid accuracy of the exchange-correlation functional part to four times CUTOFF, experience shows this has no practical use, while the computational cost increases dramatically.
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence problems in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 调整初猜波函数中的原子组态
content: 初猜波函数中的孤立原子的组态越接近整个体系收敛的波函数中原子的实际组态则SCF越容易收敛。计算孤立原子所用的电子组态可以通过&KIND里的MAGNETIZATION（定义alpha电子数减beta电子数）或者&BS（可以具体控制各个主量子数的各个角量子数上的alpha和beta电子数）来设置。若体系有磁性且SCF不收敛，应尝试用MAGNETIZATION或&BS尽可能令初猜波函数中原子组态与实际情况接近。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Adjusting atomic configurations in the initial guess wavefunction
content: The closer the configurations of isolated atoms in the initial guess wavefunction are to the actual atomic configurations in the converged wavefunction of the whole system, the easier the SCF convergence. The electron configurations used for computing isolated atoms can be set via MAGNETIZATION in &KIND (defining the number of alpha electrons minus beta electrons) or &BS (which allows detailed control of the numbers of alpha and beta electrons in each angular momentum shell of each principal quantum number). If the system is magnetic and SCF does not converge, try using MAGNETIZATION or &BS to make the atomic configurations in the initial guess wavefunction as close to reality as possible.
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence problems in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 利用离子性特征调整初猜
content: 即便体系没有磁性，利用&BS使初猜波函数中的原子带电状态使之尽可能符合实际也往往是有益的。例如对于NaCl这样高度离子性体系计算时SCF不收敛，可以尝试令初猜中Na和Cl的原子组态分别对应Na+和Cl-的状态（默认情况下分别对应中性的Na和Cl）。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Using ionic character to adjust the initial guess
content: Even if the system is not magnetic, using &BS to make the charge states of the atoms in the initial guess wavefunction match reality as closely as possible is often beneficial. For example, when SCF does not converge for a highly ionic system such as NaCl, try setting the atomic configurations of Na and Cl in the initial guess to correspond to Na+ and Cl- states (by default they correspond to neutral Na and Cl).
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence problems in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 调整数值精度参数
content: 尝试将&QS / EPS_DEFAULT减小几个数量级，默认为1E-10。EPS_DEFAULT这个参数控制一堆涉及数值计算精度的参数，如果设得太大，有可能造成SCF难收敛。若这个数值当前已经很小了，比如都1E-12了，尝试继续减小则没必要。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Adjusting numerical precision parameters
content: Try decreasing &QS / EPS_DEFAULT by a few orders of magnitude; the default is 1E-10. EPS_DEFAULT controls a bunch of parameters related to numerical computation accuracy; if set too large, it may cause difficult SCF convergence. If this value is already very small, e.g., 1E-12, further decreasing it is unnecessary.
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence problems in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 更换泛函、基组或方法
content: 改用其它泛函、基组。如果原先的计算级别就是极难收敛，而有其它级别性价比、精度相仿佛，且发现能收敛，那就别死磕当前的了。也可以在GPW与GAPW之间切换，如果之前用的GPW结合GTH赝势基组不收敛，尝试用GPAW结合一个全电子基组计算试试，反之亦然。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Changing the functional, basis set, or method
content: Switch to a different functional or basis set. If the original level of theory is extremely hard to converge, but another level with comparable cost-effectiveness and accuracy is found to converge, stop struggling with the current one. You can also switch between GPW and GAPW: if GPW combined with a GTH pseudopotential basis set did not converge, try GPAW combined with an all-electron basis set, and vice versa.
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence problems in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 修改波函数产生方式与原子SCF迭代
content: 修改默认产生波函数的方式，参见手册里&SCF / SCF_GUESS设置，除了默认的ATOMIC（基于孤立原子密度叠加）以及RESTART（读取之前的波函数当初猜），其它的没什么用。用ATOMIC产生初猜时，CP2K计算每个KIND对应的孤立原子需要的SCF迭代上限固定为50轮，若导致初猜质量烂，可通过atom_kind_orbitals.F里atom%optimization%max_iter修改迭代次数上限（如改成300）然后重新编译。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Modifying the wavefunction generation method and atomic SCF iterations
content: Modify the default wavefunction generation method; see the &SCF / SCF_GUESS setting in the manual. Apart from the default ATOMIC (based on superposition of isolated atom densities) and RESTART (reading a previous wavefunction as the initial guess), the other options are not very useful. When generating the initial guess with ATOMIC, the upper limit of SCF iterations for the isolated atom of each KIND is fixed at 50 by CP2K; if this leads to poor initial guess quality, you can modify the iteration limit (e.g., to 300) via atom%optimization%max_iter in atom_kind_orbitals.F and then recompile.
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence problems in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 外电场设置与SCF收敛
content: 如果加了外电场时SCF很难收敛，可能是外电场过大所致，可尝试更小的数值。如果就是要用较大的外电场，可以试试读取较小电场或不带电场时收敛的波函数当初猜。有的体系在很强外电场下本来就不可能稳定存在，这时候SCF不收敛自然很正常。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: External electric field settings and SCF convergence
content: If SCF is very hard to converge when an external electric field is applied, it may be because the external electric field is excessive; try a smaller value. If a large external field is indeed required, try reading a converged wavefunction obtained with a smaller field or without a field as the initial guess. Some systems simply cannot exist stably under very strong external electric fields, in which case SCF non-convergence is naturally expected.
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence problems in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 放宽SCF收敛限
content: 实在没辙时干脆放宽SCF收敛限，即加大&SCF / EPS_SCF，默认是1E-5。这是走投无路时的做法，或者换程序（如Quantum ESPRESSO），或者尝试CP2K里的纯粹基于平面波的SIRIUS模块。某些体系用CP2K的quickstep模块就是很难收敛，这和算法、基函数特征有关。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Relaxing the SCF convergence criterion
content: When all else fails, simply relax the SCF convergence criterion, i.e., increase &SCF / EPS_SCF, whose default is 1E-5. This is a last-resort approach; alternatively, switch to another program (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO), or try the purely plane-wave-based SIRIUS module in CP2K. For some systems, convergence is simply very hard to achieve with CP2K's quickstep module, which is related to the algorithm and the characteristics of the basis functions.
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence problems in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 晶胞尺寸正确性检查
content: SCF不收敛时需要检查晶胞尺寸设置是否正确，错误的晶胞设置会导致计算体系物理意义错误从而导致不收敛。例如氧化石墨烯本来是二维周期性体系，若晶胞在平行于层的方向太大造成不该有的真空区，相当于计算了一个边缘全是碳悬键的体系，这种离谱的结构SCF能收敛才怪。可通过Multiwfn主功能0检查输入文件的晶胞设置。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Unit cell dimension correctness check
content: When SCF does not converge, check whether the unit cell dimensions are set correctly; incorrect unit cell settings give the calculated system the wrong physical meaning, leading to non-convergence. For example, graphene oxide is inherently a two-dimensional periodic system; if the unit cell is too large along directions parallel to the layers, creating an unintended vacuum region, this amounts to computing a system whose edges are all carbon dangling bonds — it would be surprising for SCF to converge for such an absurd structure. The unit cell settings in the input file can be checked via Multiwfn main function 0.
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence problems in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 金属或小带隙体系的Smearing设置
content: 对无gap（如金属、石墨烯）或gap很小的体系（非常窄带半导体）应当使用smearing。即加入&SCF / &SMEAR / METHOD FERMI_DIRAC，且在&SCF里用ADDED_MOS要求求解一些空轨道从而能被热激发的电子所占据。ADDED_MOS数目够用就行，设太大会增加耗时。用较小电子温度（如200K、300K）时若不收敛可尝试提升&SMEAR / ELECTRONIC_TEMPERATURE，温度设高时ADDED_MOS往往需要相应增加。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Smearing Settings for Metallic or Small-Gap Systems
content: Smearing should be used for systems with no gap (e.g., metals, graphene) or a very small gap (very narrow-gap semiconductors). That is, add &SCF / &SMEAR / METHOD FERMI_DIRAC, and use ADDED_MOS in &SCF to request solving some unoccupied orbitals so that thermally excited electrons can occupy them. ADDED_MOS only needs to be sufficient; setting it too large increases the cost. With a small electron temperature (e.g., 200 K, 300 K), if SCF convergence is not achieved, try increasing &SMEAR / ELECTRONIC_TEMPERATURE; when the temperature is set high, ADDED_MOS often needs to be increased accordingly.
topic: Strategies for Resolving Difficult SCF Convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Smearing的适用性与能量外推
content: 对于gap不是很小的体系（比如氧化锂等绝缘体），根本没必要尝试smearing，这在原理上就不是smearing能起到帮助SCF收敛的情况。用smearing还会对结果产生一定影响，结果会依赖于电子温度T的设置，用Fermi-Dirac函数做smearing时最终给出的能量相当于是T温度下电子的自由能。如果要得到基态（0K）的电子能量，原则上最好做T→0的外推，能量横向对比时至少也应当用相同的smearing设置。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Applicability of Smearing and Energy Extrapolation
content: For systems whose gap is not very small (e.g., insulators such as lithium oxide), there is no need at all to try smearing—in principle this is not a situation where smearing can help SCF convergence. Using smearing also affects the results to some extent: the results depend on the electron temperature T, and when smearing with the Fermi-Dirac function, the final energy is effectively the electronic free energy at temperature T. If you want the electronic energy of the ground state (0 K), in principle it is best to perform a T→0 extrapolation; at minimum, when comparing energies across systems, the same smearing settings should be used.
topic: Strategies for Resolving Difficult SCF Convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 能级移动辅助收敛
content: 对gap较小的体系可尝试使用能级移动，即&SCF / LEVEL_SHIFT，设比如0.3、0.4左右（默认单位是Hartree）。这使得SCF过程中人为加大空轨道与占据轨道之间的能级差，从而减轻彼此间混合的剧烈程度而有时令SCF更容易收敛。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Level Shifting to Assist Convergence
content: For systems with a small gap, try using level shifting, i.e., &SCF / LEVEL_SHIFT, set to e.g. around 0.3 or 0.4 (the default unit is Hartree). This artificially increases the energy gap between the unoccupied and occupied orbitals during the SCF process, thereby reducing the severity of their mixing and sometimes making SCF easier to converge.
topic: Strategies for Resolving Difficult SCF Convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: SCF密度矩阵混合方法
content: 修改&SCF / &MIXING / METHOD设置SCF过程中将旧密度矩阵与新密度矩阵混合得到实际每一轮密度矩阵的方法。默认的DIRECT_P_MIXING往往表现极差，通常用BROYDEN_MIXING（Multiwfn默认），亦可尝试KERKER_MIXING，以及PULAY_MIXING（一般不比BROYDEN_MIXING好）。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: SCF Density Matrix Mixing Method
content: Modify &SCF / &MIXING / METHOD to set the method by which the old density matrix and the new density matrix are mixed to obtain the actual density matrix at each SCF iteration. The default DIRECT_P_MIXING often performs very poorly; BROYDEN_MIXING (the Multiwfn default) is usually used, but you can also try KERKER_MIXING, as well as PULAY_MIXING (generally no better than BROYDEN_MIXING).
topic: Strategies for Resolving Difficult SCF Convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: BROYDEN_MIXING参数调整
content: 对于使用BROYDEN_MIXING的情况，尝试修改&MIXING中的ALPHA（新密度矩阵混入旧的的比例，一般用默认的0.4，难收敛时可尝试0.1~0.3）和NBROYDEN（默认的4明显太小，改大到8通常很有助于收敛，Multiwfn默认为8，也可尝试12）。对于磁性体系，ALPHA_MAG是新的自旋密度混入旧的的比例，默认和ALPHA相同，把ALPHA_MAG设得比ALPHA明显更大有可能帮助收敛。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: BROYDEN_MIXING Parameter Tuning
content: When using BROYDEN_MIXING, try modifying ALPHA in &MIXING (the fraction of the new density matrix mixed into the old one; the default 0.4 is generally fine, but when convergence is difficult try 0.1~0.3) and NBROYDEN (the default of 4 is clearly too small; increasing it to 8 usually greatly helps convergence—Multiwfn defaults to 8, and you can also try 12). For magnetic systems, ALPHA_MAG is the fraction of the new spin density mixed into the old one; it defaults to the same value as ALPHA, and setting ALPHA_MAG noticeably larger than ALPHA may help convergence.
topic: Strategies for Resolving Difficult SCF Convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: PULAY_MIXING参数调整
content: 对于使用PULAY_MIXING的情况，尝试修改&MIXING中的NPULAY。默认的4偏小，改大往往很有助于收敛。注：NPULAY、NBROYDEN、NBUFFER三个关键词实际上等价。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: PULAY_MIXING Parameter Tuning
content: When using PULAY_MIXING, try modifying NPULAY in &MIXING. The default of 4 is a bit small; increasing it often greatly helps convergence. Note: the three keywords NPULAY, NBROYDEN, and NBUFFER are actually equivalent.
topic: Strategies for Resolving Difficult SCF Convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: DIRECT_P_MIXING与DIIS设置
content: 对于使用DIRECT_P_MIXING的情况，收敛到&SCF / EPS_DIIS值后会切换到加速收敛的DIIS算法。默认的EPS_DIIS为0.1，有点偏小，可以尝试改大以早点启用DIIS（但借助DIIS通常仍不如BROYDEN_MIXING）。还可以把控制最大DIIS矢量的&SCF / MAX_DIIS从默认的4改大到诸如7。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: DIRECT_P_MIXING and DIIS Settings
content: When using DIRECT_P_MIXING, once convergence reaches the value of &SCF / EPS_DIIS, the program switches to the convergence-accelerating DIIS algorithm. The default EPS_DIIS is 0.1, which is a bit small; you can try increasing it to enable DIIS earlier (but relying on DIIS is usually still inferior to BROYDEN_MIXING). You can also increase &SCF / MAX_DIIS, which controls the maximum number of DIIS vectors, from the default of 4 to e.g. 7.
topic: Strategies for Resolving Difficult SCF Convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 对角化转OT策略
content: 在对角化框架下各种方法都不行的话，尝试改用OT。如果OT能收敛的话，而且当前由于特殊目的又必须用对角化，也可以用OT收敛的波函数当对角化计算的初猜。由于OT不支持k点，因此如果之前对角化是结合k点算的较小晶胞情况，用OT时就只能靠超胞模型了。OT也不支持用ADDED_MOS，因此必须用smearing的导体体系就别指望OT了。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Switching from Diagonalization to OT
content: If nothing works within the diagonalization framework, try switching to OT. If OT can converge, and you must use diagonalization for some special purpose, you can also use the wavefunction converged with OT as the initial guess for the diagonalization calculation. Since OT does not support k-points, if the diagonalization calculation was previously done on a smaller unit cell with k-points, then with OT you can only rely on a supercell model. OT also does not support ADDED_MOS, so for conducting systems that require smearing, do not count on OT.
topic: Strategies for Resolving Difficult SCF Convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: OT方法中的Outer SCF
content: 如果之前没用outer SCF则开启之，这对解决SCF不收敛非常有效，即加入&SCF / &OUTER_SCF字段。开启outer SCF时inner SCF的迭代次数上限应当设得比平时更小（15至35是比较合适的范围），这样每次到达&SCF / MAX_SCF所设的inner SCF步数上限时，就会进入outer SCF过程更新OT的preconditioner。&SCF / EPS_SCF设的是inner SCF收敛限，&SCF / &OUTER_SCF / EPS_SCF设的是outer SCF收敛限，后者应当小于或等于前者。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Outer SCF in the OT Method
content: If outer SCF was not used before, enable it—it is very effective at resolving SCF non-convergence, i.e., add the &SCF / &OUTER_SCF section. When outer SCF is enabled, the maximum number of inner SCF iterations should be set smaller than usual (15 to 35 is a suitable range), so that each time the maximum number of inner SCF steps set by &SCF / MAX_SCF is reached, the outer SCF procedure is entered to update the OT preconditioner. &SCF / EPS_SCF sets the inner SCF convergence criterion, and &SCF / &OUTER_SCF / EPS_SCF sets the outer SCF convergence criterion; the latter should be smaller than or equal to the former.
topic: Strategies for Resolving Difficult SCF Convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: OT Preconditioner选择
content: 尝试其它的preconditioner。FULL_ALL通常最好，但最贵。大体系可以尝试明显更便宜的FULL_SINGLE_INVERSE和FULL_KINETIC。个别时候FULL_KINETIC反倒比FULL_ALL更容易收敛。GAPW计算总应当用FULL_ALL。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Choice of OT Preconditioner
content: Try other preconditioners. FULL_ALL is usually the best but the most expensive. For large systems, you can try the noticeably cheaper FULL_SINGLE_INVERSE and FULL_KINETIC. Occasionally, FULL_KINETIC actually converges more easily than FULL_ALL. GAPW calculations should always use FULL_ALL.
topic: Strategies for Resolving Difficult SCF Convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 关键词与基本设置合理性
content: 确认关键词、设置没有明显不合理之处，不当的设置会导致SCF很难收敛或收敛到离谱结果。例如计算自旋极化体系时必须在&DFT里写UKS（或等价的LSD），否则即便自旋多重度设的是>1，程序也会当成闭壳层算；用wavelet的Poisson solver算孤立体系时，若体系有明显电子密度分布的区域跨越了盒子，结果也无意义。建议使用Multiwfn产生输入文件以减小关键词使用不当的可能性。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Sanity Check of Keywords and Basic Settings
content: Confirm that there are no obviously unreasonable keywords or settings; improper settings can make SCF very difficult to converge or lead to absurd results. For example, when calculating a spin-polarized system, you must write UKS in &DFT (or the equivalent LSD); otherwise, even if the spin multiplicity is set to >1, the program will treat it as closed shell. When calculating an isolated system with the wavelet Poisson solver, if a region with significant electron density distribution crosses the box boundary, the results are also meaningless. It is recommended to use Multiwfn to generate input files to reduce the likelihood of improper keyword usage.
topic: Strategies for Resolving Difficult SCF Convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: OT算法调整
content: 修改OT算法，把&OT里的ALGORITHM从默认的STRICT改为IRAC，SCF经常会收敛得更稳健。特别是用pob系列全电子基组的时候，用IRAC往往容易收敛得多，而且用约束性DFT（CDFT）时，用IRAC也会令SCF容易收敛得多得多。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: OT Algorithm Adjustment
content: Modify the OT algorithm: change ALGORITHM in &OT from the default STRICT to IRAC, and SCF will often converge much more robustly. In particular, when using the pob series all-electron basis sets, IRAC often converges much more easily, and when using constrained DFT (CDFT), IRAC also makes SCF convergence far easier.
topic: Strategies for Resolving Difficult SCF Convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: OT极小化方法与线搜索
content: &OT / MINIMIZER控制OT用的极小化方法，若之前用的是较快的DIIS（也是Multiwfn产生的用OT的输入文件里默认的），可改为更稳健但耗时更高的CG（共轭梯度法），也可以尝试BROYDEN。MINIMIZER用CG时，尝试用&OT / LINESEARCH选项把线搜索方式设为比默认2PNT更贵但也更稳的3PNT。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: OT Minimization Method and Line Search
content: &OT / MINIMIZER controls the OT minimization method. If the faster DIIS was used before (also the default in OT input files generated by Multiwfn), you can switch to the more robust but more expensive CG (conjugate gradient method), or try BROYDEN. When MINIMIZER is CG, try using the &OT / LINESEARCH option to set the line search mode to 3PNT, which is more expensive but more stable than the default 2PNT.
topic: Strategies for Resolving Difficult SCF Convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 几何优化中偶发SCF不收敛
content: 在几何优化过程中，有可能中途偶尔出现几步SCF不收敛，此时程序还会继续算下去（从CP2K 2024.1开始，优化中途SCF不收敛会导致任务自动停止，需在&SCF里写IGNORE_CONVERGENCE_FAILURE才会继续）。只要最终几何优化收敛时SCF也是收敛的状态就行了。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Occasional SCF Non-Convergence during Geometry Optimization
content: During geometry optimization, it is possible that SCF occasionally fails to converge for a few steps midway; in that case the program will continue the calculation (starting from CP2K 2024.1, SCF non-convergence during optimization causes the job to stop automatically; you must write IGNORE_CONVERGENCE_FAILURE in &SCF for it to continue). As long as the SCF is in a converged state when the geometry optimization finally converges, it is fine.
topic: Strategies for Resolving Difficult SCF Convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 几何优化初期SCF不收敛
content: 有时候在几何优化初期SCF一直不收敛，不要急于把任务停掉，可以先凑合跑跑看看情况。初始几何结构相对于实际的极小点结构而言肯定存在不合理性，此时SCF也肯定比极小点结构处更难收敛。在SCF不收敛、受力也较糙的情况下凑合跑一定步数后，结构一般会变得比一开始更为合理，此时SCF也往往变得更容易收敛。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: SCF Non-Convergence in the Early Stage of Geometry Optimization
content: Sometimes SCF keeps failing to converge in the early stage of geometry optimization; do not rush to stop the job—you can first let it run for a while and see how things go. The initial geometric structure certainly has some unreasonableness relative to the actual minimum structure, and SCF is certainly harder to converge there than at the minimum structure. After running a certain number of steps under SCF non-convergence and rather crude forces, the structure generally becomes more reasonable than at the start, and SCF often becomes easier to converge at that point.
topic: Strategies for Resolving Difficult SCF Convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 几何优化与MD中的波函数外推
content: 在几何优化、分子动力学过程中，程序会自动利用之前一些结构的波函数外推出当前步的初猜波函数，这比起直接产生的初猜波函数质量通常好得多。外推方式可以通过&DFT / &QS / EXTRAPOLATION来具体设置，默认的ASPC通常是最好的选择。由于这一点，当跑一定步数之后，SCF达到收敛限所需的迭代次数明显减小。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Wavefunction extrapolation in geometry optimization and MD
content: During geometry optimization and molecular dynamics, the program automatically extrapolates the initial-guess wavefunction for the current step from the wavefunctions of previous structures; this guess is usually of much better quality than a directly generated initial guess. The extrapolation scheme can be configured in detail via &DFT / &QS / EXTRAPOLATION, and the default ASPC is usually the best choice. Because of this, after a certain number of steps, the number of iterations required to reach the SCF convergence threshold is noticeably reduced.
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 减小步长提升SCF收敛性
content: 如果想减小MD中途出现SCF不收敛的可能，可以尝试减小步长（&MD / TIMESTEP）。如果想减小几何优化中途出现SCF不收敛的可能，可减小优化的步长上限，即置信半径（如通过&MOTION / &GEO_OPT / &BFGS / TRUST_RADIUS）。这样做之后由于相邻两个结构间差异变小了，外推给出的初始波函数对于当前结构而言就越理想，自然SCF收敛也会更容易。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Reducing the step size to improve SCF convergence
content: If you want to reduce the chance of SCF non-convergence during MD, you can try reducing the step size (&MD / TIMESTEP). If you want to reduce the chance of SCF non-convergence during geometry optimization, you can reduce the maximum step size of the optimization, i.e., the trust radius (e.g., via &MOTION / &GEO_OPT / &BFGS / TRUST_RADIUS). After doing so, the difference between adjacent structures becomes smaller, so the extrapolated initial wavefunction becomes more ideal for the current structure, and SCF naturally converges more easily.
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 体系净电荷与自旋多重度设置
content: 确保体系的净电荷、自旋多重度的设置合理，设置不当相当于计算了无意义或激发态的电子结构，极可能导致SCF难收敛。特别是对于磁性体系，自旋多重度的设置对SCF收敛往往影响极大。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Setting the net charge and spin multiplicity of the system
content: Make sure the net charge and spin multiplicity of the system are set reasonably; improper settings are equivalent to computing a meaningless or excited-state electronic structure and can very likely lead to difficult SCF convergence. Especially for magnetic systems, the spin multiplicity setting often has a huge impact on SCF convergence.
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 增大SCF迭代次数上限
content: 如果SCF有收敛趋势，可增大SCF迭代次数上限再试，即&SCF里的MAX_SCF。其默认的50对于很多情况明显太小，Multiwfn产生的CP2K输入文件里默认用128，绝大多数情况都够了，但也可能碰上极个别体系仍需要加大。若SCF过程发生显著震荡、没收敛的苗头，增加迭代次数毫无意义。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Increasing the maximum number of SCF iterations
content: If SCF shows a tendency to converge, you can increase the maximum number of SCF iterations and try again, i.e., MAX_SCF in &SCF. The default value of 50 is clearly too small for many cases; the CP2K input file generated by Multiwfn uses 128 by default, which suffices for the vast majority of cases, but in rare individual systems you may still need to increase it. If the SCF process oscillates significantly with no sign of convergence, increasing the number of iterations is meaningless.
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 读取其他级别收敛波函数作初猜
content: 如果发现用其它泛函或基组下计算能收敛，可以读取其收敛的波函数作为初猜，这通常比自动产生的初猜波函数要好。在&SCF里用SCF_GUESS RESTART，且&DFT里WFN_RESTART_FILE_NAME指定成之前任务的.wfn文件（若考虑了k点是.kp文件）。注意两次的基组特征必须定性一致，比如之前计算用的大核赝势，而现在用小核赝势或全电子基组，这时候读之前的波函数就没意义了。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Reading a converged wavefunction from another level of theory as the initial guess
content: If you find that the calculation converges with another functional or basis set, you can read its converged wavefunction as the initial guess, which is usually better than the automatically generated initial guess wavefunction. Use SCF_GUESS RESTART in &SCF, and set WFN_RESTART_FILE_NAME in &DFT to the .wfn file of the previous task (or the .kp file if k-points were considered). Note that the characteristics of the two basis sets must be qualitatively consistent; for example, if the previous calculation used a large-core pseudopotential while the current one uses a small-core pseudopotential or all-electron basis set, reading the previous wavefunction would be meaningless.
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 利用小基组辅助收敛
content: 通常较小的基组下计算比大基组下计算更容易收敛，若直接用TZV2P档次的MOLOPT基组不收敛，可以尝试用DZVP档次的算。若小基组计算收敛了，读取其收敛的波函数为初猜用于大基组计算。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Using a small basis set to assist convergence
content: Calculations with a smaller basis set usually converge more easily than with a large basis set. If the MOLOPT basis set at the TZV2P level does not converge, you can try computing with the DZVP level. If the small basis set calculation converges, read its converged wavefunction as the initial guess for the large basis set calculation.
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 利用高HF成份泛函辅助收敛
content: HF成份越大的泛函越容易收敛，很大程度是因为其HOMO-LUMO gap更大、SCF过程中占据和空轨道混合程度相对更缓和所致。遇到SCF难收敛时可以尝试用HF成份比实际要用的泛函更大的泛函，若能收敛，读取其收敛的波函数当初猜。HF成份可参考《不同DFT泛函的HF成份一览》。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Using functionals with high HF component to assist convergence
content: Functionals with a larger HF component converge more easily, largely because their HOMO-LUMO gaps are larger and the mixing between occupied and virtual orbitals during SCF is relatively milder. When facing difficult SCF convergence, you can try a functional with a larger HF component than the one you actually intend to use; if it converges, read its converged wavefunction as the initial guess. For the HF component, refer to 《不同DFT泛函的HF成份一览》.
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: 利用DFT+U辅助收敛
content: 如果原本用的是纯泛函，想尝试杂化泛函但用不动，也可以用DFT+U试试，耗时和纯泛函基本一致，但此时不支持k点。如果实际计算不打算+U，也可以尝试3或4 eV的+U看看能否令SCF收敛，如果能，则不+U时读取其收敛的波函数当初猜。
topic: CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

file: 08-其他量化软件/665_CP2K中SCF难收敛问题的解决策略_卡片.md
heading: Using DFT+U to assist convergence
content: If you originally used a pure functional and want to try a hybrid functional but cannot afford it, you can also try DFT+U; the cost is essentially the same as a pure functional, but k-points are not supported in this case. Even if you do not plan to apply +U in the actual calculation, you can try +U of 3 or 4 eV to see whether it makes SCF converge; if it does, then without +U read its converged wavefunction as the initial guess.
topic: Strategies for solving difficult SCF convergence in CP2K
fm_title: CP2K中遇到SCF难收敛时的解决方法

heading: Functions and classification of the files .32 to .40 of the NBO program
content: The plot files with suffixes .31 to .40 generated by the NBO program contain basis function information and orbital combination coefficients, which can be combined to compute orbital properties and plot figures. The file 31 contains only basis function information, while files .32 to .40 store various orbital expansion coefficients in basis functions recorded in .31 file. The orbital types corresponding to each suffix are: 32 PNAO, 33 NAO, 34 PNHO, 35 NHO, 36 PNBO, 37 NBO, 38 PNLMO, 39 NLMO, 40 MO.

content: 开壳层时，.34至.40文件分别记录ALPHA SPIN和BETA SPIN轨道，先记录完所有ALPHA SPIN再记录BETA SPIN。PNAO(.32)和NAO(.33)不同自旋不分开记录。Gaussian03的NBO3.1模块输出的.32和.33文件存在bug，缺失前三行。

heading: Orbital recording rules for open-shell systems
content: For an open shell, the files .34 to .40 record ALPHA SPIN and BETA SPIN orbitals respectively, with all ALPHA SPIN orbitals recorded first and then the BETA SPIN ones. For PNAO (.32) and NAO (.33), orbitals of different spins are not recorded separately. The .32 and .33 files output by the NBO3.1 module of Gaussian03 have a bug: the first three lines are missing.

heading: Variables that must be assigned when reading .31 files
content: Reading .31 files requires conversion to .wfn format. The variables that must be assigned include: the total number of orbitals nmo, the total number of GTFs nprims, the total number of atoms ncenter, the coefficient matrix CO(:,:), the atomic information array a(:), and the GTF information array b(:). The .37 and .39 files additionally require reading the orbital occupation numbers into MOocc(:). Unrecorded information (such as the total energy totenergy and orbital energies MOene) can be set to arbitrary values.

heading: Conversion from basis function label to .wfn type identifier
content: In the code, the `bastype2func` array converts NBO basis function labels to the type numbers in the .wfn file. For example, s(1) corresponds to 1, p(101-103) to X/Y/Z(2-4), d(201-206) to XX/YY/ZZ/XY/XZ/YZ(5-10), and f(301-310) to the various components (11-20). The g functions (401-415) are mapped to 20-35 in a specific order.

heading: 开壳层与闭壳层文件的读取差异
content: 读取.32至.40文件时，若检测到" ALPHA SPIN"字符串，则判定为开壳层，轨道数设为基函数数目二倍，依次读取Alpha和Beta轨道系数；否则为闭壳层，轨道数等于基函数数目。对于.37和.39文件，在读取系数后还需读取占据数信息。

heading: .31文件中的科学记数法数据

heading: Scientific notation data in file 31
content: The scientific notation data in file 31 is divided into five major sections, recording in order the exponents of the primitive shells and the contraction coefficients of the s-, p-, d-, and f-type GTFs; newer versions also include the g-type GTF contraction coefficients. The contraction coefficients have already been multiplied by the normalization coefficients of the GTFs. file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/66_NBO程序.31至.40文件格式及转换_卡片.md
heading: d/f函数收缩系数的归一化修正
content: 对于d函数，.31文件中的收缩系数包含的是XX、YY、ZZ的归一化系数，计算XY、XZ、YZ时需将系数除以XX（或YY、ZZ）的归一化系数再乘以XY（或XZ、YZ）的归一化系数。对于f函数，.31文件记录的是XXX、YYY、ZZZ的归一化系数，获得其它f函数的正确收缩系数也需进行类似的除法再乘法处理。

heading: Normalization correction of d/f function contraction coefficients
content: For d functions, the contraction coefficients in file 31 contain the normalization coefficients of XX, YY, and ZZ; when computing XY, XZ, and YZ, the coefficient must be divided by the normalization coefficient of XX (or YY, ZZ) and then multiplied by the normalization coefficient of XY (or XZ, YZ). For f functions, file 31 records the normalization coefficients of XXX, YYY, and ZZZ, and obtaining the correct contraction coefficients of other f functions also requires a similar divide-then-multiply treatment.

heading: 轨道对NICS贡献方法的理论基础
content: 利用Gaussian的AICD程序界面结合NMR=CSGT任务可以将NICS分解为不同类型分子轨道的贡献，该方法基于CSGT而非NCS。计算所有电子贡献的总NICS时，NCS(GIAO)与CSGT结果差异很小可忽略，但单个轨道的贡献可能相差很大，而同类轨道的总和差异通常很小。此方法适用于Gaussian G09 D.01及之后版本。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/670_Gaussian_CSGT计算轨道对NICS贡献_卡片.md
heading: Theoretical basis of the method for orbital contributions to NICS
content: Using the AICD program interface of Gaussian combined with an NMR=CSGT task, NICS can be decomposed into contributions of different molecular orbital types; this method is based on CSGT rather than NCS. When computing the total NICS from the contributions of all electrons, the difference between NCS (GIAO) and CSGT results is negligible, but the contributions of individual orbitals may differ greatly, while the sum over orbitals of the same type usually shows a very small difference. This method is applicable to Gaussian 09 D.01 and later versions.

heading: Execution of the orbNICS.sh script and its output
content:
After running the orbNICS.sh script, the NICS contributions of the orbitals within the specified range are calculated one by one, and the results are saved in iso.txt and ZZ.txt. iso.txt contains the contributions of each orbital to the isotropic magnetic shielding value at the Bq position, and ZZ.txt contains the contributions to the ZZ component. heading: Requirements for the wavefunction file needed to simulate STM images
content: To analyze CP2K wavefunctions with Multiwfn, you must have CP2K generate a molden file recording the wavefunction information. If the bias voltage used in the simulated STM is positive, you must require CP2K to solve for a certain number of unoccupied orbitals; the larger the bias voltage, the more unoccupied orbitals need to be calculated.

heading: CP2K计算生成molden文件的流程

content: Launch Multiwfn and load the structure file (e.g., Phosphorus-black.gjf), then generate a CP2K input file through the menu: enter `cp2k` to specify the file name (e.g., SP.inp), set the periodicity to `XY` for two-dimensional periodicity, and choose to generate a molden file. In the structure editing interface, generate a supercell based on the original unit cell parameters (e.g., a=3.31 angstroms, b=4.38 angstroms) (e.g., 7 times along a and 5 times along b), and in the other settings specify the number of unoccupied orbitals to calculate (e.g., the lowest 20 unoccupied orbitals). After running the CP2K calculation, you need to manually insert the unit cell information and valence electron information at the beginning of the generated .molden file.

heading: 无间隙体系（金属表面）模拟STM的注意事项
content: 对于无间隙体系（如金属表面），由于通常开启smearing导致轨道占据数非整数，Multiwfn无法直接绘制STM。解决方法是先使用主功能300的子功能9（计算费米能级功能），该功能会按整数方式修改轨道占据数（相当于0 K占据方式）。记下程序提供的费米能级值，退出该功能后进入STM绘制界面，将费米能级值输入选项3 Set Fermi level即可。

heading: Points to note when simulating STM of systems without a band gap (metal surfaces)
content: For systems without a band gap (e.g., metal surfaces), since enabling smearing typically causes non-integer orbital occupations, Multiwfn cannot directly plot the STM. The solution is to first use subfunction 9 of main function 300 (the Fermi level calculation function), which modifies the orbital occupation numbers to integer values (equivalent to the 0 K occupation scheme). Note the Fermi level value provided by the program; after exiting this function, enter the STM plotting interface and input the Fermi level value into option 3 Set Fermi level.

heading: 文件压缩的定义与分类
content: 文件压缩的目的是为了减小原文件的尺寸，原文件尺寸除以压缩后的尺寸称为压缩率。根据压缩的目的，分为特定目的的压缩（如视频、音频、图像压缩）和通用目的的压缩（可用于所有文件）。文件压缩又分为有损和无损压缩，前者会降低原文件承载的信息的质量无法复原，后者完整保持原文件里的信息在解压后可以复原。

heading: Definition and classification of file compression
content: The purpose of file compression is to reduce the size of the original file; the size of the original file divided by the compressed size is called the compression ratio. According to the purpose of compression, it is divided into compression for specific purposes (e.g., video, audio, image compression) and compression for general purposes (applicable to all files). File compression is also divided into lossy and lossless compression: the former degrades the quality of the information carried by the original file and cannot be restored, while the latter fully preserves the information in the original file so it can be restored after decompression.

heading: Using the zip and unzip commands on Linux
content: On Linux, to compress one or more files into sob.zip, use zip sob [one or more file names]; if directory names are included, add -r. During compression, all compressed file names are displayed by default; adding -q avoids the display. The zip command uses the deflate algorithm by default; to use the bzip2 algorithm with a higher compression ratio, you need to add the -Z bzip2 option. To decompress a zip file, use unzip sob.zip.

file: 11-软件安装与环境/672_计算化学文件压缩方法与效率对比_卡片.md
heading: Winrar与7zip压缩效果对比结论
content: Winrar压缩成rar的速度很快，但压缩率很平庸，提高压缩质量会令耗时增加至少一倍而压缩率提升不多，所以rar只推荐用于Windows下快速压缩目的。7zip程序用LZMA2算法在默认设置下压缩成7z格式的速度远不如rar，但压缩率高得多，用“极限压缩”设置耗时提升甚巨而压缩率提升极为有限。7zip的“快速压缩”耗时比winrar默认时还低而压缩率至少不输于之，“极速压缩”的耗时非常低而压缩率依然说得过去，因此非常推荐追求速度的时候用。

heading: Conclusions from comparing the compression performance of WinRAR and 7zip
content: WinRAR compresses to rar very quickly, but the compression ratio is mediocre; increasing the compression quality at least doubles the time cost while the compression ratio improves only marginally, so rar is only recommended for the fast compression purpose on Windows. The 7zip program using the LZMA2 algorithm to compress to 7z format under default settings is far slower than rar, but the compression ratio is much higher; with the "ultra compression" setting the time cost increases enormously while the compression ratio gain is extremely limited. 7zip fast compression mode costs even less time than WinRAR default while the compression ratio is at least no worse; "fastest compression" has a very low time cost and its compression ratio is still acceptable, so it is highly recommended when speed is prioritized.

content: 如果是分享要被很多人下载的大文件，或者要把文件放到硬盘空间很紧张的地方，建议使用压缩率较高的方式压缩，比如基于LZMA2算法在默认设置下的xz或7z格式。如果文件只是用于临时性的一对一传输，想通过压缩节约传输时间，那只需要用很快速的方法压缩一下就够了，若把过多的CPU运算时间花在对压缩率的追求上就得不偿失。

heading: Recommendations for choosing a compression method
content: If you are sharing large files downloaded by many people, or placing files where disk space is very tight, it is recommended to compress with a method of higher compression ratio, such as xz or 7z format based on the LZMA2 algorithm under default settings. If the file is only for a temporary one-to-one transfer and you want to save transfer time through compression, then just a very fast compression method is enough; spending too much CPU time on pursuing the compression ratio is not worthwhile.

heading: 压缩格式与压缩算法的关系
content: 格式和压缩算法不总是同一个概念，比如7z格式支持LZMA、LZMA2、bzip2等算法，zip格式支持Deflate、LZMA、bzip2等算法。有的格式就只对应一种算法，比如rar格式（rar算法）、bz2格式（全称bzip2，特有算法）、gz格式（全称gzip，基于Deflate算法）、xz格式（基于LZMA2算法）、zst格式（Zstandard算法）。由于某些压缩格式允许用不同的算法，因此不能简单说这种格式的压缩率如何，必须具体到压缩算法，且对于同一种压缩算法压缩率还取决于一些参数。
topic: 计算化学文件压缩方法与效率对比
fm_title: 计算化学研究者应当了解的文件压缩的常识

file: 11-软件安装与环境/672_计算化学文件压缩方法与效率对比_卡片.md
heading: Relationship between compressed formats and compression algorithms
content: A format and a compression algorithm are not always the same concept; for example, the 7z format supports LZMA, LZMA2, bzip2 and other algorithms, and the zip format supports Deflate, LZMA, bzip2 and other algorithms. Some formats correspond to only one algorithm, such as rar (rar algorithm), bz2 (full name bzip2, its own algorithm), gz (full name gzip, based on Deflate), xz (based on LZMA2), and zst (Zstandard algorithm). Since some compressed formats allow different algorithms, one cannot simply say how the compression ratio of such a format is; it must be specific to the compression algorithm, and for the same algorithm the compression ratio also depends on some parameters.
topic: Computational chemistry file compression methods and efficiency comparison

file: 11-软件安装与环境/672_计算化学文件压缩方法与效率对比_卡片.md
heading: 文本型与二进制型文件的定义
content: 计算机文件分为文本型和二进制型两种：文本型文件通过文本编辑器打开后看到的都是人能阅读的信息，在计算化学领域里包括Gaussian的fch文件、通用的记录波函数信息的mwfn/wfn/wfx/molden文件、记录格点数据的cube文件、记录化学体系坐标的pdb/xyz/mol/mol2文件、GROMACS的gro/mdp/top文件、AMBER的mdcrd/prmtop文件、CP2K的restart文件等等，以及各种程序的输入和输出文件（如Gaussian的gjf和out文件）；二进制文件用文本编辑器打开后会看到许多乱码，在计算化学领域里包括Gaussian的chk文件、GROMACS的trr/xtc/tpr/cpt文件、dcd轨迹文件、AMBER的binpos文件等等。
topic: 计算化学文件压缩方法与效率对比
fm_title: 计算化学研究者应当了解的文件压缩的常识

file: 11-软件安装与环境/672_计算化学文件压缩方法与效率对比_卡片.md
heading: Definitions of text and binary files
content: Computer files fall into two types, text and binary: when opened in a text editor, text files show only human-readable information. In computational chemistry these include the Gaussian fch file, the general-purpose wavefunction information files mwfn/wfn/wfx/molden, the cube file recording grid data, the pdb/xyz/mol/mol2 files recording coordinates of chemical systems, the GROMACS gro/mdp/top files, the AMBER mdcrd/prmtop files, the CP2K restart file, and so on, as well as the input and output files of various programs (such as Gaussian's gjf and out files). Binary files show many garbled characters when opened in a text editor; in computational chemistry these include the Gaussian chk file, the GROMACS trr/xtc/tpr/cpt files, dcd trajectory files, the AMBER binpos file, and so on.

file: 11-软件安装与环境/672_计算化学文件压缩方法与效率对比_卡片.md
heading: 文件“油水”与压缩效果的关系
content: 文本型文件一般总是有巨大的压缩“油水”，像是好几百MB甚至上GB的fch、cube文件，通过网络传给别人时如果不压缩是浪费资源的行为。已经压缩过的二进制文件（如H.264编码的mp4视频文件、mp3音频文件、png文件）再压缩尺寸没有明显减小，刻意去压缩显得很没常识。如果二进制文件是“生”的，可能有压缩的价值，比如Gaussian计算直接产生的chk经过压缩后普遍能减小非常多尺寸；GROMACS的trr轨迹压成rar后往往能减小几分之一；而GROMACS的xtc轨迹本身就已经是有损压缩了，再压缩就没有什么油水了。
topic: 计算化学文件压缩方法与效率对比
fm_title: 计算化学研究者应当了解的文件压缩的常识

file: 11-软件安装与环境/672_计算化学文件压缩方法与效率对比_卡片.md
heading: Relationship between file redundancy and compression benefit
content: Text files generally always have enormous compression "headroom"; for example, fch and cube files of several hundred MB or even over 1 GB, if sent over the network without compression, are a waste of resources. Re-compressing already compressed binary files (such as mp4 video files encoded with H.264, mp3 audio files, png files) shows no significant size reduction, and deliberately compressing them reflects a lack of common sense. If a binary file is "raw", it may be worth compressing; for example, the chk file produced directly by a Gaussian calculation can generally be reduced in size by a great deal after compression; a GROMACS trr trajectory compressed into rar can often be reduced to a fraction of its size; whereas the GROMACS xtc trajectory is itself already lossy-compressed, so compressing it again offers no headroom.
topic: Computational chemistry file compression methods and efficiency comparison

file: 11-软件安装与环境/672_计算化学文件压缩方法与效率对比_卡片.md
heading: Linux下tar命令的基本压缩与解压用法
content: Linux下使用tar命令解压文件（程序自动根据后缀判断）的命令为tar -xf [压缩文件名]。把指定的文件或整个目录压缩成new.tbz（tar.bz2的简写）、new.tgz（tar.gz的简写）、new.tar.xz或new.tar.zst的命令均为tar -caf [压缩文件名] [文件名或目录名]。-caf选项等同于同时写-c -a -f，-c代表压缩，-a代表根据后缀自动判断压缩方法，-f代表指定文件名。

file: 11-软件安装与环境/672_计算化学文件压缩方法与效率对比_卡片.md
heading: Basic compression and extraction usage of the tar command under Linux
content: Under Linux, the command to extract a file with tar (the program automatically determines the format from the extension) is tar -xf [archive name]. To compress a specified file or an entire directory into new.tbz (shorthand for tar.bz2), new.tgz (shorthand for tar.gz), new.tar.xz, or new.tar.zst, the command is always tar -caf [archive name] [file or directory name]. The -caf option is equivalent to writing -c -a -f together: -c means compress, -a means automatically determine the compression method from the extension, and -f means specify the file name.

file: 11-软件安装与环境/672_计算化学文件压缩方法与效率对比_卡片.md
heading: Linux下tar打包与压缩格式的区别
content: 7z、zip、rar格式能够包含多个被压缩的文件，而bz2、gz、xz、zst这些格式本身只能记录单个文件。tar是一种可以由tar程序产生的打包格式，多个文件（或目录）可以合并成一个.tar文件，这个过程不改变文件的总尺寸。.tar.xz是先把被压缩的文件用tar打包然后再压缩成xz格式的产物，如果被压缩的文件只有一个，.tar.xz可以简化为.xz，而如果涉及多个文件就必须写成.tar.xz。

file: 11-软件安装与环境/672_计算化学文件压缩方法与效率对比_卡片.md
heading: Difference between tar packaging and compressed formats under Linux
content: The 7z, zip, and rar formats can contain multiple compressed files, whereas formats such as bz2, gz, xz, and zst can themselves only record a single file. tar is a packaging format produced by the tar program; multiple files (or directories) can be merged into one .tar file, and this process does not change the total size of the files. .tar.xz is the product of first packaging the files to be compressed with tar and then compressing them into the xz format; if there is only a single file to compress, .tar.xz can be simplified to .xz, whereas if multiple files are involved it must be written as .tar.xz.

file: 11-软件安装与环境/672_计算化学文件压缩方法与效率对比_卡片.md
heading: Linux下使用tar进行并行压缩
content: 在Linux下使用tar进行并行压缩以显著节约时间，可以通过-I明确指定使用并行版压缩程序。并行压缩成tar.xz格式使用tar -I pxz -cf new.tar.xz [文件名或目录名]，若CPU占用率太低可加上-D 1参数（如tar -I 'pxz -D 1' -cf new.tar.xz [文件名或目录名]）。并行压缩成tar.zst格式使用tar -I pzstd -cf new.tar.zst [文件名或目录名]。并行压缩成tbz格式使用tar -I pbzip2 -cf new.tbz [文件名或目录名]。并行压缩成tgz格式使用tar -I pigz -cf new.tgz [文件名或目录名]。

file: 11-软件安装与环境/672_计算化学文件压缩方法与效率对比_卡片.md
heading: Parallel compression with tar under Linux
content: Under Linux, using tar for parallel compression to significantly save time can be done by explicitly specifying a parallel version of the compression program via -I. For parallel compression into tar.xz format use tar -I pxz -cf new.tar.xz [file or directory name]; if CPU utilization is too low, add the -D 1 parameter (e.g., tar -I 'pxz -D 1' -cf new.tar.xz [file or directory name]). For parallel compression into tar.zst format use tar -I pzstd -cf new.tar.zst [file or directory name]. For parallel compression into tbz format use tar -I pbzip2 -cf new.tbz [file or directory name]. For parallel compression into tgz format use tar -I pigz -cf new.tgz [file or directory name].

file: 11-软件安装与环境/672_计算化学文件压缩方法与效率对比_卡片.md
heading: Linux下压缩质量的设置参数
content: Linux下压缩程序可以通过选项控制压缩质量：压缩成.tgz时，-1是最快，-9是最好，默认是-6，例如tar -I 'pigz -9' -cf new.tgz [文件名或目录名]；压缩成.tar.xz时，-0是最快，-9是最好，一般用默认的-6就足够好了，例如tar -I 'pxz -5 -D 1' -cf new.tar.xz [文件名或目录名]；压缩成.tar.zst时，-1是最快，-19是最好，默认的-3时压缩率比较烂，例如tar -I 'pzstd -16' -cf new.tar.zst [文件名或目录名]。

file: 11-软件安装与环境/672_计算化学文件压缩方法与效率对比_卡片.md
heading: Parameters for setting compression quality under Linux
content: Under Linux, compression programs allow controlling the compression quality via options: when compressing into .tgz, -1 is the fastest, -9 is the best, and the default is -6, e.g., tar -I 'pigz -9' -cf new.tgz [file or directory name]; when compressing into .tar.xz, -0 is the fastest, -9 is the best, and the default -6 is generally good enough, e.g., tar -I 'pxz -5 -D 1' -cf new.tar.xz [file or directory name]; when compressing into .tar.zst, -1 is the fastest, -19 is the best, while the default -3 gives a rather poor compression ratio, e.g., tar -I 'pzstd -16' -cf new.tar.zst [file or directory name].

heading: 18碳环进入OPP的动力学过程
content: 分子动力学模拟显示，C18进入OPP的过程分为三个阶段：(1) wander（在周围漫游），(2) adsorption（进入并处于亚稳态构型），(3) equilibrium（处于完全平衡状态）。C18可从外沿滑入大环空腔，自发从倾斜的亚稳态变为平行于大环的稳定构型。

heading: Dynamic process of the 18-carbon ring entering OPP
content: Molecular dynamics simulation shows that the process of C18 entering OPP occurs in three stages: (1) wander (roaming around the vicinity), (2) adsorption (entering and staying in a metastable configuration), and (3) equilibrium (in a fully equilibrated state). C18 can slide into the macrocyclic cavity from the outside edge, spontaneously transforming from the tilted metastable state to a stable configuration parallel to the macrocycle.

content: The lowest singlet excited state S1 of OPP is dominated by the HOMO to LUMO+8 transition (86.8% contribution); electronic excitation leads to a wider opening of the pi-linker and a more circular macrocyclic moiety. file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/674_OPP吸附18碳环的波函数分析与动力学模拟_卡片.md
heading: Adsorption structure model and computational settings
content: The geometry optimization and vibrational analysis were performed with Gaussian 16 using the wB97XD functional, with the 6-31G* basis set for the OPP portion containing 224 atoms and the 6-311G* basis set for C18. This setting originates from the validation in Carbon, 165, 468 (2020), which showed that wB97XD can well describe the C18 structure and reasonably describe weak interactions, and that C18 must use the 6-311G* basis set for its geometric structure to be reasonably described.

heading: 结合自由能与温度的关系
content: 在404 K以下，结合自由能为负，C18能够与OPP结合；在此温度以上则热力学上无法结合，已吸附的C18也会发生脱附。利用这一特性，可以通过低温吸附、高温释放来实现OPP对C18的可控吸附和释放。

heading: Relationship between binding free energy and temperature
content: Below 404 K, the binding free energy is negative and C18 can bind to OPP; above this temperature binding is thermodynamically impossible, and any adsorbed C18 will desorb. This property can be exploited to achieve controlled adsorption and release of C18 by OPP through low-temperature adsorption and high-temperature release.

content: When computing the binding free energy and binding enthalpy, the electronic energy was calculated with ORCA at the wB97M-V/def2-QZVPP level with RIJCOSX enabled, and a half-side model (removing the macrocycle irrelevant to adsorption and capping with hydrogens) was used to reduce the computational cost. heading: Visualization features of the interaction
content: The interaction region between OPP and the 18-carbon ring has very low electron density, and the isosurface is flat, broad, and entirely green, which is characteristic of a dispersion-attraction-dominated interaction. Since the 18-carbon ring has in-plane pi electrons positioned opposite the pi electron distribution region of the benzene ring of the OPP macrocycle, a significant pi-pi stacking interaction forms between the two. heading: 局部电子附着能(LEAE)的定义
content: 局部电子附着能(LEAE)由J. Phys. Chem. A., 120, 10023 (2016)提出，公式包含总电子密度、分子轨道概率密度和轨道能量，计算循环考虑从LUMO开始的所有能量低于0的空轨道。在Multiwfn中LEAE对应于第-27号自定义函数，数值越负说明该处越亲电、越容易被亲核进攻，且可在不同体系间对比反应速率常数。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/676_Multiwfn计算局部电子附着能LEAE_卡片.md
heading: Definition of local electron attachment energy (LEAE)
content: The local electron attachment energy (LEAE) was proposed in J. Phys. Chem. A., 120, 10023 (2016). Its formula involves the total electron density, molecular orbital probability density, and orbital energies, and the computation loop considers all unoccupied orbitals with energy below 0 starting from the LUMO. In Multiwfn, LEAE corresponds to user-defined function number -27; the more negative the value, the more electrophilic the site and the more susceptible to nucleophilic attack, and rate constants can be compared across different systems.

heading: Revelation of electrophilic sites in 1-bromo-3,5-difluorobenzene by LEAE analysis
content: The LEAE map of 1-bromo-3,5-difluorobenzene shows that the sigma-hole region of bromine is highly electrophilic, and the ortho and para carbons of bromine are more electrophilic than the meta ones. heading: LEAE与LEA的区别及LUMO能量限制
content: LEAE比LEA（J. Mol. Model., 9, 342 (2003)）更优越，因为LEAE只依赖能量低于0的空轨道，对基组敏感性小；而LEA依赖所有空轨道，带弥散函数时结果往往无意义。使用LEAE必须保证至少LUMO的能量低于0，否则无法使用，建议使用B3LYP/6-31+G**产生的波函数。

heading: Difference between LEAE and LEA and the LUMO energy restriction
content: LEAE is superior to LEA (J. Mol. Model., 9, 342 (2003)) because LEAE depends only on virtual orbitals with energies below 0 and is insensitive to the basis set, whereas LEA depends on all virtual orbitals, whose results are often meaningless when diffuse functions are included. Using LEAE requires at least that the LUMO energy is below 0; otherwise it cannot be used. It is recommended to use the wavefunction generated at B3LYP/6-31+G**.

heading: Advantages of LEAE over the LUMO distribution and the Fukui function
content: Compared with predictions based solely on the LUMO distribution, LEAE takes into account all virtual orbitals with energies below 0, avoiding misleading results when virtual orbitals are near-degenerate. Compared with the Fukui function f+, LEAE requires computing only a single electronic state, which is more convenient, and allows comparison of absolute magnitudes across different systems.

heading: LEAE与轨道权重福井函数及Hirshfeld电荷的对比
content: 轨道权重福井函数fw+与LEAE都基于非占据轨道且不止考虑LUMO，但fw+用人为权重，LEAE权重隐含在轨道能量中；LEAE可直接对比不同分子的绝对大小，且能考察化学键等特定区域。Hirshfeld电荷是一个原子一个值，无法像LEAE那样考察特定局部区域亲电性或绘制直观的表面着色图，二者互补。

heading: Comparison of LEAE with the orbital-weighted Fukui function and Hirshfeld charge
content: The orbital-weighted Fukui function fw+ and LEAE are both based on unoccupied orbitals and consider more than just the LUMO, but fw+ uses artificial weights while LEAE's weights are implicit in the orbital energies. LEAE can directly compare absolute magnitudes between different molecules and can examine specific regions such as chemical bonds. Hirshfeld charge gives one value per atom and cannot examine electrophilicity of specific local regions like LEAE or produce intuitive colored surface maps; the two are complementary.

heading: Advantages of LEAE over the electrostatic potential in predicting nucleophilic reactions
content: LEAE is far more reliable than the surface electrostatic potential for analyzing nucleophilic reactions. For example, in pentafluoronitrobenzene, the electrostatic potential failed to reflect the reaction advantages of the ortho and para carbons, whereas LEAE successfully predicted the ortho and para nucleophilic aromatic substitution reaction sites and their relative reactivities (para -2.21 eV, ortho -2.11 eV).

heading: Linear relationship between the LEAE minimum and nucleophilic reaction rates
content: The LEAE surface minimum correlates linearly and very well with the ln value of the nucleophilic reaction rate constant k; the more negative the LEAE at a site, the larger the reaction rate usually is. This relationship has been verified in nucleophilic addition reactions of fluorine-substituted heterocyclic systems and substituted nitrostilbenes, and can be used to predict reaction rates for other substituents.

heading: Application of LEAE in weak interaction studies

heading: 无限长碳链（碳炔）的键长预测
content: 根据Scemama等人给出的外推公式推断，无限长碳链中长C-C键和短C-C键的长度分别收敛至约1.329 Å和1.229 Å。随着链长增加，分子中相应位置的长键和短键分别有缩短和增长趋势，C-H键长度随链长增长无明显改变。

heading: Bond length prediction for the infinitely long carbon chain (carbyne)
content: According to the extrapolation formula given by Scemama et al., the long and short C-C bonds in an infinitely long carbon chain converge to approximately 1.329 Å and 1.229 Å, respectively. As the chain length increases, the long and short bonds at the corresponding positions in the molecule show tendencies to shorten and lengthen, respectively, while the C-H bond length shows no significant change with increasing chain length.

heading: 11Σu+ ← X1Σg+跃迁波长的外推公式
content: 将ωB97XD/def2-TZVP水平得到的吸收波长用指数函数拟合，得到公式λ(nm) = -305.807exp(-n/8.153) + 389.522，R2 > 0.999。该公式通过n = 15的验证（外推值341.0 nm vs 计算值338.9 nm）被证实可靠。根据公式推断，无限长碳链的渐近值为389.5 nm，修正系统误差后，碳炔-(C≡C∞)-的最大吸收收敛到约395.1 nm。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/679_碳链电子光谱尺寸依赖性及碳炔预测_卡片.md
heading: Extrapolation formula for the 11Σu+ ← X1Σg+ transition wavelength
content: Fitting the absorption wavelengths obtained at the ωB97XD/def2-TZVP level with an exponential function yields the formula λ(nm) = -305.807exp(-n/8.153) + 389.522, with R2 > 0.999. The formula was verified with n = 15 (extrapolated value 341.0 nm vs calculated value 338.9 nm) and confirmed to be reliable. According to the formula, the asymptotic value for an infinitely long carbon chain is 389.5 nm; after correcting for systematic error, the maximum absorption of carbyne -(C≡C∞)- converges to about 395.1 nm.

heading: 几何结构优化方法与设置
content: 研究使用ωB97XD交换相关泛函和def2-TZVP基组，在气相条件下通过密度泛函理论（DFT）对碳链H-(C≡C)n-H (n = 3-9, 15)的几何结构进行了优化。该计算水平能很好地再现实验观测及UCCSD/def2-TZVP水平上得到的环[18]碳几何结构，保证了具有相同sp杂化构型的体系优化的准确性和稳健性。所有优化的几何结构均为键长交替的线型结构且无虚频。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/679_碳链电子光谱尺寸依赖性及碳炔预测_卡片.md
heading: Geometry optimization method and settings
content: The study optimized the geometric structures of the carbon chains H-(C≡C)n-H (n = 3-9, 15) under gas phase conditions using density functional theory (DFT) with the ωB97XD exchange-correlation functional and the def2-TZVP basis set. This computational level reproduces well the experimentally observed structures and the geometric structure of cyclo[18]carbon obtained at the UCCSD/def2-TZVP level, ensuring the accuracy and robustness of optimizing systems with the same sp-hybridized configuration. All optimized geometric structures are linear with bond length alternation (BLA) structure and have no imaginary frequencies.

heading: 电子激发能计算与验证
content: 碳链的激发能通过含时密度泛函理论（TD-DFT）在ωB97XD/def2-TZVP水平下计算得到，计算对象为50个最低激发态。为了验证TDDFT计算的可靠性，研究还利用ORCA软件进行了高精度的STEOM-DLPNO-CCSD/def2-TZVP计算。所有量子化学计算均采用Gaussian 16 (A.03)程序包完成，电子结构分析使用Multiwfn 3.8(dev)，可视化使用VMD软件。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/679_碳链电子光谱尺寸依赖性及碳炔预测_卡片.md
heading: Excitation energy calculation and validation
content: The excitation energies of the carbon chains were calculated using time-dependent density functional theory (TD-DFT) at the ωB97XD/def2-TZVP level for the 50 lowest excited states. To validate the reliability of the TDDFT calculation, high-accuracy STEOM-DLPNO-CCSD/def2-TZVP calculation was also performed with the ORCA software. All quantum chemical calculations were carried out with the Gaussian 16 (A.03) package, electronic structure analysis used Multiwfn 3.8(dev), and visualization used the VMD software.

heading: 碳链的基态几何特征
content: 碳链H-(C≡C)n-H具有11Σg+基态和闭壳层电子构型，属于D∞h点群，表现为具有中心对称性的长短C-C键交替的线型结构。这种键长交替（BLA）结构可理解为Peierls畸变的结果。计算得到的H-(C≡C)3-H的C-C键长为1.201/1.366/1.207 Å，与实验值1.20/1.38/1.20 Å一致。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/679_碳链电子光谱尺寸依赖性及碳炔预测_卡片.md
heading: Ground-state geometric features of the carbon chains
content: The carbon chains H-(C≡C)n-H have an 11Σg+ ground state with a closed-shell electronic configuration, belong to the D∞h point group, and exhibit a linear structure with alternating long and short C-C bonds and centrosymmetry. This bond length alternation (BLA) structure can be understood as a consequence of the Peierls distortion. The calculated C-C bond lengths of H-(C≡C)3-H are 1.201/1.366/1.207 Å, consistent with the experimental values of 1.20/1.38/1.20 Å.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/679_碳链电子光谱尺寸依赖性及碳炔预测_卡片.md
heading: 碳链的π电子离域特征
content: LOL-π分析显示，碳链具有两套相互垂直的π共轭系统。尽管π电子整体离域显著，但由于长C-C键性质更类似单键，LOL-π在短C-C键附近的分布比在长C-C键附近充分得多，体现了长键附近电子离域受阻。Wiberg键级分析表明，长C-C键的π轨道Wiberg键级明显小于短键，但仍达到约0.48，表明其π电子离域不可忽略。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/679_碳链电子光谱尺寸依赖性及碳炔预测_卡片.md
heading: π electron delocalization characteristics of carbon chains
content: LOL-π analysis shows that carbon chains possess two mutually perpendicular π conjugated systems. Although π electrons are significantly delocalized overall, since the long C-C bonds behave more like single bonds, LOL-π is distributed far more abundantly around the short C-C bonds than around the long C-C bonds, reflecting hindered electron delocalization around the long bonds. Wiberg bond order analysis indicates that the π-orbital Wiberg bond order of the long C-C bonds is markedly smaller than that of the short bonds, yet still reaches about 0.48, showing that their π electron delocalization is non-negligible.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/679_碳链电子光谱尺寸依赖性及碳炔预测_卡片.md
heading: 11Σu+ ← X1Σg+跃迁的波长计算精度
content: TD-ωB97XD/def2-TZVP计算的11Σu+ ← X1Σg+波长与实验观测值惊人地一致，相对于实验值总体偏小5.6 ± 1.8 nm。STEOM-DLPNO-CCSD/def2-TZVP结果与TD-ωB97XD的系统偏差为14.3 ± 1.0 nm。ωB97XD在长程极限具有100%的Hartree-Fock成分，有效避免了自相互作用误差，使其在大范围共轭体系的TD-DFT计算中表现出色。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/679_碳链电子光谱尺寸依赖性及碳炔预测_卡片.md
heading: Accuracy of wavelength calculation for the 11Σu+ ← X1Σg+ transition
content: The 11Σu+ ← X1Σg+ wavelength calculated by TD-ωB97XD/def2-TZVP agrees strikingly well with experimental observations, being overall smaller than the experimental values by 5.6 ± 1.8 nm. The STEOM-DLPNO-CCSD/def2-TZVP results show a systematic deviation of 14.3 ± 1.0 nm relative to TD-ωB97XD. ωB97XD has 100% Hartree-Fock exchange in the long-range limit, effectively avoiding self-interaction error, which makes it perform excellently in TD-DFT calculation of extended conjugated systems.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/679_碳链电子光谱尺寸依赖性及碳炔预测_卡片.md
heading: 振子强度随链长的变化趋势
content: 碳链11Σu+ ← X1Σg+跃迁的振子强度随链长增加而增大，计算值非常接近链中的n值。变化原因包括：(1)激发能随链长增加而降低，而激发能是振子强度的分母；(2)跃迁偶极矩随链长增加而增大，振子强度与跃迁偶极矩的模的平方成正比。相同计算水平下环[18]碳的振子强度(f = 3.02)远小于相近尺寸碳链。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/679_碳链电子光谱尺寸依赖性及碳炔预测_卡片.md
heading: Trend of oscillator strength with chain length
content: The oscillator strength of the 11Σu+ ← X1Σg+ transition of carbon chains increases with chain length, and the calculated values are very close to n, the number in the chain. The reasons for this variation include: (1) the excitation energy decreases with increasing chain length, and the excitation energy is the denominator of the oscillator strength; (2) the transition dipole moment increases with chain length, and the oscillator strength is proportional to the square of the magnitude of the transition dipole moment. At the same level of theory, the oscillator strength of cyclo[18]carbon (f = 3.02) is far smaller than that of a carbon chain of similar size.

file: 03-激发态与光谱/679_碳链电子光谱尺寸依赖性及碳炔预测_卡片.md
heading: 11Σu+ ← X1Σg+跃迁的轨道特征
content: 紫外范围内的强吸收主要由前线分子轨道HOMO-1/HOMO → LUMO/LUMO+1之间的电子激发产生，对应于典型的π-π*激发。由于分子对称性，HOMO-1/HOMO和LUMO/LUMO+1在能量上分别简并。随着链长增加，占据轨道能级升高和未占据轨道能级降低导致能隙显著减小，吸收带发生红移。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/679_碳链电子光谱尺寸依赖性及碳炔预测_卡片.md
heading: Orbital characteristics of the 11Σu+ ← X1Σg+ transition
content: The strong absorption in the ultraviolet range mainly arises from electronic excitations between HOMO-1/HOMO and LUMO/LUMO+1, the frontier molecular orbitals, corresponding to a typical π-π* excitation. Due to molecular symmetry, HOMO-1/HOMO and LUMO/LUMO+1 are each energy-degenerate. As the chain length increases, the occupied orbital levels rise and the unoccupied orbital levels lower, causing the energy gap to decrease significantly and the absorption band to red-shift.

heading: 11Σu+ ← X1Σg+跃迁的空穴-电子分析
content: 空穴-电子分析表明，最大吸收由π-π*跃迁引起，空穴和电子环绕分布在C-C键周围。在激发过程中，空穴和电子的分布集中在碳链中心而非沿整个链均匀分布，说明链中间的π电子共轭比两端强。高度重叠的空穴和电子分布解释了碳链具有巨大振子强度的原因。

file: 03-激发态与光谱/679_碳链电子光谱尺寸依赖性及碳炔预测_卡片.md
heading: Hole-electron analysis of the 11Σu+ ← X1Σg+ transition
content: Hole-electron analysis shows that the maximum absorption arising from π-π* transition, with the hole and electron distributed around the C-C bonds. During excitation, the distributions of the hole and electron are concentrated at the center of the carbon chain rather than uniformly along the entire chain, indicating that π electron conjugation in the middle of the chain is stronger than at the two ends. The highly overlapping hole and electron distributions explain why carbon chains have enormous oscillator strengths.

file: 05-分子动力学与力场/67_Amber_11_在_Tesla_C2050_上的_GPU_卡片.md
heading: Tesla C2050在Amber 11上的测试环境与模式
content: 测试在搭载2颗XEON 5520、16GB内存和2块Tesla C2050的服务器上进行，Amber 11的GPU加速版pmemd.cuda采用预编译的SPDP模式（单精度运算为主，双精度运算为辅）。SPDP模式在保持精度的前提下，利用Tesla单双精度相对运算能力以达到最佳性能。对比测试使用的是MKL+ifort编译的Amber10和内部版Amber11，在Q6600四核并行下运行Fedora7。

file: 05-分子动力学与力场/67_Amber_11_在_Tesla_C2050_上的_GPU_卡片.md
heading: Test environment and mode of Tesla C2050 on Amber 11
content: The tests were carried out on a server equipped with two XEON 5520 CPUs, 16GB of memory, and two Tesla C2050 cards; the GPU-accelerated pmemd.cuda of Amber 11 used the precompiled SPDP mode (mainly single precision, with double precision as a supplement). The SPDP mode exploits the relative single/double precision compute capability of Tesla to achieve the best performance while maintaining accuracy. The comparison tests used Amber 10 compiled with MKL+ifort and an internal build of Amber 11, running Fedora7 with Q6600 four-core parallelism.

heading: Cellulose大体系的显存瓶颈测试
content: Cellulose体系（408609 atoms）在C2050上运行时因显存不足无法启动，尽管C2050拥有3GB显存。相比之下，官网数据显示拥有4GB显存的C1060可正常运行该体系，而纯CPU四核并行仅需2GB内存即可运行。这表明CUDA加速对显存容量要求远高于CPU对内存的要求。

heading: VRAM bottleneck test with the Cellulose large system
content: The Cellulose system (408609 atoms) failed to start on the C2050 due to insufficient video memory, even though the C2050 has 3GB of video memory. In contrast, official data show that the C1060 with 4GB of video memory can run this system normally, while pure CPU four-core parallelism requires only 2GB of memory. This indicates that CUDA acceleration demands far higher video memory capacity than CPU computing requires memory.

file: 05-分子动力学与力场/67_Amber_11_在_Tesla_C2050_上的_GPU_卡片.md
heading: Tesla与GeForce显卡的架构差异
content: Fermi架构的Tesla（如C2050）相比同核心Geforce（如GTX 470）具有显存更大和双精度运算能力更强的优势。Tesla拥有专用双精度单元，性能达单精度的1/2；而Geforce专用双精度单元被屏蔽，依靠SFU运算，性能仅为单精度的1/8（GTX460为1/6）。双精度运算是运行pmemd.cuda的必要条件（SHAKE部分需要），即使使用全单精度的SPSP模式也是如此。

file: 05-分子动力学与力场/67_Amber_11_在_Tesla_C2050_上的_GPU_卡片.md
heading: Architectural differences between Tesla and GeForce cards
content: Fermi architecture Tesla cards (e.g., C2050) have advantages over same-core GeForce cards (e.g., GTX 470) in larger video memory and stronger double-precision compute capability. Tesla has dedicated double-precision units, achieving performance of 1/2 of single precision; whereas the dedicated double-precision units on GeForce are disabled and rely on SFU computation, delivering only 1/8 of single-precision performance (1/6 for the GTX460). Double precision required for running pmemd.cuda (needed by the SHAKE part), even when using the fully single-precision SPSP mode.

heading: 量化软件GPU加速的现状
content: 目前量化软件对GPU加速支持尚不成熟，TeraChem虽支持但使用人数少且收费，Firefly仅支持微扰等少数功能。Gaussian等主流软件短期内支持GPU加速的可能性较低。Tesla的双精度运算优势在量化领域暂未充分发挥，购买Tesla用于量化加速的时机尚未成熟。

file: 05-分子动力学与力场/67_Amber_11_在_Tesla_C2050_上的_GPU_卡片.md
heading: Current status of GPU acceleration in quantum chemistry software
content: At present, support for GPU acceleration in quantum chemistry software is still immature: TeraChem supports it but has few users and is paid software, while Firefly supports only a few features such as perturbation methods. The likelihood of mainstream software such as Gaussian supporting GPU acceleration in the short term is low. Tesla's double-precision advantage has not yet been fully exploited in the quantum chemistry field, so it is not yet the right time to buy Tesla cards for quantum chemistry acceleration.

heading: 针对Amber用户的显卡购买建议
content: 如果用于运行Amber且体系在十万个原子以内，个人用户无需购买昂贵的Tesla C2050，选择1.5千元左右的1G版GTX460（或2G版）即可满足需求。对于显存需求极大的体系（几十万原子），C1060（4G显存，约八千元）是比C2050更具性价比的选择。

heading: Graphics card purchase advice for Amber users

heading: 量化计算硬件采购的未来展望
content: 预计2年后主流量化程序的关键模块将支持GPU加速，届时Tesla价格可能下降且性能会增强。此外，基于x86架构的Intel Larrabee（如48核Atom）若能推出，因无需修改量化代码且价格合理，将具有很强竞争力。目前不建议急于购买Tesla用于量化加速。

heading: Future outlook on hardware procurement for quantum chemical calculation
content: It is expected that within 2 years the key modules of mainstream quantum chemistry programs will support GPU acceleration, by which time Tesla prices may drop and performance will improve. heading: Multi-task parallel GPU test in Amber 11
content: Amber 11 does not support single-task multi-GPU acceleration, but you can use the -gpu x option to invoke different CUDA devices and run multiple tasks simultaneously (x is the device ID; -1 by default invokes the device with the most VRAM). file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/681_Multiwfn绘制一维NICS曲线及积分分析_卡片.md
heading: NICS曲线积分与INICS指数
content: NICS曲线积分是指从环中心开始在垂直于环方向上对NICS_ZZ进行扫描并积分，该积分值被称为INICS指数。根据J. Phys. Chem. A, 123, 3922 (2019)和J. Phys. Chem. A, 126, 3433 (2022)的研究，INICS比考察个别点的NICS(0)ZZ或NICS(1)ZZ在衡量芳香性上更严格可靠。垂直穿越某环的NICS_ZZ曲线积分值为明显负值、接近0、明显正值分别说明相应的环表现芳香性、非芳香性和反芳香性。
domain: 波函数与电子结构分析

fm_title: 使用Multiwfn绘制一维NICS曲线并通过积分衡量芳香性

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/681_Multiwfn绘制一维NICS曲线及积分分析_卡片.md
heading: NICS curve integration and the INICS index
content: NICS curve integration refers to scanning and integrating NICS_ZZ along the direction perpendicular to the ring starting from the ring center; this integrated value is called the INICS index. According to studies in J. Phys. Chem. A, 123, 3922 (2019) and J. Phys. Chem. A, 126, 3433 (2022), INICS is more rigorous and reliable for measuring aromaticity than examining individual points such as NICS(0)ZZ or NICS(1)ZZ. If the integrated value of the NICS_ZZ curve crossing a ring perpendicularly is clearly negative, close to 0, or clearly positive, it indicates that the corresponding ring is aromatic, non-aromatic, or antiaromatic, respectively.

heading: 一维NICS曲线功能相比ICSS的优势
content: Multiwfn的一维NICS曲线计算功能相比ICSS格点数据计算具有明显优势：计算耗时少，笔记本即可完成；支持NICS分解成轨道贡献（如分离sigma和pi电子贡献），这解决了ICSS模块因Ghost原子多导致卡顿无法分解的技术限制；支持考察任意方向NICS分量，例如垂直于某个倾斜的环方向的分量。

heading: Advantages of the one-dimensional NICS curve feature over ICSS
content: The one-dimensional NICS curve calculation feature of Multiwfn has clear advantages over ICSS grid data calculation: it is computationally time-efficient and can be done on a laptop; it supports NICS decomposition into orbital contributions (e.g., separating sigma and pi electron contributions), which overcomes the technical limitation of the ICSS module that becomes unresponsive due to many ghost atoms and cannot perform decomposition; it supports examining NICS components along any direction, for example the component perpendicular to a tilted ring.

heading: One-dimensional NICS scan and integration procedure for benzene
content: To perform a one-dimensional NICS scan on benzene, enter the following in Multiwfn in sequence: examples\NICS_scan\benzene.pdb -> 25 -> 13 -> 2 -> 1-6 -> [Enter] -> 10 -> 10 -> 200 -> 1 -> examples\NICS_scan\template_NMR.gjf. heading: Calculating NICS orbital contribution via the Gaussian CSGT interface
content: To calculate the contribution of specific orbitals (e.g., pi orbitals) to the NICS, you need to use the CSGT interface of Gaussian. Write #p b3lyp/6-31+G* nmr=csgt iop(10/93=2) in the template file and append the orbital indices at the end (e.g., the pi orbitals of benzene are 17,20,21). Orbital indices can be obtained by viewing the fch file via Multiwfn main function 0, or determined automatically as described in 《在Multiwfn中单独考察pi电子结构特征》. Note that NMR=CSGT gives quantitatively different results from the default GIAO approach (e.g., NICS(1)ZZ of benzene are -27.13 and -28.76 ppm respectively), so they are not suitable for direct comparison.

heading: One-dimensional NICS scan settings for tilted or distorted rings
content: For tilted or distorted rings (such as the middle rings of [10]annulene-like systems in infinitene), if a two-sided scan is not possible, a one-sided scan can be set up. After defining the ring atoms in Multiwfn, set one end-point distance (e.g., 10 Angstrom below) and the other end-point distance (e.g., 0 Angstrom above); the number of points can be the default recommended value. If the Bq distribution direction is opposite to what is expected, exchange the upper and lower distances and regenerate the input file. The one-sided 10 Angstrom NICS scan of the middle ring of infinitene gives an integrated value of -96.46 ppm*Angstrom.

heading: NICS计算中基组的选择与弥散函数的影响
content: 是否带弥散函数对NICS曲线影响甚微，但计算耗时差异巨大。以无穷烯体系为例，6-31G*和6-31+G*在96核机上计算耗时分别为1m6s和4m37s，积分值分别为-96.46和-96.19 ppm*Angstrom。对于中性体系，计算NICS时没太大必要带弥散函数，若追求更好结果可用3-zeta档次基组。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/681_Multiwfn绘制一维NICS曲线及积分分析_卡片.md
heading: Basis set selection and the influence of diffuse functions in NICS calculation
content: Whether diffuse functions are included has little effect on the NICS curve, but the computational time differs enormously. Taking the infinitene system as an example, on a 96-core machine 6-31G* and 6-31+G* took 1m6s and 4m37s respectively, with integrated values of -96.46 and -96.19 ppm*Angstrom respectively. For neutral systems, there is not much need to include diffuse functions when computing NICS; if better results are desired, a triple-zeta level basis set may be used.

heading: 注意事项与文献引用建议
content: 使用Multiwfn产生NICS扫描的gjf文件后，建议放入GaussView检查Bq位置是否正确。相邻环产生的磁屏蔽效果会产生叠加，可能导致某环积分值偏高，此时应结合多中心键级或AV1245指数等其他指标综合判断芳香性。发表文章时请按Multiwfn启动后显示的信息恰当引用Multiwfn原文，并建议引用Chem. Eur. J., 30, e202403369 (2024)等应用了该方法的文章。

file: 02-波函数与电子结构分析/681_Multiwfn绘制一维NICS曲线及积分分析_卡片.md
heading: Notes and citation recommendations
content: After using Multiwfn to generate gjf files for NICS scanning, it is recommended to check in GaussView whether the Bq positions are correct. The magnetic shielding effects of adjacent rings can overlap, which may cause the integrated value of a given ring to be somewhat high; in that case, aromaticity should be judged comprehensively using the multicenter bond order, AV1245 index, and other related indices. When publishing a paper, please give proper citation of Multiwfn according to the information displayed after launching Multiwfn, and it is also recommended to cite papers that applied this method, such as Chem. Eur. J., 30, e202403369 (2024).

heading: Definition and advantages of the 2D NICS plane map plotting feature
content: Multiwfn has newly added a dedicated feature for plotting 2D NICS plane maps. Compared with computing 3D ICSS grid data and then interpolating, the new feature only requires a Gaussian calculation of the grid points on the mapping plane, reducing the computational time by one to two orders of magnitude. A Multiwfn version updated on 2023-Aug-7 or later is required. The Gaussian version used is G16 C.02.
