heading: Deficiencies of Mulliken charges for electrostatic potential analysis
content: poor reproduction of exact electrostatic potential by Mulliken charges; the deviation is typically 2~3 times that of electrostatic potential fitted charges. In addition, Mulliken charges suffer from problems such as cross terms being split equally with no physical meaning, results not converging with improving basis set quality, and absurd results easily arising with basis sets containing diffuse functions. Therefore, Mulliken charges not recommended for generating electrostatic potential, and the electrostatic potential computed by Molekel's built-in method can at best serve as a qualitative reference.

heading: 网络硬件对并行效率的影响
content: 多节点并行运算时CPU不能100%满载是正常的，性能受限于网络连接方式。将100M网换到1000M网会有好处，使用InfiniBand、Myrinet等专适于HPC的连接方式效果更佳，建议使用超五类或者六类网线。

file: 11-软件安装与环境/9_MPICH2多节点并行环境配置与SSH互信_卡片.md
heading: Effect of network hardware on parallel efficiency
content: During multi-node parallel computing it is normal for CPUs not to be 100% fully loaded, since performance is limited by the network connection. Upgrading from a 100M network to 1000M network is beneficial; using HPC-dedicated interconnects such as InfiniBand and Myrinet works even better, and Cat 5e or Cat 6 cables are recommended.

heading: 虚拟机环境下的并行运算性能
content: 在VMware Station 6下使用Fedora虚拟机进行双节点并行测试，这种方式可解决旧版本VMware不支持4核的问题。经测试，该方式速度可达实际Fedora中单节点4核速度的82%，实际运算速度等于单核的三倍。

heading: Parallel computing performance in virtual machine environments
content: Using a Fedora virtual machine under VMware Station 6 for two-node parallel testing, this approach solves the problem that older versions of VMware do not support 4 cores. Tests show this approach reaches 82% of the single-node 4-core speed of a real Fedora system, with actual computation speed equal to three times that of a single core.

heading: 虚拟机网络模式选择
content: 在VMware6中测试虚拟机的网络应使用vmnet1（host-only）方式，这样虚拟机之间以及主机之间可以互相访问并共享上网。此方式下网卡虚拟为82545EM千兆网卡，双虚拟机互连速度足够。

heading: Choosing the virtual machine network mode
content: Guest VM network tested in VMware6 should use vmnet1 (host-only) mode, so that virtual machines and the host can access each other and share Internet access. In this mode the network card is virtualized as an 82545EM gigabit NIC, and the interconnection speed between two VMs is sufficient.

heading: 虚拟机数据吞吐量监控误区
content: 在系统监视器中双虚拟机并行跑Amber的数据吞吐量往往显示只有十几兆，这是因为数据传输是瞬间进行的，持续几秒不传输。若将监控速度间隔调成0.25s，会发现峰值远高于100M网限制，1秒一次的检测会取平均值导致误判。

heading: Misconceptions about data throughput monitoring of virtual machines
content: The system monitor showing only ~10 MB/s throughput when running Amber in parallel on two VMs is because data transfer happens in instantaneous bursts, with no transfer for several seconds at a time. If you set the monitoring speed interval to 0.25 s, you will find peaks far higher than the 100M network limit; per-second detection averaging causing misjudgment.

heading: 在节点1上配置SSH免密登录
content: 在vmware1节点上运行`ssh-keygen -t rsa`并全程按回车使用默认设置生成RSA密钥。将公钥复制为授权密钥，执行`cd /root/.ssh`和`cp id_rsa.pub authorized_keys`，最后运行`ssh vmware1`并输入yes建立本机信任连接。

heading: Configuring SSH passwordless login on node 1
content: On the vmware1 node, run `ssh-keygen -t rsa` and press Enter throughout to use the default settings to generate an RSA key. Copy the public key as the authorized key by executing `cd /root/.ssh` and `cp id_rsa.pub authorized_keys`, then run `ssh vmware1` and enter yes to establish a local trust connection.

heading: 在节点2上同步SSH密钥
content: 在vmware2节点上运行`ssh-keygen -t rsa`并使用默认设置，将vmware1中/root/.ssh/目录下的所有文件复制覆盖到vmware2的/root/.ssh/目录。执行`chmod 700 /root/.ssh/*`设置文件权限，并运行`ssh vmware1`输入yes完成信任。

heading: Synchronizing SSH keys on node 2
content: On the vmware2 node, run `ssh-keygen -t rsa` with default settings, and copy all files from /root/.ssh/ on vmware1 to overwrite those in /root/.ssh/ on vmware2. Execute `chmod 700 /root/.ssh/*` to set file permissions, and run `ssh vmware1`, entering yes to complete the trust setup.

heading: Starting the MPD daemon
